Presenta señal inhomogénea predominantemente hiperintensa en Flair y T1 . Con probable componente hemático en periodo subagudo en su interior .
En la secuencias de eco de gradiente se observa hiper e hipointensa en relación a productos de degradación de la hemoglobina. Muestra signos de facilitación en la difusión con componente hiperintenso en la secuencia B 1000 en su interior .

translation:
Description and Findings

Posterior Fossa:
- Fourth Ventricle: Normal shape and size
- Brainstem: Unremarkable
- Cerebellum: Unremarkable

Midline: Unremarkable

Supratentorial Ventricular System: Normal shape and size

Cortical Sulci and Cisterns: Preserved

Cerebral Parenchyma: There is an intra-axial, cortico-subcortical, parieto-occipital lesion on the left side, appearing ovoid and slightly multilobulated. It shows an inhomogeneous signal, predominantly hyperintense on FLAIR and T1, with a probable subacute hemorrhagic component inside. On gradient echo sequences, it appears both hyperintense and hypointense, related to hemoglobin degradation products. There are signs of diffusion facilitation with a hyperintense component on the B1000 sequence inside. The described lesion shows irregular, predominantly peripheral enhancement. It measures approximately 32 mm anteroposteriorly, 31 mm in height, and 27 mm transversely. It is surrounded by hyperintense perilesional edema on FLAIR, causing effacement of adjacent cortical sulci and partial collapse of the occipital horn and atrium of the left lateral ventricle.

Imaging Comment:
Left cortico-subcortical parieto-occipital expansive lesion of probable secondary etiology. It presents with perilesional edema.

translation:

translation:
Posterior fossa:
-Fourth ventricle: Normal shape and size
-Brainstem: Unremarkable
-Cerebellum: Hyperintense lesion on Flair and T2 sequences and hypointense on T1 in the basal part of the right cerebellar hemisphere. It is markedly hyperintense on B 1000, with signal drop on ADC mapping, consistent with an acute ischemic lesion. In its anterior part, there is a hypointense area on gradient echo sequence related to the presence of blood degradation products.
Midline: Unremarkable
Supratentorial ventricular system: Normal shape and size
Cortical sulci and cisterns: Preserved
Cerebral parenchyma: Presence of multiple punctate hyperintense images in the deep white matter of both hemispheres with a chronic vascular appearance (Fazekas 2).

Angiographic sequence:
Intracranial internal carotid arteries: Unremarkable
Anterior cerebral arteries: Unremarkable, hypoplasia of the A1 segment of the left anterior cerebral artery (anatomical variant).
Middle cerebral arteries: Unremarkable
Vertebrobasilar system: No flow signal identified in the proximal V4 segment of the right vertebral artery. The distal segment of V4 shows flow signal with apparent retrograde filling.
The left vertebral artery shows preserved flow. Partial visualization of the right PICA. Preserved flow in the left PICA.
Left posterior communicating artery is patent.

Imaging comment:
Acute ischemic lesion in the right cerebellar hemisphere, with the presence of blood degradation products in its anterior part.
Absence of flow signal in the proximal V4 segment of the right vertebral artery.
Chronic vascular-appearing white matter changes.

Signos de HSA con vuelco intraventricular (Fischer 4).

translation:
Description and Findings:
There is spontaneous hyperdensity corresponding to blood content in the cerebellopontine, prebulbar, prepontine cisterns, and basal cisterns, as well as in both Sylvian fissures, cortical sulci of the convexity, and interhemispheric fissure. Signs of intraventricular extension and early dilation of the supratentorial ventricular system are observed. A small spontaneously hyperdense lesion with adjacent hypodensity in the right lateral frontal region is compatible with a hemorrhagic contusion. The rest of the parenchyma shows no densitometric alterations.

Imaging Comment:
Signs of subarachnoid hemorrhage with intraventricular extension (Fisher grade 4).

Description and Findings:
Right internal carotid artery: Unremarkable.
Right anterior cerebral artery: Unremarkable.
Right middle cerebral artery: Unremarkable.

Left internal carotid artery: Unremarkable.
Left anterior cerebral artery: Unremarkable.
Left middle cerebral artery: Unremarkable.

Left vertebral artery: Dominant. At the topography of the origin of the left PICA, there is an irregular saccular dilation approximately 8 mm in maximum diameter. The PICA arises from this dilation.
Basilar trunk: Unremarkable.
Right posterior cerebral artery: Unremarkable.
Left posterior cerebral artery: Unremarkable.

Imaging Comment:
Irregular saccular aneurysmal dilation at the origin of the left PICA in the vertebral artery, as previously described. Preserved flow in the remaining vascular structures of the circle of Willis.

report:
Descripción y hallazgos
Alineación: conservada 
Rectificación de la lordosis cervical.
Articulación atlanto-axoidea: conservada
Cuerpos vertebrales: de altura, morfología y señal conservadas
Incipientes osteofitos marginales.
Signos discretos de uncartrosis y artrosis inter-apofisaria posterior.
Espacios y discos intervertebrales:
C2-C3: altura y señal conservada sin evidencia de protrusiones ni hernias discales
C3-C4: Signos de deshidratación discal. Anulo discal global con desgarro anular mediano y lateral izquierdo.
C4-C5 : signos de deshidratación discal. Se se observa una hernia discal focal paramediana izquierda, que impronta la cara anterior del saco dural, colapsando el espacio subaracnoideo anterior y se pone en contacto con la cara ventral de la médula a este nivel.
C5-C6 : signos de deshidratación discal y disminución de altura del espacio intervertebral. A este nivel se observa una protrusión osteofito discal global a predominio paramediano y lateral izquierdo, que impronta la cara anterior del saco dural, colapsando el espacio subaracnoideo anterior y compromete el neuroforamen.
C6-C7 : signos de deshidratación discal y pinzamiento del espacio intervertebral. Cambios degenerativos tipo MODIC 2 de los platillos vertebrales. Presenta una protrusión osteofito-discal global que impronta en la cara anterior del saco dural, colapsando el espacio subaracnoideo anterior.
Diámetros del canal raquídeo: disminución del diámetro AP del saco dural secundario a las protrusiones y los cambios degenerativos.
Médula cervical: sin alteraciones
Tejidos blandos extraraquideos: sin alteraciones
translation:
Description and Findings

Alignment: preserved  
Loss of cervical lordosis.  
Atlanto-axial joint: preserved  
Vertebral bodies: height, morphology, and signal preserved  
Early marginal osteophytes.  
Mild signs of uncovertebral and posterior facet joint arthrosis.  

Intervertebral spaces and discs:  
C2-C3: height and signal preserved with no evidence of protrusions or disc herniations  
C3-C4: Signs of disc dehydration. Global disc annulus with median and left lateral annular tear.  
C4-C5: signs of disc dehydration. A focal left paramedian disc herniation is observed, impinging on the anterior aspect of the dural sac, collapsing the anterior subarachnoid space, and contacting the ventral surface of the spinal cord at this level.  
C5-C6: signs of disc dehydration and reduced intervertebral space height. At this level, there is a global disc-osteophyte protrusion predominantly left paramedian and lateral, impinging on the anterior aspect of the dural sac, collapsing the anterior subarachnoid space, and compromising the neuroforamen.  
C6-C7: signs of disc dehydration and narrowing of the intervertebral space. MODIC type 2 degenerative changes of the vertebral endplates. There is a global disc-osteophyte protrusion impinging on the anterior aspect of the dural sac, collapsing the anterior subarachnoid space.  

Spinal canal diameters: decreased AP diameter of the dural sac secondary to protrusions and degenerative changes.  
Cervical cord: unremarkable  
Extravertebral soft tissues: unremarkable

report:
Descripción y hallazgos
Alineación: Se observa persistencia de cambios postquirúrgicos con presencia de tornillos transpediculares L4 y L5 bilaterales.
Persistencia de material protésico intersomático L4-L5.
Secuela ósea de laminectomía de L4.
Espacios y discos intervertebrales:
L1-L2: altura y señal conservada sin evidencia de protrusiones ni hernias discales
L2-L3: Disminución de altura. Discreta retrolistesis de L2 con persistencia de una pseudo-protrusión osteofito discal global, sin signos francos de compresión radicular.
L3-L4: Se observa disminución en la altura de este espacio intervertebral y signos de deshidratación discal con protrusión osteofito discal global sin signos francos de compresión radicular.
L4-L5: Presencia de material protésico intersomático L4-L5. Persiste una sutil anterolistesis de L4 sobre L5.
Se observa marcada disminución de tamaño de la imagen líquida adyacente a la laminectomía de L4 en situación mediana y paramediana izquierda.
Regresión parcial de la alteración de señal de los músculos paraespinales a nivel de la lodge quirúrgica.
L5-S1: Se observa disminución en la altura de este espacio intervertebral con cambios degenerativos de los platillos vertebrales tipo modic 1 y signos de deshidratación discal. Persistencia de una protrusión osteofito discal global a predominio derecho.
Cono medular: respetado
Porción visible del retroperitoneo y pelvis: sin alteraciones.
translation:
Description and Findings

Alignment: There are persistent post-surgical changes with the presence of bilateral L4 and L5 transpedicular screws. There is also persistent interbody prosthetic material at L4-L5. Bone sequelae from L4 laminectomy are noted.

Intervertebral Spaces and Discs:
- L1-L2: Height and signal are preserved with no evidence of disc protrusions or herniations.
- L2-L3: Decreased height. Mild retrolisthesis of L2 with persistent global disc osteophyte pseudo-protrusion, without clear signs of nerve root compression.
- L3-L4: Decreased height of this intervertebral space and signs of disc dehydration with global disc osteophyte protrusion, without clear signs of nerve root compression.
- L4-L5: Presence of interbody prosthetic material at L4-L5. A subtle anterolisthesis of L4 over L5 persists. There is a marked reduction in the size of the fluid image adjacent to the L4 laminectomy in the median and left paramedian position. Partial regression of the signal alteration in the paraspinal muscles at the surgical site is observed.
- L5-S1: Decreased height of this intervertebral space with Modic type 1 degenerative changes of the vertebral endplates and signs of disc dehydration. Persistent global disc osteophyte protrusion with right-sided predominance.

Conus Medullaris: Intact

Visible Portion of the Retroperitoneum and Pelvis: Unremarkable.

Fosa posterior:
Persistencia del aspecto hipoplásico de tronco cerebral, vermis y hemisferios cerebelosos con verticalización del tentorio.Agenesia de cuerpo calloso.Persistencia del catéter de derivación ventricular sin modificaciones en relación a estudio previo con mínima disminución de tamaño del sistema ventricular supratentorial. translation:
Posterior fossa:  
There is persistent hypoplastic appearance of the brainstem, vermis, and cerebellar hemispheres with verticalization of the tentorium. Agenesis of the corpus callosum is noted. - Fourth Ventricle: Normal shape and size

These cause generalized effacement of cortical sulci and partial collapse of the lateral ventricles. 

Signs of ventricular shift are noted at the level of the body of the left lateral ventricle and both occipital horns.

There is spontaneous hyperdensity at the level of the falx cerebri related to a subdural hematoma measuring 7 mm in thickness.

On bone window, multiple fracture lines are observed bilaterally in the frontal region, involving the floor of both frontal sinuses and the roof of both orbits, with segments displaced caudally on the right side, causing compression of the eyeball.

A fracture line is noted in the left superior frontal region extending to involve the lateral wall of the orbit and ipsilateral anterior mastoid air cells, without involvement of the middle or inner ear.

Bilateral parietal fracture lines are present.

There is evidence of an entry and exit bullet trajectory in the right frontal and left fronto-parietal regions, with displaced bone fragments at this level. Underlying these, there are laminar subdural collections measuring 5 mm on the left and 4 mm on the right.

Occupation of the left middle ear and mastoid air cells is observed.

Signs of hemosinus are present in the frontal sinuses and ethmoid air cells.

translation:
Description and Findings

Posterior Fossa:
- Cerebellum: There is an intraparenchymal space-occupying lesion in the right cerebellar hemisphere. The lesion is heterogeneous, predominantly hypointense on FLAIR and T1, with intense enhancement on post-gadolinium series. It presents some small pseudo-cystic areas that are hyperintense on T2 and FLAIR and hypointense on T1 without enhancement. It measures approximately 38 x 25 mm in its largest axial diameter, 36 mm in the anteroposterior direction, and 27 mm in height. The lesion is surrounded by perilesional vasogenic edema that is hyperintense on T2 and FLAIR. The lesion exerts a mild mass effect on the fourth ventricle and causes slight caudal displacement of the right cerebellar tonsil into the foramen magnum. Two small nodular enhancement foci are observed at the right posterobasal level measuring 5 mm and at the right anterosuperior cerebellar level measuring 4 mm. The rest of the cerebellum shows no significant abnormalities.

- Midline: Unremarkable
- Supratentorial Ventricular System: Normal shape and size
- Cortical Sulci and Cisterns: Preserved
- Cerebral Parenchyma: Normal morphology and signal intensity in both gray and white matter
In the post-gadolinium series, no other pathological parenchymal or meningeal enhancements are observed.

Imaging Comment:
Right cerebellar intraparenchymal lesion with a heterogeneous appearance, showing intense post-contrast enhancement and surrounded by perilesional vasogenic edema. It exerts a mild mass effect on the fourth ventricle and causes caudal displacement of the right cerebellar tonsil. Small satellite enhancing nodules in the right cerebellar hemisphere.

Descripción y hallazgos
Se observa la presencia de una voluminosa lesión expansiva en región occipitoparietal paramediana izquierda que involucra parte del esplenio del cuerpo calloso. Dicha lesión es hiperintensa en secuencias T2 y Flair e hipointensa en T1 y muestra hipointensidad secuencia eco de gradiente en relación a la presencia de productos de degradación hemáticos. 
Presenta realce intenso y heterogéneo a predominio periférico en la serie postcontraste, con área necrótica central. 
Mide aproximadamente 82 mm anteroposterior por 43 mm transversal por 66 mm de altura. 
En la secuencia de difusión se aprecia hiperintensidad periférica en B 1000 con disminución de la señal en la cartografía de ADC en relación a mayor celularidad.
Se realizó secuencia de perfusión que mostró aumento de volumen sanguíneo cerebral relativo en la periferia de la misma, en particular en su porción medial.
Presenta efecto de masa evidenciado por colapso del asta occipital del ventrículo lateral izquierdo y del atrio ventricular izquierdo, así como de surcos corticales occipito parietales del lado izquierdo. 
Se aprecia desplazamiento de la línea media hacia la derecha (5 mm).
El resto del sistema ventricular es ligeramente amplio, en particular las prolongaciones temporales de los ventrículos laterales a predominio izquierdo.
Acentuación de la amplitud de los restantes surcos corticales y cisternas.Imágenes puntiformes hiperintensas en sustancia blanca periventricular y profunda de probable etiología vascular crónica.

translation:
Description and Findings  
A large expansive lesion is observed in the left paramedian occipitoparietal region, involving part of the splenium of the corpus callosum. This lesion appears hyperintense on T2 and FLAIR sequences and hypointense on T1, with hypointensity on gradient echo sequences related to the presence of blood degradation products.  
It shows intense and heterogeneous enhancement, predominantly peripheral, on post-contrast series, with a central necrotic area.  
The lesion measures approximately 82 mm anteroposteriorly, 43 mm transversely, and 66 mm in height.  
On diffusion sequence, there is peripheral hyperintensity on B 1000 with decreased signal on ADC mapping, indicating increased cellularity.  
Perfusion sequence was performed, showing increased relative cerebral blood volume at the periphery, particularly in its medial portion.  
There is a mass effect evidenced by the collapse of the occipital horn of the left lateral ventricle and the left ventricular atrium, as well as the occipitoparietal cortical sulci on the left side.  
There is a 5 mm shift of the midline to the right.

Anterior Cerebral Arteries: Unremarkable
Middle Cerebral Arteries: Unremarkable
Vertebrobasilar System: Unremarkable, with fetal origin of the right posterior cerebral artery and a patent right posterior communicating artery.

Imaging Comment:
Expansive lesion with characteristics suggestive of a probable meningioma in the left cerebellopontine cistern, as previously described. The rest of the examination and the angiographic sequence did not reveal any significant abnormalities.

translation:
Indication: Malunion of the right femoral neck.  
Imaging Technician:  
Secretary:  

MRI OF THE PELVIS  

Technique:  
Axial T1, coronal T1, axial T2, coronal T2, and coronal STIR sequences were performed without contrast injection.  

Results  

There is evidence of shortening of the left femoral neck with a heterogeneous appearance, showing hyperintensity on T1, T2, and STIR sequences.  
There is posteromedial slippage of the left femoral head, appearing hyperintense on STIR, and thinned, measuring 15mm compared to 26mm on the right side.  
This is associated with a reduction of the left cervico-femoral angle, measured at 91° compared to 133° on the right.  
The sphericity of the left femoral head is preserved.  
An osteophyte is noted on the left greater trochanter.  
No intra-articular effusion is present.  
On the right, the sphericity of the femoral head is preserved.  
No acetabular abnormalities.  
No joint effusion.  
No abnormalities of the sacroiliac and symphyseal joints.  

CONCLUSION  

MRI findings suggest shortening of the left femoral neck with heterogeneous signal and posteromedial epiphyseal slippage, along with a reduction of the cervico-femoral angle: these features suggest possible post-traumatic sequelae of the left femoral neck or epiphyseal remodeling.  
No abnormalities in the hip joints.

MRI findings suggest a signal anomaly in the sacral segments, vertebral bodies L3 and L5, and the right femoral head, consistent with bone metastases. 
No abnormalities in the soft tissues or other lumbar spondylodiscal and osteoarticular structures of the pelvis.

Dilatation du système ventriculaire notamment des ventricules latéraux avec aspect arrondi de la corne majorée au niveau des cornes occipitales et dilatation du V3 mesurant 09mm.

translation:
Indication: Right-sided hemiparesis with brachio-facial predominance  
Imaging Technician:  
Secretary:  

BRAIN MRI  

Technique:  
Diffusion sequences, T1, T2, and FLAIR sequences, and a 3D TOF sequence in the axial plane were performed with gadolinium injection.  

Result  

** Supratentorial Level  

There is a FLAIR, T2, diffusion hyperintense area in the left fronto-parietal cortico-subcortical region involving the lenticular nucleus, caudate nucleus, and ipsilateral internal capsule, exerting a slight mass effect on the ipsilateral lateral ventricle.  
This lesion area is isointense on T1 and T2* and slightly displaces the falx structure to the right by 3mm.  
Dilation of the ventricular system, particularly the lateral ventricles, with a rounded appearance of the occipital horns and dilation of the third ventricle measuring 9mm.  
Diffuse widening of cortical sulci.  
No pathological pericerebral fluid collection.

The fourth ventricle has a normal high morphology.  
No abnormality of the cisterna magna.  
The prepontine cisterns are without abnormality.  
Sinus cavities of the face and skull base are without abnormalities.  

CONCLUSION  

MRI appearance of an acute ischemic stroke in the superficial and deep territory of the left middle and anterior cerebral arteries, with mass effect on the left lateral ventricle without signs of brain herniation.  
Chronic adult hydrocephalus associated with diffuse cortical atrophy.  
The posterior fossa is normal.  
Sinus cavities of the face and skull base are without abnormalities.

translation:
Indication: Evaluation for cervical spinal cord compression syndrome.

CERVICAL SPINE MRI

Technique:
Sagittal T1, T2, and axial 3D BASG sequences were performed without gadolinium contrast.

Findings:
On sagittal sequences:
- Mild reversal of cervical lordosis is observed.
- Grade I pancake-like compression of C5 and C6 is noted.
- Presence of anterior vertebral body osteophytes from C4 to C6.
- Presence of posterior vertebral body osteophytes at C5 and C6.
- Posterior disc protrusion at C5-C6 impacting the adjacent spinal cord.
- Disc degeneration is indicated by hypointense appearance on T2-weighted images.
- No signal abnormality of the spinal cord.

On axial sequences:

**At C2-C3 and C3-C4:
- No global or focal disc protrusion suggestive of a disc herniation.
- No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No foraminal stenosis.
- Normal anteroposterior canal dimensions.

**At C4-C5:
- No global or focal disc protrusion.
- No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No foraminal stenosis.
- Normal anteroposterior canal dimensions.

**At C5-C6:
- Posterior median hard disc herniation in conflict with the adjacent spinal cord and C6 ventral roots.
- No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No foraminal stenosis.

**At C6-C7:
- No global or focal disc protrusion.
- No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No foraminal stenosis.

CONCLUSION:
MRI evidence of a subligamentous median hard disc herniation at C5-C6 in conflict with the adjacent spinal cord and C6 ventral roots, without any identified spinal cord distress at this time.
Mild reversal of cervical lordosis.
Degenerative spondylotic changes from C3 to C6.

MRI OF THE CERVICAL SPINE  

Technique:  
Sagittal T1, T2, and axial 3D BASG sequences were performed without gadolinium injection.  

Results:  
On sagittal sequences:  
There is a straightening of the cervical spine.  
No signal or height abnormalities of the vertebral bodies.  
Disc degeneration is noted by a hypointense appearance of the discs on T2.  
There is a posterior subligamentous disc protrusion observed at C3-C4 and C6-C7.  
A slight signal anomaly of the spinal cord at C3-C4, suggestive of edema.  

On axial sequences:  

**At C2-C3:**  
No global or focal disc protrusion suggestive of a disc herniation.  
No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No foraminal abnormalities.  

**At C3-C4:**  
Median disc herniation in conflict with the spinal cord at this level.  

**At C4-C5:**  
Minimal median disc herniation not in conflict with the spinal cord at this level.  

**At C5-C6:**  
No global or focal disc protrusion suggestive of a disc herniation.  
No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No foraminal abnormalities.  

**At C6-C7:**  
Median disc herniation partially contacting the spinal cord at this level.  
No global or focal disc protrusion.  
No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No foraminal abnormalities.  

Elsewhere, no abnormalities are noted on the myelographic sequences.  

CONCLUSION:  
MRI evidence of subligamentous median disc herniation observed at C3-C4, C4-C5, and C6-C7, with conflict with the spinal cord at C3-C4 and C5-C6, with early signs of distress at C3-C4.  
No foraminal abnormalities.

translation:

translation:
Indication: Evaluation for collateral ligament injuries.

LEFT ANKLE MRI

Technique:
Sequences were performed in three planes using proton density Fat Sat, followed by axial T1, sagittal T2, and coronal Dixon sequences.

Findings

**Osseous and Articular Structures

The distal tibiofibular joint appears normal with no focal or diffuse signal abnormalities identified. No abnormalities are noted in the talocalcaneal or potentially the anterior tarsal bones. The examined joints show no irregularities of the articular surfaces. There is a bony outgrowth on the posterior margin of the talus measuring approximately 9mm.

**Menisco-ligamentous and Tendinous Structures

No lesions are observed affecting the tendons of the peroneus longus and brevis, or potentially the flexor hallucis longus and brevis ligaments. The plantar fascia appears normal. The Achilles tendon is intact. A minimal intra-articular tibio-talar effusion is noted.

CONCLUSION

MRI evidence of a posterior talar bony outgrowth with slight impingement on the Cagger's fat pad. No abnormalities of the tibio-talar joint or the various articular structures of the posterior tarsus. No lesions of the tendinous and ligamentous structures of the ankle. Minimal intra-articular tibio-talar effusion.

report:
Indication : Exploration d’une tuméfaction chronique de la cheville gauche.
Technicien d’Imagerie : 	
Secrétaire : 

IRM / ECHO DE LA CHEVILLE GAUCHE

Technique : 
On réalise une séquence en densité de proton dans les trois plans puis les séquences Dixon et une séquence STIR dans le plan sagittal centré sur la cheville. Cet examen à été corréler avec l’échographie.

Résultat

Sur le plan tendino-ligamentaire

On note un aspect très discrètement épaissi, à structure peu remaniée du tendon fléchisseur commun des orteils au niveau de la région retro malléolaire médiale et tibiale.
Il s’en suit une minime collection liquidienne péri tendineuse.
Pas d’anomalie notée au niveau du tendon propre du hallux.
Pas d’anomalie du tendon du court et du long tendon fibulaire.
Pas d’anomalie observée au niveau des différents réticulums.
Au niveau du tendon d’Achille, on retrouve un discret remaniement à l’exception  de ce tendon sur le calcanéus avec un foyer en hypersignal.
Echographiquement, on identifie de discret foyer de calcification. 

Sur le plan ostéo-articulaire

On note une minime collection intra articulaire tibio tarsienne sans anomalie lésionnelle observée au niveau des différentes structures en place notamment l’extrémité inférieure tibiale et fibulaire, et de la structure talo calcanéenne.
Au plan veineux
On ne note pas d’image de thrombose veineuse pouvant intéresser les régions superficielles et ou profondes. 
 
CONCLUSION

Aspect IRM / ECHO d’une  tendinite chronique intéressant les fléchisseurs communs des orteils au niveau de la région retro malléolaire médiale et tibiale gauche avec une minime collection liquidienne péri tendineuse.
Minime collection intra articulaire tibio tarsienne.
Très discrète tendinite calcifiante du tendon d’Achille à son insertion au niveau du calcanéus.
Absence d’anomalie des différentes structures veineuses de la cheville.
translation:
Indication: Evaluation of a chronic swelling in the left ankle.  
Imaging Technician:  
Secretary:  

MRI / ULTRASOUND OF THE LEFT ANKLE  

Technique:  
A proton density sequence was performed in three planes, followed by Dixon sequences and a STIR sequence in the sagittal plane centered on the ankle. This examination was correlated with ultrasound findings.  

Findings  

Tendinous and Ligamentous Structures  

There is a very slight thickening with minimal structural changes of the flexor digitorum longus tendon in the medial and tibial retro-malleolar region. This is accompanied by a minimal peritendinous fluid collection.  
No abnormalities are noted in the flexor hallucis longus tendon.  
No abnormalities in the peroneus brevis and longus tendons.  
No abnormalities observed in the various retinacula.  
Regarding the Achilles tendon, there is a slight alteration at its insertion on the calcaneus with a hyperintense signal focus.  
Ultrasound reveals small foci of calcification.  

Osseous and Articular Structures  

There is a minimal intra-articular tibio-talar fluid collection without any observed lesions in the surrounding structures, including the distal tibia and fibula, and the talo-calcaneal structure.  

Venous Structures  

No evidence of venous thrombosis affecting the superficial or deep regions.  

CONCLUSION  

MRI / Ultrasound findings suggest chronic tendinitis involving the flexor digitorum longus tendons in the medial and tibial retro-malleolar region of the left ankle, with a minimal peritendinous fluid collection.  
Minimal intra-articular tibio-talar fluid collection.  
Very mild calcific tendinitis of the Achilles tendon at its insertion on the calcaneus.  
No abnormalities in the venous structures of the ankle.

translation:
Indication: Probable rotator cuff lesion.

LEFT SHOULDER MRI

Technique: 
Coronal, axial, and sagittal T2 sequences were performed, followed by sagittal T1 proton density Fat Sat.

Results

**Musculo-tendinous and ligamentous findings

The supraspinatus tendon appears thickened with a slight hyperintense signal on the T2 Fat Sat sequence, but no tear is noted. There is no signal abnormality or lesion in the ligamentous structures, including the infraspinatus, subscapularis, and long head of the biceps tendons. No perilesional fluid collection is observed.

**Osseous and articular findings

The femoral head maintains its sphericity. No signal abnormalities are noted in the various bony structures. The glenoid labrum is intact.

CONCLUSION

MRI findings are consistent with left supraspinatus tendinitis without evidence of a tear. No abnormalities are noted in the other tendinous structures of the rotator cuff. The glenoid labrum is normal.

translation:
Indication: Chronic left shoulder pain.  
Imaging Technician:  
Secretary:  

MRI OF THE LEFT SHOULDER  

Technique:  
Coronal, axial, and sagittal T2 sequences were performed, followed by sagittal T1 proton density Fat Sat.  

Results

There is evidence of thickening with a remodeled appearance at the insertion of the supraspinatus tendon, measuring approximately 15mm x 10mm.

report:

Techniciens d’Imagerie : 
Secrétaire : 

IRM DE L’EPAULE  GAUCHE

Technique : 
On réalise des séquences T1en densité de proton Fat Sat coronale, sagittale, axiale puis  T1 coronale avec injection de gadolinium.

Résultat
Sur le plan ostéo articulaire
Il est objectivé la présence d’une formation lacunaire métaphyso épiphysaire proximale humérale gauche mesurée à 23,9mm x 20mm x 21mm dont la matrice se présente en hypersignal T2, hyposignal T1, non rehaussée après injection du produit de contraste.
Il est objectivé une rupture corticale au niveau de la face antérieure de la lésion avec présence d’une collection liquidienne en sous deltoïdienne de minime abondance.
On note une conservation de la sphéricité céphalique humérale.
Présence d’une apposition périostée para lésionnelle.
Pas d’anomalie des autres structures osseuses notamment de la clavicule et de la scapula. 

Sur le plan tendino-musculaire 
On note la présence d’une collection liquidienne sous deltoïdienne sans anomalie de signal du muscle 
On ne note pas d’anomalie des autres structures musculaires notamment de la coiffe des rotateurs.
Pas d’anomalie de signal des autres structures musculaires de l’épaule gauche.
CONCLUSION

Aspect IRM d’une lésion lacunaire métaphyso épiphysaire proximale humérale gauche rapidement évolutive responsable d’une rupture corticale avec présence d’une collection liquidienne sous deltoïdienne de minime abondance.
Pas d’envahissement des autres structures musculo-tendineuses de l’épaule.
Pas d’anomalie de la scapula ni de la clavicule.
translation:
Indication: Bone tumor with soft tissue involvement.  
Imaging Technicians:  
Secretary:  

MRI OF THE LEFT SHOULDER  

Technique:  
Proton density T1 sequences with Fat Sat in coronal, sagittal, and axial planes, followed by coronal T1 with gadolinium contrast injection.

Findings  
Osteoarticular findings:  
A lytic lesion is identified in the proximal metaphyseal-epiphyseal region of the left humerus, measuring 23.9mm x 20mm x 21mm. The lesion matrix shows T2 hyperintensity, T1 hypointensity, and does not enhance post-contrast.  
There is cortical breach on the anterior aspect of the lesion with a small subdeltoid fluid collection.  
The humeral head maintains its spherical shape.  
There is periosteal reaction adjacent to the lesion.  
No abnormalities are noted in other bony structures, including the clavicle and scapula.  

Tendinous-muscular findings:  
A subdeltoid fluid collection is present without any signal abnormality in the muscle.  
No abnormalities are noted in other muscular structures, including the rotator cuff.  
No signal abnormalities in other muscular structures of the left shoulder.  

CONCLUSION  

MRI appearance of a rapidly evolving lytic lesion in the proximal metaphyseal-epiphyseal region of the left humerus, causing cortical breach with a small subdeltoid fluid collection.  
No involvement of other musculo-tendinous structures of the shoulder.  
No abnormalities in the scapula or clavicle.

report:

Techniciens d’Imagerie: 
Secrétaire : 

IRM DU  GENOU GAUCHE 

Technique : 
On réalise une séquence dans les trois plans en Fat Sat densité de proton, puis des séquences T1 axiale, T2 sagittale et coronale Dixon.

Résultat

**Sur le plan ménisco-ligamentaire
L’analyse des différentes séquences objective une lésion de fissure horizontale allant jusqu’à l’articulation classée type III de Stoller et Crues de la corne postérieure du ménisque médial.
Rupture partielle du ligament croisé antérieur.
Pas d’image de fissure au niveau des autres structures méniscales.
Pas d’anomalie du ligament croisé postérieur.
Les tendons des muscles quadricipital et les ligaments patellaires sont également sans anomalies.
Pas d’anomalie des ligaments collatéraux.

**Sur le plan ostéo-articulaire
Minéralisation osseuse satisfaisante.
Absence d’anomalie de signal des différentes structures osseuses du genou, outre quelques ilots condensants intéressant l’extrémité distale du fémur.
Pas de pincement de l’interligne articulaire fémoro tibial et fémoro patellaire.
Absence d’ostéophyte des condyles fémoraux, des plateaux tibiaux et des extrémités de la patella.
Pas d’hypertrophie des épines tibiales.
Sub luxation de l’interligne fémoro patellaire d’environ 1cm.
Epanchement liquidien péri articulaire de minime abondance.
Formation kystique sous méniscale antérieure d’environ 6mm de grand axe.

CONCLUSION

	
Argument IRM d’une rupture partielle du ligament croisé antérieur associée à une fissure horizontale de type III de Stoller et Crues de la corne postérieure du ménisque médial gauche.
Sub luxation de l’interligne fémoro patellaire d’environ 1cm associée à un épanchement liquidien intra articulaire de minime abondance.
Kyste sous méniscal antérieur d’environ 6mm de grand axe.
Intégrité du ligament croisé postérieur.
Pas d’anomalie des tendons du muscle quadricipital, patellaire et des muscles collatéraux.
translation:
Indication: ACL Tear?

LEFT KNEE MRI

Technique:
Sequences were performed in three planes using proton density Fat Sat, followed by axial T1, sagittal T2, and coronal Dixon sequences.

Findings

**Menisco-ligamentous assessment
The analysis of the various sequences reveals a horizontal fissure lesion extending to the joint, classified as a type III Stoller and Crues lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
Partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
No fissure observed in other meniscal structures.
No abnormalities of the posterior cruciate ligament.
The quadriceps tendon and patellar ligaments are also without abnormalities.
No abnormalities of the collateral ligaments.

**Osteo-articular assessment
Satisfactory bone mineralization.
No signal abnormalities in the various bony structures of the knee, except for a few sclerotic foci affecting the distal end of the femur.
No narrowing of the femorotibial and femoropatellar joint spaces.
No osteophytes on the femoral condyles, tibial plateaus, or patellar edges.
No hypertrophy of the tibial spines.
Subluxation of the femoropatellar joint space by approximately 1 cm.
Minimal periarticular fluid effusion.
Anterior sub-meniscal cyst measuring approximately 6 mm in its longest axis.

CONCLUSION

MRI evidence of a partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament associated with a type III Stoller and Crues horizontal fissure of the posterior horn of the left medial meniscus.
Subluxation of the femoropatellar joint space by approximately 1 cm associated with minimal intra-articular fluid effusion.
Anterior sub-meniscal cyst measuring approximately 6 mm in its longest axis.
Intact posterior cruciate ligament.
No abnormalities of the quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, and collateral ligaments.

translation:
Indication: Left knee instability.

LEFT KNEE MRI

Technique:
Sequences were performed in three planes using proton density Fat Sat, followed by axial T1, sagittal T2, and coronal Dixon sequences.

Findings

**Osseous and Articular Structures

A sub-centimeter bone fragment is noted in the lateral soft tissues adjacent to the tibia of the knee. No abnormalities are observed in the femorotibial and femoropatellar joint spaces. The articular cartilage appears normal.

**Meniscal and Ligamentous Structures

There is evidence of remodeling of the lateral collateral ligament, with a signal anomaly at its juxta-tibial segment, appearing as a mild hyperintensity on Fat Sat. A type II Stoller and Crue fissure lesion is present in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. No abnormalities are noted in the central pivot ligaments or the medial collateral ligament. The quadriceps tendons and patellar ligaments are also unremarkable.

CONCLUSION

MRI findings suggest a strain of the lateral collateral ligament of the left knee. Type II Stoller and Crue fissure lesion of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. No other ligamentous or osseous-articular abnormalities are present in the left knee.

translation:

No abnormalities in the central pivot ligaments or other ligamentous structures.
Moderate intra- and peri-articular fluid effusion.
Degenerative changes in the femoropatellar joint.

Résultat
**Sur le plan ménisco-ligamentaire
Il est observé la présence de fissure horizontale très significative de type III aboutissant à l’articulation de la corne postérieure du ménisque latéral et de type II de façon horizontale de la corne antérieure du ménisque latéral.
 On ne note pas d’anomalie ligamentaire du pivot  central et des ligaments collatéraux.
Pas d’anomalie du tendon patellaire et du ligament patellaire.
**Sur le plan ostéo-articulaire 
Il est mis en évidence une solution de continuité uni corticale des bords inférieurs de la patella.
 Il n’est pas noté d’anomalie des bords de l’extrémité inférieure du fémur et supérieur de la fibula et du tibia.
 Présence d’une collection liquidienne de minime abondance intra articulaire.
CONCLUSION
	
Argument IRM de lésion de fissure de type III de Stoller et Crues de la corne postérieure du ménisque latéral et de type II de la corne antérieure du ménisque latéralgauche avec une collection liquidienne intra articulaire de moyenne abondance intra articulaire associée à une hémarthrose réactionnelle de minime abondance.
Fracture uni corticale du bord inférieur de la patella.
Absence d’anomalie des structures ligamentaires notamment croisée antérieure et postérieure, des ligaments collatéraux et patellaires.
translation:
Indication: Contusion and partial tear of the right medial collateral ligament on knee ultrasound + fluid effusion

LEFT KNEE MRI

Technique:
Sequences were performed in three planes using proton density Fat Sat, followed by axial T1, sagittal T2, and coronal Dixon sequences.

Results
**Menisco-ligamentous findings
There is a significant horizontal tear, classified as type III, extending to the joint surface of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus, and a type II horizontal tear of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
No abnormalities are noted in the central pivot ligaments or the collateral ligaments.
The patellar tendon and patellar ligament appear normal.
**Osteo-articular findings
There is a unicortical fracture at the inferior margin of the patella.
No abnormalities are noted at the margins of the distal femur, proximal fibula, or tibia.
There is a small amount of intra-articular fluid collection.

CONCLUSION

MRI findings indicate a type III Stoller and Crues tear of the posterior horn of the left lateral meniscus and a type II tear of the anterior horn of the left lateral meniscus, with a moderate intra-articular fluid collection associated with minimal reactive hemarthrosis.
Unicortical fracture of the inferior margin of the patella.
No abnormalities in the ligamentous structures, including the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, collateral ligaments, and patellar ligaments.

report:
Indication : Volumineuse masse à cheval sur les segments II et III 
Technicien d’Imagerie : 
Secrétaire : 

IRM HEPATIQUE

Technique
On réalise des séquences axiales, coronale T1, T2 puis une séquence dynamique suivie d’une séquence T1 gadolinium.

Résultat
L’analyse des différents séquences objective un foie de taille normale mesuré à 14cm de FLESH, de contour peu régulier et de structure hétérogène remaniée par la présence d’une formation tissulaire au contour bien limité se présentant en hyposignal hétérogène T1, hypersignal hétérogène T2 de rehaussement de façon périphérique à 5mm après injection du produit de contraste, en monte après 10min et s’homogénéisant après 15mmin. Cette formation siège au niveau du segment II et III.
La veine porte est perméable et de calibre normal.
Pas d’anomalie des voies biliaires intra hépatiques.
La vésicule biliaire est  normale.
Le pancréas est de taille normale sans anomalie de signale objectiver.
La rate est de taille et de morphostructure normale.
Les reins sont de taille normale conservant leurs fonctions physiologiques sans formation lithiasique ni de prise de contraste intra parenchymateuse anormale.
Absence d’ascite ni d’adénopathie profonde.
CONCLUSION

Aspect IRM d’une formation tissulaire bien limitée au contour net, se présentant en hyposignal hétérogène T1, hyper signal hétérogène T2 et de rehaussement annulaire en 5min après injection de de gadolinium, en monte après 10min et s’homogénéisant après 15min : aspect faisant évoquer à priori un angiome hépatique du segment II et III.
Morphostructure bilio pancréatique et spléno rénale sans anomalie.
Absence d’ascite ni d’adénomégalie profonde.
translation:
Indication: Large mass straddling segments II and III  
Imaging Technician:  
Secretary:  

LIVER MRI

Technique  
Axial and coronal T1, T2 sequences were performed, followed by a dynamic sequence and a T1 gadolinium sequence.

Result  
Analysis of the various sequences reveals a liver of normal size, measuring 14 cm in FLESH, with slightly irregular contours and a heterogeneous structure altered by the presence of a well-defined tissue formation. This formation appears as heterogeneous T1 hypointense, heterogeneous T2 hyperintense with peripheral enhancement 5 minutes after contrast injection, increasing after 10 minutes and becoming homogeneous after 15 minutes. This formation is located in segments II and III.  
The portal vein is patent and of normal caliber.  
No abnormalities in the intrahepatic bile ducts.  
The gallbladder is normal.  
The pancreas is of normal size with no signal abnormalities observed.  
The spleen is of normal size and morphostructure.  
The kidneys are of normal size, maintaining their physiological functions without lithiasis formation or abnormal intraparenchymal contrast enhancement.  
No ascites or deep lymphadenopathy.

CONCLUSION

MRI appearance of a well-defined tissue formation with clear margins, presenting as heterogeneous T1 hypointense, heterogeneous T2 hyperintense, and showing ring enhancement 5 minutes after gadolinium injection, increasing after 10 minutes and becoming homogeneous after 15 minutes: findings suggestive of a hepatic hemangioma in segments II and III.  
Biliary, pancreatic, splenic, and renal morphostructure without abnormalities.  
No ascites or deep lymphadenopathy.

Pas d’anomalie de signal ni de hauteur des corps vertébraux.
Ostéophytes somatiques antérieurs de L2 à L5.

Sur les séquences hélicoïdales

Saillie discale focale para médiane gauche conflictuelle avec le fourreau dural et les émergences radiculaires de L5 plus marquée à gauche.

Aspect IRM d’une hernie discale para médiane  gauche sous ligamentaire en    L5-S1 conflictuelle avec les émergences radiculaires de L5 plus marquée à gauche.
Lésion protrusionnelle discale en L4-L5 conflictuelle avec les émergences radiculaires de L4.

Etroitesse canalaire lombaire relative à hauteur de la vertèbre L4.
translation:
Indication: Severe chronic sciatica for 2 years.

LUMBAR SPINE MRI

Technique:

Sagittal T1, T2, and axial 3D BASG sequences were performed without gadolinium injection.

Findings:

On sagittal and coronal sequences:
- Straightening of the lumbar spine is noted.
- No signal or height abnormalities of the vertebral bodies.
- Anterior osteophytes from L2 to L5.
- Disc degeneration at L4-L5 and L5-S1, appearing as T2 hypointense.
- No abnormalities of the posterior vertebral wall.
- Canal measurements at the pedicular level in the anteroposterior direction are 15.8mm at L1, 14.9mm at L2, 13.6mm at L3, 12.6mm at L4, and 14.5mm at L5.

On helical sequences:

**At L1-L2 to L3-L4:
- No global or focal disc protrusion.
- No abnormalities of the ligamentum flavum or paravertebral soft tissues.
- No facet joint osteoarthritis.

**At L4-L5:
- Global disc protrusion impinging on the L4 nerve roots and the dural sac.
- No abnormalities of the ligamentum flavum.
- No facet joint osteoarthritis.

**At L5-S1:
- Focal left paramedian disc protrusion impinging on the dural sac and L5 nerve roots, more pronounced on the left.

CONCLUSION:

MRI findings suggest a left paramedian subligamentous disc herniation at L5-S1 impinging on the L5 nerve roots, more pronounced on the left. Disc protrusion at L4-L5 impinging on the L4 nerve roots. Degenerative disc changes at L4-L5, L5-S1, and spondylotic changes from L2 to L5. Relative lumbar canal stenosis at the level of L4.

report:

Observance d’une rectitude rachidienne lombaire.
Dégénérescence discale marquée par un aspect en hyposignal du disque en T2, en L4-L5.

Présences des géodes sous chondrales des plateaux vertébraux de L4-L5.

**En L3-L4,
On note un débord discal global effaçant la graisse épidurale antérieure venant au contact du fourreau dural en regard.
 Pas d’anomalie des ligaments jaunes.

translation:
Indication: Lumbar spinal stenosis.

LUMBAR SPINE MRI

Technique:

Sagittal T1, T2, and axial 3D BASG sequences were performed without gadolinium contrast.

Findings:

On sagittal and coronal sequences:
- There is a straightening of the lumbar spine.
- Notable disc degeneration is observed with a hypointense signal of the L4-L5 disc on T2.
- Disc collapse is noted at L4-L5.
- Subchondral cysts are present in the vertebral endplates of L4-L5.
- No signal or height abnormalities of the vertebral bodies.
- No signal abnormalities of the posterior wall.

On axial sequences:

**At L2-L3:**
- No global or focal disc protrusion suggestive of a herniated disc.
- No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava.
- No canal dimension abnormalities.
- Facet joint osteoarthritis.

**At L3-L4:**
- A global disc bulge is noted, effacing the anterior epidural fat and contacting the dural sac.
- No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava.
- No canal dimension abnormalities.
- Facet joint osteoarthritis.

**At L4-L5:**
- A global disc bulge is in conflict with the bilateral supraforaminal nerve root emergence of L5.
- Thickening of the ligamenta flava.
- No canal dimension abnormalities.
- Facet joint osteoarthritis.

**At L5-S1:**
- Minimal global disc bulge not in conflict with nerve root emergence.
- No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava.
- No canal dimension abnormalities.
- Facet joint osteoarthritis.

CONCLUSION:

MRI evidence of a narrowed lumbar canal secondary to diffuse minimal disc protrusions at L3-L4 and L5-S1, more pronounced at L4-L5, conflicting with the supraforaminal nerve root emergence of L5 and the adjacent dural sac. This condition is associated with thickening of the ligamenta flava at L4-L5, contributing to the increased canal narrowing at this level. Facet joint osteoarthritis is present from L2-L3 to L5-S1.

translation:

Secretary:

translation:
Indication: Patient underwent surgery in 2019 for cauda equina syndrome due to a narrow lumbar canal with a large L3-L4 disc herniation.

LUMBAR SPINE MRI

Technique:

Sagittal T1, T2, axial T2 STIR, and FAT SAT sequences were performed without gadolinium contrast.

Findings

On the sagittal sequence:

There is a relatively straight lumbar spine alignment.
There is multilevel disc collapse, more pronounced at L3-L4 and L4-L5.
Disc dehydration is indicated by hypointense T2 signal, particularly at L3-L4 and L4-L5.
There is spondylodesis from L3 to L5 with osteosynthesis hardware in place.

On the axial sequences:

**At L2-L3,**
There is no global or focal disc protrusion. No zygapophyseal joint osteoarthritis.
No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava.
The anteroposterior canal diameter is 14mm at L2.

**At L3-L4,**
There is a global disc bulge without distinct disc-root conflict.
No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No signs of fibrosis.

**At L4-L5,**
There is a minimal disc bulge contacting the dural sac without distinct disc-root conflict. The appearance of the lateral paravertebral soft tissues is likely altered.
No signs of fibrosis.

**At L5-S1,**
There is a minimal global disc bulge with a left paramedian herniation abutting the ipsilateral S1 root.
No abnormalities of the ligamenta flava. No canal diameter abnormalities.
No zygapophyseal joint osteoarthritis.

CONCLUSION

MRI evidence of spondylodesis from L2 to L5 with osteosynthesis hardware in place.
Minimal diffuse disc protrusion from L3-L4 to L5-S1 partially contacting the dural sac at L4-L5 without distinct disc-root conflict.
Left paramedian herniation at L5-S1 with relative ipsilateral root conflict.
No signs of fibrosis noted.

report:
Indication : Bilan systématique. 
Techniciens d’Imagerie : 
Secrétaire : 

MAMMO/ECHO/IRM MAMMAIRE

Résultat 

Mammographiquement :
les seins sont de densité de type b de BIRADS avec des logettes adipeuses en sous cutané en retro mammaire.
Il n’existe pas d’image de distorsion architecturale glandulaire.
On retrouve quelques rares foyers analysés à la loupe, peu groupés à l’union des cadrans externes de façon bilatérale.
Très discrète suropacité observée dans le quadrant supérieur externe du sein droit, profondément située.
Pas d’anomalie du revêtement cutané et du prolongement axillaire.

Une échographie complémentaire réalisée objective : 
la présence d’une formation hypo écogène ovalaire profondément située à 10h du sein droit ayant les contours réguliers, un grand axe transversal et mesurée à 11mm x 9mm x 5,4mm, soit un poids de 03g.
On note une vascularisation observée en périphérie à l’écho Doppler, puis une contrainte à l’élastographie, affichant des valeurs comprises entre 26 et 35kp (valeur correspondant à une formation de faible contrainte).

L’analyse des différentes séquences d’IRM réalisé en T1 gadolinium avec soustraction a permis d’objectiver :
 une absence de processus expansif suspect observé dans le sein gauche.
On visualise à peine la formation ayant les caractéristiques de lésion bénigne dans le sein droit.
La formation décrite à l’échographie dans le sein droit n’est pas d’allure suspecte.
Pas d’image d’adénomégalie observée dans le prolongement axillaire.

CONCLUSION

Aspect mammo/écho et IRM d’une formation nodulaire tissulaire ayant des caractéristiques de lésion bénigne du quadrant supéro externe (à 10h) du sein droit évoquant un fibro adénome.
Absence de lésion suspecte observée dans les deux seins, notamment les quadrants externes du sein gauche.
translation:
Indication: Routine evaluation.

Imaging Technicians:  
Secretary:  

MAMMOGRAM/ULTRASOUND/BREAST MRI

Result

Mammographically:  
The breasts are of BIRADS type b density with subcutaneous and retro-mammary fatty lobules.  
There is no evidence of glandular architectural distortion.  
A few rare foci are noted, sparsely grouped at the union of the external quadrants bilaterally.  
A very slight over-opacity is observed in the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, located deeply.  
No abnormalities of the skin covering or axillary extension are noted.

A complementary ultrasound shows:  
The presence of an oval-shaped hypoechoic formation located deeply at 10 o'clock in the right breast with regular contours, a transverse long axis, measuring 11mm x 9mm x 5.4mm, with a weight of 3g.  
Peripheral vascularization is observed on Doppler ultrasound, and elastography shows strain values between 26 and 35kp (values corresponding to a low-strain formation).

Analysis of the different MRI sequences performed with T1 gadolinium subtraction shows:  
No suspicious expansive process observed in the left breast.  
The formation with benign lesion characteristics in the right breast is barely visible.  
The formation described on ultrasound in the right breast does not appear suspicious.  
No adenopathy is observed in the axillary extension.

CONCLUSION

Mammogram/ultrasound and MRI aspects of a nodular tissue formation with benign lesion characteristics in the upper outer quadrant (at 10 o'clock) of the right breast, suggesting a fibroadenoma.  
No suspicious lesions observed in either breast, particularly in the external quadrants of the left breast.

report:

IRM MAMMAIRE / MAMMO / ECHO

Résultat 

:
Mammographiquement, on réalise des incidences dans de face, profil axillaire qui a objectivé des seins présentant une harmonie des structures fibro glandulaires sans lésion focale suspecte individualisée sans anomalie de revêtement cutané  et du maillon.

L’échographie réalisée en complémentaire n’objective pas de dilatation des canaux galactophores de façon significative, tout au plus un très discret épaississement pariétal galactophorique et péri alvéolaire gauche de 3,7mm.
Il n’est pas individualisé de formation endoluminale.

Pas d’anomalie de signal focal notée.
Pas d’anomalie de revêtement cutané.
Pas d’image d’adénomégalie observée dans le prolongement axillaire.

CONCLUSION

Aspect en imagerie (MAMMO /ECHO et IRM) dans les limites de la normale tout au plus une très discrète dilatation galactophorique retro alvéolaire à paroi peu épaissie n’excluant pas une galactophorite : il est souhaitable de poursuivre la surveillance clinique et en imagerie si possible tous les ans.
translation:
Indication: Unipore nipple discharge from the left breast. Investigation for an intracystic lesion smaller than one centimeter.

MAMMOGRAPHY / ULTRASOUND / MRI

Result:

Mammographically, frontal and axillary profile views were performed, revealing breasts with harmonious fibroglandular structures without any suspicious focal lesion identified, and no abnormalities of the skin covering or the nipple-areolar complex. No suspicious microcalcifications were observed.

The complementary ultrasound did not show significant dilation of the milk ducts, at most a very slight thickening of the galactophoric and peri-alveolar wall on the left side measuring 3.7mm. No intraluminal formation was identified. No lymphadenopathy was noted in the axillary extensions.

On MRI, no signal abnormality was noted on T1, T2, and T1 gadolinium sequences. No focal signal abnormality was noted. No skin covering abnormality. No lymphadenopathy observed in the axillary extension.

CONCLUSION

Des Creux axillaires libres.

On note un remaniement du tissu fibro glandulaire avec des zones hypoéchogènes non vascularisé au doppler couleur dans le QIE du sein droit.
Une absence de lésion tissulaire, kystique typique ou atypique intra corpus mammaire.

Adénopathie du creux axillaire droit.

Arguments échomammographiques d’un remaniement du tissu fibro glandulaire avec des zones hypoéchogènes non vascularisé au doppler couleur dans le QIE du sein droit pouvant faire évoquer un abcès mammaire à la phase pré suppurative.

translation:

No abnormalities of the skin or nipple.
No abnormal breast opacities.
No pathological calcifications.
Clear axillary regions.

There is remodeling of the fibroglandular tissue with hypoechoic areas that are non-vascularized on color Doppler in the lower inner quadrant of the right breast.
No typical or atypical cystic or tissue lesions within the breast tissue.
No abnormalities of the milk ducts or thickening of Duret's ridges.
Lymphadenopathy in the right axillary region.

Echomammographic evidence of fibroglandular tissue remodeling with hypoechoic areas that are non-vascularized on color Doppler in the lower inner quadrant of the right breast, suggestive of a pre-suppurative phase breast abscess.

report:

RESULTATS

Une infiltration du tissu graisseux sous cutané rétro-aréolaire du sein droit.
Une adénopathie axillaire droite de 11mm de petit axe. 
CONCLUSION

Arguments échomammographiques d’une ectasie canalaire galactophorique rétro aréolaire mammaire droite avec épaississement pariétal, de contenu liquidien finement échogène associée à un épaississement du revêtement cutané et à une infiltration du tissu graisseux sous cutané en regard puis à une adénopathie axillaire homolatérale faisant discuter une galactophorite ou un carcinome canalaire : à corréler au bilan biologique du liquide d’écoulement.

translation:
Clinical Information: Right breast pain.

FINDINGS

Mammography reveals:
Symmetrically sized breasts with heterogeneously dense tissue, classified as BIRADS type B.
Increased opacity in the retroareolar region of the right breast with thickening of the peri-areolar skin.
No abnormal opacity in the left breast.
No pathological calcifications.
Clear axillary regions.

Ultrasound findings include:
No typical or atypical solid or cystic lesions within the breast tissue.
Bilateral retroareolar ductal dilatation, more pronounced on the right, with thickened walls and finely echogenic fluid content, without intraluminal tissue lesions.
Infiltration of the subcutaneous fatty tissue in the retroareolar region of the right breast.
A right axillary lymph node measuring 11mm in short axis.

CONCLUSION

Ultrasound and mammographic findings suggest right retroareolar ductal ectasia with wall thickening and finely echogenic fluid content, associated with skin thickening and subcutaneous fatty tissue infiltration, as well as ipsilateral axillary lymphadenopathy. This raises the possibility of ductal mastitis or ductal carcinoma, warranting correlation with the biological analysis of the discharge fluid.
Left retroareolar ductal ectasia without intraluminal material: benign anomaly classified as BIRADS 2.

report:
HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHIEIndication : étude de la perméabilité tubaire
 Technique Préhension pneumatique du col avec une  tulipe, suivie  d’une injection du produit de contraste hydrosoluble iodée de 20ml.
PSPAbsence d’anomalie lésionnelle spontanément dans l’excavation  pelvienne.
APRES OPACIFICATION

 Le canal cervical est normal.
 L’utérus est de morphologie normo haute avec une plage cavitaire renfermant des images lacunaires corporéales et fundiques d’allure myomateuse. La statique utérine est normo fléchi.
 L’opacification tubaire est cependant bilatérale, synchrone avec les replis muqueux ampullaires normaux.
 Il existe un passage tubo péritonéal assez franc
 La diffusion péritonéale est acceptable
 L’évacuation utéro-salpingienne est normale.

CONCLUSION
 Canal cervical normal.
 Morphologie normo haute cavitaire utérine avec des lésions lacunaires traduisant des formations myomateuses : à corréler avec l’échographie.
 Perméabilité tubaire bilatérale normale.
 Péritonéogramme  acceptable.
translation:
HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHY

Indication: Evaluation of tubal patency

Technique: Pneumatic grasping of the cervix with a tulip device, followed by the injection of 20ml of water-soluble iodinated contrast medium.

FINDINGS

- No spontaneous lesion abnormalities in the pelvic cavity.

AFTER CONTRAST ADMINISTRATION

- The cervical canal is normal.
- The uterus has a normal height morphology with a cavity containing lacunar images in the body and fundus suggestive of myomatous formations. The uterine position is normally flexed.
- Tubal opacification is bilateral and synchronous with normal ampullary mucosal folds.
- There is a clear tuboperitoneal passage.
- Peritoneal diffusion is acceptable.
- Uterosalpingographic evacuation is normal.

CONCLUSION

- Normal cervical canal.
- Uterine cavity with normal height morphology and lacunar lesions indicating myomatous formations: correlation with ultrasound is recommended.
- Normal bilateral tubal patency.
- Acceptable peritoneogram.

report:

APRES OPACIFICATION

 On note un utérus de statique rétroversé présentant une morphologie normo haute sans anomalie contours.
 La plage cavitaire reste homogène.

 Cavité utérine quasi normale avec une statique rétroversé.
 Obstruction tubaire proximale bilatérale justifiant si possible une recanalisation par radiologie interventionnelle.

translation:
Clinical Concern: Seizure

An infiltrative mass with high T2 signal intensity is observed involving the right frontal motor cortex.
 - There is no definite enhancement within the tumor.
 - Restricted diffusion and increased rCBV are noted.

Diagnostic Impression: Possibility of oligodendroglioma or IDH-mutant astrocytoma.

report:
C.C.: seizure

좌측 상부 전두엽 피질 및 피하층에 침윤성 T2 고신호 병변이 있으며, 피질 확장이 관찰됨. 
 - 내부에 국소적인 조영증가를 보이며 괴사가 의심됨.
 - rCBV 증가 또는 확산 제한은 명확하지 않음.
-> 이상의 소견으로 고등급 신경교종 가능성 배제 불가.
translation:
Clinical Concern: Seizure

There is an infiltrative T2 hyperintense lesion in the left superior frontal lobe cortex and subcortical layer, with cortical expansion observed. 
 - Shows focal enhancement internally, with suspected necrosis.
 - Increased rCBV or diffusion restriction is not clearly evident.
-> These findings do not rule out the possibility of a high-grade glioma.

report:
좌측 전두엽, 절연체 및 측두엽을 포함하는 8.3-cm 크기의 다발성 조영증가를 동반한 팽창성 종괴를 보임.
 - 종양 내 석회화가 보임.
 - 경미한 CBV 증가.

결론: Grade 3 희소돌기아교종가 가장 유력함.
translation:
The report shows an 8.3-cm expansile mass with multiple areas of enhancement involving the left frontal lobe, insula, and temporal lobe. 
- Calcifications are observed within the tumor.
- Mild increase in cerebral blood volume (CBV).

Conclusion: Grade 3 oligodendroglioma is most likely.

report:
양측 목 2~6번 레벨에서 균일한 조영증가를 보이는 다수의 확대된 림프절이 보임. 
양측 구개편도 비대가 보임.

진단 소견: 림프종 침범.
translation:
Numerous enlarged lymph nodes with uniform enhancement are observed at levels 2 to 6 on both sides of the neck. Bilateral tonsillar hypertrophy is noted.

Diagnostic Impression: Lymphoma involvement.

report:
중뇌/뇌교, 좌측 담창구, 좌측 측두극, 좌측 외측 뇌실벽에 비교적 균일하게 조영증가를 보이는 종괴들이 있음.  
 - rCBV 증가 동반.   
 - 확산 제한이 뚜렷하지 않음. 
좌측 측두엽, 좌측 내낭/코로나 방사, 양측 전두엽 기저부에 비조영성 T2 고신호 강도의 침윤성 병변이 있음.

진단 소견: 고등급 신경교종 가능성이 더 높음. DDx. 림프종 침범.
translation:
There are masses showing relatively uniform enhancement in the midbrain/pons, left globus pallidus, left temporal pole, and left lateral ventricular wall.  
- Accompanied by increased rCBV.  
- No significant diffusion restriction observed.  
There are non-enhancing T2 high-signal intensity infiltrative lesions in the left temporal lobe, left internal capsule/corona radiata, and bilateral frontal lobe bases.

Diagnostic Impression: A high-grade glioma is more likely. Differential diagnosis includes lymphoma involvement.

report:
S/P biopsy.

좌측 대뇌 반구와 우측 전두두정 백질에 비조영성 종양이 있는 gliomatosis cerebri 패턴이 관찰되며, 좌측 전두엽 및 좌측 두정측두엽에는 조영증가 괴사성 종양이 있음.  
 - 내부 출혈, 현저한 세포 밀도 증가, 그리고 조영증가가 보이며 고형 종양에서 약간의 rCBV 증가가 관찰됨.

진단 소견: IDH-wilRXype 교모세포종 가능성이 큼.   
 - 비조영성 종양의 gliomatosis cerebri 패턴.   
 - 좌측 전두엽 및 좌측 두정측두엽의 조영증가 괴사성 종양
translation:
Post-biopsy.

A gliomatosis cerebri pattern is observed with non-enhancing tumors in the left cerebral hemisphere and right frontal-parietal white matter. There is an enhancing necrotic tumor in the left frontal lobe and left parieto-temporal lobe.
- Internal hemorrhage, marked increase in cellular density, and enhancement are noted, with a slight increase in rCBV observed in the solid tumor.

Diagnostic impression: High likelihood of IDH-wilRXype glioblastoma.
- Gliomatosis cerebri pattern of non-enhancing tumor.
- Enhancing necrotic tumor in the left frontal lobe and left parieto-temporal lobe.

report:
S/P total removal of enhancing tumor (IDH-wilRXype glioblastoma, MGMTp unmethylated), S/P CCRT. 

종양 재발의 증거는 없음. 우측 측두엽 수술 경계에서 최소한의 조영증가가 관찰되며, 이는 치료와 관련된 변화일 가능성이 큼.  
 - 세포 밀도 증가나 rCBV 증가는 없음. 
우측 측두엽에 수술로 인한 연화증 및 T2 고신호가 관찰됨.

진단 소견: 종양 재발의 증거 없음.
translation:
Post total resection of enhancing tumor (IDH-wilRXype glioblastoma, MGMTp unmethylated), post concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

No evidence of tumor recurrence. Minimal enhancement is observed at the surgical margin in the right temporal lobe, likely representing treatment-related changes.  
- No increase in cellular density or rCBV.  
Surgical encephalomalacia and T2 hyperintensity are noted in the right temporal lobe.

Impression: No evidence of tumor recurrence.

report:
소견
좌측 내측 전두엽에 불규칙한 형태의 이질적으로 조영증가된 종괴가 있으며, 종괴 주변과 우측 내측 전두엽에 여러 개의 조영증가 병변이 관찰됨.  
 - 좌측 전두두정엽 및 우측 내측 전두엽에 T2 신호 연장 병변 관찰됨.   
 - 일부 조영증가 부분에서 확산 제한이 있음.  
 - rCBV 및 CBF(ASL) 증가.   

-> 고등급 신경교종, 특히 IDH-wilRXype 교모세포종 가능성이 큼.

진단 소견: 양측 전두엽 및 좌측 두정엽에 고등급 신경교종, 특히 IDH-wilRXype 교모세포종 가능성이 큼.
translation:
Findings:  
There is an irregularly shaped, heterogeneously enhancing mass in the left medial frontal lobe, with multiple enhancing lesions observed around the mass and in the right medial frontal lobe.  
- T2 signal prolongation is noted in the left frontoparietal lobe and right medial frontal lobe.  
- Some areas of enhancement show diffusion restriction.  
- Increased rCBV and CBF (ASL) are noted.  

-> There is a high likelihood of a high-grade glioma, particularly an IDH-wilRXype glioblastoma.

Diagnostic Impression: There is a high likelihood of a high-grade glioma, particularly an IDH-wilRXype glioblastoma, in the bilateral frontal lobes and left parietal lobe.

report:
주로 우측 측두엽을 침범하는 침윤성 조영증가/괴사 및 비조영성 종양이 관찰됨.
 - 세포 밀도 증가, rCBV 증가.   
 - 광범위한 종양 주위 부종.  
 - 우측 외측 뇌실의 뇌실막을 따라 확산된 조영증가. 
시상하부, 시신경로-교차부, 좌측 측두엽에서도 비조영성 종양 침범이 의심됨. 
뇌간 부위까지 확장된 확산된 연수막 조영증가가 관찰되며, 연수막 전이가 의심됩니다.

진단 소견: 연수막 전이를 동반한 IDH-wilRXype glioblastoma 가능성이 큼.
translation:
An infiltrative enhancing/necrotic and non-enhancing tumor predominantly involving the right temporal lobe is observed.  
- Increased cellularity and elevated rCBV.  
- Extensive peritumoral edema.  
- Enhancement along the ependymal lining of the right lateral ventricle.  
Non-enhancing tumor involvement is suspected in the hypothalamus, optic pathway-chiasm, and left temporal lobe.  
Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement extending to the brainstem is observed, raising suspicion for leptomeningeal metastasis.

Diagnostic Impression: High likelihood of IDH-wilRXype glioblastoma with leptomeningeal metastasis.

report:
C.C.: 간헐적 두통, 거동 불편. 

소견 및 결론:

우측 측두엽에 중심부 괴사 또는 낭성 부분을 가진 약 4.6-cm 크기의 경계가 명확한 주변부 조영증가 종괴가 관찰됨.

 - 우측 전두엽 및 측두엽에서 조영증가가 없는 T2 중간 신호강도의 작은 부분이 관찰됨, 비조영성 종양 가능성.
 - 병변 주위 부종 및 좌측으로의 경미한 중선 이동.
 - DWI에서 유의미한 세포 밀도 증가는 없음.
 - 관류 연구에서 주변부 CBV 및 투과성 증가.
  -> 고등급 신경교종 가능성 높음.
translation:
CC: Intermittent headache, difficulty with movement.

Findings and Conclusion:

A well-defined mass measuring approximately 4.6 cm with central necrosis or cystic components is observed in the right temporal lobe, showing peripheral enhancement.

- In the right frontal and temporal lobes, there is a small area of intermediate T2 signal intensity without enhancement, suggesting the possibility of a non-enhancing tumor.
- There is surrounding edema and a mild midline shift to the left.
- No significant increase in cellular density is noted on DWI.
- Perfusion studies show increased peripheral CBV and permeability.
  -> High likelihood of a high-grade glioma.

report:
이질적인 조영증가와 내부 출혈/낭성 변화를 동반한 약 2.5cm 크기의 우측 내이도-소뇌교각(IAC-CPA) 종괴가 있으며, 전정 신경초종 가능성이 큼.  
 - 종양 주위 부종이나 수두증의 증거는 없음.  
 - 확산 제한 없음 / rCBV 증가 관찰됨.

진단 소견: 우측 전정 신경초종.
translation:
There is a heterogeneous enhancing mass with internal hemorrhage/cystic changes measuring approximately 2.5 cm in the right internal auditory canal-cerebellopontine angle (IAC-CPA), highly suggestive of a vestibular schwannoma.  
- No evidence of peritumoral edema or hydrocephalus.  
- No diffusion restriction observed / increased rCBV noted.

Diagnostic Impression: Right vestibular schwannoma.

report:
약 2.5cm 크기의 경계가 좋은 균일하게 조영증가된 종괴가 우측 이하선 표층엽에 있으며, 양성 종양일 가능성이 큼. 
양측 목 부위에서 병리적으로 확대된 림프절의 증거는 없음.

진단 소견: 우측 이하선 표층엽에 위치한 양성 종양 가능성이 큼.
translation:
There is an approximately 2.5 cm well-defined, uniformly enhancing mass in the superficial lobe of the right parotid gland, with a high likelihood of being a benign tumor. 

There is no evidence of pathologically enlarged lymph nodes in either side of the neck.

Diagnostic Impression: High likelihood of a benign tumor located in the superficial lobe of the right parotid gland.

report:
우측 전두골 outer table에 약 1.2cm 크기의 골성 돌출이 관찰되며, 이는 골종(osteoma)일 가능성이 큼.

진단 소견: 우측 전두골 outer table에 골종(osteoma).
translation:
A bony protrusion measuring approximately 1.2 cm is observed on the outer table of the right frontal bone, likely representing an osteoma.

Diagnostic Impression: Osteoma on the outer table of the right frontal bone.

report:
좌측 후두하 피하층에 약 3.2cm 크기의 지방성 종괴가 관찰됨, 아마도 지방종일 가능성이 큼. 
양측 목 부위에서 병리적으로 확대된 림프절의 증거는 없음.

진단 소견: 지방종 가능성이 높음.
translation:
A subcutaneous fatty mass measuring approximately 3.2 cm is observed in the left occipital region, most likely a lipoma. There is no evidence of pathologically enlarged lymph nodes in the neck on either side.

Impression: High likelihood of a lipoma.

report:
약 3.5 cm 크기의 우측 전두엽 두정면 볼록부 수막종이 관찰되며, 종양 주위 부종 없음.
 - 인접한 두개골의 골비후 있음.
 - 상시상정맥동 침범의 증거는 없음.
 - 세포 밀도 증가 없음 / rCBV 현저한 증가 있음.

진단 소견: 약 3.5 cm 크기의 우측 전두엽 두정면 볼록부 수막종이 관찰되며, 종양 주위 부종 없음.
translation:
A meningioma approximately 3.5 cm in size is observed in the right frontal convexity region, with no surrounding edema. 
- There is thickening of the adjacent skull bone.
- No evidence of invasion into the superior sagittal sinus.
- No increase in cellular density / significant increase in rCBV.

Diagnostic Impression: A meningioma approximately 3.5 cm in size is observed in the right frontal convexity region, with no surrounding edema.

report:
좌측 소뇌에 약 4.3cm 크기의 낭성 종괴와 조영증가된 벽결절이 관찰됨.   
 - T2WI에서 다수의 흐름 결손(flow void) 관찰됨.  
 - 세포 밀도 증가는 없으나 rCBV가 현저하게 증가됨.  
 - 경미한 종양 주위 부종이 동반됨.

진단 소견: 좌측 소뇌의 혈관모세포종(hemangioblastoma) 가능성이 높음.
translation:
A cystic mass approximately 4.3 cm in size with an enhancing mural nodule is observed in the left cerebellum.  
- Multiple flow voids are noted on T2-weighted images.  
- There is no increase in cellular density, but the relative cerebral blood volume (rCBV) is significantly elevated.  
- Mild peritumoral edema is present.

Diagnostic Impression: A hemangioblastoma in the left cerebellum is highly suspected.

report:
우측 뇌하수체 측익에 약 4mm 크기의 지연 조영증가 병변이 관찰됨, 아마도 뇌하수체 미세선종일 가능성이 큼.  
 - 해면 정맥동 침범의 증거는 없음.

진단 소견: 우측 측익의 뇌하수체 미세선종
translation:
A delayed contrast-enhancing lesion approximately 4mm in size is observed in the right pituitary wing, most likely indicative of a pituitary microadenoma.  
- There is no evidence of cavernous sinus invasion.

Diagnostic Impression: Pituitary microadenoma in the right wing.

report:
약 2.8cm 크기의 뇌하수체 내/상부 시상하부 종양이 우측 해면 정맥동을 침범하고 시신경 교차부를 상승시킴.  
 - 낭성/출혈성 변화 동반.  
 - 뇌하수체 줄기가 좌측으로 편위됨.

진단 소견: 우측 해면 정맥동 침범과 시신경 교차부 상승을 동반한 뇌하수체 선종
translation:
A pituitary tumor approximately 2.8 cm in size is present in the intrasellar/suprasellar region, invading the right cavernous sinus and elevating the optic chiasm.  
- Accompanied by cystic/hemorrhagic changes.  
- The pituitary stalk is deviated to the left.

Diagnostic Impression: Pituitary adenoma with invasion of the right cavernous sinus and elevation of the optic chiasm.

report:
뇌하수체 중간엽에 약 8mm 크기의 낭성 병변이 관찰되어, 아마도 라스케 열낭종(Rathke's cleft cyst)일 가능성이 큼.  
 - 벽 내부에 결절이 동반됨.

진단 소견: 라스케 열낭종(Rathke's cleft cyst).
translation:
An approximately 8mm cystic lesion is observed in the pituitary gland, likely representing a Rathke's cleft cyst.  
- A nodule is present within the wall.

Diagnostic Impression: Rathke's cleft cyst.

report:
양쪽 뇌 기저핵 담창구, 뇌교, 그리고 중소뇌각 (MCP)의 현저한 위축이 관찰되며, 뇌교에서 hot cross bun sign이 보임. 
좌측 소뇌, 뇌교, 우측 전두엽에 미세출혈이 관찰됨.

진단 소견: 다계통 위축 의심됨. 
임상적 상관관계 권장됨
translation:
Significant atrophy is observed in the bilateral basal ganglia, globus pallidus, pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles (MCP), with the presence of the hot cross bun sign in the pons. Microhemorrhages are noted in the left cerebellum, pons, and right frontal lobe.

Diagnostic Impression: Suspected multiple system atrophy. Clinical correlation is recommended.

report:
우측 AICA가 같은 쪽 안면신경 근출구와 근접해 있어 동측 안면경련을 유발함. 

두개 내 협착 또는 동맥류의 증거는 없음.

진단 소견: 우측 AICA가 같은 쪽 안면신경 근출구와 근접해 있어 반측 안면경련을 유발함.
translation:
The right AICA is in close proximity to the ipsilateral facial nerve root exit, causing hemifacial spasm on the same side.

There is no evidence of intracranial stenosis or aneurysm.

Diagnostic Impression: The right AICA is in close proximity to the ipsilateral facial nerve root exit, causing hemifacial spasm.

report:
비대칭적인 양측 실비우스 열의 확장과 뇌량 각도의 좁아짐을 동반한 뇌실확대가 관찰되며, 정상압 수두증(NPH) 가능성이 큼.
우측 시상과 좌측 기저핵에서 미세출혈이 관찰됨. 
양측 뇌실 주변 백질에서 융합된 T2 고신호 강도가 관찰됨.

진단 소견: 정상압 수두증(NPH) 가능성이 높음.
translation:
The report shows ventricular enlargement with asymmetric dilation of the bilateral Sylvian fissures and narrowing of the callosal angle, suggesting a high likelihood of normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH). Microbleeds are observed in the right thalamus and left basal ganglia. There is confluent T2 hyperintensity in the periventricular white matter on both sides.

Diagnostic Impression: High likelihood of normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH).

report:
양측 외안근(EOM) 비대와 현저한 양측 안구 돌출이 관찰되어, 갑상선 관련 안병증이 의심됨.

진단 소견: 갑상선 관련 안병증
translation:
Bilateral enlargement of the extraocular muscles (EOM) and significant bilateral proptosis are observed, suggesting thyroid-associated ophthalmopathy.

Diagnostic Impression: Thyroid-associated ophthalmopathy

report:
우측 유양동 공기 세포와 중이강의 혼탁 및 고막 두꺼워짐이 관찰되며, 우측 만성 중이염(COM)이 의심됨.  
 - 이소골 연쇄의 침식 증거는 없음.

진단 소견: 우측 만성 중이염(COM)
translation:
There is observed clouding of the right mastoid air cells and middle ear cavity, along with thickening of the tympanic membrane, suggesting right chronic otitis media (COM).  
- No evidence of ossicular chain erosion.

Diagnostic Impression: Right chronic otitis media (COM).

report:
좌측 실비우스 열과 좌측 시상상 수조에서 급성 지주막하 출혈(SAH)이 관찰됨.
 - 경미한 2차 뇌실내 출혈(IVH)이 동반됨.
우측 기저핵에 오래된 작은 뇌경색. 
뇌실질 부피 감소.

약 3.5mm 크기의 좌측 MCBIF 동맥류가 있으며, 이는 원인 동맥류일 가능성이 큼. 
우측 근위부 ICA에 중등도 협착이 관찰됨. 
양측 원위부 ICA에서 혈관 내강의 불규칙성이 관찰됩니다.

진단 소견: 좌측 MCBIF 파열로 인한 급성 SAH.
translation:
Acute subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) is observed in the left Sylvian fissure and left ambient cistern.  
- Accompanied by mild secondary intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH).  
An old small infarct is noted in the right basal ganglia.  
Decreased brain parenchymal volume.  

There is an approximately 3.5mm aneurysm in the left MCBIF, which is likely the causative aneurysm.  
Moderate stenosis is observed in the proximal right ICA.  
Irregularities in the lumens of the distal ICAs are noted bilaterally.  

Impression: Acute SAH due to rupture of the left MCBIF aneurysm.

There is diffuse superficial siderosis in the bilateral cerebral sulci, likely due to previous subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH). 
No change in the size of mild ventriculomegaly. 
Decreased brain volume.

report:

양측 대뇌 반구에서 다발성 미세출혈이 보임.

좌측 M1 폐색. 
우측 근위부 내경동맥(ICA)에서 중등도 협착.

진단 소견: 좌측 M1 폐색을 동반한 좌측 MCA 영역의 급성 경색.
translation:
CC: Right-sided paralysis (onset 3 hours ago)

Acute infarction in the left middle cerebral artery (MCA) territory.
- SWI blooming artifact indicating thrombus in the left M1 segment.
- No evidence of hemorrhagic transformation.
Old lacunar infarcts observed in the bilateral basal ganglia and left thalamus.
Multiple microbleeds noted in both cerebral hemispheres.
Findings suggestive of brain volume loss.

Occlusion of the left M1 segment.
Moderate stenosis in the proximal right internal carotid artery (ICA).

Perfusion delay in the left MCA territory with reduced rCBV in the infarct core.

Impression: Acute infarction in the left MCA territory with occlusion of the left M1 segment.

report:
Quesito diagnostico: “dolore addominale”.
Referto
Esame ostacolato dalla presenza di notevole meteorismo intestinale.
Per quanto valutabile il fegato si presenta di regolare morfovolumetria ad ecostruttura parenchimale lievemente e diffusamente addensata come da steatosi.
Colecisti eumorfica, a pareti regolari, nel cui lume si evidenzia formazione litiasica del diametro di 2,5 cm, mobile al variare del decubito.
Non dilatazione delle vie biliari intra ed extra-epatiche.
Asse spleno portale regolare per decorso, calibro e cinesi respiratoria.
Milza di regolare morfovolumetria ed ecostruttura.
Regione pancreatica nei limiti di norma.
Entrambi i reni si presentano di regolare morfovolumetria ed ecostruttura, in assenza di immagini da riferire a litiasi o idronefrosi.
Vescica a pareti regolari, esente da immagini patologiche endoluminali.
Prostata ai limiti morfovolumetrici superiori della norma (DAP: 3,1 cm; RX: 4,1 cm) ad ecostruttura disomogenea per la presenza nel suo contesto di millimetriche areole fibrocalcifiche.
translation:
Diagnostic Question: "Abdominal pain."

Report
The examination is hindered by significant intestinal gas.

As far as can be assessed, the liver appears to have a normal shape and size with a parenchymal echotexture that is slightly and diffusely increased, consistent with steatosis.

The gallbladder is normal in shape, with regular walls, and contains a mobile gallstone measuring 2.5 cm in diameter that moves with changes in position.

There is no dilation of the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts.

The splenoportal axis is normal in course, caliber, and respiratory motion.

The spleen is of normal shape, size, and echotexture.

The pancreatic region is within normal limits.

Both kidneys are of normal shape, size, and echotexture, with no evidence of stones or hydronephrosis.

The bladder has regular walls and shows no pathological images within the lumen.

The prostate is at the upper limits of normal size (AP diameter: 3.1 cm; transverse diameter: 4.1 cm) with a heterogeneous echotexture due to the presence of small fibrocalcific areas.

report:

Non alterazioni tomodensitometriche parenchimali patologiche a carattere d’urgenza, in particolare non spandimenti ematici intra- ed extra-assiali né focolai contusivi parenchimali.
Sistema ventricolare sotto- e sovra-tentoriale regolare per morfologia, volume e sede.

Strutture della linea mediana in asse.

Cisti da ritenzione mucosa del seno mascellare destro.
