translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination: Abdominal pain since today. Nausea. No diarrhea. Constipation. Atrial fibrillation without anticoagulation. Known abdominal aortic aneurysm. Status post scar hernia surgery. Mesenteric ischemia? Aneurysm? Free fluid? 

Consent and Information: After taking the risk history, verbal and written information was provided about the contrast medium application and the examination procedure, as well as possible risks of the examination (see also consent form). Written consent from the patient.

Examination Technique: Digital overview radiographs. MS-CT of the abdomen in arterial and venous contrast phases after intravenous administration of 120 ml Xenetix-350. MPR. DLP: 334 mGy.cm.

Findings and Assessment: No comparable previous images.

• Fusiform abdominal aortic aneurysm up to 7 cm in diameter (Series 4 Image 307). Minimal peripheral thrombosis. Origin of the SMA from the proximal part of the aneurysm.
• No evidence of mesenteric ischemia. No stenosis or occlusion of the visceral and mesenteric arteries.
• Suspected calcified aneurysm of a distal mesenteric artery in the right mid-abdomen (Series 4 Image 269).
• No cholestasis. No urinary obstruction, trabeculated bladder. No bowel obstruction.
• Multiple liver and kidney cysts.
• No free intra-abdominal air or fluid.
• Incidentally noted small consolidations in the dorsobasal right lower lobe, possible early pneumonic infiltrates. Narrow basal pericardial effusion. Coronary sclerosis.
• Ventrolisthesis of L4, Meyerding Grade I.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: Pt. am Sonntag für 30 Sekunden Doppelbilder gehabt hohes kardiovaskuläres Risikoprofil Herzschrittmacher . Bitte cCT + CTA. Ischämie? Stenosen?   Notfallindikation. Kontrolle der Schilddrüsen- und Nierenparameter im Verlauf empfohlen.  Untersuchungstechnik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native CCT. Anschließend i.v. Gabe von 100 ml Xenetix-350 CT-Angiographie Kopf/Hals. MPR. DLP: 1163 mGy.cm.  Neurokranium: •    Kein Blutungsnachweis. Keine territoriale Infarktdemarkation. •    Einzelne kleinere lakunäre Defekte im Bereich der Stammganglien rechts. •    Keine Herniation. Keine Hirndruckzeichen. Keine Liquorzirkulationsstörung. •    Schädelkalotte intakt. Mastoidzellen frei belüftet.  Gefäßsystem: •    P2-Stenose links. Im übrigen kein Nachweis einer Stenose oder eines Verschlusses der hirnversorgenden Arterien. •    Kein Anhalt für eine Gefäßmalformation oder ein zerebrales Aneurysma. •    Halswirbelsäule intakt. Miterfasst moderate Pleuraergüsse beidseits mit angrenzenden Belüftungsstörungen. •    Schrittmacheraggregat links pektoral.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination: Patient experienced double vision for 30 seconds on Sunday, has a high cardiovascular risk profile, and a pacemaker. Request for cCT + CTA. Ischemia? Stenoses? Emergency indication. Monitoring of thyroid and kidney parameters recommended during follow-up.

Examination Technique: Digital scout radiographs. Non-contrast CCT. Subsequently, intravenous administration of 100 ml Xenetix-350 for CT angiography of the head/neck. MPR. DLP: 1163 mGy.cm.

Neurocranium:
- No evidence of bleeding. No territorial infarct demarcation.
- Isolated small lacunar defects in the area of the right basal ganglia.
- No herniation. No signs of increased intracranial pressure. No cerebrospinal fluid circulation disorder.
- Skull vault intact. Mastoid air cells are well-aerated.

Vascular System:
- P2 stenosis on the left. Otherwise, no evidence of stenosis or occlusion of the cerebral arteries.
- No indication of vascular malformation or cerebral aneurysm.
- Cervical spine intact. Incidentally noted moderate pleural effusions on both sides with adjacent ventilation disturbances.
- Pacemaker device located in the left pectoral region.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: Z.n. Resektion petroclivales Meningeom heute, jetzt erneut Vigilanzminderung. cCT zur Kontrolle.   Untersuchungstechnik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native CCT. MPR. DLP: 800 mGy.cm.  •    Geringfügig umverteiltes Pneumencephalon. Im übrigen kein durchgreifender Befundwandel im kurzfristigen Verlauf. •    Weitgehend konstante Mittellinienverlagerung um bis zu 9 mm nach links. •    Aufgebrauchte äußere Liquorräume. Pelottierung des rechten Seitenventrikels. •    Unveränderte postoperative Veränderungen im operativen Zugangsweg und im OP-Bereich mit kleiner Blutung rechts temporomesial, keine Nachblutung.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Status post resection of petroclival meningioma today, now experiencing reduced alertness. Non-contrast CT for evaluation.  

Technique: Digital scout radiographs. Non-contrast CT. Multiplanar reconstruction. Dose-length product: 800 mGy.cm.  

Findings:  
- Slight redistribution of pneumocephalus. Otherwise, no significant change in findings over the short term.  
- Largely stable midline shift up to 9 mm to the left.  
- External cerebrospinal fluid spaces are obliterated. Compression of the right lateral ventricle.  
- Unchanged postoperative changes along the surgical access route and in the operative area with a small hemorrhage in the right temporomesial region, no rebleeding.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Verdacht auf Urolithiasis links. Bilanzierung Steine.  Untersuchungstechnik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native MS-CT des Abdomens in Niedrigdosistechnik. MPR. DLP: 128 mGy*cm.  •    Bis zu 6 mm durchmessendes Konkrement linksseitig am pyeloureteralen Übergang (Serie 3 Image 216). Konsekutiv zweitgradiger Harnstau links. Weiteres kleines Konkrement (3 mm) in der unteren Kelchgruppe links (Serie 3 Image 225). •    Kein Nachweis einer Urolithiasis oder eines Harnstaus rechts. •    Keine freie intraabdominelle Luft oder Flüssigkeit.
translation: Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination: Suspected left-sided urolithiasis. Stone assessment. Examination Technique: Digital scout radiographs. Non-contrast low-dose MS-CT of the abdomen. MPR. DLP: 128 mGy*cm. • A calculus measuring up to 6 mm is present on the left side at the ureteropelvic junction (Series 3 Image 216), resulting in secondary grade hydronephrosis on the left. Another small calculus (3 mm) is noted in the lower calyx group on the left (Series 3 Image 225). • No evidence of urolithiasis or hydronephrosis on the right. • No free intra-abdominal air or fluid.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Dyspnoe seit heute. Nierenzellkarzinom. Verdacht auf Rechtsherzbelastung. LAE? Infiltrat? Erguss?   Kritisch kranker Patient. Es erfolgte kein Aufklärungsgespräch.  Untersuchungstechnik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. MS-CT des Thorax in pulmonalarterieller KM-Phase nach i.v. Gabe von 50 ml Xenetix-350. MPR. DLP: 170 mGy.cm.  Befund und Beurteilung: CT Voraufnahmen zum Vergleich vorliegend.  •    Kein Nachweis einer Lungenarterienembolie. Keine Rechtsherzbelastungszeichen. •    Coronarsklerose. Mitralklappensklerose. Kein zirkulärer Perikarderguss. Aneurysma der Aorta ascendens (5 cm), Ektasie auch der übrigen miterfassten Aortenabschnitte, deutliche Aortenelongation. •    Weitgehend konstanter, allenfalls geringfügig nach basal umverteilter Pleuraerguss rechts mit bis zu 6 cm dorsaler Saumbreite und angrenzender Unterlappenteilatelektase. Geringer Pleuraerguss auch links. Kein Pneumothorax. •    Verdickte Bronchialwände sowie peribronchiale Konsolidierungen im dorsobasalen linken Unterlappen, DD pneumonisch. Emphysematöse Lungengerüstveränderungen. •    Im kurzfristigen Verlauf orientierend unveränderter onkologischer Status thorakal. Miterfasste Raumforderung in der Nierenloge rechts unverändert. •    Demers-Katheter über rechts jugulär mit Spitze in der Vena cava superior.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination: Dyspnea since today. Renal cell carcinoma. Suspected right heart strain. Pulmonary embolism? Infiltrate? Effusion? Critically ill patient. No informed consent discussion was conducted.

Examination Technique: Digital overview radiographs. Multislice CT of the thorax in the pulmonary arterial contrast phase following intravenous administration of 50 ml Xenetix-350. Multiplanar reconstruction. Dose-length product: 170 mGy.cm.

Findings and Assessment: Previous CT scans available for comparison.
- No evidence of pulmonary artery embolism. No signs of right heart strain.
- Coronary sclerosis. Mitral valve sclerosis. No circumferential pericardial effusion. Aneurysm of the ascending aorta (5 cm), ectasia of other captured aortic segments, significant aortic elongation.
- Largely stable, at most slightly basally redistributed right pleural effusion with up to 6 cm dorsal rim wiRXh and adjacent lower lobe atelectasis. Small pleural effusion on the left as well. No pneumothorax.
- Thickened bronchial walls and peribronchial consolidations in the dorsobasal left lower lobe, differential diagnosis pneumonia. Emphysematous changes in lung structure.
- Oncological status in the thorax appears unchanged in the short term. Captured mass in the right renal fossa unchanged.
- Demers catheter via right jugular vein with tip in the superior vena cava.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Z. n. Körperverletzung. Fraktur? ICB?  Untersuchungstechnik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native Akquisition des Neurokraniums, des Viszerokraniums und der Halswirbelsäule. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen.  Befund und Beurteilung: Keine vergleichbaren Voraufnahmen.  Neurokranium: •    Keine intrakranielle Blutung. •    Keine demarkierte oder sich demarkierende Ischämie. •    Keine Mittellinienverlagerung. Keine Herniation. Kein Liquoraufstau. •    Keine Frakturen. Prellmarke links frontal.  Viszerokranium: •    Verdacht auf nicht dislozierte Nasenbeinfraktur. Im Übrigen keine Frakturen. •    Nasennebenhöhlen, Paukenhöhlen und Mastoidzellen frei belüftet.  Halswirbelsäule: •    Keine Frakturen. •    Keine Alignmentstörungen. •    Keine höhergradigen degenerative Veränderungen. •    Unauffällige Darstellung der Halsweichteile und der miterfassten Lungenabschnitte.
translation: Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Status post assault. Fracture? Intracerebral bleeding? Examination Technique: Digital overview radiographs. Native acquisition of the neurocranium, viscerocranium, and cervical spine. Multiplanar reconstructions. Findings and Assessment: No comparable prior images. Neurocranium: •    No intracranial bleeding. •    No demarcated or demarcating ischemia. •    No midline shift. No herniation. No cerebrospinal fluid accumulation. •    No fractures. Contusion mark left frontal. Viscerocranium: •    Suspicion of non-displaced nasal bone fracture. Otherwise, no fractures. •    Paranasal sinuses, tympanic cavities, and mastoid air cells are well aerated. Cervical Spine: •    No fractures. •    No alignment abnormalities. •    No significant degenerative changes. •    Unremarkable appearance of the cervical soft tissues and included lung sections.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Covid 19 mit Infiltrat im Röntgenthorax. Frage nach Milchglasinfiltraten/bakterielle Superinfektion.   Technik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Natives MS CT des Thorax in axialer Schichtung. Multiplanare Rekonstruktion. Dosislängenprodukt: 51,6 mGy.cm.  Befund und Beurteilung: Röntgen Thorax von heute zum Vergleich.  •    Leichte Dystelektase mediales Mittellappensegment (S5/664), DD ältere Infektion, kein Nachweis frischer pneumonischer Infiltrate. Kein Anhalt für bakterielle Superinfektion. Keine Milchglastrübungen. DD postentzündlich kleine subpleurale Knoten im linken Unterlappen. •    Keine Pleuraergüsse. Kein Pneumothorax. Keine malignomsuspekte pulmonale Raumforderung. •    Im miterfassten Oberbauch keine freie Luft und keine freie Flüssigkeit. •    In Konsolidierung befindliche nicht dislozierte Rippenfraktur rechts (dorsale Costa 10). •    Degenerative BWS-Veränderungen mit Spondylosis deformans. Kein Nachweis frischer ossärer Läsionen.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: COVID-19 with infiltrate on chest X-ray. Query regarding ground-glass opacities/bacterial superinfection.

Technique: Digital overview radiographs. Non-contrast MS CT of the thorax in axial slices. Multiplanar reconstruction. Dose-length product: 51.6 mGy.cm.

Findings and Assessment: Today's chest X-ray for comparison.

- Mild atelectasis in the medial segment of the middle lobe (S5/664), differential diagnosis includes previous infection, no evidence of new pneumonic infiltrates. No indication of bacterial superinfection. No ground-glass opacities. Differential diagnosis suggests post-inflammatory small subpleural nodules in the left lower lobe.
- No pleural effusions. No pneumothorax. No pulmonary mass suspicious for malignancy.
- No free air or free fluid in the included upper abdomen.
- Healing non-displaced rib fracture on the right (dorsal 10th rib).
- Degenerative changes in the thoracic spine with spondylosis deformans. No evidence of new bony lesions.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Z. n. Subileus. Z. n. Ileus OP 2004. Verdacht auf Ileus/Subileus.  Aufklärung und Einwilligung: Nach Erhebung der Risikoanamnese mündliche und schriftliche Aufklärung über die Kontrastmittelapplikation und den Untersuchungsablauf sowie mögliche Risiken der Untersuchung (vergleiche auch Aufklärungsbeleg). Schriftliche Einwilligung des Patienten.  Technik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. MS CT des Abdomens in axialer Schichtung und venöser Kontrastmittelphase. Komplikationslose Applikation von 120 ml Xenetix-350. Multiplanare Rekonstruktion. Dosislängenprodukt: 1156,8 mGy.cm.  Befund und Beurteilung: CT Abdomen vom 03.04.23 zum Vergleich.  •    Leber nicht vergrößert und glatt berandet mit homogener Binnenstruktur. Keine intra- oder extrahepatische Cholestase. Unauffällige Darstellung der Gallenblase. Homogene Pfortader Kontrastierung. DHC nicht dilatiert. •    Milz grenzwertig groß (Polabstand 12 cm) mit homogener Berandung und ohne Nachweis fokaler Läsionen. Pankreas organtypisch lobuliert. Keine Dilatation des Ductus pancreaticus. Kein Nachweis fokaler Läsionen. Nebennieren unauffällig. •    Nieren normal groß und seitengleich kontrastiert. Keine Dilatation der harnableitenden Wege. Harnblase nur gering gefüllt. Keine Wandverdickung. •    Gering distendierte Ileumschlingen im Mittelbauch (z.B. Serie 3, Bild 421). OP-Clips im Mittelbauch idem. Z. n. Appendektomie. Reizlos imponierendes Nahtmaterial im Sigma (Serie 4 Bild 451). Keine freie Luft und keine freie Flüssigkeit. •    Kein Nachweis pathologisch vergrößerter oder konfigurierter mesenterialer, retroperitonealer oder iliakaler Lymphknoten. •    Fettgefüllte Umbilikalhernie. •    Unauffällige Darstellung der miterfassten unteren Lungenabschnitte. •    Kein Nachweis entzündungssuspekter Osteodestruktionen.  Zusammenfassende Beurteilung: Gering distendierte Dünndarmschlingen im Mittelbauch ohne Anhalt für einen Passagestop oder ein mechanisches Passagehindernis. Keine freie Luft, geringe Mengen freier Flüssigkeit im Unterbauch. Kein Nachweis eines überzeugenden abdominellen Infektfokus.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination: Status post subileus. Status post ileus surgery in 2004. Suspected ileus/subileus. 

Consent and Explanation: After taking a risk history, verbal and written explanation was provided regarding the contrast application and examination procedure, as well as potential risks of the examination (see also consent form). Written consent from the patient was obtained.

Technique: Digital overview radiographs. Multislice CT of the abdomen in axial sections and venous contrast phase. Uncomplicated administration of 120 ml Xenetix-350. Multiplanar reconstruction. Dose-length product: 1156.8 mGy.cm.

Findings and Assessment: CT abdomen from 04/03/23 for comparison.

- Liver is not enlarged and has smooth margins with a homogeneous internal structure. No intra- or extrahepatic cholestasis. Gallbladder appears normal. Homogeneous portal vein contrast. Common bile duct not dilated.
- Spleen is borderline enlarged (pole-to-pole distance 12 cm) with homogeneous margins and no evidence of focal lesions. Pancreas is lobulated as typical for the organ. No dilation of the pancreatic duct. No evidence of focal lesions. Adrenal glands are unremarkable.
- Kidneys are normal in size and show symmetrical contrast enhancement. No dilation of the urinary tract. Bladder is only slightly filled. No wall thickening.
- Slightly distended ileal loops in the mid-abdomen (e.g., series 3, image 421). Surgical clips in the mid-abdomen as well. Status post appendectomy. Suture material in the sigmoid colon appears non-irritating (series 4, image 451). No free air and no free fluid.
- No evidence of pathologically enlarged or configured mesenteric, retroperitoneal, or iliac lymph nodes.
- Fat-filled umbilical hernia.
- Unremarkable appearance of the included lower lung sections.
- No evidence of osteodestruction suggestive of inflammation.

Summary Assessment: Slightly distended small bowel loops in the mid-abdomen without evidence of an obstruction or mechanical passage hindrance. No free air, small amounts of free fluid in the lower abdomen. No evidence of a convincing abdominal infection focus.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Z.n. TEP einer Leistenhernie rechts. Frage nach Hernie.  Aufklärung und Einwilligung: Nach Erhebung der Risikoanamnese mündliche und schriftliche Aufklärung über die Kontrastmittelapplikation und den Untersuchungsablauf sowie mögliche Risiken der Untersuchung (vergleiche auch Aufklärungsbeleg). Schriftliche Einwilligung des Patienten.  Technik: Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. MS CT des Abdomens in axialer Schichtung und venöser Kontrastmittelphase. Komplikationslose Applikation von 120 ml Xenetix-350. Multiplanare Rekonstruktion. Dosislängenprodukt: 240 mGy.cm.  Befund und Beurteilung: Keine entsprechenden Voraufnahmen.  •    Rechts inguinale Hernie mit prolabierter Ileumschlinge samt Meso (ca. 6,3 x 3 cm in Serie 4 Bild 511 oder Serie 4, Bild 484). Im Vergleich zum übrigen Dünndarm zeigt sich die hernierte Schlinge etwas flauer Kontrastierung, DD als Anhalt für eine Inkarzeration. •    Imbibiertes Fettgewebe am Anulus umbilicalis und angrenzend am Rectus abdominis (Serie 4 Bild 334). Geringe Mengen freier Flüssigkeit im OP-Gebiet. •    Leber und Milz unauffällig. Keine intra- oder extrahepatische Cholestase. Kleine Nebenmilz (Serie 4 Bild 188). Pankreas organtypisch lobuliert. •    Nieren seitengleich kontrastiert. Kleine zystoide Läsion im rechten kortikalen Unterpol der rechten Niere, am ehesten parapelvine Zyste links. Akzentuiertes Nierenbecken und prominenter Ureter links DD aufsteigender HWI. Klinik? Die Harnblase imponiert bei geringem Füllungszustand wandverdickt. •    Keine pathologisch distendierten Darmschlingen. Keine freie Luft und keine freie Flüssigkeit. •    Keine abdominelle Lymphadenopathie. •    Unauffällige Darstellung der miterfassten unteren Lungenabschnitte. •    Älter imponierende Impression der Deckplatte von LWK 5 DD degenerativ. Kein Nachweis entzündungssuspekter Osteodestruktionen.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination: Status post total extraperitoneal (TEP) repair of a right inguinal hernia. Query for hernia. 

Consent and Explanation: After taking a risk history, both oral and written explanations were provided regarding the contrast medium application, examination procedure, and potential risks (see also consent form). Written consent obtained from the patient.

Technique: Digital overview radiographs. Multislice CT of the abdomen in axial sections and venous contrast phase. Uncomplicated administration of 120 ml Xenetix-350. Multiplanar reconstruction. Dose-length product: 240 mGy.cm.

Findings and Assessment: No previous images available for comparison.

- Right inguinal hernia with prolapsed ileal loop including mesentery (approximately 6.3 x 3 cm in series 4 image 511 or series 4, image 484). Compared to the rest of the small intestine, the herniated loop shows slightly reduced contrast, differential diagnosis suggests possible incarceration.
- Infiltrated fatty tissue at the umbilical ring and adjacent to the rectus abdominis (series 4 image 334). Small amounts of free fluid in the surgical area.
- Liver and spleen are unremarkable. No intra- or extrahepatic cholestasis. Small accessory spleen (series 4 image 188). Pancreas shows typical lobulated structure.
- Kidneys show symmetrical contrast enhancement. Small cystic lesion in the right cortical lower pole of the right kidney, most likely a parapelvic cyst on the left. Accentuated renal pelvis and prominent ureter on the left, differential diagnosis suggests ascending urinary tract infection. Clinical correlation needed? The bladder appears wall-thickened with low filling state.
- No pathologically distended bowel loops. No free air and no free fluid.
- No abdominal lymphadenopathy.
- Unremarkable depiction of the included lower lung sections.
- Older appearing impression of the endplate of L5, likely degenerative. No evidence of osteodestruction suggestive of inflammation.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: NSCLC unter IO Therapie. VK, Metastasen?  Technik: 1,5 T MRT des Kopfes. Lokalisationssequenzen. T2 TSE FS axial, T2 FL2D hemo axial, DWI/ADC axial, T2 TIRM coronar, T1 flash axial prä- und post-KM (6,40 ml Gadovist) mit Subtraktion, MPRAGE.  Befund: Vergleich mit den externen MR-Voraufnahmen   Konstanter Defekt des dorsobasalen Kleinhirns beidseits (links paramedian betont) mit Suszeptibilitätsartefakten im Randbereich. Kein pathologisches KM-Enhancement bei bekannten punktförmigen T2w-Hyperintersitäten des zerebralen Marklagers und winzigen lakunären Defekten bds. kapsulostriatal (jeweils a. e. mikroangiopathisch). Mittelständiger Interhemispherenspaltt. Keine Einklemmungszeichen. Regelrechte Weite der externen Liquorzisternen und des symmetrischen Ventrikelsystems. Kleinhirnbrückenwinkel bds. frei. Sehr flach konfigurierte Hypophyse i.S. einer „Empty Sella“. Meningen ohne pathologische Verdickung oder KM-Affinität. Unauffällige und symmetrische Darstellung der Orbitae. Erhaltenes T2w-flow-void der großen intrakraniellen Blutleiter. Regelrechtes Signal von Kalotte und Schädelbasis. Mastoidzellen frei belüftet. Schleimhautschwellung der Ethmoidalzellen.  Beurteilung: Stable disease - Kein Nachweis neuer intrakranieller Metastasen. Konstanter zerebellärer Defekt mit residueller Hämosiderinablagerungen.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: NSCLC under immunotherapy. Follow-up, metastases? 

Technique: 1.5 T MRI of the head. Localization sequences. Axial T2 TSE FS, axial T2 FL2D hemo, axial DWI/ADC, coronal T2 TIRM, axial T1 flash pre- and post-contrast (6.40 ml Gadovist) with subtraction, MPRAGE.

Findings: Comparison with previous external MRI scans. Persistent defect in the dorsobasal cerebellum on both sides (more pronounced on the left paramedian) with susceptibility artifacts at the margins. No pathological contrast enhancement with known punctate T2-weighted hyperintensities in the cerebral white matter and tiny lacunar defects bilaterally in the capsulostriatal region (likely microangiopathic). Midline interhemispheric fissure. No signs of herniation. Normal wiRXh of the external cerebrospinal fluid cisterns and the symmetrical ventricular system. Cerebellopontine angles are clear on both sides. Very shallow configuration of the pituitary gland suggestive of an "empty sella." Meninges without pathological thickening or contrast affinity. Normal and symmetrical appearance of the orbits. Preserved T2-weighted flow void of the major intracranial blood vessels. Normal signal from the calvarium and skull base. Mastoid air cells are well-aerated. Mucosal swelling of the ethmoid cells.

Impression: Stable disease - No evidence of new intracranial metastases. Persistent cerebellar defect with residual hemosiderin deposits.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: Hydrocephalus / Shunt mit multiplen Ventilen. Befunderfassung.  Methodik: 3T MRT des Kopfes. Lokalisationssequenzen. T2 SPC 3D iso, 3D CISS über dem Aquädukt und Liquorflusssequenzen, 3D T1 MPRAGE.  Befund: Vergleich mit den externen MRT-Voraufnahmen.  Bekanntlich beidseitig einliegende VP-Shunts: Von links frontal mit Spitze im dritten Ventrikel via dem li. Foramen Monroi sowie von rechts parietal mit Spitze im rechten SV-Hinterhorn. Wie in den VA stellen sich die Ventrikel hierbei schlitzförmig dar. Normal weite (eher schmale) basale Liquorzisternen. In den Liquorflusssequenzen kein Nachweis einer relevanten Liquorabflussstörung. Keine Mittellinienverlagerung. Älterer Bohrlochdefekt der Kalotte links parietal mit angrenzendem Stichkanal im linken Parietallappen und Gliosezone am li. SV-Hinterhirn. Langfristig konstante periventrikuläre Marklagergliosen und bekannte Atrophie des rechten Marklagers sowie des Spleniums. Bekannte Dysplasie der Sella turcica mit breit angelegter, partiell extrasellärer Hypophyse und geringer Auslenkung des Infundibulums nach rechts. Erhaltenes T2w Flow void der größeren intrakraniellen Gefäße. Unauffälliges Knochensignal des Neurokraniums außerhalb der benannten Trepanationsdefekte. Kleiner Sekretverhalt in den rechten Mastoidzellen. Zirkuläre bis polypöse Schleimhautschwellung der rechten Kieferhöhle.  Beurteilung: Keine Dislokation der bekannten Ventrikelshunts. bekannte schlitzförmige Konfiguration der inneren Liquorräume und partiell verdickte Kalotte als Zeichen einer chron. Überdrainage.
translation: Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Hydrocephalus / Shunt with multiple valves. Findings. Methodology: 3T MRI of the head. Localization sequences. T2 SPC 3D iso, 3D CISS over the aqueduct and CSF flow sequences, 3D T1 MPRAGE. Findings: Comparison with previous external MRI scans. Known bilateral VP shunts: From the left frontal region with the tip in the third ventricle via the left foramen of Monro and from the right parietal region with the tip in the right lateral ventricle's posterior horn. As in previous exams, the ventricles appear slit-like. Basal cisterns are of normal wiRXh (rather narrow). No evidence of significant CSF flow obstruction in the flow sequences. No midline shift. Older burr hole defect in the left parietal skull with an adjacent tract in the left parietal lobe and a gliosis zone in the left lateral ventricle's posterior region. Long-standing stable periventricular white matter gliosis and known atrophy of the right white matter and the splenium. Known dysplasia of the sella turcica with a broadly based, partially extrasellar pituitary gland and slight deviation of the infundibulum to the right. Preserved T2-weighted flow void of the major intracranial vessels. Unremarkable bone signal of the neurocranium outside the mentioned trepanation defects. Small fluid retention in the right mastoid cells. Circular to polypoid mucosal swelling of the right maxillary sinus. Impression: No dislocation of the known ventricular shunts. Known slit-like configuration of the internal CSF spaces and partially thickened skull as a sign of chronic overdrainage.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: Glioblastom WHO IV. Rezidiv / Progress? neue Läsionen?  Technik: MRT Kopf 1,5 T: Scout. T2 TSE fs axial, T2 Flash Hemo axial, DWI axial mit ADC-Mapping, T2 TIRM koronar dark-fluid, T1 Flash axial prä- und post-KM (8,5 ml Gadovist i.v.) mit Subtraktion, T1-MPRAGE sagittal mit Rekonstruktionen.  Befund: Vergleich mit den letzten MR-Voraufnahmen.  Im Verlauf Konstante Resektionshöhle links temporal in Kommunikation mit dem linken Seitenventrikel mit flächiger Marklagergliose links temporal bis parietal / okzipital. Im kurzfristigen Verlauf konstantes im längerfristigen Verlauf  regredientes noduläres KM-Enhancement im mediokaudalen Randbereich (Se16/Im77-84). Seit der MR VU  dort neu aufgetretenes, jetzt konstante punktförmige Schrankenstörung im Thalamus links (Se. 15 Img. 108). In der letzten MR VU neue aufgetreten und jetzt hierzu konstanten Darstellung einer flau KM-enhancenden Läsion im Balken links mit angrenzendem konstantem Ödem. Keine pathologische Diffusionsrestriktion. In der Hemosequenz keine pathologischen Suszeptibilitätsartefakte. Keine Mittellinienverlagerung oder Herniation. Basale Liquorzisternen inkl. Kleinhirnbrückenwinkel frei einsehbar. Kein akuter Liquorafstau. Unauffällige Darstellung der Hypophyse und Epiphyse. Orbitae beidseits regelrecht. Erhaltenes T2w-flow-void der größeren intrakraniellen Blutleiter. Z. n. osteoplastischer Kraniotomie links temporal mit Deckung im Niveau, übriges knöchernes Neurokranium unauffällig. Mastoidzellen und NNH belüftet.  Beurteilung: Im langfristigen Verlauf konstante Darstellung der nodulären Schrankenstörung im Randbereich der Resektionshöhle. Kurzfristig konstante Darstellung in den letzten VU neu aufgetretenen Läsionen links thalamisch und im Balken links. Keine neuen malignitätssuspekten Läsionen.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Glioblastoma WHO Grade IV. Recurrence/Progression? New lesions? 

Technique: MRI of the head at 1.5 T: Scout. Axial T2 TSE with fat saturation, Axial T2 Flash Hemo, Axial DWI with ADC mapping, Coronal T2 TIRM dark-fluid, Axial T1 Flash pre- and post-contrast (8.5 ml Gadovist i.v.) with subtraction, Sagittal T1-MPRAGE with reconstructions.

Findings: Comparison with previous MRI scans. Over time, there is a stable resection cavity in the left temporal region communicating with the left lateral ventricle, with extensive white matter gliosis extending from the left temporal to parietal/occipital regions. In the short term, there is stable, and in the long term, regressing nodular contrast enhancement at the mediocaudal margin (Se16/Im77-84). Since the last MRI, a newly appeared, now stable, pinpoint enhancement in the left thalamus (Se. 15 Img. 108). In the last MRI, a newly appeared and now stable faintly enhancing lesion in the left corpus callosum with adjacent stable edema. No pathological diffusion restriction. No pathological susceptibility artifacts in the hemo sequence. No midline shift or herniation. Basal cisterns, including the cerebellopontine angle, are clearly visible. No acute cerebrospinal fluid obstruction. Normal appearance of the pituitary and pineal glands. Orbits are normal on both sides. Preserved T2-weighted flow void of the major intracranial blood vessels. Status post osteoplastic craniotomy in the left temporal region with level coverage, the remaining bony neurocranium is unremarkable. Mastoid air cells and paranasal sinuses are aerated.

Conclusion: Over the long term, stable appearance of the nodular enhancement at the margin of the resection cavity. In the short term, stable appearance of newly appeared lesions in the left thalamus and left corpus callosum in the last examination. No new lesions suspicious for malignancy.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: ZNS-Lymphom. Z. n. SteroiRXherapie; Depression + Verwirrtheit, Korrelat? Progress?  Technik: 1,5 Tesla MRT des Kopfes. Befund: Vergleich zur letzten MRT-Untersuchung Kein Nachweis von Marklagerläsionen außerhalb der bekannten punktförmigen supratentoriellen T2w Hyperintensitäten und initialem Lining bds. periventrikulär. Beurteilung: Kein Rezidiv der vollständig regredienten zerebralen Lymphommanifestationen. Kein Nachweis einer neuen malignitätssuspekten Schrankenstörung. oder einer anderweitigen Akutpathologie.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: CNS lymphoma. Status post steroid therapy; depression + confusion, correlation? Progression? 

Technique: 1.5 Tesla MRI of the head. Localizer, T2 TSE FS axial, T1 FL2D axial, T2 FL2D axial Hemo, DWI with ADC mapping, T2 TIRM coronal dark-fluid, after uncomplicated intravenous administration of 7.5 ml Gadovist, T1 FL2D axial with subtraction and T1-MPRAGE sagittal with MPR.

Findings: Compared to the previous MRI examination, there is no evidence of white matter lesions outside of the known punctate supratentorial T2-weighted hyperintensities and initial lining bilaterally periventricularly. No pathological contrast enhancement. No generalized or focal edema. No pathological diffusion restrictions or susceptibility artifacts suggestive of bleeding. Known prominence of the internal and external cerebrospinal fluid spaces with preserved symmetry. Pituitary gland size appropriate for age, pineal gland unremarkable. Normal appearance of the orbits. Normal T2-weighted flow void of the major intracranial blood vessels. Paranasal sinuses and mastoid air cells are aerated. Normal signal of the skull cap and bony skull base.

Conclusion: No recurrence of the completely regressed cerebral lymphoma manifestations. No evidence of a new malignancy-suspect barrier disruption or any other acute pathology.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Aderhautmelanom, pulmonal und zerebral metastasiert, Verlaufskontrolle.  Technik: 1,5-Tesla-MRT des Neurokraniums. Localizer. T2 FLAIR axial, T2 TSE axial, T1 SE axial und sagittal, DWI/ADC axial, SWI axial. Nach i.v. Applikation von 8 ml Gadovist T1 SE axial, T1-MPRAGE.  Befund: Es liegen Voraufnahmen zum Vergleich vor.  Weiter gering größenregrediente randständig schrankengestörte Raumforderung links temporal, aktuell bis 9 x 8 mm messend (Serie 15/63; VU: 12 x 8 mm). Allenfalls nur noch sehr flau abgrenzbare Metastase im medialen hinteren cerebellum (Serie 15/49; VU: 3 x 2 mm). Kein Nachweis einer neuen metastasensuspekten Raumforderung. Größenkonstantes frontales Falxmeningeom bis 30 mm Durchmesser (sehr 15/130). Von links frontal einliegende Ventrikeldrainage mit Spitze im linken Seitenventrikelvorderhorn. Unveränderte Asymmetrie der Seitenventrikel (rechts > links). Kein Liquoraufstau. Keine Mittellinienverlagerung. Keine Herniation. Flächiges Defektareal rechts frontotemporal. Unveränderte Gliosezone links frontal im Bereich des einliegenden Shunts. Keine Blutungs-suspekten Suszebiltätsartefakte. Keine für eine frische Ischämie suspekte Diffusionsrestriktion. Z. n. Hemikraniektomie rechts. Teilverlegte Mastoidzellen beidseits sowie basale Schleimhautschwellung im Sinus maxillaris beidseits. Weiter größenregrediente Weichteilmetastase an der Cutis am linken Mastikatorraum, aktuell bis 7 mm Durchmesser (Serie 15/730; VU: 11 x 8 mm).  Beurteilung: •    Weiter größenregrediente links temporomesiale Metastase sowie allenfalls noch fraglich abgrenzbare zerebelläre Metastase. Kein Nachweis neuer intrakranieller Metastasen. •    Miterfasst Größenregredienz der Weichteilmetastase angrenzend an den Mastikatorraum links. •    Größenkonstantes Falxmeningeom.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Choroidal melanoma with pulmonary and cerebral metastases, follow-up evaluation. 

Technique: 1.5-Tesla MRI of the brain. Localizer. Axial T2 FLAIR, axial T2 TSE, axial and sagittal T1 SE, axial DWI/ADC, axial SWI. Post-contrast administration of 8 ml Gadovist, axial T1 SE, T1-MPRAGE.

Findings: Previous images are available for comparison. There is a further slight reduction in size of the peripheral lesion with blood-brain barrier disruption in the left temporal region, currently measuring up to 9 x 8 mm (Series 15/63; previous: 12 x 8 mm). A cerebellar metastasis in the medial posterior region is now barely discernible (Series 15/49; previous: 3 x 2 mm). No evidence of new suspicious metastatic lesions. A stable-sized frontal falx meningioma measuring up to 30 mm in diameter (Series 15/130). A ventricular drain is present from the left frontal region, with the tip in the anterior horn of the left lateral ventricle. Unchanged asymmetry of the lateral ventricles (right > left). No cerebrospinal fluid accumulation. No midline shift. No herniation. A broad defect area in the right frontotemporal region. Unchanged gliosis zone in the left frontal region near the shunt. No susceptibility artifacts suggestive of bleeding. No diffusion restriction indicative of acute ischemia. Status post right hemicraniectomy. Partially opacified mastoid air cells on both sides and basal mucosal swelling in the maxillary sinuses on both sides. Further reduction in size of the soft tissue metastasis in the skin of the left masticator space, currently up to 7 mm in diameter (Series 15/730; previous: 11 x 8 mm).

Impression:
- Further reduction in size of the left temporomesial metastasis and a cerebellar metastasis that is now barely discernible. No evidence of new intracranial metastases.
- Noted reduction in size of the soft tissue metastasis adjacent to the left masticator space.
- Stable-sized falx meningioma.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Morbus Crohn, Z. n. rektovaginaler Fistel und Gracilisflap links. Verlaufsbildgebung erbeten.  Technik: 1,5-Tesla-MRT des Beckens. Localizer. T1 TSE se axial, T2 TIRM sagittal, T2 TSE axial und koronar. Nach i.v. Applikation von 7 ml Gadovist T1-TSE axial koronar und sagittal.  Befund: Aktuell einliegender Faden in dem bekannten Defekt der Rektumvorderwand ca. 2,5 cm ab ano mit Verlauf über den Gracilisflap unterhalb der Vaginalhinterwand. (Serie 9/36). Regrediente Ödematisierung des linksseitigen Gracilisflaps. Kein Nachweis eines neuen Fistelganges. Minimal freie Flüssigkeit pelvin. Miterfasstes Stoma im rechten Unterbauch. Keine pathologisch distendierten Darmschlingen. Keine vergrößerten Lymphknoten. Unauffällige Darstellung ossären Strukturen.  Beurteilung Weiterhin nicht vollständig ausgranuliert imponierender Defekt der Rektumvorderwand mit Fistelverlauf direkt unterhalb der Vaginalhinterwand bei einliegendem Faden.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Crohn's disease, status post rectovaginal fistula and left gracilis flap. Follow-up imaging requested.

Technique: 1.5-Tesla MRI of the pelvis. Localizer. T1 TSE axial, T2 TIRM sagittal, T2 TSE axial and coronal. Post intravenous administration of 7 ml Gadovist, T1-TSE axial, coronal, and sagittal.

Findings: Currently, there is a suture present in the known defect of the anterior rectal wall approximately 2.5 cm from the anus, extending over the gracilis flap beneath the posterior vaginal wall (Series 9/36). There is regressing edema of the left gracilis flap. No evidence of a new fistulous tract. Minimal free fluid in the pelvis. The stoma in the right lower abdomen is included in the imaging. No pathologically distended bowel loops. No enlarged lymph nodes. The bony structures appear unremarkable.

Impression: The defect in the anterior rectal wall, with the fistulous tract directly beneath the posterior vaginal wall and the presence of a suture, continues to appear not fully granulated.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Metastasiertes Aderhautmelanom. Frage nach Lebermetastasen.  Technik: 3-Tesla-MRT des Oberbauchs. Localizer. T2 Haste koronar axial, T1 Flash IN/OPP axial, T1 Vibe Dixon nativ und zu verschiedenen Zeitpunkten i.v. Applikation von 10 ml Primovist, T1 Vibe Dixon koronar, T2 Haste TSE axial, DWI/ADC axial.  Befund: T1w nativ hyperintense und T2w flau hyperintense Raumforderung mit korrespondierendem Primovistspeicherdefekt direkt subdiaphragmal in Segment 2 mit 23 mm Durchmesser (16/25). Weitere Läsion im Segment 6 mit 15 mm Durchmesser (Serie 16/47). Weitere kleinste Läsionen im oberen Segment 6, 3 mm (Serie 17/31 bzw. 14/67). Drei fokale Signalauslöschungen rechts unter der Zwerchfellkuppel (Serie 13, Bild 10) ohne Korrelat in der DWI. Z. n. CCE. Keine intra- oder extrahepatische Cholestase. Pankreas fettig atrophiert, Ductus schlank. Milz nicht vergrößert, keine fokalen Läsionen. Nebenmilz am ventralen Pol mit 6 mm Durchmesser. Nebennieren beidseits zart. Nieren in orthotoper Lage und seitengleich kontrastiert mit multiplen parapelvinen Nierenzysten beidseits. Keine malignitätssuspekte Raumforderung. Kein Harnstau. Keine pathologisch distendierten Darmschlingen. Keine freie Flüssigkeit. Keine malignitätssuspekt konfigurierten Lymphknoten. Durchgängiges Flusssignal großen Abdominalgefäße. In der basal erfassten Lunge keine größere Konsolidierung. Kein basaler Pleura- oder Perikarderguss. Keine ossären Destruktionen. Mehrere intraspongiöse Bandscheibenherniationen.  Beurteilung: •    Nachweis dreier Lebermetastasen: in Segment 2 mit 30 mm Durchmessers sowie in Segment 6 mit 3 bzw. 15 mm Durchmesser. •    Darüber hinaus keine Lymphknoten oder Fernmetastasen im Oberbauch.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination: Metastatic choroidal melanoma. Query regarding liver metastases.

Technique: 3-Tesla MRI of the upper abdomen. Localizer. T2 Haste coronal axial, T1 Flash IN/OPP axial, T1 Vibe Dixon native and at various time points post i.v. administration of 10 ml Primovist, T1 Vibe Dixon coronal, T2 Haste TSE axial, DWI/ADC axial.

Findings: A T1-weighted native hyperintense and T2-weighted mildly hyperintense mass with a corresponding Primovist uptake defect is located directly subdiaphragmatically in segment 2, measuring 23 mm in diameter (16/25). Another lesion in segment 6 measures 15 mm in diameter (series 16/47). Additional tiny lesions in the upper segment 6, measuring 3 mm (series 17/31 and 14/67). Three focal signal voids are noted on the right under the diaphragm dome (series 13, image 10) without correlation in DWI. Status post CCE. No intra- or extrahepatic cholestasis. The pancreas is fatty and atrophied, with a slender duct. The spleen is not enlarged, with no focal lesions. An accessory spleen is present at the ventral pole, measuring 6 mm in diameter. Adrenal glands are delicate on both sides. Kidneys are in orthotopic position and symmetrically enhanced with multiple parapelvic renal cysts on both sides. No space-occupying lesions suspicious for malignancy. No urinary obstruction. No pathologically distended bowel loops. No free fluid. No lymph nodes suspicious for malignancy. Continuous flow signal in major abdominal vessels. In the lung bases, no significant consolidation. No basal pleural or pericardial effusion. No osseous destruction. Several intraspongious disc herniations.

Conclusion:
- Evidence of three liver metastases: in segment 2 measuring 30 mm in diameter, and in segment 6 measuring 3 mm and 15 mm in diameter.
- No lymph node involvement or distant metastases in the upper abdomen.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: Schwindel unklarer Genese. Frage nach strukturellem Korrelat.  Technik: 3-Tesla-MRT des Neurokraniums. Localizer. T2 TSE fs axial, T1 flash axial, SWI axial, DWI/ADC axial, T2 TIRM koronar, T1-MPRAGE.  Befund: Keine Voraufnahmen.  Das altermaß überschreitende frontotemporal betonte Hirnvolumenminderung. Seitenventrikel schlank und symmetrisch, vierter Ventrikel frei entfaltet. Keine Mittelinienverlagerung. Keine Herniation. Regelrechte Signalgebung des Kortexbandes, der Basalganglien, des Kleinhirns und des Hirnstammes. Keine Blutungs-suspekten Suszebiltätsartefakte. Polypöse Schleimhautschwellung des basalen Sinus maxillaris links, einzelne verlegte Mastoidzellen. translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Dizziness of unclear origin. Query regarding structural correlation. 

Technique: 3-Tesla MRI of the neurocranium. Localizer. T2 TSE fs axial, T1 flash axial, SWI axial, DWI/ADC axial, T2 TIRM coronal, T1-MPRAGE.

Findings: No prior images available. There is a reduction in brain volume, exceeding what is expected for age, with a frontotemporal emphasis. The lateral ventricles are narrow and symmetrical, and the fourth ventricle is fully developed. No midline shift. No herniation. Normal signal characteristics of the cortical ribbon, basal ganglia, cerebellum, and brainstem. No susceptibility artifacts suggestive of bleeding. No diffusion restriction indicative of acute ischemia. Normal signal characteristics of the skull cap and skull base. Polypoid mucosal swelling of the left basal maxillary sinus, with some occluded mastoid cells.

Impression:
• No structural correlate for the symptoms.
• Brain volume reduction exceeding age expectations.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: Unklare Wirbelkörperfraktur DD maligne. Frage nach Wirbelkörpermetastasen.  Technik: 1,5-Tesla-MRT der Wirbelsäule. Localizer. translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Unclear vertebral fracture, differential diagnosis of malignancy. Query regarding vertebral metastases.

Technique: 1.5-Tesla MRI of the spine. Localizer. T2 TIRM sagittal, T2 TSE sagittal, T1-TSE sagittal, T1-TSE fs axial, and T2 TSE sagittal as indicated.

Findings/Assessment:
- Recent fracture of T10 vertebra with avulsion of osteophytes and underlying fluid signal in the vertebral body and disc at T10/11 (Series 12/8), differential diagnosis post-traumatic, differential diagnosis inflammatory due to diffuse surrounding reaction suggestive of spondylodiscitis (without epidural abscess). Minor posterior displacement up to 3 mm. Moderate spinal canal stenosis at this level.
- Up to 3 mm of unclear epidural fluid collection in the anterior spinal canal at the level of C2/3 (Series 12/11) without significant spinal canal stenosis, appearing as protein-rich fluid. No evidence of dens fracture.
- Older fractures of T1, T2, T3, T6, T8, T12, L1, L4, and L5. Status post kyphoplasty of T12 and L1 with posterior displacement of T12 by 2 mm (stable compared to previous examination) and L1 by 8 mm, with suspicion of minimally progressive fragment displacement of the superior endplate into the spinal canal (Series 16/8). Mild signal increase in vertebral bodies, differential diagnosis irritation.
- Multisegmental disc protrusion in the cervical spine, most prominent at C3/4, with severe accompanying spinal canal stenosis. Severe neuroforaminal stenosis at L4/5 bilaterally due to caudally displaced disc extrusion and endplate fracture of L4. No myelopathy signal.
- Mild fluid imbibition in the presacral fat tissue. Incidental renal cysts. Otherwise unremarkable soft tissues. Incidental small pleural effusion on both sides.

report: Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: Bekannter Crohn, Schmerzen rechts. Entzündung? Stenose?  Technik: Orale Gabe von 250 ml Osmofundin, i.v. Gave von 2 ml Buscopan. 1,5-Tesla-MRT Abdomen folgenden Sequenzen: Localizer. T2 Haste axial, T1 Flash opp/inn axial, T2 Haste koronar, T2 Haste sagittal, T2 Haste fs koronar, nach i.v. Gabe von 8 ml Gadovist T1 vibe fs koronar dynamische Sequenzen, T1 Flash fs axial, T1 Flash fs koronar, T2 Haste fs koronar, T2 TRUFI koronar.  Befund:  Ca. 7 cm lange vorbekannte Wandverdickung des terminalen Ileums (Serie 7, Image 45-48) ohne Signalsteigerung nach KM-Gabe, keine Ödematisierung in den fettgesättigten T2w-Sequenzen. 4 cm oral davon Wandverdickung des Ileums über 2 cm Länge, weiterhin 3 cm oral über 1 cm lange Wandverdickung des Ileums (Serie 7, Image 51), ebenso ohne Ödematisierung in den fettgesättigten T2w-Sequenzen, keine Signalsteigerung post-KM. Keine pathologisch distendierten Darmschlingen. Keine pathologisch vergrößerten Lymphknoten. Geringe Menge freier Flüssigkeit pelvin, im physiologischen Rahmen. Normal große, glatt berandete Leber, vorbekannte zystoide Läsion im Segment 4b. Keine Erweiterung der intrahepatischen oder extrahepatischen Gallengänge. Normale Lobulierung des Pankreasparenchyms ohne Aufstau des Ductus pancreaticus. Normal große Milz mit homogenem Parenchym, vorbekannte 3 Nebenmilz. Schmale Nebennieren beidseits. Normal große, orthotop gelegene Nieren beidseits, kein Harnstau. Wenig flüssigkeitsgefüllte Harnblase ohne Wandunregelmäßigkeiten. Anteflektierter Uterus. Bekannte Ovula Nabothi der Zervix. Kein flächiges Infiltrat der basalen Lunge. Kein basaler Pleuraerguss oder Perikarderguss. Keine pathologische Signalgebung der mitabgebildeten ossären Strukturen. Vorbekannte geringe Ventrolisthesis von LWK 4, Meyerding Grad I.  Beurteilung: Keine floride Entzündung. Chronisch-entzündliche Wandveränderungen des terminalen Ileums (ca. 7 cm) mit zwei kurzstreckigen (ebenfalls chronischen) „skip-lesions“ im vorgeschalteten Ileum. Keine pathologische Erweiterung der Darmschlingen.
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification: Known Crohn's disease, right-sided pain. Inflammation? Stenosis? 

Technique: Oral administration of 250 ml Osmofundin, intravenous administration of 2 ml Buscopan. 1.5-Tesla MRI of the abdomen with the following sequences: Localizer. Axial T2 Haste, Axial T1 Flash opp/in, Coronal T2 Haste, Sagittal T2 Haste, Coronal T2 Haste fat-saturated, post-contrast administration of 8 ml Gadovist T1 vibe fat-saturated coronal dynamic sequences, Axial T1 Flash fat-saturated, Coronal T1 Flash fat-saturated, Coronal T2 Haste fat-saturated, Coronal T2 TRUFI.

Findings: Approximately 7 cm long previously known wall thickening of the terminal ileum (Series 7, Images 45-48) without signal enhancement after contrast administration, no edema in the fat-saturated T2-weighted sequences. 4 cm proximally, there is a 2 cm long wall thickening of the ileum, and further 3 cm proximally, a 1 cm long wall thickening of the ileum (Series 7, Image 51), also without edema in the fat-saturated T2-weighted sequences, no post-contrast signal enhancement. No pathologically distended bowel loops. No pathologically enlarged lymph nodes. Small amount of free fluid in the pelvis, within physiological limits. Normal-sized, smoothly contoured liver, previously known cystic lesion in segment 4b. No dilation of intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts. Normal lobulation of the pancreatic parenchyma without dilation of the pancreatic duct. Normal-sized spleen with homogeneous parenchyma, previously known 3 accessory spleens. Narrow adrenal glands on both sides. Normal-sized, orthotopically located kidneys on both sides, no urinary obstruction. Slightly fluid-filled bladder without wall irregularities. Anteverted uterus. Known Nabothian cysts of the cervix. No diffuse infiltrate in the basal lung. No basal pleural effusion or pericardial effusion. No pathological signal from the included osseous structures. Previously known slight ventrolisthesis of L4, Meyerding Grade I.

Conclusion: No active inflammation. Chronic inflammatory wall changes of the terminal ileum (approximately 7 cm) with two short-segment (also chronic) "skip lesions" in the proximal ileum. No pathological dilation of the bowel loops.

report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation:
NMDA Rezeptorenzephalitis, niedriggradiges Gliom, MYB/MYBL1, Tumorteilresektion. Tumorprogress?

MRT des Neurokraniums bei 3 Tesla. Rückenlage. Kopfspule. Sequenzen: Lokalisationssequenzen in mehreren Raumebenen, T2 TSE FS axial, T1 FLASH axial, T2 TSE sagittal, T2-FLAIR coronar, EPI DWI axial, T2* axial, T1 MPRAGE sagittal nach Applikation von 2,7 ml Gadovist. 

Befund:
Bekannter Tumor im rechts zerebellären Marklager mit Infiltration des superioren Kortex, der oberen und mittleren zerebellären Pedunkel sowie den inferioren Anteil des Vermis. Die Größe ist unverändert, der Tumor wirkt jedoch insbesondere verglichen mit dem 27.09.2021 etwas weniger voluminös. Unveränderte kleine Resektionshöhle zentral in der Läsion. Kein Enhancement, keine Diffusionsrestriktionen. Diskrete postoperative Hämosiderinablagerungen.
Keine Leukenzephalopathie, keine Atrophie, kein Hinweis für eine Liquorzirkulationsstörung, altersgerecht kleine Hypophyse, keine Mikroblutungen/Karvernome.
Freie Nasennebenhöhlen, Mastoidzellen und Cava tympani.

Beurteilung:
SD bei jedoch insgesamt leicht weniger voluminös erscheinendem Tumor
translation:
Clinical Information, Question, Justification for Examination:
NMDA receptor encephalitis, low-grade glioma, MYB/MYBL1, partial tumor resection. Tumor progression?

MRI of the brain at 3 Tesla. Supine position. Head coil. Sequences: Localization sequences in multiple planes, T2 TSE FS axial, T1 FLASH axial, T2 TSE sagittal, T2-FLAIR coronal, EPI DWI axial, T2* axial, T1 MPRAGE sagittal after administration of 2.7 ml Gadovist.

Findings:
Known tumor in the right cerebellar white matter with infiltration of the superior cortex, the superior and middle cerebellar peduncles, as well as the inferior portion of the vermis. The size is unchanged, but the tumor appears slightly less voluminous compared to the examination on 09/27/2021. Unchanged small resection cavity centrally within the lesion. No enhancement, no diffusion restrictions. Subtle postoperative hemosiderin deposits. 
No leukoencephalopathy, no atrophy, no evidence of cerebrospinal fluid circulation disorder, age-appropriate small pituitary gland, no microbleeds/cavernomas. 
Clear paranasal sinuses, mastoid cells, and tympanic cavities.

Impression:
Stable disease with an overall slightly less voluminous appearance of the tumor.

report: Na nativnoj snimci abdomena učinjenoj u stojećem položaju, ne nalazi se znakova slobodnog plina u abdomenu, distenzije crijevnih vijuga niti patološki formiranih aerolikvidnih nivoa. Stanje po kolecistektomiji.
translation: On the upright abdominal X-ray, there are no signs of free air in the abdomen, bowel loop distension, or abnormal air-fluid levels. Status post-cholecystectomy.

report:
Na sumacijskim PA i LP snimkama torakalnih organa vidljiv je desnostrani pneumotoraks širine plašta apikalno do 33mm. U analizi dostupnom plućnom parenhimu nema formiranih infiltrativnih niti akutnih zastojnih promjena. Kupole ošita oštro su ocrtane i uredno položene. Zasjenjen je desni stražnji fc sinus, može odgovarati manjoj količini pleuralnog izljeva. Slobodni su lijevi fc sinusi. Sjena srca je primjerenog položaja i veličine.
Subkutani emfizem desne lateralne torakale stijenke te manja količina u projekciji desnog lateralnog dijela vrata.
translation: On the summation PA and lateral chest X-rays, there is a right-sided pneumothorax with an apical pleural thickness up to 33mm. In the available lung parenchyma, there are no formed infiltrative or acute congestive changes. The diaphragmatic domes are sharply outlined and properly positioned. The right posterior costophrenic sinus is obscured, which may correspond to a small amount of pleural effusion. The left costophrenic sinuses are clear. The cardiac silhouette is in an appropriate position and size. There is subcutaneous emphysema in the right lateral thoracic wall and a small amount in the projection of the right lateral neck area.

report:
Ne vidi se ileusa. 
Zadebljana stijenka sigmoidnog kolona s brojnim divertikulima uz zamućeno okolno masno tkivo, okolnu slobodnu tekućinu s inkluzijama plina - nalaz može odgovarati akutnom divertikulitisu s perforacijom divertikula.
Na kratkom odsječku sigmoidnog kolona vidi se zadebljana stijenka uz opisane divertikule koja usko priliježe uz lijevu lateralnu stijenku mokraćnog mjehura - u tom području nije moguće isključiti primarni proces u podlozi.

Difuzno zamućeno mezenterijalno masno tkivo s tračcima tekućine.
Paraaortalno, uz ilijačne krvne žile i mezenterijalne krvne žile vide se limfni čvorovi aksijalno kraćeg promjera do 6 mm.

Jetra je uredne veličine, blaže lobuliranih kontura, homogene strukture, bez jasno vidljivih žarišnih lezija. Žučni mjehur se ne prikaže. Stanje nakon kolecistektomije? 
Naglašeni su intrahepatalni žučni vodovi. Ductus choledochus je širine oko 11 mm.
Duodenum privučen prema žučnoj loži. Divertikul silaznog dijela duodenuma promjera oko 17 mm.
Pankreas atrofičan, analiza je otežana. Peripankreatično masno tkivo je očuvano. Slezena je uredne veličine, bez vidljivih žarišnih lezija. Dorzalno od konveksitet vidi se splenunkulus promjera 8 mm.  Bubrezi su urednog položaja, desni dužine 8 cm, lijevi dužine 9 cm, oba segmentalno reducirane debljine parenhima do 11 mm, obostrano nekoliko kortikalnih i ekstrakortikalnih cisti od kojih su pojedine ciste gušćeg sadržaja ili hemoragične ciste. Ne nalazi se dilatacije kanalnog sustava. 
Nadbubrežne žlijezde su uredne veličine, bez fokalnih lezija.
Mokraćni mjehur je primjereno distendiran urinom, bez intraluminalnog patološkog sadržaja. 
Abdominalna aorta je uredne širine.
Obostrano atrofični m.psoas. U koštanom prozoru vide se uznapredovale spondilodegenrativne promjene kralježnice, uz lokalno razjeđenje L3 kralješka. Hemangiom trupa Th10 kralješka. Difuzno smanjena mineralizacija prikazanih kostiju. Na bazalnim presjecima kroz toraks vidi se lijevo lamelarni pleuralni izljev s atelektazom priležećeg parenhima. Obostrano bazalno manje hipoventilacijske promjene. Uvećano srce. Manja hijatalna hernija kardije želuca aksijalno promjera oko 20 mm, širine vrata oko 15 mm. Želudac kolabiran.
translation:
No evidence of ileus. 
The wall of the sigmoid colon is thickened with numerous diverticula, accompanied by hazy surrounding fatty tissue, free fluid with gas inclusions in the area—findings suggestive of acute diverticulitis with diverticular perforation.
In a short segment of the sigmoid colon, the thickened wall with described diverticula closely abuts the left lateral wall of the urinary bladder—primary underlying process in this area cannot be excluded.

Diffuse haziness of mesenteric fat with fluid streaks.
Lymph nodes with an axial short diameter up to 6 mm are seen para-aortically, near the iliac vessels, and mesenteric vessels.

The liver is of normal size, with mildly lobulated contours, homogeneous structure, and no clearly visible focal lesions. The gallbladder is not visualized. Status post-cholecystectomy?
Intrahepatic bile ducts are prominent. The common bile duct measures approximately 11 mm in wiRXh.
The duodenum is drawn towards the gallbladder fossa. A diverticulum in the descending part of the duodenum measures about 17 mm in diameter.
The pancreas is atrophic, making analysis difficult. Peripancreatic fat is preserved. The spleen is of normal size, without visible focal lesions. A splenunculus measuring 8 mm in diameter is seen dorsally from the convexity. The kidneys are in a normal position, the right measuring 8 cm and the left 9 cm in length, both with segmentally reduced parenchymal thickness up to 11 mm, with several bilateral cortical and extracortical cysts, some of which are denser or hemorrhagic cysts. No dilation of the ductal system is found.
The adrenal glands are of normal size, without focal lesions.
The urinary bladder is adequately distended with urine, without intraluminal pathological content.
The abdominal aorta is of normal wiRXh.
Bilateral atrophy of the psoas muscles. Advanced spondylodegenerative changes of the spine are seen in the bone window, with localized rarefaction of the L3 vertebra. Hemangioma of the body of the Th10 vertebra. Diffuse decreased mineralization of the visualized bones. On basal sections through the thorax, a left lamellar pleural effusion with atelectasis of the adjacent parenchyma is seen. Bilateral basal minor hypoventilatory changes. Enlarged heart. A small hiatal hernia of the gastric cardia, axially measuring about 20 mm in diameter, with a neck wiRXh of about 15 mm. The stomach is collapsed.

report:
Analiza je limitirana linearnim artefaktima, posebice infratentorijalno.
Parijetalno desno vidi se zona gubitka diferencijacije sive i bijele tvari koja dif.dg. može odgovarati zoni akutne ishemije. Ne nalazi se hemoragije ili ekspanzivnog procesa u parenhimu mozga.
Obostrano u periventrikularnoj i dubokoj bijeloj tvari vide se hipodenziteti moguće u sklopu kroničnih mikroangiopatskih promjena.  Ventrikularni sustav je centralnog položaja, bez znakova hidrocefalusa.
Ne nalazi se ekstraaksijalnih kolekcija. Hiperostoza tabule interne frontalne kosti.
Lijevi frontalni sinus i oba maksilarna sinusa ispunjeni sadržajem i zadebljane stijenke u smislu kronične upale.
translation: The analysis is limited by linear artifacts, particularly in the infratentorial region. In the right parietal area, there is a zone of loss of differentiation between gray and white matter, which could correspond to an area of acute ischemia in the differential diagnosis. No hemorrhage or expansive process is found in the brain parenchyma. Bilaterally, in the periventricular and deep white matter, there are hypodensities possibly related to chronic microangiopathic changes. The ventricular system is centrally positioned, with no signs of hydrocephalus. No extra-axial collections are found. There is hyperostosis of the inner table of the frontal bone. The left frontal sinus and both maxillary sinuses are filled with content and have thickened walls, indicative of chronic inflammation.

report:
Nekompresibilna i ispunjena trombotskim masama VSM cijelim tijekom, uz potkoljenično vidljive nekompresibilne ogranke koji komuniciraju s VSP. VSP kompresibilna, ali ehogenije stijenke. U distalnoj trećini potkoljenice vidljiva šira nekompresibilna perforantna vena koja komunicira s pratilicama ATP. VFC kompresibilna. VFS i Vpopl djelomično kompresibilne uz ostatne rubne trombotske mase. U pratilicama ATP vidljivo nešto protoka uz ostatne rubne trombotske mase. Pratilice AF se otežano prikazuju. Pratilice ATA bez znakova tromboze. Mišićne vene medijalne glave m. gastrocnemiusa nekompresibilne u proksimalnoj trećini, ispunjene trombotskim masama. 
Nalaz odgovara dubokoj venskoj trombozi s površinskim tromboflebitisom - ne može se sa sigurnošću isključiti akutna tromboza na podlozi kroničnih postrombotskih promjena.
translation:
The great saphenous vein (GSV) is non-compressible and filled with thrombotic material throughout its course, with non-compressible branches visible in the lower leg that communicate with the small saphenous vein (SSV). The SSV is compressible but has more echogenic walls. In the distal third of the lower leg, a wider non-compressible perforating vein is visible, communicating with the accompanying anterior tibial veins (ATV). The common femoral vein (CFV) is compressible. The superficial femoral vein (SFV) and popliteal vein are partially compressible with residual marginal thrombotic masses. In the accompanying ATV, some flow is visible with residual marginal thrombotic masses. The accompanying femoral veins are difficult to visualize. The accompanying anterior tibial artery (ATA) shows no signs of thrombosis. The muscle veins of the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle are non-compressible in the proximal third, filled with thrombotic material. 

The findings are consistent with deep vein thrombosis with superficial thrombophlebitis - acute thrombosis on the basis of chronic post-thrombotic changes cannot be definitively excluded.

report: Hitni MSCT mozga snimljen je nativno, bez znakova svježeg krvarenja, akutne ishemije ili ekspanzivnog procesa. Nema ekstraaksijalnih kolekcija. Ventrikularni sustav je centralno smješten i primjereno širok.  Bazalne cisterne su slobodne. Nema znakova akutnog prekida kontinuiteta kostiju neurokranija.
translation: An emergency non-contrast MSCT of the brain was performed, showing no signs of recent hemorrhage, acute ischemia, or mass effect. There are no extra-axial collections. The ventricular system is centrally located and appropriately sized. The basal cisterns are clear. There are no signs of acute disruption of the neurocranial bone continuity.

report:
Jašući tromb koji se širi desno lobarni i segmentni ogranak za gornji i donji plućni režanj  te lijevo u lobarni ogranak za donji plućni režanj. Opisano odgovara masivnoj plućnoj emboliji.
T. pulmonalis promjera 32mm.
Apikoposteriorno subpleuralno u gornjem plućnom režnju desno vidljiv areal GGO uzorka sa naglašenim interlobularnim septama koji može odgovarati plućnom infarktu. 
Difuzno obostrano u plućnom parenhimu vidljivo nekoliko nodoznih lezija različite veličine, največa u posteriornom segmentu gornjeg plućnog režnja lijevo subpleuralno promjera 23mm, lezije su aspekta sekundarizama.
Desno laterobazalno subpleuralno atelektatične promjene.
Lamelarni pleuralni izljev desno, lijevo bez izljeva.
Nema perikardijalnog izljeva.
U trupu kralješka Th2 zona razrijeđene koštane strukture vel. 1cm, susp. na sekundarizam.
translation: A free-floating thrombus extends into the right lobar and segmental branches for the upper and lower lung lobes, and into the left lobar branch for the lower lung lobe. This description is consistent with a massive pulmonary embolism. The pulmonary artery measures 32mm in diameter. In the apicoposterior subpleural area of the right upper lung lobe, there is a region of ground-glass opacity pattern with prominent interlobular septa, which may correspond to a pulmonary infarction. Throughout the lung parenchyma on both sides, several nodular lesions of varying sizes are visible, the largest being in the posterior segment of the left upper lung lobe, subpleural, measuring 23mm in diameter. These lesions have the appearance of metastases. On the right, laterobasally subpleural, there are atelectatic changes. There is a lamellar pleural effusion on the right, with no effusion on the left. There is no pericardial effusion. In the body of the T2 vertebra, there is a 1cm area of reduced bone density, suspicious for metastasis.

report:
Na bazalnim presjecima kroz toraks vidi se velika hijatalna hernija čitavog želuca i dijela duodenuma oko koje se prikažu mjehurići slobodnog plina što upućuje na perforaciju šupljeg organa, moguće u području duodenuma. Nešto mjehurića slobodnog plina vidljivo i intraperitonealno u lijevom gornjem kvadrantu. Centralno u abdomenu vidljive vijuge dijela jejunuma širine oko 3 cm s aerolikvidnim nivoima što upućuje na smetnje pasaže, bez jasno vidljivog organskog uzroka.  Nema slobodne tekućine. U IVb segmentu jetre par sitnih hipovaskularnih lezija, premale za karakterizaciju. Žučni mjehur uredne debljine stijenke, bez patološkog sadržaja intraluminalno. Gušterača, slezena, nadbubrežne žlijezde bez suspektnih žarišnih lezija. Naglašeniji pijelon oba bubrega, bez znakova dilatacije kanalnog sustava. Mokraćni mjehur uredne debljine stijenke.
Divertikuloza descedentnog i sigmoidnog kolona bez znakova akutne upale.
Mezenterijalno i retroperitonealno bez limfadenopatije.
Aorta normokalibrirana. Skelet bez znakova fokalne patološke pregradnje
translation: On the basal sections through the thorax, a large hiatal hernia involving the entire stomach and part of the duodenum is observed, surrounded by free air bubbles, suggesting a perforation of a hollow organ, possibly in the duodenal area. Some free air bubbles are also visible intraperitoneally in the left upper quadrant. Centrally in the abdomen, loops of the jejunum approximately 3 cm in wiRXh are visible with air-fluid levels, indicating passage disturbances, without a clearly visible organic cause. No free fluid is present. In segment IVb of the liver, there are a few small hypovascular lesions, too small to characterize. The gallbladder has a normal wall thickness, with no pathological intraluminal content. The pancreas, spleen, and adrenal glands show no suspicious focal lesions. The renal pelvis of both kidneys is more pronounced, without signs of dilation of the ductal system. The urinary bladder has a normal wall thickness. Diverticulosis of the descending and sigmoid colon is present without signs of acute inflammation. There is no lymphadenopathy in the mesenteric or retroperitoneal regions. The aorta is of normal caliber. The skeleton shows no signs of focal pathological remodeling.

translation: The images of the right shoulder and upper arm reveal a comminuted fracture of the humerus at the level of the surgical neck and the greater tubercle, with significant displacement of the fragments. The humeral head is positioned caudally relative to the glenoid.

Središnja linija je održana.Fraktura okcipitalne i parijetalne kosti lijevo.
translation: Frontal and corticosubcortical on the left, there is a hemorrhagic contusion focus with a laminar subdural hematoma frontobasally on the left. There is a small subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) frontally on the left and bilaterally in the temporal region. No signs of acute ischemia or expansive process in the brain parenchyma are observed. report: Ileocekalno se prikaže tubularna struktura, nekompresibilna, slijepo završava, širine do 9 mm, edematozne stijenke - prema UZV karakteristikama dif. dg. može odgovarati inflamiranom apendiksu. Prikaže se blaže hiperehogenije okolno masno tkivo kao i nešto okolne slobodne tekućine.

According to ultrasound characteristics, the differential diagnosis may correspond to an inflamed appendix. There is mildly hyperechoic surrounding fatty tissue and some adjacent free fluid.

translation: Mild atherosclerotic changes in the walls of the insonated leg arteries, without significant atherosclerotic plaques. Normal, triphasic waveforms with normal flow velocities in both common femoral arteries, superficial femoral arteries, popliteal arteries, and tibial arteries of both legs, without stenosis. Normal hemodynamics. report:
Desni režanj štitne žlijezde primjerene veličine i strukture parenhima, bez žarišnih lezija i bez područja patološke vaskularizacije CD pregledom. Lijevi režanj uklonjen prije 14g. Bez uvećanih doštitnih žlijezdi na tipičnim mjestima.
