translation: The right lobe of the thyroid gland is of appropriate size and parenchymal structure, with no focal lesions and no areas of pathological vascularization on color Doppler examination. The left lobe was removed 14 years ago. No enlarged parathyroid glands in typical locations. Both submandibular glands are of appropriate size and have a homogeneous parenchymal structure, with no focal lesions. In the tail of the left parotid gland, there is a hypoechoic round lesion measuring 17 mm in diameter, which is targeted for cytological aspiration. In the right parotid gland, in the midsection, there is a smaller hypoechoic lesion up to 6 mm, which is also targeted for cytological aspiration. There is one reactive lymph node in the parotid tissue on both sides. Reactive lymph nodes are present in all regions of the neck on both sides, with no pathological lymphadenopathy.

report:
MR lijevog koljena nativno
Za komparaciju dosutpan MR lijevog koljena od 2.6.2023. godine. 
Lateralni kondil i lateralni plato tibije i dalje pokazuju zone subhondralnog koštanog edema.
Degenerativne promjene u sklopu OA obostrano, izraženije lateralnog kompartmenta koljena. 
Subhondralna sklerozacija tibijalnih zglobnih ploha obostrano. 
Hondromalacija medijalne i lateralne fasete patele te trohleje femura 3 - 4. stupnja sa sada vidljivom subhondralnom koštanom cistom centralnog dijela patele u sklopu progresije degeneratignih promjena. Suprapateralno veća količina zglobnog izljeva - intervalno stacionarno. 
Ne vidi se poplitealne ciste.  Stanje po kompleksnoj rupturi lateralnog meniska sa lateralnom ekstruzijom. Reduciran je volumen ostatnog dijela meniska u smislu progrsije deg. promjena na bazi rupture. Stacionaran nalaz stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska.  MCL i LCL su održani.  ACL i PCL prate se u kontinuitetu, mukoidna degeneracija ACL blažeg do umjerenog stupnja.  Ganglion ciste posteriornog dijela zglobne čahure uz PCL, intervalno u blagoj progresiji veličinom. Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su održanog kontinuiteta uz početne degenerativne promjene tetive kvadricepsa. Patelarni retinakulumi održani uz distenziju/entezitis hvatišta med. pat. retinakuluma za patelu. Gornja patelarna plika. Zaključak: u kontrolnom intervalu progresija deg. promjena na bazi ranije opisanih ozljeda.
translation:
MRI of the Left Knee Without Contrast

Comparison is made with the MRI of the left knee from June 2, 2023. 

The lateral condyle and lateral tibial plateau continue to show areas of subchondral bone edema. 

Degenerative changes consistent with osteoarthritis are present bilaterally, more pronounced in the lateral compartment of the knee. 

Subchondral sclerosis of the tibial articular surfaces is noted on both sides. 

Chondromalacia of the medial and lateral facets of the patella and the femoral trochlea is observed, graded 3 to 4, with a now visible subchondral bone cyst in the central part of the patella, indicating progression of degenerative changes. 

There is a larger amount of joint effusion suprapatellarly, which remains stable over the interval. 

No popliteal cysts are seen. 

Status post complex tear of the lateral meniscus with lateral extrusion. The volume of the remaining meniscus is reduced, indicating progression of degenerative changes based on the rupture. 

The posterior horn of the medial meniscus remains unchanged. 

The MCL and LCL are intact. 

The ACL and PCL are continuous, with mild to moderate mucoid degeneration of the ACL. 

Ganglion cysts in the posterior part of the joint capsule adjacent to the PCL show slight interval progression in size. 

The quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament maintain continuity, with early degenerative changes in the quadriceps tendon. 

The patellar retinacula are intact, with distension/enthesitis at the attachment of the medial patellar retinaculum to the patella. 

There is a superior patellar plica. 

Conclusion: In the follow-up interval, there is progression of degenerative changes based on previously described injuries.

report:
MR mozga nativno i postkontrastno Lijevo ekstraaksijalno , uz temporalnu kost, nalazi se T2 izointenzivna ekspanzivna tvorba  dimenzija 33x35x27,5mm (apxllxcc) koja se  medijalno utiskuje u priležeći parenhim cerebelarne hemisfere uz posljedični umjereni vazogeni edem , a lateralno se utiskuje u transverzalni duralni sinus. U leziji se nalaze mali areali kalcifikacija/depoziti hemosiderina. Tvorba se homogeno postkontrastno imbibira i najvjerojatnije  odgovara meningeomu.
 Primjerena je organizacija girusa i sulkusa, uz održan odnos sive i bijele tvari. Obostrano u  dubokoj i subkortikalnoj bijeloj tvari vidi se nekoliko nespecifičnih T2/FLAIR hiperintenzivnih fokusa. Ne nalazi se akutne ishemije, hemoragije , demijelinizacijskih lezija ni tumorskog procesa u parenhimu mozga. Ventrikualrni sustav je centralnog položaja, urednih dimenzija. Supraselarno arahnoidna cista, dimenzija 12x20x14mm(ap,ll,cc) koja se utiskuje u hipofizu. Područja optičke kijazme,  kavernoznih sinusa, pontocerebelarnih kuteva i kraniocervikalnog prijelaza su uredne morfologije.
translation:
MRI of the brain, pre- and post-contrast

On the left, extra-axially, adjacent to the temporal bone, there is a T2 isointense expansive mass measuring 33x35x27.5mm (APxLLxCC). Medially, it indents the adjacent parenchyma of the cerebellar hemisphere, causing moderate vasogenic edema, and laterally, it indents the transverse dural sinus. The lesion contains small areas of calcification/hemosiderin deposits. The mass shows homogeneous post-contrast enhancement and most likely corresponds to a meningioma.

The organization of the gyri and sulci is appropriate, with a maintained gray-white matter relationship. Bilaterally, in the deep and subcortical white matter, there are several nonspecific T2/FLAIR hyperintense foci. There is no evidence of acute ischemia, hemorrhage, demyelinating lesions, or tumor processes in the brain parenchyma. The ventricular system is centrally positioned and of normal dimensions. There is a suprasellar arachnoid cyst measuring 12x20x14mm (AP, LL, CC) that indents the pituitary gland. The regions of the optic chiasm, cavernous sinuses, pontocerebellar angles, and craniocervical junction are of normal morphology.

report:
Imala je tri dana sukrvavi iscjedak iz desne dojke. 4.6. Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrične guste dojke, miješano-žljezdanog tipa, ACR tipa C, s inhomogenijim, heterogenim, žljezdanim parenhimom bez vidljivih stelatnih lezija i patoloških mikrokalcifikacija. Fibrozne i fibrocistične promjene. Uredan je prikaz kože i pektoralnih mišića. Nema uočljive aksilarne limfadenopatije. Osobito je gust GLK DD, te je potrebno učiniti UZV i ovisno o nalazu core biopsiju. UZV dojki pokazuje guste dojke, s fibrocističnim promjenama obostrano. Osobito je heterogen širi areal na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranata desne dojke gdje su vidljivih prominentni mliječni kanalići, te se učini core-biopsija i više cilindara se pošalje na HP analizu. Nalaz core biopsije je B3- sklerozirana papilarna lezija, s atipičnom proliferacijom epitela tipa kribriformnog DCIS, nalaz odgovara atipičnom papilomu. 
Danas se učini MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Guste dojke ACR tipa C. Vidljive su obostrano multifokalna točkasta nakupljanja koja odgovaraju FCP u svim kvadrantima. U desnoj dojci u DLK i na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranata vidljivo je široko non-mass nakupljanje veličine 8.2x4.5 cm, koje je temeljito suspektno na DCIS. Nema uočljive aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 4c. Preporučujem javiti se u ambulantu za plastičnu kirurgiju. Moguće je ponoviti core biopsiju ali se preporučuje kirurška ekscizija i HP analiza.
translation:
She had a three-day history of bloody discharge from the right breast. On June 4th, a mammogram of both breasts in two projections shows symmetrically dense breasts of mixed glandular type, ACR type C, with inhomogeneous, heterogeneous glandular parenchyma without visible stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications. Fibrous and fibrocystic changes are noted. The skin and pectoral muscles are well visualized. No noticeable axillary lymphadenopathy is present. The right upper outer quadrant is particularly dense, and an ultrasound and, depending on the findings, a core biopsy are necessary. Breast ultrasound shows dense breasts with bilateral fibrocystic changes. There is a particularly heterogeneous wider area at the transition of the lateral quadrants of the right breast where prominent milk ducts are visible, and a core biopsy is performed with multiple cylinders sent for histopathological analysis. The core biopsy result is B3 - a sclerosing papillary lesion with atypical epithelial proliferation of the cribriform DCIS type, consistent with an atypical papilloma.

Today, an MRI of the breasts was performed according to the standard multiparametric protocol, with T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are dense, ACR type C. Bilateral multifocal punctate accumulations corresponding to fibrocystic changes are visible in all quadrants. In the right breast, in the upper outer quadrant and at the transition of the lateral quadrants, there is a wide non-mass accumulation measuring 8.2x4.5 cm, which is highly suspicious for DCIS. No noticeable axillary lymphadenopathy is present. BIRADS 4c. I recommend consulting with a plastic surgery clinic. A repeat core biopsy is possible, but surgical excision and histopathological analysis are recommended.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetričnog građene guste dojke žljezdano-miješanog tipa, ACR tipa C, s fibroznim i fibrocističnim promjenama. Nema vidljivih stelatnih lezija, niti patoloških mkc. Benigne disperigrane kalcifikacije obostrano. Uredan je prikaz kože i pektoralnih mišića. Nema aksilarne limfadenopatije.  BIRADS 2. Preporučuje se i UZV zbog reducirane osjetljivosti MMG u gustim dojkama.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows symmetrically dense breasts of glandular-mixed type, ACR type C, with fibrous and fibrocystic changes. No visible stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications. Benign scattered calcifications are present bilaterally. The skin and pectoral muscles appear normal. No axillary lymphadenopathy is observed. BIRADS 2. An ultrasound is recommended due to the reduced sensitivity of mammography in dense breasts.

report:
MSCT toraksa nativno i postkontrastno
Za komparaciju dostupni raniji MSCT pregledi, posljednja MSCTA plućnih arterija od 3.6.2024. godine.

Desno u gornjem i srednjem režnju te obostrano u donjim režnjevima periferno se vidi ranije opisani "tree-in-bud" uzorak najvjerojatnije uslijed upalnih procesa, bez značajnije promjene u kontrolnom intervalu.
U posteriornom segmentu gornjeg režnja desno ožiljna promjena s konsolidacijom s kalcifikatima, trakcijskim bronhioloektazijama i retikulacijama bez značajnije je promjene u komparaciji s MSCT pregledom iz 3/2022. godine.
Ožiljne promjene obostrano apikalno.
Emfizematozne promjene plućnog parenhima centrilobularnog i paraseptalnog tipa sa hiperinflacijom plućnog parenhima i aplanacijom ošita.
Nekoliko nespecifičnih subpleuralnih mikronodusa obostrano. 
Traheja i glavni bronhi su urednog tijeka i širine lumena, bez zadebljanja stijenke, bez vidljivih patoloških promjena endoluminalno.  Infrakarinalno i paratrahealno obostrano nekoliko limfnih čvorova, kraćeg promjera do 8 mm.  Bez pleuralnog ili perikardijalnog izljeva. Sitna hipovaskularna promjena veličine oko 3 mm u desnom režnju štitnjače. Nalaz je bez značajnije promjene u komparaciji s MSCT pregledom od 3.6.2024. godine. Kroz pregledom obuhvaćno područje gornjeg abdomena više sitnih hipervaskularnih promjena veličine do 5 mm u oba jetrena režnja, presitnih za definitivnu karakterizaciju. Sitna hipovaskularna promjena veličine oko 5 mm u kaudalnom polu slezene, presitna za definitivnu karakterizaciju, dif. dg. cista. Manji konkrementi u lumenu žučnog mjehura. Nodozna lijeva nadbubrežna žlijezda, dif. dg. adenomi. Analizom u koštanom prozoru ne nalazi se fokalne patološke pregradnje prikazanih kostiju. Okrugla sklerotična promjena veličine oko 4 mm u trupu Th3 kralješka, dif. dg. inzula kompakte.
translation:
MSCT of the thorax, native and post-contrast

Previous MSCT scans are available for comparison, the last being a pulmonary artery MSCTA from June 3, 2024.

In the right upper and middle lobes, as well as bilaterally in the lower lobes peripherally, the previously described "tree-in-bud" pattern is observed, most likely due to inflammatory processes, with no significant change over the follow-up interval. In the posterior segment of the right upper lobe, there is a scar change with consolidation, calcifications, traction bronchiectasis, and reticulations, with no significant change compared to the MSCT scan from March 2022. Scarring changes are noted bilaterally at the apices. Emphysematous changes in the lung parenchyma of centrilobular and paraseptal types with hyperinflation of the lung parenchyma and flattening of the diaphragm. Several nonspecific subpleural micronodules are present bilaterally. The trachea and main bronchi have a normal course and lumen wiRXh, with no wall thickening and no visible endoluminal pathological changes. Infracarinal and paratracheal lymph nodes are present bilaterally, with a short-axis diameter up to 8 mm. No pleural or pericardial effusion is observed. A small hypovascular change approximately 3 mm in size is noted in the right lobe of the thyroid gland. The findings show no significant change compared to the MSCT scan from June 3, 2024. In the upper abdomen area covered by the scan, there are several small hypervascular changes up to 5 mm in size in both liver lobes, too small for definitive characterization. A small hypovascular change approximately 5 mm in size is noted in the caudal pole of the spleen, too small for definitive characterization, differential diagnosis includes a cyst. Smaller calculi are present in the gallbladder lumen. The left adrenal gland is nodular, differential diagnosis includes adenomas. Bone window analysis shows no focal pathological remodeling of the visualized bones. A round sclerotic change approximately 4 mm in size is noted in the body of the Th3 vertebra, differential diagnosis includes an island of compact bone.

report:
Održana je fiziološka lordoza.
Stražnja interkorporalna linija je stepeničasto oblikovana u razini L3-L4 posljedično antepoziciji trupa L3 za oko 4 mm, a u istoj se razini vidi bulging i.v. diska, nema jasnih znakova kompromitacije korjenova spinalnih živaca. Koštani spinalni kanal je reducirane širine u razini trupa L4.
Trupovi prikazanih kralježaka su održane visine. Vakum fenomen i.v. diska razine L4-L5 i L5-S1. Politopne spondilodegenerativne promjene sa ventrolateralnim spondilofitima trupova L4 i L5. Osteoartrotske promjene fasetnih zglobova. U prikazanom dijelu abdomena dobiva se dojam cirkumferentno zadebljanje sluznice rektosigmoidnog prijelaza u duljini oko 2 cm. Divertikuloza kolona.
Savjetuje se gastroenterološka obrada.
translation: The physiological lordosis is maintained. The posterior intercorporal line is stepped at the L3-L4 level due to the anterior positioning of the L3 body by approximately 4 mm, and at the same level, there is a bulging of the intervertebral disc, with no clear signs of spinal nerve root compromise. The bony spinal canal is narrowed at the L4 vertebral body level. The vertebral bodies shown are of maintained height. There is a vacuum phenomenon in the intervertebral discs at the L4-L5 and L5-S1 levels. There are multilevel spondylodegenerative changes with ventrolateral spondylophytes on the L4 and L5 vertebral bodies. Osteoarthritic changes are present in the facet joints. In the depicted section of the abdomen, there is an impression of circumferential thickening of the mucosa at the rectosigmoid junction, approximately 2 cm in length. Colonic diverticulosis. Gastroenterological evaluation is advised.

report:
Na snimkama torakalne kralježnice reducirana je mineralizacija uz održanu koštanu strukturu prikazanog dijela skeleta. Naglašena je kifoza uz dekstrokonveksnu skoliozu torakolumbalna prijelaza. Održana je stražnja interkorporalna linija.
Vidi se anteklinasto oblikovan trup Th 9 kralješka (Genant III). Snižen je i bikonkavno oblikovan trup Th 12 kralješka.  Spondilodegenerativne promjene prikazanih kralježaka s formiranim ventralnim te lateralnim spondilofitima. Intervertebralni prostori su difuzno reducirani.
translation: The thoracic spine images show reduced mineralization with preserved bone structure of the depicted skeletal segment. There is pronounced kyphosis with a dextroconvex scoliosis at the thoracolumbar junction. The posterior intercorporal line is maintained. The T9 vertebral body is wedge-shaped (Genant III). The T12 vertebral body is reduced in height and biconcave in shape. There are spondylodegenerative changes in the visualized vertebrae with the formation of ventral and lateral osteophytes. The intervertebral spaces are diffusely reduced.

report: Na nativnoj snimci urotrakta vide se multiple mineralne sjene u projekciji donjeg pola lijevog bubrega, najveća mjeri 6x6 mm i 2 mineralne sjene u projekciji desnog bubrega, najveća mjeri 6x5 mm, položajem mogu odgovarati nefrolitima.
translation: On the native urogram, multiple mineral shadows are observed in the projection of the lower pole of the left kidney, the largest measuring 6x6 mm, and two mineral shadows in the projection of the right kidney, the largest measuring 6x5 mm, which in position may correspond to nephroliths.

report:
MR gornjeg abdomena nativno i postkontrastno
Za usporedbu dostupni raniji CT pregledi, zadnji od 24.1.2024. 

Jetra je primjerenog položaja, uvećana posljedično mulitplim cističnim lezijama, od kojih najveća mjeri oko 87 mm na granici II. i IV. segmenta.
Stanje nakon kolecistektomije. Ne nalazi se dilatacije intra- niti ekstrahepatalnih žučnih vodova.
Slezena je urednog položaja i veličine, urednog intenziteta signala, bez vidljivih žarišnih lezija.
Pankreas je homogene strukture, bez vidljivih žarišnih lezija, položajem u području lijevog hemiabdomena posljedično pomaku uslijed multiplih cista desnog bubrega i jetre. Koliko je analizi dostupno, peripankreatično masno tkivo je očuvano. 
Stanje po ljevostranoj nefrektomiji.
Desni bubreg je izrazito uvećan, seže do ulaza u malu zdjelicu, difuzno prožet konfluirajućim cističnim tvorbama s redukcijom bubrežnog parenhima. Ciste su različite veličine, bez značajnije promjene komparativno ranijem CT pregledu - najveća cista promjera je oko 90 mm. Brojne ciste sadrže "fluid-fluid" nivoe te su djelomično ili u cijelosti T1 hiperintenzivne u smislu hemoragičnog sadržaja te je otežana diferencijacija akutne/kronične intracistične hemoragije od potencijalno inficirane ciste. Jedna od cističnih tvorbi u gornjem polu bubrega djelomično pokazuje restrikciju difuzije na arealu aksijalno veličine oko 40x20 mm, otvorene etiologije. Nema ranijih MR pregleda za usporedbu.
Budući su cistične lezije konfluirajuće i blisko položene, koliko je moguće analizirati ne nalazi se značajnijeg zadebljanja i postkontrastne imbibicije stijenki cista koja bi govorila u prilog formiranom bubrežnom apscesu.
Nadbubrežne žlijezde su urednog nalaza. 
Lamelarna količina slobodne tekućine perihepatalno, perisplenično i interintestinalno te manja količina u zdjelici.
translation:
MRI of the Upper Abdomen with and without Contrast

Previous CT scans are available for comparison, the most recent from January 24, 2024.

The liver is in an appropriate position, enlarged due to multiple cystic lesions, the largest measuring approximately 87 mm at the junction of segments II and IV. Status post-cholecystectomy. No dilation of intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts is observed.

The spleen is in a normal position and size, with normal signal intensity and no visible focal lesions.

The pancreas has a homogeneous structure, with no visible focal lesions, positioned in the left hemiabdomen due to displacement from multiple cysts in the right kidney and liver. As far as can be assessed, the peripancreatic fat is preserved.

Status post-left nephrectomy.

The right kidney is significantly enlarged, extending to the entrance of the pelvis, diffusely infiltrated with confluent cystic formations with reduced renal parenchyma. The cysts vary in size, with no significant change compared to the previous CT scan—the largest cyst measures about 90 mm in diameter. Numerous cysts contain "fluid-fluid" levels and are partially or entirely T1 hyperintense, indicating hemorrhagic content, complicating differentiation between acute/chronic intracystic hemorrhage and potentially infected cysts. One of the cystic formations in the upper pole of the kidney partially shows diffusion restriction in an axial area measuring approximately 40x20 mm, with an open etiology. There are no previous MRI scans for comparison.

Since the cystic lesions are confluent and closely positioned, as much as can be analyzed, there is no significant thickening or post-contrast enhancement of the cyst walls that would suggest a formed renal abscess.

The adrenal glands are unremarkable.

There is a lamellar amount of free fluid perihepatically, perisplenically, and interintestinally, with a smaller amount in the pelvis.

report:
Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrično građene involutivno mješane dojke s blažim fibrocističnim promjenama bez vidljvih stelatnih lezija i patoloških MKC. Nema promjena u usporedbi sa snimkama od listopada 2022.g. BIRADS 2.
Preporučuje se redovite kontrole.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows symmetrically structured involutive mixed breasts with mild fibrocystic changes, without visible stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications. There are no changes compared to the images from October 2022. BIRADS 2. Regular follow-up is recommended.

report:
Pregledom se prikaže primjeren izgled n. radialisa od analize dostupnog dijela gornje polovine nadlaktice do periferije kao i n. ulnarisa od aksile do periferije. N. ulnaris se prilikom felksije i ekstenzije podlaktice prikaže stacionarnog položaja u kubitalnom tunelu.
N. medianus je primjerenog izgleda sve do područja karpalnog kanala gdje je povećane površine do oko 20mm2 (gornja fiziološka granica za UZV 12mm2), uz diskretno narušenu fibrilarnu arhitektoniku živca te hipoehogeniju strukturu (edem) - nalaz primarno odgovara sindromu karpalnog tunela.
translation: The examination shows a normal appearance of the radial nerve from the available portion of the upper half of the arm to the periphery, as well as the ulnar nerve from the axilla to the periphery. The ulnar nerve remains stationary in the cubital tunnel during flexion and extension of the forearm. The median nerve appears normal up to the carpal tunnel area, where it is enlarged to approximately 20mm² (the upper physiological limit for ultrasound is 12mm²), with slightly disrupted fibrillar architecture and hypoechoic structure (edema) - findings primarily consistent with carpal tunnel syndrome.

report:
Na UZV pregledu abdomena jetra je homogene strukture parehima, bez žarišnih lezija.
Žučni mjehur je ektomiran.
Ne vidi se dilatacije intra niti ekstrahepatalnih žučnih vodova.
Gušterača je primjerene strukture parenhima u prikazanom dijelu ( glava i dio tijela), bez žarišnih lezija.
Slezena je homogene strukture parenhima, bez žarišnih lezija.
Bubrezi su urednog položaja i veličine, održane debljine parenhima, bez dilatacije kanalnog sustava.
Ne vidi se slobodne tekućine intraperitonealno.
Prostata je uredne veličine, u lijevom režnju hiperehogeno područje najvjerojatnije fibroza.
translation: On the abdominal ultrasound examination, the liver shows a homogeneous parenchymal structure, with no focal lesions. The gallbladder has been removed. There is no visible dilation of the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts. The pancreas has an appropriate parenchymal structure in the visualized portion (head and part of the body), with no focal lesions. The spleen has a homogeneous parenchymal structure, with no focal lesions. The kidneys are in a normal position and size, with maintained parenchymal thickness, and there is no dilation of the collecting system. No free fluid is seen intraperitoneally. The prostate is of normal size, with a hyperechoic area in the left lobe, most likely fibrosis.

report:
Na snimkama desnog kalkaneusa ne nalazi se sigurnih znakova akutne koštane traume.
Kongruentan je odnos prikazanih zglobnih tijela. 
Calcar calcanei. 
Entezopatske promjene na mjestu hvatišta Ahilove tetive.
translation: The images of the right calcaneus show no definitive signs of acute bone trauma. The alignment of the depicted joint surfaces is congruent. There is a calcaneal spur. Enthesopathic changes are present at the insertion site of the Achilles tendon.

report:
CT aortografija nativno i postkontrastno sa EKG navođenjem:
Fiziološka konfiguracija srca i velikih krvih žila.
Trikuspidna aortna valvula. Ca score aortne valvule je 1940.
Koronarne arterije su tipičnih polazišta. CACS 119.
Ascendentna aorta je promjera 34 mm, urednog izgleda stijenke.
Luk aorte je promjera 26mm.  
Supraaortalni ogranci bez stenotskih promjena na ishodištima. Bovine arch anatomska varijanta polazišta supraaortalnih ogranaka.
Descendentna torakalna i abdominalna aorta su primjereno kalibrirane na svim razinama. 
Visceralni ogranci su bez stenotskih promjena. 
Desno dvije, lijevo jedna renalna arterija, bez stenotskih promjena.
Zdjelične arterije su obostrano bez stenotskih promjena.
AFC te AFS i AFP u prikazanim proksimalnim segmentima su obostrano bez stenotskih promjena ili značajnijih ats promjena stijenki. Desna AFC promjera 8mm, lijeva AFC 9mm.
Divertikuloza kolona. IUD u uterusu.
TEP desnog kuka.
translation:
CT aortography with and without contrast, ECG-gated:

The heart and major blood vessels have a physiological configuration. The aortic valve is tricuspid. The calcium score of the aortic valve is 1940. The coronary arteries have typical origins. Coronary Artery Calcium Score (CACS) is 119. The ascending aorta measures 34 mm in diameter, with a normal wall appearance. The aortic arch measures 26 mm in diameter. Supra-aortic branches show no stenotic changes at their origins. There is a bovine arch anatomical variant of the supra-aortic branch origins. The descending thoracic and abdominal aorta are appropriately calibrated at all levels. Visceral branches show no stenotic changes. On the right, there are two renal arteries, and on the left, one renal artery, all without stenotic changes. Pelvic arteries are bilaterally free of stenotic changes. The common femoral arteries (CFA), superficial femoral arteries (SFA), and profunda femoris arteries (PFA) in the displayed proximal segments are bilaterally free of stenotic changes or significant atherosclerotic wall changes. The right CFA measures 8 mm in diameter, and the left CFA measures 9 mm. Colonic diverticulosis is present. An intrauterine device (IUD) is in the uterus. There is a total hip replacement on the right side.

report:
Na presjecima kroz toraks u plućnom parenhimu vidi se konsolidacija srednjeg režnja uz  dominantno lateralnog segmenta te ektatične, impaktirane bronhe. U gornjem i donjem režnju desno mjestimično se vidi "tree in bud" uzorak uz okolne diskretne GGO areale. Jedan manji areal istih karakteristika vidi se i u donjem režnju lijevo posteriorno. Opisano odgovara upalnoj etiologiji.
Difuzno subpleuralno vide se nodusi promjera do 2mm. Traheja i glavni bronhi su primjerenog tijeka i širine lumena, bez zadebljanja stijenki te bez vidljivih patoloških promjena endoluminalno. Duž medijastinuma vide se brojniji i djelomično uvećani limfni čvorovi. Pretrahealno najveći, kraćeg promjera do 18mm.  Desno bazalno vidljiv lamelaran sloj pleuralnog izljeva. Stacionarno zadebljanje pleure posterobazalno desno s vidljivim punktiformnim kalcifikatima. Bez perikardijalnog izljeva.
translation:
On the thoracic sections, there is consolidation in the middle lobe of the lung, predominantly in the lateral segment, with ectatic, impacted bronchi. In the upper and lower lobes on the right, there is a patchy "tree-in-bud" pattern with surrounding discrete ground-glass opacity (GGO) areas. A smaller area with similar characteristics is seen in the posterior part of the left lower lobe. These findings are consistent with an inflammatory etiology.

Diffuse subpleural nodules up to 2mm in diameter are observed. The trachea and main bronchi have a normal course and lumen wiRXh, with no wall thickening or visible pathological changes within the lumen. Along the mediastinum, there are numerous and partially enlarged lymph nodes, the largest pretracheal node measuring up to 18mm in short-axis diameter. A lamellar layer of pleural effusion is visible in the right basal region. There is stationary pleural thickening in the right posterobasal area with visible punctate calcifications. No pericardial effusion is present.

report:
CT urografija nativno i postkontrastno u split bolus protokolu.
Nema ranijih snimki za komparaciju.
U mokraćnom mjehuru desno posteroletarelano nalazi se ekspanzivna tvorba najvećih aksijalnih dimenzija do 6 x 2 cm koja se širi u lumen mjehura, a zahvaća do 1/4 cirkumferencije stijenke. Ne nalazi se ekstravezikalnog širenja tumora. Mokraćni mjehur kateteriziran.

Obostrano se ne nalazi litijaze parenhima ili kanalnog sustava bubrega. Ne nalazi se ureterolita ili konkremenata u mokraćnom mjehuru.
Bubrezi su obostrano primjerenog položaja, oba hipotrofična. Obostrano bez žarišnih lezija.

report:
3.1.2023. PSA 5,51 urolog: Adenoma prostate, indiciran MR. Nema podataka o kliničkom statusu
Učini se MRI prostate prema standardnom biparametrijskom protokolu, s T2 i DWI sekvencama.
Prostata je uvećana, volumena 52 ccm. Vidljiva je hiperplazija CZ/TZ- BPH, koja se izbočuje prema dnu mjehura i odiže ga. Stijenka mjehura je zadebljana, trabekulirana. Periferna zona je dominantno T2 hiperintenzivna. Lijevo lateralno na bazi i u srednoj trećini vidljiv je T2 hipoeintenzivan areal veličine 18x10x17 mm, koji pokazuje umjerenu restrikciju difuzije na DWI i umjereno je suspektan. 
Konture prostate su pravilne, periprostatično masno tkivo je urednog izgleda, a vezikule su simetrične. Regionalni limfni čvorovi nisu povećani.
Zaključak: PIRADS 4. BPH i umjereno suspektan areal lijevo lateralno u PZ na prijelazu baze i srednje trećine. Preporučuje se urološki pregled, uvid u vrijednosti i dinamiku PSA, te odluka o biopsiji - obratiti pozornost na perifernu zonu lijevo lateralno.
translation:
3.1.2023. PSA 5.51 urologist: Prostate adenoma, MRI indicated. No data on clinical status.

An MRI of the prostate was performed using the standard biparametric protocol, with T2 and DWI sequences.

The prostate is enlarged, with a volume of 52 ccm. There is visible hyperplasia of the CZ/TZ - BPH, which protrudes towards the bladder base and elevates it. The bladder wall is thickened and trabeculated. The peripheral zone is predominantly T2 hyperintense. On the left lateral side at the base and in the middle third, there is a T2 hypointense area measuring 18x10x17 mm, which shows moderate diffusion restriction on DWI and is moderately suspicious.

The prostate contours are regular, the periprostatic fat tissue appears normal, and the seminal vesicles are symmetrical. Regional lymph nodes are not enlarged.

Conclusion: PIRADS 4. BPH and a moderately suspicious area on the left lateral side in the PZ at the transition of the base and middle third. A urological examination is recommended, along with a review of PSA values and dynamics, and a decision on biopsy - attention should be paid to the peripheral zone on the left lateral side.

Gušterača se zbog meteorizma ne prikaže.

Ne nalazi se slobodne tekućine intraperitonealno.
translation:

report:
CT toraksa, abdomena i zdjelice učinjen po multifaznom protokolu
Za usporedbu dostupan CT abdomena i zdjelice učinjen postkontrastno u portalno-venskoj fazi od 27.3.2024.

Ranije opisan proces desnog jetrenog režnja je u arterijskoj fazi također pretežno hipovaskularan s hipervaskularnim arealima te će prvenstveno odgovarati primarnom tm. procesu jetre. U opiani proces ukopljeni ogranci desne portalne vene. U oba režnja ranije opisane multiple rubno hipervaskularne lezije aspekta sekundarizama. Ne vidi se dilatacije intrahepatalnih niti ekstrahepatalih žučnih vodova. U području prednje trbušne stijenke lijevo parasagitalno lezija veličine 7x4 mm, prvenstveno depozit.
Ranije opisano zadebljanje u području fundusa želuca se jasno ne diferencira.
Bez jasne limfadenopatije.
Divertikuloza kolona, bez znakova akutne upale.
Mokraćni mjehur slabije ispunjen urinom.
Cistična lezija sa sklerotičnim rubom u području pubične simfize desno veličine 11x7 mm, prvenstveno degenerativne promjene.
Prate se osteolitičke lezije trupa Th11, Th12 i L5, morfološki najvjerojatnije hemangiomi.
Preostali nalaz je bez značajne promjene u kontrolnom intervalu.
Na presjecima kroz toraks, vidi se solidni nodus promjera 6 mm u inferiornom segmentu lingule, otvorene etiologije.
Obostrano, izraženije u gornjim režnjevima centrilobularni emfizem.
Obostrano bazalno hipoventilacijske promjene.
Traheja i glavni bronhi su urednog tijeka i širine lumena, bez zadebljanja stijenke, bez vidljivih patoloških promjena endoluminalno. 
Ne nalazi se uvećanih limfnih čvorova u medijastinumu i hilarno.
Pleuralni izljev desno širine do 8 mm.
Bez perikardijalnog izljeva i bez pleuralnog izljeva lijevo.
Hipovaskularna okrugla lezija promjera 4 mm u desnom režnju štitnjače.
translation:
CT of the thorax, abdomen, and pelvis performed using a multiphase protocol.  
For comparison, a CT of the abdomen and pelvis performed post-contrast in the portal venous phase from March 27, 2024, is available.

The previously described process in the right hepatic lobe is also predominantly hypovascular in the arterial phase with hypervascular areas, likely corresponding to a primary liver tumor. Branches of the right portal vein are involved in the described process. Multiple previously described marginally hypervascular lesions in both lobes suggest secondary deposits. No dilation of intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts is observed. In the area of the anterior abdominal wall, left parasagittal, there is a lesion measuring 7x4 mm, likely a deposit. The previously described thickening in the gastric fundus area is not clearly differentiated. No evident lymphadenopathy. Colonic diverticulosis without signs of acute inflammation. The urinary bladder is poorly filled with urine. A cystic lesion with a sclerotic rim in the area of the right pubic symphysis measuring 11x7 mm, likely degenerative changes. Osteolytic lesions are noted in the bodies of Th11, Th12, and L5, most likely hemangiomas morphologically. The remaining findings show no significant change in the control interval. 

On the thoracic sections, a solid nodule measuring 6 mm in diameter is seen in the inferior segment of the lingula, with an undetermined etiology. Bilaterally, more pronounced in the upper lobes, there is centrilobular emphysema. Bilateral basal hypoventilatory changes are present. The trachea and main bronchi have a normal course and lumen wiRXh, with no wall thickening or visible endoluminal pathological changes. No enlarged lymph nodes are found in the mediastinum or hilar regions. A pleural effusion on the right measures up to 8 mm in wiRXh. No pericardial effusion and no pleural effusion on the left. A hypovascular round lesion measuring 4 mm in diameter is present in the right thyroid lobe.

report:
MR cervikalne, torakalne i LS kralježnice te zdjelice po protokolu za SpA
Održana je fiziološka lordoza vratne i LS kralježnice, te kifoza torakalnog segmenta.
Trupovi kralježaka su uredne visine osim na L2 razini - bikonkavno formiran trup L2 kralješka, stanje nakon kompresivne frakture II° po Genantu.
Prikaže se koštani edem prednjih polovica trupova Th5-Th9, uz redukciju visine iv. prostora u prednjem dijelu te posljedično naznačen kifotički gibus. Opisano prvenstveno u sklopu upalnih promjena u sklopu osnovne bolesti. Na preostalim razinama ne vidi se aktivnih lezija.
Deg. promjene pokrovnih ploha trupova, na razini C5-C6 po tipu Modic II.
Sužen je ia. prostor desnog SI zgloba u donjoj trećini, uz malu zonu subhondralnog koštanog edema sa ilijačne strane, moguće u sklopu osnovne bolesti.
U preostalim dijelovima SI zglobova bez zona koštanog edema.
Sakrum je izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u okviru masne degeneracije.
translation:
MRI of the cervical, thoracic, and lumbosacral spine and pelvis following the protocol for SpA

The physiological lordosis of the cervical and lumbosacral spine, as well as the kyphosis of the thoracic segment, are maintained. The vertebral bodies are of normal height except at the L2 level, where there is a biconcave formation of the L2 vertebral body, consistent with a Grade II compression fracture according to Genant.

Bone marrow edema is observed in the anterior halves of the vertebral bodies from Th5 to Th9, with a reduction in the height of the intervertebral space anteriorly, resulting in a slight kyphotic gibbus. These findings are primarily associated with inflammatory changes related to the underlying condition. No active lesions are seen at other levels.

Degenerative changes of the endplates are noted at the C5-C6 level, classified as Modic type II. The joint space of the right sacroiliac joint is narrowed in the lower third, with a small area of subchondral bone marrow edema on the iliac side, possibly related to the underlying condition. No bone marrow edema zones are observed in the remaining parts of the sacroiliac joints.

The sacrum shows altered signal intensity consistent with fatty degeneration.

report:
MR desnog ramena nativno i postkontrastno (direktna artrografija)
Luksacija i repozicija ramena u 1. mj 2024.
Artefakti pomicanja tijekom snimanja limitiraju analizu.
Osteoartitičke promjene akromioklavikularnog zgloba. Manji intraartikularni izljev.
Koštani edem stražnje konture glave humerusa uz manju zonu legnutog kortkalisa u vidu zone impakcije (Hill-Sachs lezija), kao i manja zona edema kranijalnog dijela velikog tuberkla.
Ozljeda superoanteriornog labruma i glenoida (Bony Bankart lezija).
Glava humerusa je kranijalnije položena u GH zglobu; akromio-humeralna udaljenost 8 m, korako-humeralna 7 mm - obje udaljenosti u granicama normale.
Koliko je ovom metodom dostupno analizi, ne nalazi se znakova lezije glenohumeralnih ligamenata. Umjerena količina izljeva intraartikularno.
Tetiva duge glave bicepsa u cijelosti se nalazi izvan intertuberkularnog sulkusa, nalazi se uz anteromedijalnu stranu velikog tuberkla. U proksimalnom dijelu pred isnerciju je zadebljana te promijenjenog signala u sklopu tendinopatije. Uredne insercije ze tuberkl glenoida.
Ruptura kranijalne skupine vlakana tetive m. subskapularis.
Ruptura transverzalnog ligamenta humerusa.
Opisano odgovara ozljedi pulley sustava za tetivu duge glave m. bicepsa. 
Subtotalna ruptura artikulacijske strane vlakana tetive m. supraspinatus (>50% debljine tetive) sa retrakcijom dijela vlakana. 
Manja ruptura valkana tetive m. infraspinatus u području insercije.
Zaključak: Hill Sachs koštana lezija stražnje konture humerusa te superoanteriornog glenoida (Bony Bankart), tetiva duge glave bicepsa izvan intertuberkularnog sulkusa uslijed ozljede pulley-a te rupture mišića rotatorne manšete u sklopu anteriorne dislokacije.
translation:
MRI of the right shoulder, pre- and post-contrast (direct arthrography)

Dislocation and repositioning of the shoulder in January 2024.

Motion artifacts during imaging limit the analysis.

Osteoarthritic changes in the acromioclavicular joint. Small intra-articular effusion.

Bone edema at the posterior contour of the humeral head with a small area of cortical depression indicative of an impaction zone (Hill-Sachs lesion), as well as a small area of edema in the cranial part of the greater tubercle.

Injury to the superoanterior labrum and glenoid (Bony Bankart lesion).

The humeral head is positioned more cranially in the glenohumeral joint; acromiohumeral distance is 8 mm, coracohumeral distance is 7 mm - both distances are within normal limits.

As far as this method allows for analysis, there are no signs of glenohumeral ligament lesions. Moderate amount of intra-articular effusion.

The tendon of the long head of the biceps is entirely outside the intertubercular sulcus, located along the anteromedial side of the greater tubercle. In the proximal part before insertion, it is thickened and shows altered signal consistent with tendinopathy. Normal insertions at the glenoid tubercle.

Rupture of the cranial fiber group of the subscapularis tendon.

Rupture of the transverse humeral ligament.

The described findings correspond to an injury of the pulley system for the tendon of the long head of the biceps.

Subtotal rupture of the articular side fibers of the supraspinatus tendon (>50% of tendon thickness) with retraction of some fibers.

Small rupture of the infraspinatus tendon fibers at the insertion area.

Conclusion: Hill-Sachs bony lesion of the posterior contour of the humerus and superoanterior glenoid (Bony Bankart), tendon of the long head of the biceps outside the intertubercular sulcus due to pulley injury, and rotator cuff muscle rupture in the context of anterior dislocation.

translation:
MRI of the brain, pre- and post-contrast, following the standard protocol:

A previous MRI from an external facility dated 16.10.2023 is available for comparison.

The organization of the gyri and sulci is appropriate, and the gray-white matter differentiation is preserved.

There are no signs of acute ischemia, hemorrhage, or expansive processes in the brain parenchyma.

In the supratentorial deep white matter, nonspecific T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions are visible, likely corresponding to chronic microangiopathic changes - Fazekas grade 1.

No areas of diffusion restriction are observed.

The ventricular system is midline, symmetrical, and of appropriate wiRXh.

No extra-axial collections are present.

The appearance of the optic chiasm, cavernous sinuses, cerebellopontine angles, and the craniocervical junction is normal.

No areas of pathological contrast enhancement are observed on post-contrast T1 images.

report:
Na sumacijskoj AP snimci torakalnih organa vide se obostrani razliveni pleuralni izljevi, izraženije lijevo sa granicom koja seže do stražnjeg okrajka IV. rebra. Obostrano slabija prozračnost plućnog parenhima, po svemu uslijed smetnji ventilacije i razlivenih izljeva.Desno bazalno u sumaciji sa izljevom vidi se ovalna zona zasjenjenja - ddg. infiltrat, druga etiologija, učiniti kontrolnu snimku po sanaciji akutnih tegoba.
FC sinusi su zasjenjeni. Sjena srca je prikriena sjenom izljeva, uronjena u ošit.
translation: On the summation AP chest X-ray, bilateral pleural effusions are observed, more pronounced on the left, with the boundary reaching the posterior edge of the fourth rib. There is reduced transparency of the lung parenchyma on both sides, likely due to ventilation issues and the effusions. On the right, at the base, an oval area of opacity is seen in conjunction with the effusion - differential diagnosis includes infiltrate or other etiology; a follow-up X-ray is recommended after the resolution of acute symptoms. The frontal sinuses are opaque. The heart shadow is obscured by the effusion shadow, submerged in the diaphragm.

report:
UZV CDFI pregled karotidnih i vertebralnih arterija:
ACC, ACI i ACE su obostrano primjerene širine lumena te izgleda stijenke s aterosklerotskim plakovima u području bifurkacije obostrano, koji se šire u početne segmente ACI obostrano, desno se u početnom segmentu ACI prikaže echo-free zona na duljini od 7 mm, ispred i iza koje se bilježi primjeren spektar i brzina protoka.
U obje ACC, ACI i ACE u prikazanim segmentima uredna je hemodinamika, spektri, PSV i EDV uredni.
U prikazanim segmentima ne nalazi se hemodinamski značajnih stenoza.
U obje AV antegradan je smjer protoka, hemodinamika uredna, simetrična.
translation:
Ultrasound Color Doppler Flow Imaging (CDFI) Examination of Carotid and Vertebral Arteries:

The common carotid arteries (CCA), internal carotid arteries (ICA), and external carotid arteries (ECA) on both sides have normal lumen wiRXh and wall appearance, with atherosclerotic plaques present at the bifurcation on both sides, extending into the initial segments of the ICAs bilaterally. On the right side, an echo-free zone measuring 7 mm in length is observed in the initial segment of the ICA, with normal flow spectrum and velocity recorded before and after this zone.

In the segments of the CCA, ICA, and ECA that were examined, hemodynamics are normal, with normal spectral patterns, peak systolic velocity (PSV), and end-diastolic velocity (EDV).

No hemodynamically significant stenoses are found in the examined segments.

In both vertebral arteries (VA), the direction of flow is antegrade, with normal and symmetrical hemodynamics.

report:
Ultrazvučnim pregledom lijeve  Ahilove tetive vidi se blago edematozan pripoj za kalkaneus uz znakove hipervaskularizacije u smislu entezitisa. Održan je kontinuitet tetive.
Ultrazvučnim pregledom desnog koljena prikaže se parcijalna ruptura ligamenta patele na hvatištu za patelu, s unutarnje strane vlakana. Ruptura zahvaća oko 70 % volumena tetive u poprečnom presjeku. U području rupture vidljiva je opsežna hipervaskularizacija. Primjeren je prikaz ostalih struktura desnog koljena.
Preporučuje se terapija nesteroidnim protuupalnim lijekovima,na primjer iuprofen 3 × 400 mg kroz 4-5 dana, nakon toga kontrola ovdje te se u slučaju nepotpune regresije simptoma može pokušati se instilacija kortikosteroida i/ili "dry needling".
translation:
Ultrasound examination of the left Achilles tendon reveals a mildly edematous attachment to the calcaneus with signs of hypervascularization, indicative of enthesitis. The continuity of the tendon is maintained.

Ultrasound examination of the right knee shows a partial rupture of the patellar ligament at its attachment to the patella, on the inner side of the fibers. The rupture involves approximately 70% of the tendon volume in cross-section. Extensive hypervascularization is visible in the area of the rupture. Other structures of the right knee are appropriately visualized.

Therapy with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs is recommended, for example, ibuprofen 3 × 400 mg for 4-5 days, followed by a follow-up here. In case of incomplete regression of symptoms, corticosteroid instillation and/or "dry needling" may be attempted.

report:
Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje guste dojke, žljezdanog tipa, ACR D, s heterogenim, obilnim, fibrozno promijenjenim parenhimom, s vidljivim FCP. Nema sigurno vidljivih stelatnih lezija, niti patoloških mkc. U GLK LD kuglasta tvorba promjera 3.5 cm, pravilnih rubova, koja može odgovarati makrocisti, FA ili drugoj etiologiji. Uredan je prikaz kože i pektoralnih mišića. Nema aksilarne limfadenopatije.
BIRADS 3.
UZV pokazuje heterogeni, vj.FC konglomerat u GLK LD duljine 3.5 cm, koji je elastografski mekan. Učini se core biopsija i više cilindara se pošalje na HP analizu. Daljnji postupak ovisno o HP nalazu. BIRADS 3.
Molim danas mirovati, ne nositi teret, ne raditi fizičke poslove.
translation:
Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows dense, glandular-type breasts, ACR D, with heterogeneous, abundant, fibrously altered parenchyma, with visible FCP. No clearly visible stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a spherical mass with a diameter of 3.5 cm, with regular borders, which may correspond to a macro cyst, fibroadenoma, or other etiology. The skin and pectoral muscles are well visualized. No axillary lymphadenopathy. BIRADS 3.

Ultrasound shows a heterogeneous, likely fibro-cystic conglomerate in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, measuring 3.5 cm, which is elastographically soft. A core biopsy is performed, and multiple cylinders are sent for histopathological analysis. Further management will depend on the histopathological findings. BIRADS 3.

Please rest today, avoid carrying heavy loads, and refrain from physical activities.

report:
CTA luka aorte, karotidnih i vertebralnih arterija:
Tip 1 luka aorte. Supraaortalni ogranci su tipičnih polazišta, bez stenotskih promjena na ishodištima. 
Subokluzivna stenoza desne ACI 8mm nakon polazišta, miješanim, dominantno mekim plakom. Lijeva ACI i obje ACC su uredne širine.
Vertebralne arterije su obostrano primjerene prohodnosti. 
Intrakranijalno se ne nalazi aneurizmi niti AVM u prikazanom dijelu intrakranijalne cirkulacije. 
Hipoplastičan A1 segment desne ACA.
Blijeđi prikaz prednje cirkulacije desne strane mozga, posljedica slabijeg punjenja desne ACI.
translation:
CT Angiography of the Aortic Arch, Carotid, and Vertebral Arteries:

Type 1 aortic arch. The supra-aortic branches have typical origins, with no stenotic changes at the origins. 
There is a subocclusive stenosis of the right internal carotid artery (ICA) 8mm from its origin, with a mixed, predominantly soft plaque. The left ICA and both common carotid arteries (CCAs) are of normal caliber.
The vertebral arteries are bilaterally patent. 
No aneurysms or arteriovenous malformations (AVMs) are found in the depicted portion of the intracranial circulation. 
There is a hypoplastic A1 segment of the right anterior cerebral artery (ACA).
There is a diminished appearance of the anterior circulation on the right side of the brain, a consequence of reduced filling of the right ICA.

report:
MR abdomena i zdjelice nativno i postkontrastno u ranoj i kasnoj arterijskoj i portalno-venskoj fazi, uključujući MR sekvence

Jetra je primjerene veličine, diskretno hipertrofičan lobus kaudatus. Blaže difuzno masno infiltriran jetreni parenhim, bez vidljivih žarišnih lezija. 
Na MR i standardnim sekvencama:
Žučni mjehur je primjerene veličine i debljine stijenke, bez sadržaja endoluminalno. 
Naznačeni intrahepatali žučni vodovi centralno.
D.cysticus promjera do 4mm. D.hepaticus communis promjera 13mm.
D.choledocus najširi u centralnom dijelu promjera do 15mm, postupno se sužava, prepapilarno promjera do 4mm.
D.pancreaticus primjerene širine lumena. Bez ispada signala u smislu opstrukcije vodova.
Slezena je primjerene veličine, bez žarišnih lezija.
Gušterača je primjerenog prikaza, bez žarišnih lezija.
Bubrezi su jednoliko stanjeog parenhima, obostrano multiple parapijelične ciste. Nekoliko manjih parenhimskih cisti obostrano. Nema dilatacije kanalnog sustava.
Adenom desne nadbubrežne žlijezde aksijalne veličine 28x17mm. 
Lijeva nadbubrežna žlijezda primjerenog izgleda, bez fokalnih lezija. 
Nema limfadenopatije niti slobodne tekućine u prikazanom dijelu abdomena.
translation:
MRI of the abdomen and pelvis, native and post-contrast in early and late arterial and portal-venous phases, including MR sequences

The liver is of appropriate size, with a slightly hypertrophic caudate lobe. There is mild diffuse fatty infiltration of the hepatic parenchyma, with no visible focal lesions. 
On MR and standard sequences:
The gallbladder is of appropriate size and wall thickness, with no endoluminal contents. 
The intrahepatic bile ducts are prominent centrally.
The cystic duct measures up to 4mm in diameter. The common hepatic duct measures 13mm in diameter.
The common bile duct is widest in the central part, measuring up to 15mm, gradually narrowing to a prepapillary diameter of up to 4mm.
The pancreatic duct has an appropriate lumen wiRXh. There is no signal dropout indicating ductal obstruction.
The spleen is of appropriate size, with no focal lesions.
The pancreas is well visualized, with no focal lesions.
The kidneys have uniformly maintained parenchyma, with multiple parapelvic cysts bilaterally. There are several smaller parenchymal cysts on both sides. There is no dilation of the ductal system.
There is an adenoma of the right adrenal gland measuring 28x17mm in axial size. 
The left adrenal gland appears normal, with no focal lesions. 
There is no lymphadenopathy or free fluid in the visualized portion of the abdomen.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari radiali passanti per la fovea (Radial Line – RX Avanti Optovue) e ricostruzione in 3D (Retina Map) - RX Avanti OptoVue - ha evidenziato: In ambo gli occhi presenza di lieve disomogeneità vitreale. Il profilo interno della retina appare regolare lungo i profili esaminati con normale presenza della fisiologica depressione foveale. Ben evidenziabili tutti gli strati della retina, in particolar modo quelli esterni, come l’ellissoide e la membrana limitante esterna che appaiono chiaramente individuabili. Assenza di fluidi anomali. L’epitelio pigmentato retinico si presenta di aspetto e reflettività normale. La coroide nella norma per l’età. Lo spessore retinico delle aree esaminate è nella norma in entrambi gli occhi, con spessore foveale pari a 252 µ in OD e 256 µ in OS.
translation: The examination conducted using radial linear scans through the fovea (Radial Line – RX Avanti Optovue) and 3D reconstruction (Retina Map) - RX Avanti OptoVue - revealed: In both eyes, there is a slight vitreous inhomogeneity. The internal retinal profile appears regular along the examined sections with a normal presence of the physiological foveal depression. All retinal layers are well visualized, particularly the outer layers, such as the ellipsoid zone and the external limiting membrane, which are clearly identifiable. No abnormal fluids are present. The retinal pigment epithelium shows normal appearance and reflectivity. The choroid is normal for the patient's age. The retinal thickness in the examined areas is within normal limits in both eyes, with a foveal thickness of 252 µm in the right eye and 256 µm in the left eye.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari radiali passanti per la fovea (Radial Line) e ricostruzione in 3D (Retina Map) ha evidenziato: Il profilo interno della retina appare regolare lungo i profili esaminati con normale presenza della fisiologica depressione foveale in entrambi gli occhi. Ben evidenziabili tutti gli strati della retina, in particolar modo quelli esterni, come l’ellissoide e la membrana limitante esterna che appaiono chiaramente individuabili. Assenza di fluidi anomali. L’epitelio pigmentato retinico si presenta di aspetto e reflettività normale. La coroide nella norma per l’età. Lo spessore retinico delle aree esaminate è nella norma in entrambi gli occhi.
translation: The examination conducted using radial linear scans through the fovea (Radial Line) and 3D reconstruction (Retina Map) revealed: The internal profile of the retina appears regular along the examined profiles with a normal presence of the physiological foveal depression in both eyes. All layers of the retina are well visualized, particularly the outer layers, such as the ellipsoid zone and the external limiting membrane, which are clearly identifiable. No abnormal fluids are present. The retinal pigment epithelium shows normal appearance and reflectivity. The choroid is normal for the patient's age. The retinal thickness in the examined areas is within normal limits in both eyes.

report: Esiti di occlusione della vena centrale della retina con anastomosi venovenose a livello del disco ottico. Presenza di aree ischemiche retiniche nei quattro quadranti (superiore, nasale, inferiore, temporale). Aumento della permeabilità vasale al polo posteriore da edema maculare. Conclusioni: esiti di occlusione della vena centrale della retina. Si consiglia laser terapia retinica nei quattro quadranti e successivo impianto intravitreale di corticosteroidi.
translation: Findings consistent with central retinal vein occlusion with venous-venous anastomoses at the optic disc. Presence of retinal ischemic areas in all four quadrants (superior, nasal, inferior, temporal). Increased vascular permeability at the posterior pole due to macular edema. Conclusions: findings consistent with central retinal vein occlusion. Retinal laser therapy is recommended in all four quadrants, followed by intravitreal corticosteroid implantation.

report: L’esame fluorangiografico evidenzia la presenza di una retinopatia diabetica proliferante in entrambi gli occhi con neovasi al disco ottico e solo nell’occhio sinistro con neovasi retinici nei settori superiore, nasale ed inferiore. Si evidenziano aree di non perfusione retinica in media ed estrema periferia retinica in tutti i settori di entrambi gli occhi. Sono presenti esiti di fotocoagulazione laser in estrema periferia retinica nel settore nasale di entrambi gli occhi. Diffuso aumento della permeabilità vasale al polo posteriore e leakage petaloide da edema maculare cistoide. Conclusioni: retinopatia diabetica proliferante grave con edema maculare cistoide. Si consiglia di eseguire panretinica laser e trattamento con antiVEGF in entrambi gli occhi.
translation: The fluorescein angiography reveals the presence of proliferative diabetic retinopathy in both eyes, with neovascularization at the optic disc and, in the left eye only, retinal neovascularization in the superior, nasal, and inferior quadrants. There are areas of retinal non-perfusion in the mid and far periphery across all quadrants of both eyes. Evidence of laser photocoagulation is noted in the far peripheral nasal quadrant of both eyes. There is a widespread increase in vascular permeability at the posterior pole and petaloid leakage due to cystoid macular edema. Conclusions: severe proliferative diabetic retinopathy with cystoid macular edema. It is recommended to perform panretinal laser photocoagulation and anti-VEGF treatment in both eyes.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari radiali (Radial Line) passanti per l’area maculare e ricostruzione in 3D (Retina Map), ha evidenziato: In OD il profilo interno della retina appare notevolmente alterato in area maculare e perimaculare a causa di vasto edema con celle piccole e grandi interessanti i diversi strati retinici. È presente anche un ampio distacco del neuroepitelio in zona centrale. Non sempre evidenziabili la MLE e l’ellissoide. Lo spessore retinico delle aree esaminate è ampiamente superiore alla norma, con spessore medio del campo centrale pari a 641 micron. Conclusioni: sindrome di irvine gass
translation: The examination conducted using radial linear scans (Radial Line) through the macular area and 3D reconstruction (Retina Map) revealed the following: In the right eye (OD), the internal retinal profile appears significantly altered in the macular and perimacular areas due to extensive edema with small and large cysts affecting various retinal layers. There is also a large detachment of the neuroepithelium in the central zone. The external limiting membrane (ELM) and ellipsoid zone are not always discernible. The retinal thickness in the examined areas is significantly above normal, with an average central field thickness of 641 microns. Conclusions: Irvine-Gass syndrome.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni circolari parallele al disco ottico (ONH and RNFL) ha evidenziato: I parametri relativi allo studio della testa del nervo ottico sono ai limiti della norma in ambo gli occhi. Lo spessore di RNFL è nell’ambito della norma in ambo gli occhi, eccetto che nel settore temporale. In ambo gli occhi l’area della rima neurale del nervo ottico è normale, mentre il rapporto cup/disc è ai limiti della norma. L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni circolari parallele alla macula (Analisi delle cellule ganglionari: Macular Cube 512X218), ha evidenziato: Spessore delle cellule ganglionari ridotto in ampia area centrale in OD e soltanto in due piccole aree perifoveali dell’OS.
translation: The examination conducted using circular scans parallel to the optic disc (ONH and RNFL) revealed: The parameters related to the study of the optic nerve head are at the borderline of normal in both eyes. The RNFL thickness is within normal limits in both eyes, except in the temporal sector. In both eyes, the optic nerve rim area is normal, while the cup/disc ratio is at the borderline of normal. The examination conducted using circular scans parallel to the macula (Ganglion Cell Analysis: Macular Cube 512X218) revealed: Reduced ganglion cell thickness in a large central area in the right eye (OD) and only in two small perifoveal areas in the left eye (OS).

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari parallele (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster ) passanti per l’area maculare e ricostruzione in 3D (Macular Cube 512x128), ha evidenziato: In OD Il profilo interno della retina appare notevolmente alterato ed irregolare, quale esito di peeling della MER, con persistenza di pseudoforo maculare e tratti di MER. I diversi strati della retina sono ben individuabili soltanto in alcuni tratti. Presenza di alcune drusen e pseudodrusen, nonché di migrazione del pigmento. Lo spessore retinico delle aree esaminate risulta globalmente ridotto rispetto alla norma.
translation: The examination, conducted using parallel linear scans (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster) through the macular area and 3D reconstruction (Macular Cube 512x128), revealed the following: In the right eye (OD), the internal retinal profile appears significantly altered and irregular, as a result of epiretinal membrane (ERM) peeling, with the persistence of a macular pseudohole and segments of ERM. The various retinal layers are clearly identifiable only in certain areas. There is the presence of some drusen and pseudodrusen, as well as pigment migration. The retinal thickness in the examined areas is generally reduced compared to normal.

report: L’esame OCT- Angiography HD Macula 6 x 6 mm ha evidenziato: In ambo gli occhi si evidenzia una lieve rigidità dei vasi nella rete superficiale e profonda. In ambo gli occhi l’area foveale avascolare non appare ingrandita, ma irregolare. La vessel density superficiale è diffusamente ridotta. Non si evidenziano fenomeni di neovascolarizzazione nei vari strati retinici. Conclusioni: Ischemia maculare diabetica
translation: The OCT-Angiography HD Macula 6 x 6 mm examination revealed: In both eyes, there is a slight rigidity of the vessels in the superficial and deep networks. In both eyes, the foveal avascular zone is not enlarged but appears irregular. The superficial vessel density is diffusely reduced. There is no evidence of neovascularization in the various retinal layers. Conclusions: Diabetic macular ischemia.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari parallele (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster) passanti per l’area maculare e ricostruzione in 3D (Macular Cube 512x128), ha evidenziato: In ambo gli occhi il profilo interno della retina presenta una convessità in corrispondenza della macula con depressione foveale non individuabile, conseguente ad edema maculare cistoide di tipo diabetico, con celle di medie e grandi dimensioni. In regione soprafoveale dell’OS si evidenzia un'altra emorragia di discrete dimensioni. Di nuovo in ambo gli occhi, gli strati della retina ed in particolare la MLE e l’ellissoide sono disordinati. Lo strato EPR-coriocapillare è di aspetto e reflettività lievemente irregolari. Lo spessore retinico è notevolmente aumentato in OD<OS anche in campo foveale e misura nel campo centrale in OD 485 μ, in OS a 613 μ.
translation: The examination, conducted using linear parallel scans (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster) through the macular area and 3D reconstruction (Macular Cube 512x128), revealed the following: In both eyes, the internal retinal profile shows a convexity at the macula with an undetectable foveal depression, due to diabetic cystoid macular edema, with medium and large-sized cysts. In the supraphoveal region of the left eye, there is another hemorrhage of moderate size. Again, in both eyes, the retinal layers, particularly the external limiting membrane and ellipsoid zone, appear disorganized. The RPE-choriocapillaris layer has a slightly irregular appearance and reflectivity. Retinal thickness is significantly increased in the right eye compared to the left, even in the foveal field, measuring 485 μm in the central field of the right eye and 613 μm in the left eye.

report: In OD il profilo interno della retina presenta una marcata convessità in macula e al di sotto della fovea in corrispondenza della quale si evidenziano tratti di SHRM, alcuni DEP drusenoidi, edema intraretinico ed emorragia intraretinica, nonché riduzione dello strato dei fotorecettori e double layer sign. Si evidenzia ancora la depressione foveale seppure alterata. Evidenziabili i diversi strati interni della retina, mentre non lo sono la MLE e l’ellissoide. In OS il profilo interno della retina appare regolare con normale depressione foveale. Ben evidenziabili i diversi strati della retina ed in particolare la MLE e l’ellissoide. Assenza di fluidi anomali. Lo strato EPR-coriocapillare è di aspetto irregolare con presenza di diverse drusen di piccole dimensioni. Lo spessore retinico medio ed il volume delle aree esaminate sono nella norma.
translation: In the right eye (OD), the internal profile of the retina shows a pronounced convexity at the macula and beneath the fovea, where segments of subretinal hyperreflective material (SHRM), some drusenoid pigment epithelial detachments (DEP), intraretinal edema, and intraretinal hemorrhage are observed, along with a reduction in the photoreceptor layer and a double layer sign. The foveal depression is still present, albeit altered. The various internal layers of the retina are discernible, while the external limiting membrane (ELM) and ellipsoid zone are not. In the left eye (OS), the internal profile of the retina appears regular with a normal foveal depression. The different layers of the retina are well-defined, particularly the ELM and ellipsoid zone. There is an absence of abnormal fluids. The retinal pigment epithelium-choriocapillaris (RPE-choriocapillaris) layer has an irregular appearance with the presence of several small drusen. The average retinal thickness and the volume of the examined areas are within normal limits.

report: L’esame Angio-OCT(OCT-Angiography HD 6x6 mm) ha evidenziato: In OD la rete vascolare è normale con assenza di Membrana neovascolare. Invece in OS si evidenzia in coriocapillare un network vascolare anomalo associato ad aumento di flusso all’esame strutturale tipico di membrana neovascolare coroideale.
translation: The Angio-OCTexamination (OCT-Angiography HD 6x6 mm) revealed: In the right eye (OD), the vascular network is normal with no evidence of neovascular membrane. However, in the left eye (OS), there is an abnormal vascular network in the choriocapillaris associated with increased flow on the structural examination, typical of a choroidal neovascular membrane.

report: L’esame OCT- Angiography HD Macula 6 x 6 mm ha evidenziato: In ambo gli occhi Complesso Capillare Superficiale: Normale corso della trama vascolare con aspetto rigido e filiforme dei capillari. La vessel density superficiale mostra una chiara riduzione (in OD<OS) soprattutto nei settori temporali del polo posteriore. Outer Retina: Assenza di segnali di flusso. Coriocapillare: presenza di flusso anomalo in corrispondenza di una drusen centrale in OD, non presente nel precedente esame.
translation: The OCT-Angiography HD Macula 6 x 6 mm examination revealed the following: In both eyes, the Superficial Capillary Plexus shows a normal vascular pattern with a rigid and thread-like appearance of the capillaries. The superficial vessel density demonstrates a clear reduction (more in the right eye than the left), particularly in the temporal sectors of the posterior pole. Outer Retina: Absence of flow signals. Choriocapillaris: Presence of abnormal flow corresponding to a central drusen in the right eye, which was not present in the previous examination.

report: Esame eseguito con strategia 30 – 2 ZETA. 1° esame computerizzato. In OD il tracciato presenta lieve riduzione della sensibilità retinica in tutti i settori, eccetto che nel temporale inferiore. Le mappe della Total deviation e della Pattern deviation presentano diversi punti di anomalia. GHT oltre i limiti della norma. La macchia cieca è di dimensioni normali. Fovea 35 dB; MD -2.87 dB; PSD 3.71 dB. In OS il tracciato presenta una notevole riduzione della sensibilità retinica soprattutto nel settore temporale superiore e a seguire in quello inferiore, mantenendo un’area di visione residua soprattutto in un’area a cavallo dei settori temporali e oltre i 20°. La macchia cieca è inglobata in un’area scotomatosa che interessa gran parte del campo visivo. Le mappe della Total deviation e della Pattern deviation presentano grave alterazione corrispondente ai deficit su indicati. GHT oltre i limiti della norma. Fovea -1 dB; MD -23.32 dB; PSD 9.45 dB.Gli indici di attendibilità sono bassi in ambo gli occhi. Conclusioni: l'esame effettuato è compatibile con la presenza di glaucoma in stadio incipiente in OD, avanzato in OS.
translation: Exam performed using the 30 – 2 ZETA strategy. This is the first computerized test. In the right eye (OD), the trace shows a slight reduction in retinal sensitivity across all sectors, except for the lower temporal sector. The Total Deviation and Pattern Deviation maps show several points of abnormality. The Glaucoma Hemifield Test (GHT) is outside normal limits. The blind spot is of normal size. Fovea measures 35 dB; Mean Deviation (MD) is -2.87 dB; Pattern Standard Deviation (PSD) is 3.71 dB. In the left eye (OS), the trace shows a significant reduction in retinal sensitivity, particularly in the upper temporal sector, followed by the lower sector, with a residual area of vision mainly spanning the temporal sectors and beyond 20°. The blind spot is encompassed within a scotomatous area affecting a large portion of the visual field. The Total Deviation and Pattern Deviation maps show severe alterations corresponding to the aforementioned deficits. GHT is outside normal limits. Fovea measures -1 dB; MD is -23.32 dB; PSD is 9.45 dB. Reliability indices are low in both eyes. Conclusions: The exam results are consistent with the presence of early-stage glaucoma in the right eye and advanced-stage glaucoma in the left eye.

report: Esame eseguito con strategia 30 – 2 – ZETA. 1° esame computerizzato. In OD emianopsia destra associata a quadranopsia nasale inferiore nettamente delimitata rispetto al piano orizzontale e al settore nasale superiore con risparmio dell’area centrale in tutti i settori. Fovea 31 dB; MD - 21.28 dB; PSD 13.23 dB.La macchia cieca è inglobata nell’emianopsia temporale. In OS campo visivo assente in tutti i settori. Gli indici di attendibilità dell’esame sono accettabili. Conclusioni: Lesione chiasmatica anteriore e pre-chiasmatica interessante anche il nervo ottico dell’OS e parte di quello dell’OD. Si consiglia di effettuare RM dell’encefalo e dell’ipofisi con mezzo di contrasto.
translation: Exam performed using the 30 – 2 – ZETA strategy. First computerized exam. In the right eye (OD), there is right hemianopia associated with a clearly defined lower nasal quadrantanopia relative to the horizontal plane and the upper nasal sector, with sparing of the central area in all sectors. Fovea 31 dB; MD -21.28 dB; PSD 13.23 dB. The blind spot is encompassed within the temporal hemianopia. In the left eye (OS), the visual field is absent in all sectors. The reliability indices of the exam are acceptable. Conclusions: Anterior chiasmal and pre-chiasmal lesion affecting the optic nerve of the left eye (OS) and part of the right eye (OD). A brain and pituitary MRI with contrast is recommended.

report: Esame eseguito con strategia 30 – 2 – ZETA. 2° esame computerizzato. In OD la sensibilità retinica risulta ampiamente ridotta soprattutto nella fascia a cavallo dei settori superiori ed inferiori, sia temporali che nasali, a partenza dalla macchia cieca che risulta inglobata nell'ampio scotoma centrale (scotoma superiore di Bjerrum).Fovea -1 dB; MD -10.97 dB; PSD 11.22 dB. La mappa della Total deviation e quella della Pattern deviation presentano profonda alterazione della sensibilità retinica nei settori superiori, mentre è in parte recuperata la sensibilità nei settori inferiori, rispetto all'esame precedente. GHT oltre i limiti della norma. In OS la sensibilità retinica risulta complessivamente nei limiti della norma pur presentandosi delle piccole aree di riduzione in periferia, oltre i 20°, nel settore nasale superiore ed in quello temporale inferiore. La macchia cieca è di dimensioni normali. Fovea 37 dB; MD 1.61 dB; PSD 2.96 dB La mappa della Total deviation è normale, mentre quella della Pattern deviation presenta alcuni punti di riduzione della sensibilità nei settori inferiori. GHT entro i limiti della norma. Gli indici di attendibilità dell’esame sono scarsi in OO. Conclusioni: Il tracciato presenta ampia alterazione della sensibilità retinica in OD ed una condizione ai limiti della norma in OS.
translation: Exam performed using the 30 – 2 – ZETA strategy. This is the second computerized test. In the right eye (OD), retinal sensitivity is significantly reduced, particularly across the upper and lower sectors, both temporal and nasal, starting from the blind spot, which is encompassed within the large central scotoma (superior Bjerrum scotoma). Fovea -1 dB; MD -10.97 dB; PSD 11.22 dB. The Total Deviation and Pattern Deviation maps show a profound reduction in retinal sensitivity in the upper sectors, while there is partial recovery of sensitivity in the lower sectors compared to the previous exam. GHT is beyond normal limits. In the left eye (OS), retinal sensitivity is generally within normal limits, although there are small areas of reduction in the periphery, beyond 20°, in the upper nasal and lower temporal sectors. The blind spot is of normal size. Fovea 37 dB; MD 1.61 dB; PSD 2.96 dB. The Total Deviation map is normal, while the Pattern Deviation map shows some points of reduced sensitivity in the lower sectors. GHT is within normal limits. The reliability indices of the exam are poor in both eyes (OO). Conclusions: The trace shows a significant alteration in retinal sensitivity in the right eye and a condition at the limits of normal in the left eye.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari radiali passanti per la fovea (Radial) e ricostruzione in 3D (Retina Map) ha evidenziato: In OD presenza di pucker maculare che si mostra nelle scansioni esaminate come una linea ipereflettente lungo il profilo interno della retina associato a fenomeni di trazione sulla retina e la formazione di foro maculare stadio 1-2 con presenza di evidente pseudocisti foveale. Lieve edema degli strati interni. Evidenziabili i diversi strati della retina ed in particolare la MLE e l’ellissoide, che presenta una interruzione superiormente alla fovea in corrispondenza di una piccola area con dispersione di pigmento. Altra area di dispersione di pigmento è posta nasalmente alla fovea stessa. Assenza di fluidi anomali. Lo spessore retinico dell'area foveale risulta moderatamente aumentato in fovea (OD pari a 331μ). Il volume del cubo esaminato è pari a 10,3 mm3. Conclusioni: Pucker maculare in OD associato a foro maculare stadio 1-2. Dispersione di pigmento in alcune aree maculari. In OS esame nell’ambito della norma.
translation: The examination conducted using radial linear scans through the fovea (Radial) and 3D reconstruction (Retina Map) revealed: In the right eye (OD), the presence of a macular pucker, which appears in the examined scans as a hyper-reflective line along the inner profile of the retina, associated with traction phenomena on the retina and the formation of a stage 1-2 macular hole with an evident foveal pseudocyst. There is mild edema of the inner layers. The different layers of the retina are distinguishable, particularly the external limiting membrane (ELM) and the ellipsoid zone, which shows a disruption above the fovea corresponding to a small area with pigment dispersion. Another area of pigment dispersion is located nasally to the fovea itself. No abnormal fluids are present. The retinal thickness in the foveal area is moderately increased at the fovea (OD measuring 331μ). The volume of the examined cube is 10.3 mm3. Conclusions: Macular pucker in the right eye (OD) associated with a stage 1-2 macular hole. Pigment dispersion in some macular areas. Examination of the left eye (OS) is within normal limits.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari parallele (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster ) passanti per l’area maculare e ricostruzione in 3D (Macular Cube 512x128), ha evidenziato: In OD presenza di punti di bassa reflettività pre-retinici indice di disomogeneità del vitreo e di una zona pre-retinica otticamente vuota dovuta a retrazione del vitreo (vitreoschisi). Il profilo interno della retina presenta la fisiologica depressione foveale ed appare regolare tranne che in un’area extramaculare corrispondente al fascio papillo-maculare dove è presente una convessità dovuta a distacco sieroso del neuroepitelio (CSCR). Ben evidenziabili i diversi strati della retina ed in particolare la MLE e la giunzione segmento interno/segmento esterno dei fotorecettori. Lo strato EPR-coriocapillare è di aspetto e reflettività normali. Spessore medio del campo centrale = 269 µ, volume del cubo esaminato = 11,2 mm3. In OS punti di bassa reflettività pre-retinici indice di disomogeneità del vitreo e di una zona pre-retinica otticamente vuota dovuta a retrazione del vitreo (vitreoschisi). Il profilo interno della retina, pur mostrando la fisiologica depressione foveale, presenta una marcata convessità conseguenza dell’ampio distacco sieroso del neuroepitelio (CSCR) che impegna la macula ed un’ampia area temporalmente ad essa. In corrispondenza delle stesse aree si nota edema intraretinico diffuso interessante tutti gli strati retinici. Ben evidenziabili i diversi strati della retina ed in particolare la MLE e la giunzione segmento interno/segmento esterno dei fotorecettori (o ellissoide). Spessore medio del campo centrale = 493 µ, volume del cubo esaminato = 14,3 mm3. Conclusioni: in OD corioretinopatia sierosa extramaculare. In OS corioretinopatiasierosa centrale (CSCR) di ampie proporzioni.
translation:
The examination conducted using parallel linear scans (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster) through the macular area and 3D reconstruction (Macular Cube 512x128) revealed the following:

In the right eye (OD), there are areas of low reflectivity in the pre-retinal space, indicating vitreous heterogeneity and an optically empty pre-retinal zone due to vitreous retraction (vitreoschisis). The internal retinal profile shows the physiological foveal depression and appears regular except in an extramacular area corresponding to the papillomacular bundle, where there is a convexity due to serous detachment of the neuroepithelium (CSCR). The various retinal layers are well-defined, particularly the external limiting membrane (ELM) and the inner segment/outer segment junction of the photoreceptors. The RPE-choriocapillaris layer appears normal in aspect and reflectivity. The average central field thickness is 269 µm, and the volume of the examined cube is 11.2 mm³.
