In the left eye (OS), there are areas of low reflectivity in the pre-retinal space, indicating vitreous heterogeneity and an optically empty pre-retinal zone due to vitreous retraction (vitreoschisis). The internal retinal profile, while showing the physiological foveal depression, presents a marked convexity as a result of a large serous detachment of the neuroepithelium (CSCR) involving the macula and a large temporal area adjacent to it. In these same areas, there is diffuse intraretinal edema affecting all retinal layers. The various retinal layers are well-defined, particularly the ELM and the inner segment/outer segment junction of the photoreceptors (or ellipsoid). The average central field thickness is 493 µm, and the volume of the examined cube is 14.3 mm³.

Conclusions: In the right eye (OD), there is extramacular serous chorioretinopathy. In the left eye (OS), there is a large central serous chorioretinopathy (CSCR).

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari radiali passanti per la fovea (Radial) e ricostruzione in 3D (Retina Map) -ha evidenziato: In OD il profilo interno della retina appare regolare nelle scansioni effettuate con normale presenza della depressione foveale. Ben evidenziabili i diversi strati della retina diversamente da quelli interni che mostrano irregolarità e appaiono associati a DEP di natura drusenoide e vascolare. Quadro compatibile con la presenza di strie angioidi. Lo strato EPR-coriocapillare è di aspetto e reflettività ridotte rispetto la norma con migrazione di pigmento. Lo spessore retinico medio ed il volume delle aree esaminate sono nella norma, ad eccezione del settore superiore. Spessore medio del campo centrale = 246 μ. In OS il profilo interno della retina appare regolare nelle scansioni effettuate con normale presenza della depressione foveale. Ben evidenziabili i diversi strati della retina diversamente da quelli interni che mostrano irregolarità e appaiono associati a migrazioni di pigmento multiple. Spessore medio del campo centrale = 240 μ. L’esame Angiography Analysis: Angiography 6x6 mm (HD Angio Retina) ha evidenziato: In OD si evidenzia neovascolarizzazioni peripapillari non associate a segnali di attività. In OS assenza di alterazioni vascolari. Conclusioni: In OO strie angiodi associate a pseudoxantoma elastico.
translation: The examination conducted using radial linear scans through the fovea (Radial) and 3D reconstruction (Retina Map) revealed the following: In the right eye (OD), the internal retinal profile appears regular in the scans performed, with a normal presence of the foveal depression. The various retinal layers are well-defined, unlike the inner layers, which show irregularities and appear associated with drusenoid and vascular pigment epithelial detachments (DEP). This is consistent with the presence of angioid streaks. The RPE-choriocapillaris layer shows reduced appearance and reflectivity compared to normal, with pigment migration. The average retinal thickness and volume of the examined areas are within normal limits, except for the superior sector. Average central field thickness = 246 μm. In the left eye (OS), the internal retinal profile appears regular in the scans performed, with a normal presence of the foveal depression. The various retinal layers are well-defined, unlike the inner layers, which show irregularities and appear associated with multiple pigment migrations. Average central field thickness = 240 μm. The Angiography Analysis: Angiography 6x6 mm (HD Angio Retina) revealed: In the right eye (OD), peripapillary neovascularizations are evident, not associated with signs of activity. In the left eye (OS), there are no vascular alterations. Conclusions: In both eyes (OU), angioid streaks associated with pseudoxanthoma elasticum.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari parallele (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster ) passanti per l’area maculare e ricostruzione in 3D (Macular Cube 512x128), ha evidenziato: In OD il profilo interno della retina presenta una marcata concavità correlata alla elevata myopia presente; peraltro appare irregolare lungo i profili esaminati con difficoltà ad individuare la fisiologica depressione foveale e presenza di tratti di membrana epiretinica. Evidenziabili con difficoltà i diversi strati della retina, la membrana limitante esterna (ELM) e l'ellissoide non sono individuabili. L'EPR appare scompaginato. Assenza di fluidi anomali. È ridotta la reflettività dello strato delle fibre nervose. Ampia area di atrofia corioretinica che impegna buona parte del polo posteriore e l'intera area peripapillare. Lo spessore del campo centrale è al di sotto della norma, come il volume del cubo esaminato. Spessore medio del campo centrale = 155 μ. Volume del cubo esaminato = 8,6 mm3.
translation: The examination conducted using linear parallel scans (High Definition Images 5 Line Raster) through the macular area and 3D reconstruction (Macular Cube 512x128) revealed the following: In the right eye (OD), the inner retinal profile shows a pronounced concavity associated with high myopia; moreover, it appears irregular along the examined profiles, making it difficult to identify the normal foveal depression, with segments of epiretinal membrane present. The different retinal layers are difficult to discern, and the external limiting membrane (ELM) and ellipsoid zone are not identifiable. The retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) appears disrupted. No abnormal fluids are present. There is reduced reflectivity of the nerve fiber layer. There is a large area of chorioretinal atrophy involving much of the posterior pole and the entire peripapillary area. The central field thickness is below normal, as is the volume of the examined cube. Average central field thickness = 155 μm. Volume of the examined cube = 8.6 mm³.

report: L’esame effettuato mediante scansioni lineari radiali passanti per la fovea (Radial) e ricostruzione in 3D (Retina Map)- ha evidenziato: Esame sostanzialmente simile al precedente effettuato 10 mesi prima, pertanto: in ambo gli occhi (OD < OS) si evidenzia la presenza di pucker maculare che si mostra nelle scansioni esaminate come una linea ipereflettente lungo il profilo interno della retina associato a fenomeni di trazione che determinano delle pieghe della retina stessa ed edema dello strato nucleare esterno. Sono presenti alcune pseudocisti in deep retina, non evidenziate in passato. Depressione foveale appena individuabile in OD, assente in OS. Evidenziabili i diversi strati della retina ed in particolare la MLE e l’ellissoide. Lo spessore retinico dell'area maculare (fovea in OD pari a 338 micron, in OS 399 micron) è aumentato rispetto alla norma. Il volume del cubo esaminato è pari a 7,72 mm3 in OD e 7,79 mm3 in OS). Conclusioni: Pucker maculare bilaterale di proporzioni stabili in OD e moderatamente peggiorate in OS. Si consiglia la ripetizione dell’esame tra 8 mesi.
translation: The examination, conducted using radial linear scans through the fovea (Radial) and 3D reconstruction (Retina Map), revealed the following: The findings are essentially similar to the previous exam conducted 10 months ago. In both eyes (right eye less than left eye), there is evidence of a macular pucker, which appears in the scans as a hyper-reflective line along the inner profile of the retina, associated with traction phenomena causing folds in the retina itself and edema of the outer nuclear layer. Some pseudocysts are present in the deep retina, which were not noted previously. The foveal depression is barely detectable in the right eye and absent in the left eye. The different layers of the retina are distinguishable, particularly the external limiting membrane and the ellipsoid zone. The retinal thickness in the macular area (fovea in the right eye is 338 microns, in the left eye 399 microns) is increased compared to normal. The volume of the examined cube is 7.72 mm³ in the right eye and 7.79 mm³ in the left eye. Conclusions: Bilateral macular pucker with stable proportions in the right eye and moderately worsened in the left eye. A follow-up examination is recommended in 8 months.

report: OD: Al polo posteriore, sono presenti aree iperfluorescenti che aumentano di intensità e dimensioni nel tempo. L’esame ICG e OCTA evidenziano una neovascolarizzazione sottoretinica. L’esame OCTmostra segni di attività della neovascolarizzazione sottoretinica. OS: Assenza di anomalie angiografiche al polo posteriore. L’esame OCTmostra conservato profilo e spessore maculare. L’esame OCTRNFL mostra lieve riduzione dello spessore dello strato delle fibre nervose nel quadrante temporale inferiore in OD e appare nella norma in OS. Conclusioni: OD: neovascolarizzazione sottoretinica attiva. Si consiglia iniezione intravitreale di anti-VEGF in OD.
translation: Right Eye (OD): In the posterior pole, there are hyperfluorescent areas that increase in intensity and size over time. The ICG and OCTA exams reveal subretinal neovascularization. The OCTexam shows signs of activity in the subretinal neovascularization. Left Eye (OS): No angiographic abnormalities are present in the posterior pole. The OCTexam shows a preserved macular profile and thickness. The OCTRNFL exam shows a slight reduction in the thickness of the nerve fiber layer in the lower temporal quadrant of the right eye (OD) and appears normal in the left eye (OS). Conclusions: Right Eye (OD): Active subretinal neovascularization. An intravitreal injection of anti-VEGF is recommended for the right eye (OD).

report: OD:Al livello del disco ottico sono presenti aree iperfluorescenti  che aumentano irregolarmente  di intensita’ nel tempo,e’ evidente una tortuosita’ vasale e anomalie vascolari in regione peripapillare. L’esame ICG non evidenzia segni di neovascolarizzazione sottoretinica. In regione maculare  non si evidenziano alterazioni patologiche degne di nota. OS: non si evidenziano alterazioni patologiche all’esame FAG,ICG. Conclusioni: OD:Amartoma del disco ottico
translation: Right Eye (OD): At the level of the optic disc, there are hyperfluorescent areas that increase irregularly in intensity over time. There is evident vascular tortuosity and vascular anomalies in the peripapillary region. The ICG exam does not show signs of subretinal neovascularization. No noteworthy pathological changes are observed in the macular region. Left Eye (OS): No pathological changes are observed on the FAG and ICG exams. Conclusions: Right Eye (OD): Optic disc hamartoma.

report: OO: Retinopatia diabetica background con rari microaneurismi al polo posteriore OD>OS. Lieve aumento della permeabilità vasale al polo posteriore. All’esame OCTsi evidenzia cisti intraretiniche in regione maculare in OD e conservato profilo e spessore maculare in OS.
translation: Findings: Background diabetic retinopathy with rare microaneurysms in the posterior pole, more pronounced in the right eye than the left. There is a slight increase in vascular permeability in the posterior pole. OCTexamination reveals intraretinal cysts in the macular region of the right eye, while the macular profile and thickness are preserved in the left eye.

report: OO: Strie angioidi. OD: In regione maculare sono presenti aree irregolari ipo-iperfluorescenti che non aumentano di intensita’ nel tempo per alterazione dell’epitelio pigmentato retinico. L’esame ICG mostra numerose aree ipofluorescenti al polo posteriore con aspetto a “peau  d’orange” ed al polo posteriore nel settore temporale è presente un’area ipocianescente che non si modifica nel tempo da nevo della coroide, confermato anche da scansioni OCT. L’esame OCTevidenzia piccola falda di fluido sottoretinico sottoretinico in regione subfoveale. OS: In regione maculare sono presenti aree irregolari ipo-iperfluorescente che non aumentano di intensita’ nel tempo per alterazione dell’epitelio pigmentato retinico. L’esame ICG mostra numerose aree ipofluorescenti al polo posteriore con aspetto a “peau  d’orange”  ed evidenzia una neovascolarizzazione sottoretinica. L’esame OCTmostra una piccola falda di fluido sottoretinico sottoretinico in regione subfoveale. Conclusioni: Strie angioidi complicate in OO da neovascolarizzazione sottoretinica attiva. Si consiglia iniezione intravitreale di ANTI-VEGF in OO.
translation: Both Eyes: Angioid streaks. Right Eye: In the macular region, there are irregular hypo-hyperfluorescent areas that do not increase in intensity over time due to alterations in the retinal pigment epithelium. The ICG exam shows numerous hypofluorescent areas in the posterior pole with a "peau d'orange" appearance, and in the temporal sector of the posterior pole, there is a hypocyanscent area that remains unchanged over time, consistent with a choroidal nevus, also confirmed by OCTscans. The OCTexam reveals a small pocket of subretinal fluid in the subfoveal region. Left Eye: In the macular region, there are irregular hypo-hyperfluorescent areas that do not increase in intensity over time due to alterations in the retinal pigment epithelium. The ICG exam shows numerous hypofluorescent areas in the posterior pole with a "peau d'orange" appearance and highlights subretinal neovascularization. The OCTexam shows a small pocket of subretinal fluid in the subfoveal region. Conclusions: Angioid streaks complicated in both eyes by active subretinal neovascularization. Intravitreal injection of ANTI-VEGF is recommended in both eyes.

report: OD: Esame angiografico nella norma. L’esame OCTevidenzia profilo e spessore retinico nella norma. OS: Inferiormente all’arcata vascolare temporale inferiore si evidenzia un’area ipo-iperfuorescente che non si modifica nel tempo da esiti di melanoma della coroide trattato con brachiterapia. Si evidenzia occlusione di branca venosa, ramo di II ordine della vena temporale inferiore. Presenza di estese aree di non perfusione retinica nel settore inferiore. Lieve Aumento della permeabilità vasale al polo posteriore. L’esame OCTevidenzia conservato profilo foveolare con rare cisti intraretiniche e sollevamento dell’epitelio pigmentato retinico e della coriocapillare con ombreggiamento degli strati sottostanti in corrispondenza della lesione tumorale. Conclusioni: OS: Retinopatia da radiazione in esiti di melanoma della coroide trattato con brachiterapia. Si consiglia trattamento laser retinico in OS
translation: OD: The angiographic examination is normal. The OCTscan shows a normal retinal profile and thickness. OS: Below the inferior temporal vascular arcade, there is an area of hypo-hyperfluorescence that remains unchanged over time, consistent with the aftermath of choroidal melanoma treated with brachytherapy. There is an occlusion of a branch vein, a second-order branch of the inferior temporal vein. Extensive areas of retinal non-perfusion are present in the inferior sector. There is a slight increase in vascular permeability at the posterior pole. The OCTscan shows a preserved foveal profile with rare intraretinal cysts and elevation of the retinal pigment epithelium and choriocapillaris with shadowing of the underlying layers corresponding to the tumor lesion. Conclusions: OS: Radiation retinopathy as a result of choroidal melanoma treated with brachytherapy. Retinal laser treatment is recommended for OS.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con dolore addominale

Il fegato ha dimensioni nei limiti della normalità e struttura normoecogena omogenea.
Le vie biliari intra ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate. 
La colecisti, di normale morfologia e ampiezza, ha pareti di regolare spessore e non contiene calcoli.
Il pancreas nelle sue porzioni esplorabili (testa e corpo) e la milza hanno regolare aspetto ecografico.
I reni hanno dimensioni nei limiti della normalità e parenchima di spessore ed ecogenicità conservati.
Non sono riconoscibili segni di litiasi nè dilatazione delle vie escretrici urinarie.
L'aorta addominale nel tratto esplorabile ha calibro regolare.
La vescica ha pareti regolari e contenuto omogeneo.
translation:
Clinical Query: Follow-up in a patient with abdominal pain

The liver is within normal size limits and has a homogeneous, normoechoic structure.  
The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated.  
The gallbladder is of normal shape and size, with walls of regular thickness and contains no stones.  
The pancreas, in its accessible portions (head and body), and the spleen have a normal ultrasound appearance.  
The kidneys are within normal size limits, with preserved parenchymal thickness and echogenicity.  
There are no signs of lithiasis or dilation of the urinary excretory pathways.  
The abdominal aorta, in the explored segment, has a regular caliber.  
The bladder has regular walls and homogeneous content.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con cisti renali

Il fegato presenta dimensioni normali e struttura priva di significative alterazioni di tipo sia diffuso sia focale.
Le vie biliari intra- ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate.
La colecisti, di normale ampiezza, è priva di calcoli.
Il pancreas, esplorabile al corpo, e la milza (11 - 12 cm) hanno normale aspetto ecotomografico.
I reni hanno dimensioni normali e parenchima di spessore ed ecogenicità conservati. A destra si osservano due formazioni cistiche delle dimensioni di 5,2 e 3,7 centimetri. A sinistra si segnala una cisti polare superiore del diametro massimo di 3,2 centimetri.
Non si osservano segni evidenti di litiasi né di dilatazione delle cavità escretrici.
L'aorta addominale presenta calibro regolare.
La vescica ha pareti ben distensibili ed è priva di evidenti formazioni vegetanti endoluminali.
La prostata ha dimensioni lievemente aumentate (diametro trasverso 4,6 cm) e struttura lievemente disomogenea per adenomiomatosi.
translation:
Clinical question: follow-up in a patient with renal cysts

The liver is of normal size and shows no significant diffuse or focal structural alterations. The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The gallbladder is of normal size and free of stones. The pancreas, visible at the body, and the spleen (11 - 12 cm) have a normal ultrasound appearance. The kidneys are of normal size with preserved parenchymal thickness and echogenicity. On the right, there are two cystic formations measuring 5.2 and 3.7 centimeters. On the left, there is an upper pole cyst with a maximum diameter of 3.2 centimeters. There are no evident signs of lithiasis or dilation of the excretory cavities. The abdominal aorta has a regular caliber. The bladder has well-distensible walls and shows no evident endoluminal vegetative formations. The prostate is slightly enlarged (transverse diameter 4.6 cm) with a mildly heterogeneous structure due to adenomyomatosis.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con noti angiomi epatici

Il fegato dimensioni nei limiti di norma con ecostruttura regolare.
Nel VII e nel  VI segmento sono presenti due piccole formazioni nodulari solide iperecogene rotondeggianti del diametro massimo rispettivamente di 7 e 9 mm da riferire in prima ipotesi ad angiomi.
Le vie biliari intra ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate.
La colecisti è alitiasica.
Si  rileva presenza di una piccola formazione vegetante endoluminale della diametro massimo di 5 mm  da riferire a polipo colesterinico.
La milza e la porzione esplorabile del pancreas (parte del corpo) sono nella norma.
All'ilo epatico si riconosce un linfonodo del diametro massimo di 13 mm.
I reni sono regolari per margini, dimensioni e spessore parenchimale senza segni di litiasi od idroureteronefrosi.
D'ambo i lati sono presenti alcune cisti parapieliche  del  diametro massimo di 18 mm.
Non si riconoscono linfonodi di dimensioni od  aspetto patologico in sede inguinale d'ambo i lati ed in corrispondenza del cavo popliteo.
translation:
Clinical Query: Follow-up in a patient with known hepatic hemangiomas

The liver is within normal size limits with a regular echotexture. In segments VII and VI, there are two small, round, solid hyperechoic nodules with maximum diameters of 7 mm and 9 mm, respectively, likely representing hemangiomas. The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The gallbladder is free of stones. There is a small endoluminal vegetative formation with a maximum diameter of 5 mm, likely a cholesterol polyp. The spleen and the explored portion of the pancreas (part of the body) are normal. A lymph node with a maximum diameter of 13 mm is noted at the hepatic hilum. The kidneys are normal in terms of margins, size, and parenchymal thickness, with no signs of lithiasis or hydronephrosis. On both sides, there are some parapelvic cysts with a maximum diameter of 18 mm. No lymph nodes of pathological size or appearance are identified in the inguinal region on either side or in the popliteal fossa.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con sospetta colelitiasi

Il fegato dimensioni nei limiti della normalità con ecostruttura regolare ed è privo di lesioni focali.
Le vie biliari intra ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate.
La colecisti è alitiasica in presenza di una piccola formazione iperecogena endoluminale del diametro massimo di 5 mm da riferire a polipo colesterinico.
La milza e il pancreas sono regolari.
I reni sono regolari per margini, dimensioni e spessore parenchimale senza segni di litiasi od idroureteronefrosi. La vescica, ben distesa, è priva di aggetti endoluminali.
translation:
Clinical question: follow-up in a patient with suspected cholelithiasis

The liver is normal in size with a regular echotexture and shows no focal lesions. The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The gallbladder is free of stones, with a small hyperechoic intraluminal formation measuring a maximum diameter of 5 mm, suggestive of a cholesterol polyp. The spleen and pancreas are normal. The kidneys are normal in terms of margins, size, and parenchymal thickness, with no signs of lithiasis or hydronephrosis. The bladder is well-distended and free of intraluminal projections.

report:
Quesito clinico: valutazione in paziente con splenomegalia

Il fegato ha dimensioni nei limiti di norma con margini regolari ed ecostruttura iperecogena per steatosi senza che siano riconoscibili lesioni focali.
Le vie biliari intra ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate.
La colecisti è alitiasica.
La milza è ingrandita (DL 14 cm). 
Il pancreas e i reni sono regolari.
La vescica, repleta, è priva di aggetti endoluminali. 
Non è presente versamento nei livelli esaminati.
translation:
Clinical Query: Evaluation in a patient with splenomegaly

The liver is of normal size with regular margins and shows a hyperechoic texture due to steatosis, with no focal lesions identified. The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The gallbladder is free of stones. The spleen is enlarged (longitudinal diameter 14 cm). The pancreas and kidneys are normal. The bladder, when full, shows no endoluminal projections. No fluid collection is present in the areas examined.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente fumatore

Non si osservano lesioni polmonari o pleuriche con caratteristiche radiologiche di attività.
L'ombra cardiaca è nei limiti della normalità.
La trachea è in asse.
translation:
Clinical question: follow-up in a smoker patient

No pulmonary or pleural lesions with radiological features of activity are observed.
The cardiac silhouette is within normal limits.
The trachea is midline.

report:
Quesito clinico: valutazione preoperatoria

Non si osservano lesioni polmonari con caratteristiche radiologiche di attività . 
Sono presenti ispessimenti pleurici biapicali.
Non è presente versamento pleurico.
L'ombra cardiaca ha dimensioni nei limiti della normalità.
La trachea è in asse.
translation:
Clinical Query: Preoperative Evaluation

No pulmonary lesions with radiological features of activity are observed. 
There are bilateral apical pleural thickenings. 
No pleural effusion is present. 
The cardiac silhouette is within normal size limits. 
The trachea is midline.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in esiti di polmonite

Non si osservano lesioni polmonari con caratteristiche radiologiche di attività.
A destra si segnala la presenza di versamento pleurico dello spessore massimo di 3 cm; non si osserva versamento pleurico a sinistra.
L'ombra cardiaca ha dimensioni nei limiti della normalità.
La trachea è in asse.
translation:
Clinical question: follow-up after pneumonia

No pulmonary lesions with radiological features of activity are observed. On the right side, there is a pleural effusion with a maximum thickness of 3 cm; no pleural effusion is observed on the left side. The cardiac silhouette is within normal size limits. The trachea is midline.

report:
Quesito clinico: sospetta occlusione intestinale

Non si osservano livelli idroaerei o falde di aria libera sub diaframmatica.
Si rileva marcata coprostasi colica, più evidente nei quadranti di destra.
translation:
Clinical question: suspected intestinal obstruction

No air-fluid levels or free air under the diaphragm are observed. There is marked colonic fecal stasis, more pronounced in the right quadrants.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con dolore cervicale

Il rachide cervicale è in asse.
La fisiologica lordosi cervicale è conservata.
I corpi vertebrali hanno altezza regolare e non vi sono disallineamenti dei muri somatici posteriori.
translation:
Clinical question: follow-up in a patient with neck pain

The cervical spine is aligned.
The normal cervical lordosis is preserved.
The vertebral bodies have regular height, and there are no misalignments of the posterior vertebral walls.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in nota scoliosi

Sul piano frontale si osserva una scoliosi a convessità sinistra con rotazione antioraria dei metameri L2 - L3.
Sul piano sagittale si osserva la verticalizzazione della fisiologica lordosi.
Il tono minerale del piano osseo è diffusamente ridotto.
translation:
Clinical Query: Follow-up for noted scoliosis

On the frontal plane, there is a left-convex scoliosis with counterclockwise rotation of the L2-L3 vertebrae. On the sagittal plane, there is a straightening of the normal lordosis. The bone mineral density is diffusely reduced.

report:
Quesito clinico: sospetta frattura

Non si osservano lesioni focali ossee di significato post-traumatico recente.
I rapporti articolari sono conservati.
translation:
Clinical question: suspected fracture

No focal bone lesions indicative of recent trauma are observed. Joint alignments are preserved.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con pregresso ca mammella

In ambito encefalico non sono comparsi  anomali accumuli contrastografici di pertinenza cerebro meningea in sede sovra e sottotentoriale.
Il sistema ventricolare è in asse, regolare per dimensioni e morfologia.
translation:
Clinical Query: Follow-up in a patient with a history of breast cancer

In the brain, there are no abnormal contrast-enhancing lesions in the supra- or infratentorial regions related to the cerebro-meningeal area. The ventricular system is midline, with normal size and morphology.

report:
Quesito clinico: sospetta lesione polmonare

In ambito polmonare, in esiti di lobectomia superiore destra si documenta una formazione nodulare, a margini spiculati, delle dimenisoni massime di 20 x 17mm, di sospetta natura evolutiva. Non si osservano ulteriori lesioni polmonari con caratteristiche radiologiche di attività.
La trachea ed i bronchi principali sono pervi.
Non si osservano falde di versamento pleurico.
translation:
Clinical question: Suspected lung lesion

In the pulmonary field, following a right upper lobectomy, there is a nodular formation with spiculated margins, measuring up to 20 x 17 mm, suspected to be of an evolving nature. No additional pulmonary lesions with radiological characteristics of activity are observed. The trachea and main bronchi are patent. No pleural effusion is observed.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con sospetta lesione renale

In ambito addominale, il fegato è privo di leisoni focali.
Le vie via biliari intra- ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate.
La milza, il pancreas, i surreni ed i reni (in presenza di una formazione cistica al polo superiore del rene destro di 5 mm) hanno regolare aspetto TC.
Le vie escretrici urinarie non sono dilatate.
Non sono comparse falde di versamento o libero o saccato in addome nè linfonodi di dimensioni o aspetto patologico.
translation:
Clinical question: follow-up in a patient with suspected renal lesion

In the abdominal region, the liver is free of focal lesions. The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The spleen, pancreas, adrenal glands, and kidneys (with a 5 mm cystic formation at the upper pole of the right kidney) have a normal CT appearance. The urinary excretory pathways are not dilated. There is no evidence of free or encapsulated fluid in the abdomen, nor are there lymph nodes of pathological size or appearance.

report:
Quesito clinico: valutazione in paziente con sospetto adenoma surrenalico

In ambito addominale, il fegato è privo di leisoni focali.
Le vie via biliari intra- ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate e la vena porta è regolarmente pervia.
La milza, il pancreas ed i reni hanno regolare aspetto TC.
Si segnala ispessimento dell'aletta mediale del surrene sinistro di natura adenomatosa.
Le vie escretrici urinarie non sono dilatate.
Non sono comparse falde di versamento o libero o saccato in addome nè linfonodi di dimensioni o aspetto patologico.
translation:
Clinical question: evaluation in a patient with suspected adrenal adenoma

In the abdominal region, the liver is free of focal lesions. The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated, and the portal vein is patent. The spleen, pancreas, and kidneys have a normal CT appearance. There is noted thickening of the medial limb of the left adrenal gland, consistent with an adenomatous nature. The urinary excretory pathways are not dilated. There is no evidence of free or encapsulated fluid in the abdomen, nor are there lymph nodes of pathological size or appearance.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in sospetta calcolosi della colecisti

Le vie biliari intra- ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate e non si osservano vuoti di segnale riferibili a calcoli. La VBP ha calibro massimo di 8 mm.
La colecisti, sovradistesa, è sede di una formazione ipointensa in T1 e caratterizzata da ''vuoto di segnale'' in T2 riferibile a calcolo. Il dotto cistico ha decorso retrocoledocico con sbocco al passaggio tra tratto prossimale e medio della VBP.
Il dotto di Wirsung non è dilatato.
Il fegato, la milza, il pancreas, i surreni e entrambi i reni hanno regolare aspetto RM nelle sequenze acquisite.
Non si osservano falde di versamento, né adenopatie ai livelli esaminati.
translation:
Clinical Query: Follow-up for suspected gallbladder stones

The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated, and no signal voids indicative of stones are observed. The common bile duct has a maximum diameter of 8 mm. The gallbladder is overdistended and contains a T1 hypointense formation with a "signal void" on T2, suggestive of a stone. The cystic duct follows a retrocholedochal course, opening at the junction between the proximal and middle sections of the common bile duct. The pancreatic duct (Wirsung's duct) is not dilated. The liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenal glands, and both kidneys appear normal on the acquired MRI sequences. No fluid collections or lymphadenopathy are observed in the examined areas.

report:
Quesito clinico: valutazione in paziente con adenoma surrenalico

Le vie biliari intra- ed extraepatiche non sono dilatate e non si osservano vuoti di segnale riferibili a calcoli. La VBP ha calibro massimo di 8 mm.
La colecisti, sovradistesa, è alitiasica. Il dotto cistico ha decorso retrocoledocico con sbocco al passaggio tra tratto prossimale e medio della VBP.
Il dotto di Wirsung non è dilatato.
La milza, il pancreas, il surrene destro, il fegato ed i reni hanno regolare aspetto RM nelle sequenze acquisite.
Il surrene sinistro presenta un espanso di 25 mm caratterizzato da abbattimento del segnale nelle sequenze dual "fuori fase" per contenuto lipidico intracellulare compatibile con adenoma.
Non si osservano falde di versamento, né adenopatie ai livelli esaminati.
translation:
Clinical question: evaluation in a patient with adrenal adenoma

The intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated, and there are no signal voids indicative of stones. The common bile duct has a maximum diameter of 8 mm. The gallbladder is overdistended and free of stones. The cystic duct follows a retrocholedochal course, emptying at the junction between the proximal and middle segments of the common bile duct. The pancreatic duct (Wirsung's duct) is not dilated. The spleen, pancreas, right adrenal gland, liver, and kidneys appear normal on the acquired MRI sequences. The left adrenal gland shows a 25 mm mass characterized by signal drop in the dual "out-of-phase" sequences due to intracellular lipid content, consistent with an adenoma. No fluid collections or lymphadenopathy are observed at the examined levels.

report:
Quesito clinico: controllo in paziente con nota INF

In ambito epatico, in S4, si osserva una voluminosa formazione nodulare a margini polibati, di  76 x 62 mm caratterizzata sfumata iperintensità in T2, prive di incremento di segnale in diffusione e che , allo studio dinamico, presenta alcuni spot ipervascolarizzati nella compagine in fase arteriosa mentre risulta isointense in fase portale e tardiva. In fase di escrezione epatobiliare è caratterizzata da un'area periferica iperintensa e da una compontente centrale ipointensa, come da scar cicatriziale da riferire a INF. 
La colecisti, normodistesa, contiene minima quota di sludge biliare; le vie biliari non sono dilatate.
Il pancreas, la milza, i surreni ed i reni hanno regolare segnale RM.
Non si osservano falde di versamento in addome nè linfonodi di dimensioni incrementate ai livelli esaminati.
translation:
Clinical question: follow-up in a patient with known FNH

In the liver, within segment 4, there is a large nodular formation with lobulated margins, measuring 76 x 62 mm. It shows a faint hyperintensity on T2-weighted images, with no diffusion signal increase. On dynamic study, it exhibits some hypervascular spots in the arterial phase, while appearing isointense in the portal and delayed phases. During the hepatobiliary excretion phase, it is characterized by a peripheral hyperintense area and a central hypointense component, consistent with a scar typical of FNH.  
The gallbladder is normally distended and contains a minimal amount of biliary sludge; the bile ducts are not dilated.  
The pancreas, spleen, adrenal glands, and kidneys show normal MRI signal characteristics.  
No abdominal fluid collections or enlarged lymph nodes are observed at the examined levels.

report:
Quesito clinico: paziente con recente riscontro di ca retto

In corrispondenza del retto medio-basso a 3 cm dalla rima anale, si osserva la presenza di una lesione eteroplastica che si estende in direzione cranio-caudale per 4.5 cm circa e presenta spessore massimo di 1.7 cm con interessamento circonferenziale "a manicotto" e aspetto substenostante. Essa risulta caratterizzata da segnale disomogeneo nelle sequenze T2-pesate, con incremento dello stesso nelle sequenze pesate in diffusione (ADC 0.56).
Le anse intestinali a monte non sono dilatate.
In sede posteriore si osserva discontinuità del profilo parietale del viscere, con invasione del tessuto adiposo mesorettale pari a circa 8-9 mm.
Non si osservano sicuri segni di infiltrazione della fascia mesorettale (distanza lesione-MRF: 2.-3 mm), né di invasione vascolare extra-murale.
In sede mesorettale, si osserva la presenza di almeno 7 linfonodi a morfologia rotondeggiante e margini irregolari, di 4-5 mm, di sospetta natura secondaria.
Non si osservano ulteriori linfonodi loco-regionali con caratteristiche RM di sospetto.
Non si osservano falde di versamento liquido libero nello scavo pelvico. 

Staging MR: T3c, N2, MRF-, EMVI-.
translation:
Clinical Query: Patient with recent diagnosis of rectal cancer

At the level of the mid to lower rectum, 3 cm from the anal verge, there is an observed heteroplastic lesion extending craniocaudally for approximately 4.5 cm, with a maximum thickness of 1.7 cm, showing circumferential "sleeve-like" involvement and a substenotic appearance. The lesion is characterized by heterogeneous signal on T2-weighted sequences, with increased signal on diffusion-weighted sequences (ADC 0.56).
The upstream bowel loops are not dilated.
Posteriorly, there is a discontinuity in the bowel wall profile, with invasion into the mesorectal fat measuring approximately 8-9 mm.
There are no definite signs of mesorectal fascia infiltration (lesion-MRF distance: 2-3 mm), nor extramural vascular invasion.
Within the mesorectal area, there are at least 7 lymph nodes with a rounded morphology and irregular margins, measuring 4-5 mm, suspected to be secondary in nature.
No additional loco-regional lymph nodes with suspicious MRI characteristics are observed.
No free fluid collections are seen in the pelvic cavity.

Staging MR: T3c, N2, MRF-, EMVI-.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protoklu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Uočavaju se miješano-involutivne dojke, bez značajnijeg pozadinskog nakupljnja. Nema uočljivih suspektnih tvorbi, nema patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta, niti u tvorbama, niti non-mass tipa, kao niti restikcije difuzije na DWI. Nema uočljve aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se redovite MMG kontrole.
translation: Breast MRI was performed according to the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts appear mixed-involutive, with no significant background enhancement. No suspicious lesions are observed, and there is no pathological contrast enhancement, either in masses or non-mass-like areas, nor is there any diffusion restriction on DWI. No axillary lymphadenopathy is noted. BIRADS 1. Regular mammography follow-ups are recommended.

report: Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Na učinjenim snimkama dojke su za dob gustog žljezdanog parenhima (ACR tip D), koji pokazuje blago pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. Ne nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija, patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije. Nema limfadenopatije.  BIRADS 1, uredan nalaz. Učiniti UZV dojki ove godine kako je i preporučeno. Daljnje kontrole UZV i MMG.
translation: The MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The breast images show dense glandular parenchyma appropriate for age (ACR type D), with mild background contrast enhancement. No morphologically suspicious lesions, pathological contrast enhancement, or areas of diffusion restriction are found. There is no lymphadenopathy. BIRADS 1, normal findings. An ultrasound of the breasts should be performed this year as recommended. Further follow-up with ultrasound and mammography is advised.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Dojke su miješanog tipa. Na suptrakcijskim sekvencama nema suspektnih lezija, niti patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta. Na DWI sekvencama nema uočljive restrikcije difuzije. Nema aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se redovite MMG i UZV kontrole.
translation: Breast MRI was performed according to the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are of mixed type. No suspicious lesions or pathological contrast enhancement are observed on the subtraction sequences. There is no apparent diffusion restriction on the DWI sequences. No axillary lymphadenopathy is present. BIRADS 1. Regular mammography and ultrasound follow-ups are recommended.

report: MRI dojki se učini prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama nakon i.v. aplikacije paramagnetskog kontrastnog sredstva. Dojke su miješanog tipa, ACR tipa B, bez značanijeg pozadinskog nakupljanja kontrasta. U dojkama nema uočljivih suspektnih tvorbi koje nakupljaju kontrast, niti se vidi non-mass nakupljanje. Nema restrikcije difuzije na DWI. Aksilarno vidljivi obstrano manji l.čvorovi reaktivne morfologije, s masnim sinusima.  BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se redovite MMG i UZV kontrole.
translation: MRI of the breast was performed according to the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences following intravenous administration of a paramagnetic contrast agent. The breasts are of mixed type, ACR type B, without significant background contrast enhancement. No suspicious contrast-enhancing lesions or non-mass enhancement are observed in the breasts. There is no diffusion restriction on DWI. Axillary lymph nodes are visible bilaterally, smaller in size, with reactive morphology and fatty hila. BIRADS 1. Regular mammography and ultrasound follow-ups are recommended.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Dojke su miješanog tipa, bez vidljivog značajnijeg pozadinskog nakupljanja. Na postkontrastnim suptrakcijskim sekvencama nema vidljivih tvorbi, niti patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta, niti u tvorbama, niti non-mass tipa. Na DWI sekvencama nema uočljive restrikcije difuzije. BIRADS 1. Uredan MRI. Preporučuju se godišnje MRI kontrole obzirom na "high-risk" genetsku mutaciju, te UZV dojki za 6 mjeseci.
translation: Breast MRI was performed according to the standard multiparametric protocol with T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are of mixed type, without significant background enhancement. Post-contrast subtraction sequences show no visible masses or pathological contrast enhancement, neither in masses nor in non-mass type. DWI sequences reveal no apparent diffusion restriction. BIRADS 1. Normal MRI. Annual MRI follow-ups are recommended due to the "high-risk" genetic mutation, along with a breast ultrasound in 6 months.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Miješano-involutivne dojke. Nema vidljivog patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta niti u tvorbama niti non-mass tipa. Na DWI nema restrikcije difuzije u dojkama. Nema aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se redovite kontrole.
translation: An MRI of the breasts was performed following the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are of mixed-involutive type. There is no visible pathological contrast enhancement in either mass or non-mass type lesions. On DWI, there is no diffusion restriction in the breasts. No axillary lymphadenopathy is present. BIRADS 1. Regular follow-up is recommended.

report: Učini se MRI prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Miješane dojke. Na T2 nema vidljivih cista. Nema pozadinskog nakupljanja. Na postkontrastnim suptrakcijskim sekvencama nema uočljivih suspektnih tvorbi, nema patološkog nakupljanja, niti u tvorbama, niti non-mass tipa. Nema znakova restrikcije difuzije na DWI. Nema uočljive aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se redovite kontrole.
translation: MRI was performed according to the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are heterogeneous. No visible cysts on T2. No background enhancement. Post-contrast subtraction sequences show no suspicious lesions, no pathological enhancement in either masses or non-mass-like areas. No signs of diffusion restriction on DWI. No noticeable axillary lymphadenopathy. BIRADS 1. Regular follow-up is recommended.

report: Učini se MRI prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Dojke su guste, žljezdano-miješanog tipa, ACR tipa C. Na T2 sekvencama nema cista. Na postkontrastnim suptrakcijskim sekvencama nema suspektnih tvorbi, nema patološkog nakupljanja, niti u tvorbama, niti non-mass tipa. Nema znakova restrikcije difuzije na DWI. Nema uočljive aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 1. Preproučuju se redovite UZV kontrole, a nakon 40-te god.života i MMG. Preporučuje se pregled u genetskom savjtovalištu obzirom na obiteljsku anamnezu, te odluka o ev. genetskom testiranju.
translation: An MRI was performed following the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are dense, of a glandular-mixed type, ACR type C. No cysts are visible on the T2 sequences. Post-contrast subtraction sequences show no suspicious lesions, no pathological enhancement, either in masses or of the non-mass type. There are no signs of diffusion restriction on DWI. No noticeable axillary lymphadenopathy is observed. BIRADS 1. Regular ultrasound follow-ups are recommended, and after the age of 40, mammography is advised. A consultation at a genetic counseling center is recommended due to family history, with a decision on potential genetic testing.

report: Učini se MRI prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Miješano involutivne dojke. Na T2 sekvencama nema vidljivih cista. Na postkontrastnim suptrakcijskim sekvencama nema suspektnih tvorbi, nema patološkog nakupljanja, niti u tvorbama, niti non-mass tipa. Nema znakova restrikcije difuzije na DWI. Nema uočljive aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se redovite MMG i UZV kontrole.
translation: An MRI was performed following the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts show mixed involutional changes. No visible cysts are present on the T2 sequences. Post-contrast subtraction sequences reveal no suspicious lesions, with no pathological enhancement in either mass or non-mass type. There are no signs of diffusion restriction on DWI. No noticeable axillary lymphadenopathy is observed. BIRADS 1. Regular mammography and ultrasound follow-ups are recommended.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Dojke su miješanog tipa. Na postkontrastnim suptrakcijskim sekvencama nema vidljivih suspektnih tvorbi, niti non-mass nakupljanja. Na DWI nema restrikcije difuzije. Nema vidljive aksilarne limfadenopatije. BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se redovite kontrole.
translation: An MRI of the breasts was performed following the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breast tissue is of mixed type. Post-contrast subtraction sequences show no visible suspicious masses or non-mass enhancement. There is no diffusion restriction on DWI. No visible axillary lymphadenopathy is present. BIRADS 1. Regular follow-up is recommended.

report: Prvi UZV pregled obje dojke: Primjeren je izgled kože i potkožnog tkiva. UZV pregled obje dojke pokaže simetrično građene dojke žlijezdanog tipa. Ne nalazi se suspektnih žarišnih lezija. Obostrano aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi. BIRADS 1. Preporučuju se godišnje UZV kontrole.
translation: Initial ultrasound examination of both breasts: The appearance of the skin and subcutaneous tissue is normal. Ultrasound examination of both breasts reveals symmetrically structured glandular-type breasts. No suspicious focal lesions are found. Bilateral reactive axillary lymph nodes. BIRADS 1. Annual ultrasound follow-ups are recommended.

report: Učini se MRI sa standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući T2, DWI i DCE sekvence. report: Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Daljnje kontrole prema onkološkom protokolu.
translation: MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The images show a subpectorally placed implant in the right breast, with intact walls and no signs of rupture. There is a small amount of fluid around the implant and edema of the breast tissue in the medial part, consistent with postoperative changes. No suspicious morphological lesions are identified that would suggest residual or recurrent neoplastic processes. The left breast also shows no suspicious changes in the parenchyma. BIRADS 2. Further follow-up according to the oncological protocol.

report: Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. report: Učini se MRI sa standardnim T1, T2 i difuzijskim sekvencama, aplicira se 15 ml paramagnetskog kontrastnog sredstva (Dotarem) i.v. i učini šest brzih postkontrastnih T1 sekvenci, koje se suptrahiraju s prekontrastnom T1 sekvencom. Učine se 3D rekonstrukcije i generiraju se dinamičke krivulje. Lijeva dojka manja postoperativno s učinjenom rekonstrukcijom mišićnim režnjem. U GMK u dnu ožiljka i dalje vidljiv areal postkontrastne imbibicije, veličinom u regresiji prema ranijm MR pregledu, sada promjera 6mm. Kinetička krivulja nakupljanja kontrasta je benignog, perzistentog tipa, te opisano prvenstveno odgovara postoperativnim promjenama. Desna dojka mješovitog tipa, s difuzno blažim FCP, bez suspektnih formiranih tvorbi ili područja non mass imbibicije. BIRADS 2. Preporuča se kontrolni UZV u kraćem vremenskom intervalu unutar iduća 3 mjeseca te u slučaju urednog nalaza dalje redovite kontrole po protokolu.
translation: An MRI was performed using standard T1, T2, and diffusion sequences. A total of 15 ml of paramagnetic contrast agent (Dotarem) was administered intravenously, followed by six rapid post-contrast T1 sequences, which were subtracted from the pre-contrast T1 sequence. 3D reconstructions were created, and dynamic curves were generated. The left breast is smaller postoperatively with reconstruction using a muscle flap. In the glandular tissue at the base of the scar, there is still an area of post-contrast enhancement, which has regressed in size compared to previous MRI exams, now measuring 6mm in diameter. The kinetic curve of contrast uptake is of a benign, persistent type, primarily corresponding to postoperative changes. The right breast is of a mixed type, with diffusely mild fibroglandular parenchyma, without suspicious formed masses or areas of non-mass enhancement. BIRADS 2. A follow-up ultrasound is recommended within the next 3 months, and if the findings are normal, regular follow-ups should continue according to the protocol.

report: Učini se kontrolni MRI sa standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Obostrano vidljivi sitni fokusi imbibicije u sklopu FC promjena. Ne nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija kao ni patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područjarestrikcije difuzije. U usporedbi s MR dojki od 2020.g. nema bitnijih promjena. BIRADS 2. Preporučuju se redovite MMG i UZV kontrole.
translation: A follow-up MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques according to a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. Bilaterally, small foci of enhancement are visible as part of fibrocystic changes. There are no morphologically suspicious lesions, nor is there pathological contrast enhancement or areas of diffusion restriction. Compared to the breast MRI from 2020, there are no significant changes. BIRADS 2. Regular mammography and ultrasound follow-ups are recommended.

report: Lijevo je pravilna struktura kože, potkožnog tkiva i mišićnog režnja, bez vidljivih suspektnih žarišnih lezija. Još nekoliko manjih cisti u GMK i prijelazu medijalnih kvadranata veličine do 10mm. Intramamarni limfni čvor u DMK. Ne nalazi sesuspektnih žarišnih lezija u desnoj dojci. The right breast is of a mixed type with denser glandular parenchyma and pronounced fibrocystic changes; the largest cyst is located para-areolar at 2 o'clock, measuring 15mm. There are several smaller cysts in the upper outer quadrant and the transition of the medial quadrants, up to 10mm in size. An intramammary lymph node is present in the upper outer quadrant. No suspicious focal lesions are found in the right breast. There are no pathologically altered lymph nodes in the axillae. BIRADS 2. Regular follow-up is recommended as per the oncologist's advice.

report: UZV pregled pokazuje zadovoljavajući poslijeoperacijski nalaz. Lijevo je pravilna struktura kože, potkožnog tkiva i mišićnog režnja. Ne nalazi se fokalnih suspektnih lezija u smislu recidivirajućeg tm. procesa. U lijevoj aksili reaktivni limfni čvor veličine do 1 cm. Desna dojka je mješovitog tipa s gustim žljezdanim parenhimom i difuznim fibrocističnim promjenama parenhima. Multiple anehogene cistične lezije od kojih je najveća retromamilarno prema prijelazu gornjih kvadranata veličine 1.4 cm. Ne nalazi se fokalnih suspektnih lezija. Reaktivni limfni čvorovi. BIRADS 2. Preporučuju se kontrole po onkološkom protokolu.
translation: The ultrasound examination shows satisfactory postoperative findings. On the left side, the skin, subcutaneous tissue, and muscle flap have a normal structure. No focal suspicious lesions indicative of recurrent tumor process are found. In the left axilla, there is a reactive lymph node measuring up to 1 cm. The right breast is of mixed type with dense glandular parenchyma and diffuse fibrocystic changes in the parenchyma. There are multiple anechoic cystic lesions, the largest of which is located retroareolar towards the transition of the upper quadrants, measuring 1.4 cm. No focal suspicious lesions are found. Reactive lymph nodes are present. BIRADS 2. Follow-up according to the oncological protocol is recommended.

report: UZV pregled dojki pokazuje zadovoljavajući poslijeoperacijski nalaz. Desna dojka je manja posljedično op. zahvatu, nema fokalnih suspektnih lezija u dojci. U desnoj aksili bez patološke limfadenopatije. Lijeva dojka je mješovitog tipa, na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranata intramamarni limfonod veličine 4mm. Bez fokalnih suspektnih lezija lijeve dojke. U aksili reaktivni limfni čvorovi. BIRADS 2.
translation: Ultrasound examination of the breasts shows satisfactory post-operative findings. The right breast is smaller as a result of the surgical procedure, with no focal suspicious lesions detected. There is no pathological lymphadenopathy in the right axilla. The left breast is of mixed type, with an intramammary lymph node measuring 4mm at the transition of the lateral quadrants. No focal suspicious lesions are observed in the left breast. Reactive lymph nodes are present in the axilla. BIRADS 2.

report: UZV pregled dojki pokazuje posljedično operaciji našto manju volumenom desnu dojku uz posljedično radioterapiji zadebljanje kože u gornjim kvadrantima. U GLK desne dojke cista promjera 5mm. Bez suspektnih lezija. Zadovoljavajući poslijeoperacijski nalaz. Lijeva dojka je mješovitog tipa.Na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranata i vidi se manji areal proširenih kanalića. Bez suspektnih lezija lijeve dojke. Obostrano u aksilama reaktivni limfni čvorovi. BIRADS 2.
translation: Ultrasound examination of the breasts shows a slightly reduced volume of the right breast as a consequence of surgery, with skin thickening in the upper quadrants due to radiotherapy. In the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, there is a 5mm cyst. No suspicious lesions are observed. Postoperative findings are satisfactory. The left breast is of mixed type. At the junction of the lateral quadrants, a small area of dilated ducts is visible. No suspicious lesions in the left breast. Reactive lymph nodes are present bilaterally in the axillae. BIRADS 2.

report: UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene dojke, mješovitog tipa s izraženom masnom supstitucijom parenhima te ostatnim žljezdanom parenhimom dominantno u vanjskim kvadrantima. Diskretno obilniji parenhim u GLK desne dojke. Obostrano u parenhimu dojke nee izdvaja se suspektnih žarišnih lezija. Primjeren izgled kože i potkožnog masnog tkiva. U aksilama ne nalazi se patološke limfadenopatije. BIRADS 2. S obzirom na pozitivnu obiteljsku anamnezu i nalaz mamografije (snimke na CD-u nije moguće prikazati) savjetujem učiniti MR dojki.
translation: Ultrasound of the breasts shows symmetrically structured breasts of a mixed type with pronounced fatty replacement of the parenchyma and residual glandular parenchyma predominantly in the outer quadrants. There is slightly more abundant parenchyma in the upper outer quadrant of the right breast. No suspicious focal lesions are identified in the breast parenchyma on either side. The appearance of the skin and subcutaneous fatty tissue is appropriate. No pathological lymphadenopathy is found in the axillae. BIRADS 2. Considering the positive family history and the mammography findings (images on the CD cannot be displayed), I recommend performing an MRI of the breasts.

report: Prikažu se simetrične voluminozne dojke mješovitog tipa s ostatnim žljezdanim parenhimom u GLK i retromamilarno, sa umjerenim duktektazijama i pojedinačnim cistama promjera do 7mm. U području od radiološkog i kliničkog interesa u GLK DD ne izdvaja se sa sigurnošću UZV vidljivih solidnih niti suspektnih cističnih lezija. Na granici LK paramamilarno hipoehogena nepravilna lezija koja se prati superficijalno do subkutanog područja, diff.dg. može odgovarati postoperativnom ožiljku- stanje nakon fibradenoektomije desne dojke. Aksile obostrano bez patološke limfadenopatije. BI RADS 2 Učiniti i kontrolni MRI prema prvotnom planu do kraja ove kalendarske godine, potom odluka o daljem tretmanu.
translation: The breasts are symmetrically voluminous and of a mixed type, with residual glandular parenchyma in the upper outer quadrant and retroareolar area, showing moderate duct ectasia and individual cysts up to 7mm in diameter. In the area of radiological and clinical interest in the upper outer quadrant, no solid or suspicious cystic lesions are definitively identified on ultrasound. At the border of the lower quadrant near the nipple, there is a hypoechoic irregular lesion extending superficially to the subcutaneous area, which may correspond to a postoperative scar—status post-fibroadenectomy of the right breast. Axillary regions on both sides show no pathological lymphadenopathy. BI-RADS 2. A follow-up MRI should be performed as initially planned by the end of this calendar year, after which a decision on further treatment will be made.

report: UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene voluminozne dojke s gustim žljezdanim parenhimom koji je difuzno fibrocistično promijenjen. Obostrano su vidljive multiple ciste, najveća lijevo mjeri do 30 mm, a desno do 25 mm. Ne nalazi se suspektnih žarišnih lezija. U aksilama se prikažu reaktivni limfni čvorovi. BIRADS 2 Preporučuje se učiniti inicijalna MMG te redovite UZV kontrole.
translation: Ultrasound of the breasts shows symmetrically structured, voluminous breasts with dense glandular parenchyma that is diffusely fibrocystic. Multiple cysts are visible on both sides, with the largest measuring up to 30 mm on the left and 25 mm on the right. No suspicious focal lesions are found. Reactive lymph nodes are observed in the axillae. BIRADS 2. It is recommended to perform an initial mammogram and regular ultrasound follow-ups.

report: UZV pokazuje lijevu dojku koja je promijenjena nakon kvadrantektomije i RT, zadebljana je koža i potkožno tkivo, vidljiv je edem i veći serom na mjestu operacijskog ožiljka u organizaciji. Nema UZV vidljivog rezidualnog tumora. Naručena je na MRI dojki 28.11.23., nakon toga odluka o ev.dopunskim pregledima. BIRADS 2.
translation: The ultrasound shows changes in the left breast following quadrantectomy and radiotherapy, with thickened skin and subcutaneous tissue. Edema is visible, along with a larger seroma at the site of the surgical scar in organization. There is no ultrasound-visible residual tumor. A breast MRI is scheduled for 11/28/23, after which a decision will be made regarding any additional examinations. BIRADS 2.

report: UZV lijeve dojke pokazuje uredan položaj implantata koji je glatkih kontura, bez znakova rupture kapsule. Ne vidi se suspektnih lezija. U GLK lijeve dojke dva intramamarna limfna čvora prema aksili 9 i 12mm, reaktivnog izgleda. UZV pregled desne dojke pokaže dojku mješovitog tipa s ostatnim žljezdanim parenhimom koji pokazuje znakove fc.promjena. Ne nalazi se suspektnih žarišnih lezija. Uredan je izgled kože i potkožnog tkiva. Aksilarno se prikažu limfni čvorovi reaktivnih karakteristika. BIRADS 2.Preporučuju se daljnje kontrole po onkološkom protokolu.
translation: Ultrasound of the left breast shows the implant in a normal position with smooth contours, without signs of capsular rupture. No suspicious lesions are observed. In the left breast's upper outer quadrant, there are two intramammary lymph nodes measuring 9 and 12mm towards the axilla, appearing reactive. Ultrasound of the right breast reveals a mixed-type breast with residual glandular parenchyma showing signs of fibrocystic changes. No suspicious focal lesions are found. The appearance of the skin and subcutaneous tissue is normal. Axillary lymph nodes with reactive characteristics are displayed. BIRADS 2. Further follow-up according to the oncological protocol is recommended.

report: UZV dojki pokazuje stanje nakon augmetnacije subpektoralnim implantatima, koji su uredno ekspandirani, bez znakova leakinga. U rezidualnom parenhimu nema vidljivih fokalnih suspektnih lezija, dojke su miješanog tipa. Uredan je prikaz kože, pektoralnih mišića i aksila. BIRADS 2. Preporučuje se učiniti i MRI dojki.
translation: Breast ultrasound shows the condition post-augmentation with subpectoral implants, which are properly expanded with no signs of leakage. In the residual parenchyma, there are no visible focal suspicious lesions, and the breasts are of mixed type. The skin, pectoral muscles, and axillae are unremarkable. BIRADS 2. An MRI of the breasts is recommended.

report: Na mamografiji obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije parenhim je heterogenog tipa. Nalaz je bez promjene u odnosu na snimke iz 9./2022. Lijeva dojka je manja posljedično op. zahvatu, bez ovom metodom jasno vidljivog recidiva. U desnoj dojci ne izdvaja se suspektnih lezija niti suspektnih mkc. BIRADS 2.
translation: On the mammography of both breasts in two standard projections, the parenchyma is of a heterogeneous type. The findings show no change compared to the images from September 2022. The left breast is smaller due to surgical intervention, with no clearly visible recurrence by this method. In the right breast, there are no suspicious lesions or microcalcifications. BIRADS 2.

report: Mamografija s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije. Dojke su heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima. Žljezdani parenhim je gust i fc. promijenjen uz manju zonu asimetrije u GLK desne dojke, koja odgovara otočiću žljezdanog tkiva. Obostrano se ne nalazi suspektnih, stelatnih lezija niti patološki formiranih mkc. Bez arhitekturalne distorzije parenhima dojke. Koža, mamila i pektoralni mišici primjerenog su izgleda. BIRADS 2. S obzirom na gustoću parenhima savjetuje se učiniti komplementarni UZV pregled.
translation: Mammography with tomosynthesis of both breasts in two standard projections. The breasts have heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma. The glandular parenchyma is dense and fibrocystically changed with a small area of asymmetry in the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, corresponding to an island of glandular tissue. No suspicious, stellate lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications are found on either side. There is no architectural distortion of the breast parenchyma. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles appear normal. BIRADS 2. Given the density of the parenchyma, a complementary ultrasound examination is recommended.

report: Na mamografiji obje dojke s tomosintezom u dvije standardne projekcije prati se heterogeni parenhim s dominacijom masne supstitucije i ostatni parenhim u vansjkim kvadrantima nešto obilniji u lijevoj dojci. Nalaz je bez promjene u odnosu na snimke iz 2020. godine. Ne vidi se novonastalih suspektnih lezija niti patološki formiranih mkc. Koža, mamile i pektoralni mišići urednog su prikaza. BIRADS 2.
translation: Mammography of both breasts with tomosynthesis in two standard projections shows heterogeneous parenchyma with predominant fatty replacement and residual parenchyma in the outer quadrants, slightly more abundant in the left breast. The findings are unchanged compared to the images from 2020. No newly developed suspicious lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications are observed. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles are displayed normally. BIRADS 2.

report: Mamografija s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije. Dojke su heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima. Žljezdani parenhim je zrnat, heterogen, fc. promijenjen. Obostrano se ne nalazi suspektnih, stelatnih lezija niti patološki formiranih mkc. Bez arhitekturalne distorzije parenhima dojke. Koža, mamila i pektoralni mišici primjerenog su izgleda. BIRADS 2. Nalaz je bez bitnije promjene u odnosu na snimke iz 2020. godine. Savjtuje se učiniti i UZV pregled dojki ukoliko nije recentno učinjen.
translation: Mammography with tomosynthesis of both breasts in two standard projections. The breasts have heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma. The glandular parenchyma is granular, heterogeneous, and functionally altered. No suspicious, stellate lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications are found on either side. There is no architectural distortion of the breast parenchyma. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles appear normal. BIRADS 2. The findings show no significant change compared to the images from 2020. An ultrasound examination of the breasts is recommended if not recently performed.

report: Na mamografiji obje dojke s tomosintezom u dvije standardne projekcije dojke su heterogenog tipa. Žljezdana komponenta je fc. promijenjena i inhomogena obostrano. Ne izdvaja se suspektnih, stelatnih lezija niti patološki formiranih mkc. Mamile obostrano blaže uvućene. Koža i pektoralni mišići urednog su prikaza. BIRADS 2.
translation: On the mammography of both breasts with tomosynthesis in two standard projections, the breasts are of a heterogeneous type. The glandular component is functionally altered and inhomogeneous on both sides. There are no suspicious, stellate lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications. The nipples are mildly retracted on both sides. The skin and pectoral muscles are displayed normally. BIRADS 2.

report: Na mamografiji s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije dojke dojke su heterogenog tipa s ostatnim žljezdanim parenhimom u vanjskim kvadrantima, obilnijim u lijevoj dojci. U gornjim kvadrantima lijeve dojke izdvaja se manja nodozna lezija karakteristika intramamarnog limfonoda Obostrano bez suspektnih žarišnih lezija, patološki formiranih mkc. Koža, mamile i pektoralni mišići urednog su prikaza. BIRADS 2.
translation: On the mammography with tomosynthesis of both breasts in two standard projections, the breast tissue is of a heterogeneous type with residual glandular parenchyma in the outer quadrants, more abundant in the left breast. In the upper quadrants of the left breast, a small nodular lesion is noted, characteristic of an intramammary lymph node. No suspicious focal lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications are observed in either breast. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles are displayed normally. BIRADS 2.

report: Na mamografiji s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije dojke su heterogenog tipa, žljezdani parenhim je gust i inhomogen. Nalaz je bez promjene u odnosu na snimke iz 2019. godine. Ne izdvaja se novonastalih suspektnih lezija niti mkc. Koža, mamila i pektoralni mišići urednog su prikaza. BIRADS 2. Učiniti i kontrolni UZV dojki ukoliko nije recentno učinjen.
translation: On the mammography with tomosynthesis of both breasts in two standard projections, the breasts are of a heterogeneous type, with dense and inhomogeneous glandular parenchyma. The findings are unchanged compared to the images from 2019. No newly developed suspicious lesions or microcalcifications are noted. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles are displayed normally. BIRADS 2. A follow-up breast ultrasound should be performed if not done recently.

report: Na mamografiji obje dojke s tomosintezom u dvije standardne projekcije implantat u desnoj dojci urednog je položaja i izgleda. U lijevoj dojci ne izdvaja se suspektnih lezija niti patološki formiranih mkc. Bez arhitekturalne distorzije parenhima. BIRADS 2. Daljnje kontrole prema onkološkom protokolu.
translation: Mammography of both breasts with tomosynthesis in two standard projections shows the implant in the right breast is in normal position and appearance. In the left breast, there are no suspicious lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications. No architectural distortion of the parenchyma is observed. BIRADS 2. Further follow-up according to the oncological protocol.

report: Na mamografiji s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije dojke su heterogenog tipa. Tvorba koja se duži period prati u GLK lijeve dojke stacionarnih je dimenzija. Intervalno bez novonastalih suspektnih lezija, patološki formiranih mkc. Nalaz je bez bitnije promjene u odnosu na snimke iz 2022. godine. BIRADS 2.
translation: On the tomosynthesis mammography of both breasts in two standard projections, the breasts are of a heterogeneous type. The lesion that has been monitored over a long period in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast remains stable in size. There are no newly developed suspicious lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications. The findings show no significant change compared to the images from 2022. BIRADS 2.

report: Na mamografiji s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije dojke su heterogenog tipa. Nalaz je bez promjene u odnosu na snimke iz 11./2022. Bez intervalno novonastalih suspektnih lezija i mkc. Koža, mamile i pektoralni mišići urednog su prikaza. BIRADS 2.
translation: On the tomosynthesis mammography of both breasts in two standard projections, the breast tissue is of a heterogeneous type. The findings show no changes compared to the images from November 2022. There are no newly developed suspicious lesions or microcalcifications. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles are displayed normally. BIRADS 2.

report: Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Na učinjenim snimkama dojke su heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima, koji pokazuje blago pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. Obostrano fokusi postkontrastne imbibicije u smislu FCP te ciste veličine do 3.5 cm. Pojedine manje ciste na granici GK LD pokazuju rubnu postkontrastnu imbibiciju moguće u smislu inflamacije. Ne nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija, patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije. U aksilama bez patološke limfadenopatije. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se učiniti second look UZV te ponoviti CP opisanog područja GK LD.
translation: MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques following a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The breast images show heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma with mild background enhancement of contrast material. Bilateral post-contrast enhancement foci are noted, consistent with FCP, along with cysts measuring up to 3.5 cm. Some smaller cysts at the border of the upper outer quadrant of the left breast exhibit marginal post-contrast enhancement, possibly indicative of inflammation. No morphologically suspicious lesions, pathological contrast uptake, or areas of diffusion restriction are identified. No pathological lymphadenopathy is observed in the axillae. BIRADS 3. A second-look ultrasound is recommended, as well as a follow-up of the described area in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast.

report: Učini se kontrolni MRI dojki standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Usporedba s preoperativnim MR dojki od 5.4.2022. Dojke su simetricne rasprsenog fibroglandularnog tkiva s manjom pozadinskom imbibicojom. Na granici donjih kvadranata lijeve dojke dvije promjene koje perzistentno nakupljaju kontrastno sredstvo, promjera do 1,2 cm u srednjoj i straznjoj trecini vj. u sklopu FCP, dok tvorba smjestena anteriornije moze odgovarati i l.cvoru. U GLK desne dojke postoperativni ožiljak uz koji je vidljiva lamelarna T2 hiperintenzivna zona koja odgovara seromu. Ne nalazi se drugih morfološki suspektnih lezija, patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije. BIRADS 3 - uredan postoperativni nalaz, desno. Preporuca se second look UZV pormjena u lijevoj dojci.
translation: A follow-up breast MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. Comparison was made with the preoperative breast MRI from April 5, 2022. The breasts are symmetrical with scattered fibroglandular tissue and minimal background enhancement. At the border of the lower quadrants of the left breast, there are two lesions that persistently accumulate contrast, measuring up to 1.2 cm in the middle and posterior thirds, likely part of a fibroadenomatous change, while the more anterior lesion could correspond to a lymph node. In the lower outer quadrant of the right breast, there is a postoperative scar with an adjacent lamellar T2 hyperintense area consistent with a seroma. No other morphologically suspicious lesions, pathological contrast enhancement, or areas of diffusion restriction are found. BIRADS 3 - normal postoperative findings on the right. A second-look ultrasound is recommended for the changes in the left breast.

report: Učini se MRI sa standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence Na učinjenim snimkama vidi se stanje po desnostranoj mastektomiji i rekonstrukciji implantatom koji je održanog volumena, bez znakova rupture. Manji fokus na granici lateralnih kvadranata neposredno uz implantat koji se vidi i na navedenom ranije MR pregledu je intervalno bez promjene. U desnoj dojci ne nalazi se suspektnih lezija u smislu recidiva tumora.  Lijeva dojka je heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima koji pokazuje umjereno pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva uz prisutne umjerene FC P i sitne ciste. Lijeva dojka također bez morfološki suspektnih lezija, patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije. Dva manja fokusa nakupljanja kontrastnog sredstva na granici lateralnih kvadranta lijeve dojke bez promjene u veličini u odnosu na raniji pregled, vjerojatno u sklopu FC promjena. BIRADS 3. bez sigurnih znakova recidiva tumora. Preporuca se second UZV lijeve dojke na mjestu fokusa na granici kvadranata. U slucaju urednog nalaza daljnje redovite kontrole.
translation: An MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques following a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The images show the status post right mastectomy and reconstruction with an implant that maintains its volume, with no signs of rupture. A small focus at the junction of the lateral quadrants adjacent to the implant, which was also seen on the previous MRI, remains unchanged. No suspicious lesions indicative of tumor recurrence are found in the right breast. The left breast has heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma with moderate background enhancement and the presence of moderate fibrocystic changes and small cysts. The left breast also shows no morphologically suspicious lesions, pathological contrast enhancement, or areas of diffusion restriction. Two small foci of contrast enhancement at the junction of the lateral quadrants of the left breast remain unchanged in size compared to the previous examination, likely part of fibrocystic changes. BIRADS 3, with no definite signs of tumor recurrence. A follow-up ultrasound of the left breast at the site of the focus at the quadrant junction is recommended. If the findings are normal, regular follow-up is advised.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DCE i DWI sekvencama. Dojke su miješanog tipa, s umjerenim pozadinskim nakupljanjem kontrasta koji ometa vizualizaciju. Nema vidljivih suspektnih tvorbi. Nešto je jače pozadinsko nakupljanje u desnoj dojci, ali nema jasnog non-mass nakupljanja, koje bi nedvojbeno ukazivalo na DCIS, niti ima jasne restrikcije difuzije. Nema vidljive aksilarne limfadenopatije. Zaključak: BIRADS 3. Nema MRI sigurno uočljivih patoloških lezija. Obzirom na MMG suspektne mkc molim ponoviti MMG (prošlo je 14 mjeseci od prethodne) i usporediti nalaze, te ponoviti ciljani UZV ovdje, nakon čega će se donijeti odluka o daljnjem postupku.
translation: An MRI of the breasts was performed following the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DCE, and DWI sequences. The breasts are of mixed type, with moderate background enhancement that hinders visualization. No suspicious lesions are visible. There is somewhat stronger background enhancement in the right breast, but no clear non-mass enhancement that would definitively indicate DCIS, nor is there any clear diffusion restriction. No visible axillary lymphadenopathy is present. Conclusion: BIRADS 3. No MRI-detectable pathological lesions are clearly visible. Given the suspicious microcalcifications on the mammogram, please repeat the mammogram (14 months have passed since the previous one) and compare the findings, and perform a targeted ultrasound here, after which a decision on further management will be made.

report: Učini se MRI sa standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući T2, DWI i DCE sekvence. Dojke su vrlo guste, žljezdano-miješanog tipa, ACR tipa C. Vidljivo je blago pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. Obostrano u svim kvadrantima vidljive ovalne lezije, glatkih kontura, T1 hipointenzivne, T2 hiperintenzivne koje postkontrastno pretežito perzistentno nakupljaju kontrast, a pojedinačne lezije pokazuju plato tip dinamičke krivulje. Većina opisanih lezija pokazuje tamne interne septe koje se postkontrastno ne imbibiraju te morfološki prvenstveno odgovaraju fibroadenomima. Lezije su veličine do 2 cm u promjeru. U usporedbi s prethodnim MRI nema značajnijih promjena. Nema vidljivih stelatnih lezija, niti non-mass nakupljanja. BIRADS 3. Multipli fibroadenomi obostrano. Jake fibrocistične promjene. Preporučuje se second-look UZV i ovisno o nalazu odlučiti o potrebi core biopsije.
translation: An MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are very dense, of a glandular-mixed type, ACR type C. There is mild background enhancement of the contrast agent. Bilaterally, in all quadrants, oval lesions with smooth contours are visible, T1 hypointense, T2 hyperintense, which predominantly show persistent contrast uptake post-contrast, with some lesions exhibiting a plateau type dynamic curve. Most of the described lesions show dark internal septa that do not imbibe post-contrast and morphologically correspond primarily to fibroadenomas. The lesions measure up to 2 cm in diameter. Compared to the previous MRI, there are no significant changes. No stellate lesions or non-mass enhancement are visible. BIRADS 3. Multiple fibroadenomas bilaterally. Strong fibrocystic changes. A second-look ultrasound is recommended, and depending on the findings, the need for a core biopsy should be determined.
