report: Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Na učinjenim snimkama dojke su involutivne uz blago pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. U GMK desne dojke vidi se lobulirana T1/T2 hiperintenzivna lezija dimenzija 10 x 6 mm, glatkih rubova, koja se perzistentno imbibira te ne pokazuje porast veličine u komparaciji s UZV pregledom od 2015. U GLK DD vidi se ovalna hiperintenzivna lezija veličine 7 mm, karakteristika limfnog čvora. Ne nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija niti patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta. U aksilama bez patološke limfadenopatije. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se cesond look UZV i ev. ponoviti CP lezije u GMK DD.
translation: MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The breast images show involutional changes with mild background enhancement of contrast material. In the right breast's upper outer quadrant, there is a lobulated T1/T2 hyperintense lesion measuring 10 x 6 mm with smooth margins, which persistently imbibes contrast and shows no increase in size compared to the ultrasound examination from 2015. In the left breast's upper outer quadrant, there is an oval hyperintense lesion measuring 7 mm, characteristic of a lymph node. No morphologically suspicious lesions or pathological contrast enhancement are found. No pathological lymphadenopathy is observed in the axillae. BIRADS 3. A second-look ultrasound is recommended, and possibly a follow-up of the lesion in the right breast's upper outer quadrant.

report: Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Na učinjenim snimkama dojke su heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima, koji pokazuje umjereno pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. U GLK DD vidi se ovalna lezija glatkih rubova s internim tamnim septama promjera 10 mm, pokazuje benigni obrazac postkontrastne imbibicije - odgovara vjerojatno citološki verificiranom fibroadenomu. Obostrano više fokusa imbibicije u smislu FCP.Ne nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija niti patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta. U aksilama limfni čvorovi reaktivnog izgleda. BIRADS 3. Preporučujem kontrolni UZV dojki, ovdje.
translation: MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The breast images show heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma with moderate background enhancement of contrast material. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is an oval lesion with smooth margins and internal dark septations, measuring 10 mm in diameter, displaying a benign post-contrast enhancement pattern—likely corresponding to a cytologically verified fibroadenoma. Multiple bilateral foci of enhancement are noted, consistent with fibrocystic changes. No morphologically suspicious lesions or pathological contrast enhancement are found. Lymph nodes in the axillae appear reactive. BIRADS 3. Recommend follow-up breast ultrasound here.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. Dojke su miješanog tipa, s vidljivim FC promjenama i T2 hiperintenzivnim sitnim cistama, osobito u LD. U DD nema uočjlivih suspektnih tvorbi, niti patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta. U LD nema vidljivih tvorbi, ali se uočava multifokalno točkasto nakupljanje centralno od kože do pektoralnog mišića, koje odgovara FC promjenama, a prije opisivano non-mass nakupljanje je sada manjeg intenziteta i volumena. BIRADS 3. Preporučujem učiniti second-look UZV lijeve dojke, te ovisno o nalazu odlučiti o ev.ponavljanju core biopsije. Preporučuje se također učiniti mamografija s RXS, ovdje. Molim naručiti se za ove postupke u Tajništvu zavoda na 2903-255.
translation: Perform an MRI of the breasts following the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The breasts are of mixed type, with visible fibrocystic changes and T2 hyperintense small cysts, particularly in the left breast. In the right breast, there are no noticeable suspicious lesions or pathological contrast enhancement. In the left breast, no lesions are visible, but there is multifocal punctate enhancement from the skin to the pectoral muscle, corresponding to fibrocystic changes. The previously described non-mass enhancement is now of lower intensity and volume. BIRADS 3. I recommend a second-look ultrasound of the left breast, and depending on the findings, consider repeating a core biopsy. A mammogram with digital tomosynthesis is also recommended here. Please schedule these procedures at the Department Secretariat at 2903-255.

report: Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Na učinjenim snimkama dojke su heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima, koji pokazuje blago pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. U desnoj dojci prepektoralno na granici medijalnih kvadranata vidi se cistična rubno imbibirana lezija veličine 10 mm, dif.dg. može odgovarati inflamiranoj cisti. Ne nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija, patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije u drugim dijelovima dojki. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se učiniti second look UZV s CP lezije u desnoj dojci.
translation: MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The breast images show heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma with mild background enhancement of contrast material. In the right breast, prepectorally at the border of the medial quadrants, there is a cystic lesion with peripheral enhancement measuring 10 mm, which could correspond to an inflamed cyst as a differential diagnosis. No morphologically suspicious lesions, pathological contrast enhancement, or areas of diffusion restriction are found in other parts of the breasts. BIRADS 3. A second-look ultrasound with color Doppler of the lesion in the right breast is recommended.

report: Učini se kontrolni MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence. Na učinjenim sekvencama prikaže se stanje nakon rekonstrukcije desne dojke implantatom. Uz gornji lateralni rub implantata prikažu okrugle lezije intenziteta masti, koje se postkontrastno rubno imbibiraju, a radiomorfološkim karakteristikama odgovaraju područjima masne nekroze. U aksilarnom repu desne dojke limfonodi veličine do 8 x 12 mm, moguće reaktivno uvećani uslijed poslijeoperacijskih promjena. Ne nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija kao ni patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije. Ostali nalaz je bez promjene. BIRADS 3 - Preporučuje se "second-look" UZV zone masne nekroze u GLK i limfonoda u aksilarnom repu lijeve dojke.
translation: A follow-up MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. The sequences show the condition post-reconstruction of the right breast with an implant. Along the upper lateral edge of the implant, round lesions with fat intensity are observed, which exhibit peripheral enhancement post-contrast and radiomorphologically correspond to areas of fat necrosis. In the axillary tail of the right breast, lymph nodes measuring up to 8 x 12 mm are possibly reactively enlarged due to postoperative changes. No morphologically suspicious lesions or pathological contrast accumulation or diffusion restriction areas are found. The rest of the findings remain unchanged. BIRADS 3 - A "second-look" ultrasound of the fat necrosis area in the upper outer quadrant and the lymph nodes in the axillary tail of the left breast is recommended.

report: UZV pokazuje u DLK DD, prepektoralno, pomičnu, horizontalno orijentiranu, lobulranu tvorbu duljine 17 mm, koja je dominantno elastografski mekana, s manjim rubnim tvrđim arealima. Tvorba se bioptira pod nadzorom UZV i više cilindra se pošalje na HP analizu. BIRADS 3. U slučaju da se potvrdi dijagnoza FA preporučuje se kontrolni UZV za 6 mj.
translation: The ultrasound shows in the left breast, prepectoral region, a mobile, horizontally oriented, lobulated mass measuring 17 mm in length, which is predominantly elastographically soft, with some smaller, harder peripheral areas. The mass is biopsied under ultrasound guidance, and multiple cores are sent for histopathological analysis. BIRADS 3. If the diagnosis of fibroadenoma is confirmed, a follow-up ultrasound is recommended in 6 months.

report: UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene dojke, gustog žljezdanog parenhima koji je obostrano difuzno FC promjenjen. U DLK lijeve dojke vidi se hipoehogena, blago lobulirana, horizontalno položena lezija duljine 15 mm koja prvenstveno odgovara prethodno opisanom FA, stacionarne veličine. Na prijelazu gornjih kvadranata lijeve dojke vidi se hipoehogeniji areal bez jasno formirane solidne komponente, moguće areal gušćih fcp - učini se ciljana citopunkcija. U desnoj dojci nekoliko subcentimetarskih cisti te u DLK intramamarni limfni čvor. Uredan izgled kože i potkožnog masnog tkiva. Reaktivni limfni čvorovi u obje aksile. BIRADS 3 Daljnji postupak prema nalazu citopunkcije. U slučaju normalnog nalaza preporučuju se redoviti samopregled dojki te godišnje UZV kontrole.
translation: Ultrasound of the breast shows symmetrically structured breasts with dense glandular parenchyma that is diffusely fibrocystic on both sides. In the lower outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a hypoechoic, slightly lobulated, horizontally oriented lesion measuring 15 mm, which primarily corresponds to the previously described fibroadenoma, with stable size. At the junction of the upper quadrants of the left breast, there is a hypoechoic area without a clearly formed solid component, possibly an area of denser fibrocystic changes - a targeted fine-needle aspiration is recommended. In the right breast, there are several subcentimeter cysts and an intramammary lymph node in the lower outer quadrant. The appearance of the skin and subcutaneous fat tissue is normal. Reactive lymph nodes are present in both axillae. BIRADS 3. Further management will depend on the results of the fine-needle aspiration. In the case of normal findings, regular breast self-examinations and annual ultrasound follow-ups are recommended.

report: U GMK se prikaže edem kože i potkožja te na granici kože i potkožja hipoehogena kolekcija 8 x 5 mm s kanalom prema dubljim strukturama, medijalnije je vidljiva još jedna kolekcija udaljena oko 3 cm, veličine do 11 mm. Učini se CP lateralnije kolekcije. Aksilarno vidljivi reaktivno oblikovani limfonodi. BIRADS 3.
translation: The ultrasound of the left breast shows skin and subcutaneous edema, with a hypoechoic collection measuring 8 x 5 mm at the junction of the skin and subcutaneous tissue, extending with a tract towards deeper structures. Medially, another collection is visible, approximately 3 cm away, measuring up to 11 mm. A core biopsy of the lateral collection is performed. Reactive lymph nodes are visible in the axillary region. BIRADS 3.

report: Na UZV pregledu desna dojka je diskretno manja uz zadebljanu kožu nakon provedene iradijacije. Uz ožiljak se prati inhomogena, nepravilna i dominantno hipoehogena promjena navjerojatnije u sklopu ožiljka/postiradijacijskih promjena. Promjena se citološki punktira. U preostalom parenhimu obje dojke koji je heterogen s gušćom žljezdanom komponentom u lateralnim kvadrantima ne izdvaja se suspektih lezija. Obostrano aksilarno te desno supra i infraklavikularno i parasternalno bez patološke limfadenopatije. BIRADS 3. Konačni zaključak nakon nalaza citološke punkcije. U slučaju benignog nalaza daljnje kontrole prema uputama nadležnog onkologa.
translation: On the ultrasound examination, the right breast is slightly smaller with thickened skin following radiation therapy. Adjacent to the scar, there is an inhomogeneous, irregular, and predominantly hypoechoic change, most likely related to scar/post-radiation changes. This change is being sampled for cytology. In the remaining parenchyma of both breasts, which is heterogeneous with a denser glandular component in the lateral quadrants, no suspicious lesions are identified. There is no pathological lymphadenopathy bilaterally in the axillary regions, nor in the right supraclavicular, infraclavicular, and parasternal areas. BIRADS 3. Final conclusion pending cytology results. If the findings are benign, further follow-up will be according to the oncologist's recommendations.

report: Ucini se kontrolni UZV podrucja u GLK desne dojke nakon uvida u MR koji ne pokazuje jasno vidljivu tvorbuu GLK desne dojke. Vidljivo je inhomogeno hipoehogeno podrucje koje prema svemu odgovara FCP promjenama, no molim kontrolni UZV kod nas za tri mjeseca. Molim kontrolni MR dojki krajem godine.  BIRADS 3.
translation: A follow-up ultrasound of the upper outer quadrant of the right breast was performed after reviewing the MRI, which does not show a clearly visible mass in the upper outer quadrant of the right breast. An inhomogeneous hypoechoic area is visible, which appears to correspond to fibrocystic changes. However, a follow-up ultrasound at our facility is recommended in three months. A follow-up breast MRI is advised at the end of the year. BIRADS 3.

report: Primjeren izgled kože i potkožnog masnog tkiva. UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene dojke mješovitog tipa s gustim žljezdanim parenhimom koji je difuzno blaže fibrocistično promijenjen. Na granici donjih kvadranata desne dojke vidi se hipoehogena lezija veličine 6x5mm, cista gustog sadržaja, jedina fokalna lezija u dojkama - učini se citološka punkcija. Obostrano aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi. Ne vidi se patološki promijenjenih limfnih čvorova. BIRADS 3. konačni zaključak nakon citološkog nalaza
translation: The skin and subcutaneous fat tissue appear normal. Ultrasound of the breasts shows symmetrically structured breasts of a mixed type with dense glandular parenchyma that is diffusely mildly fibrocystic. At the border of the lower quadrants of the right breast, there is a hypoechoic lesion measuring 6x5mm, a cyst with dense content, the only focal lesion in the breasts - a cytological puncture should be performed. Bilateral axillary reactive lymph nodes are observed. No pathological lymph nodes are seen. BIRADS 3. Final conclusion pending cytological results.

report: Primjeren izgled kože i potkožnog masnog tkiva. UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene dojke involutivnog tipa. Bez suspektnih žarišnih lezija. U aksilama reaktivni limfni čvorovi, bez patološki promijenjenih limfnih čvorova. BIRADS 3. Obzirom na nalaz mamografije preporučuje se kontrolni UZV pregeld dojki za 6 mjeseci.
translation: The skin and subcutaneous fat tissue appear normal. Ultrasound of the breasts shows symmetrically structured breasts of the involutive type. No suspicious focal lesions. Reactive lymph nodes in the axillae, with no pathologically altered lymph nodes. BIRADS 3. Considering the mammography findings, a follow-up breast ultrasound is recommended in 6 months.

report: Dojke su gustog žljezdanog parenhima s izraženim fc. promjenama i difuzno širim kanalićima ispunjenim sadržajem. Na prijelazu gkv desne dojke prepektoralno prikaže se hipoehogena, oštro ograničena i horizontalno orijentirana lezija veličine 7 mm, koja će odgovarati korelati opisane lezije na MR-u. Učini se ciljana citološka punkcija. U lijevoj dojci prema GMK izdvaja se nekoliko širih kanalića, te se učini citološka punkcija jednog, ispunjenog sadržajem. U parenhimu obje dojke ne izdvaja se jasno suspektnih lezija. Obsotrano uredan izgled kože i potkožja uz održanu arhitektoniku dojke. Obostrano aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi. BIRADS 3. Konačni zaključak s nalazom citološke punkcije.
translation: The breasts exhibit dense glandular parenchyma with pronounced fibrocystic changes and diffusely dilated ducts filled with content. At the transition of the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, prepectorally, a hypoechoic, sharply defined, and horizontally oriented lesion measuring 7 mm is visualized, corresponding to the lesion described on the MRI. A targeted cytological aspiration is performed. In the left breast, near the upper outer quadrant, several dilated ducts are noted, and a cytological aspiration is performed on one of them, which is filled with content. No clearly suspicious lesions are identified in the parenchyma of either breast. The skin and subcutaneous tissue appear normal on both sides, with preserved breast architecture. Bilaterally, there are reactive axillary lymph nodes. BIRADS 3. Final conclusion pending cytological aspiration results.

report: UZV pregledom lijeva dojka involutivna bez znakova žarišnih promjena. U GLK desne dojke prikaže se hipoehogeni areal, vertikalno orijentiran, iregularan, dimenzija 1,9x1,5 cm sjakom akustičkom sjenom. Ne nalazi se drugih fokalnih lezija u desnoj dojci. U desnoj aksili bez uvećanih i patološki promijenjenih limfnih čvorova. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se ponoviti MR u 6 mj 2023. obzirom se na nalaz CB vjerojatno radi o radijalnom ožiljku s upalnom komponentom.
translation: Ultrasound examination of the left breast shows involutional changes without signs of focal lesions. In the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, there is a hypoechoic area, vertically oriented, irregular, measuring 1.9x1.5 cm with a strong acoustic shadow. No other focal lesions are found in the right breast. The right axilla shows no enlarged or pathologically altered lymph nodes. BIRADS 3. It is recommended to repeat the MRI in June 2023, as the core biopsy findings likely indicate a radial scar with an inflammatory component.

report: UZV pregled lijeve dojke pokaže dojku involutivnog parenhima s ostatnim žljezdanim parenhimom. Ne nalazi se suspektnih žarišnih lezija. Primjeren je izgled kože i potkožnog tkiva. Desno stanje nakon kvadrantektomije uz uredan izgled ožiljka. Na granici GK blizu areole hipoehogena rubno kalcificirana tvorba promjera 6 mm, SWE mekana, ciljano se citološki punktira, evakuira se sadržaj koji može odgovarati gustoj cisti. Aksilarno se ne nalazi uvećanih niti patološki promijenjenih limfnih čvorova. Opisana tvorba vjerojatno odgovara zoni žljezdanog parenhima. BIRADS 3. Kontrola s nalazom citološke punkcije, molim učiniti i kontrolni MR dojki.
translation: Ultrasound examination of the left breast reveals involuted breast parenchyma with residual glandular tissue. No suspicious focal lesions are identified. The appearance of the skin and subcutaneous tissue is appropriate. On the right, post-quadrantectomy status with a well-healed scar is noted. At the border of the glandular complex near the areola, there is a hypoechoic, marginally calcified mass measuring 6 mm in diameter, which is soft on shear wave elastography (SWE). A targeted fine-needle aspiration is performed, evacuating contents consistent with a dense cyst. No enlarged or pathologically altered lymph nodes are found in the axillary region. The described mass likely corresponds to an area of glandular parenchyma. BIRADS 3. Follow-up with cytological aspiration findings is recommended, and a control breast MRI should be performed.

report: Mamografija s digitalnom tomosintezom i u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrično građene dojke mješovitog tipa, ACR tip C. Vide se difuzne fibrocistične promjene gustog žljezdanog parenhima, brojni difuzni punktiformni kalcifikati obostrano u sklopu sklerozirajuće adenoze. Bez patoloških nodoznih ili stelatnih lezija, nema clustera mikrokalcifikata. Aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi UZV pregled dojki je u dobroj korelaciji s MMG nalazom, gust inhomogeniji žljezdani parenhim, blaga duktektazija i sitne cistične lezije obostrano. Sonografski bez suspektnih lezija. Kategorija je BIRADS 3, obzirom na povećan broj punktiformnih kalcifikata u intervalu od 2020. godine preporuča se učiniti MR dojki
translation: Mammography with digital tomosynthesis in two projections shows symmetrically structured breasts of a mixed type, ACR type C. There are diffuse fibrocystic changes in the dense glandular parenchyma, with numerous diffuse punctate calcifications bilaterally within the context of sclerosing adenosis. No pathological nodular or stellate lesions are observed, and there are no clusters of microcalcifications. Axillary lymph nodes are reactive. Ultrasound examination of the breasts correlates well with the mammography findings, showing dense, heterogeneous glandular parenchyma, mild duct ectasia, and small cystic lesions bilaterally. Sonographically, there are no suspicious lesions. The category is BIRADS 3. Given the increased number of punctate calcifications since 2020, a breast MRI is recommended.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje relativno guste dojke, miješano-žljezdanog tipa, s heterogenim, fibroznim i fibrocističnim promjenama. U GLK desne dojke vidljive su dvije kuglaste tvorbe, promjera 2.4 cm i 2 cm, pravilnih rubova. Nema vidljivih stelatnih lezija, niti patoloških mkc. BIRADS 3. Daljnji postupak ovisno o citološkom nalazu, bit će vjerojatno nužne samo redovite kontrole.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows relatively dense breasts of a mixed glandular type, with heterogeneous fibrous and fibrocystic changes. In the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, there are two spherical masses visible, measuring 2.4 cm and 2 cm in diameter, with well-defined edges. No stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications are visible. BIRADS 3. Further management will depend on the cytological findings, but regular follow-up is likely to be sufficient.

report: Mamografija s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije Dojke su mješovitog parenhima s difuznim fc promjenama žljezde. Obostrano se ne nalazi suspektnih stelatnih lezija. U DMK lijeve dojke na arealu veličine 11 mm vidi se nakupina mkc koja se vidi i na snimkama iz 2019. Koža, mamila i pektoralni mišici primjerenog su izgleda. BIRADS 3. Savjetujem učiniti kontrolu MMG za 6 mj radi praćenja dinamike mkc, ovisno o nalazu odlučiti o potrebi za VABB.
translation: Mammography with tomosynthesis of both breasts in two standard projections. The breasts have mixed parenchyma with diffuse fibrocystic changes in the glandular tissue. No suspicious stellate lesions are found on either side. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a cluster of microcalcifications measuring 11 mm, which is also visible on images from 2019. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles appear normal. BIRADS 3. It is advised to perform a follow-up mammogram in 6 months to monitor the dynamics of the microcalcifications, and based on the findings, decide on the need for a vacuum-assisted breast biopsy (VABB).

report: Mamografija s tomosintezom obje dojke u dvije standardne projekcije Dojke su heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima s gustom žljezdanom komponentom. U desnoj dojci nekoliko nakupina makrokalcifikata u sklopu involutivnih fibroadenoma. Obostrano se izdvaja više nodoznih, oštro ograničenih lezija, prvenstveno odgovaraju ranije verificiranim fibroadenomima. Obostrano se ne nalazi suspektnih, stelatnih lezija niti patološki formiranih mkc. Bez arhitekturalne distorzije parenhima dojke. Koža, mamila i pektoralni mišici primjerenog su izgleda. BIRADS 3. Savjetujem učiniti UZV dojki za 4-6 mjeseci.
translation: Mammography with tomosynthesis of both breasts in two standard projections. The breasts have heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma with a dense glandular component. In the right breast, there are several clusters of macrocalcifications associated with involuting fibroadenomas. Bilaterally, multiple nodular, well-defined lesions are noted, primarily corresponding to previously verified fibroadenomas. No suspicious, stellate lesions or pathologically formed microcalcifications are found on either side. There is no architectural distortion of the breast parenchyma. The skin, nipples, and pectoral muscles appear normal. BIRADS 3. It is advised to perform a breast ultrasound in 4-6 months.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje žljezdano-miješane dojke, ACR tipa C, s heterogenijim i inhomogenijim parenhimom i fibroznim i FC promjenama. U lijevoj dojci u GLK tri kuglaste tvorbe, promjera 3-4 cm, pravilnih rubova, po svemu makrociste. Nema uočljivih stelatnih lezija. Obostrano disperigrani mikrokalcifikati, po svemu benigni. Uredan prikaz kože i pektoralnih mišića, s reatkivnim limfnim čvorovima aksilarno. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se komplementarni UZV dojki obzirom na guste dojke, obratiti pozornost na LD. Odluka o ev.punkciji/ biopsiji na temelju UZV nalaza.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows glandular-mixed breasts, ACR type C, with more heterogeneous and inhomogeneous parenchyma and fibrous and fibrocystic changes. In the left breast, in the upper outer quadrant, there are three spherical formations, 3-4 cm in diameter, with regular borders, most likely macrocysts. No noticeable stellate lesions. Bilateral scattered microcalcifications, likely benign. Normal appearance of the skin and pectoral muscles, with reactive lymph nodes in the axillary region. BIRADS 3. A complementary breast ultrasound is recommended due to dense breast tissue, with attention to the left breast. The decision regarding possible aspiration/biopsy will be based on ultrasound findings.

report: UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene dojke, mješovito - involutivnog tipa. Žljezdani parenhim fibrocistično promijenjen sa pokojim cistično dilatiranim kanalićem, najizraženiji FCP areal u GMK DD. Prema nalzu MMG se lijevo retromamlarno područje detaljno pregleda, bez suspektnih lezija ili distorzije parenhima. Bez suspektnih lezija u obj dojke. Uredan izgled kože i potkožnog masnog tkiva. Reaktivni limfni čvorovi u obje aksile. BIRADS 3 Preporučuje se učiniti kontrolna MMG LD za 6 mj. te prema nalazu MMG i UZV dojki
translation: Ultrasound of the breasts shows symmetrically structured breasts of a mixed-involutive type. The glandular parenchyma is fibrocystically altered with occasional cystically dilated ducts, most pronounced in the fibrocystic area of the upper outer quadrant of the right breast. Based on the mammography findings, the left retroareolar area was examined in detail, revealing no suspicious lesions or parenchymal distortion. No suspicious lesions in either breast. The skin and subcutaneous fatty tissue appear normal. Reactive lymph nodes are present in both axillae. BIRADS 3. It is recommended to perform a follow-up mammogram of the left breast in 6 months, and further evaluation based on mammography and breast ultrasound findings.

report: Ucini se mamografija s tomosintezom desne dojke koja je heterogenog gustog fibroglandularnig tkiva, ACR tip C, koja pokazuje u podrucju DLK DD manju nakupinu mikrokalcifikata koji se doimaju kao da okruzuju tvorbu. Ucinjena je core biopsija te se ne nalazi markacijskog klipa u navedenom podrucju. Ne nalazi se suspektnih stelatnih lezija. Preporuca se MR dojki. BIRADS 3.
translation: A mammogram with tomosynthesis of the right breast, which has heterogeneously dense fibroglandular tissue, ACR type C, reveals a small cluster of microcalcifications in the upper outer quadrant that appear to surround a mass. A core biopsy was performed, and no marker clip is found in the specified area. No suspicious stellate lesions are observed. A breast MRI is recommended. BIRADS 3.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrično građene miješane dojke sa heterogenijim i inhomogenijim fibrocistično promjenjenim parenhimom i benignim kalcifikacijama obostrano. Nema stelatnih lezija niti patoloških MKC, ali je gušći areal vidljiv lijevo centralno. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se komplemetnarni UZV dojki, obratiti pozornost na lijevu dojku.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows symmetrically structured mixed breasts with more heterogeneous and inhomogeneous fibrocystic changes in the parenchyma and benign calcifications on both sides. There are no stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications, but a denser area is visible centrally on the left. BIRADS 3. A complementary breast ultrasound is recommended, with attention to the left breast.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrično građene dojke involutivnog tipa. U lijevoj dojci nema stelatnih lezija niti patoloških mkc. U desnoj dojci retroareolarno u srednjoj trećini mekotkivna gustoća promjera 9 mm, vjerojatno cista. Benigne kalcifikacije obostrano. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se učiniti UZV i ciljano pregledati retroareolarno područje desne dojke. Ovisno o nalazu daljnji postupak.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows symmetrically structured breasts of the involutive type. In the left breast, there are no stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications. In the right breast, there is a soft tissue density measuring 9 mm in diameter located retroareolarly in the middle third, likely a cyst. Benign calcifications are present on both sides. BIRADS 3. An ultrasound is recommended to specifically examine the retroareolar area of the right breast. Further action will depend on the findings.

report: Mamografija obje dojke (DBT tehnika sa CC i MLO projekcijama) pokazuje simetrične dojke raspršenog žljezdanog parenhima (ACR B). U desnoj dojci na prijelazu kvadranata prepektoralno se dijelom prikazuju grupirani kalcifikati na arealu promjera 4 mm. Ne nalazi se suspektnih nodoznih lezija. BIRADS 3. Preporučuje se učiniti MR dojki uslijed ograničene slikovne diferencijacije opisanog područja kalcifikata desne dojke konvencionalnim metodama, a uzevši u obzir i dvojben citološki korelat.
translation: Mammography of both breasts (DBT technique with CC and MLO views) shows symmetrical breasts with scattered glandular tissue (ACR B). In the right breast, at the transition of the quadrants, there are partially visualized grouped calcifications in an area measuring 4 mm prepectorally. No suspicious nodular lesions are found. BIRADS 3. It is recommended to perform a breast MRI due to the limited imaging differentiation of the described area of calcifications in the right breast with conventional methods, considering the uncertain cytological correlation.

report:
UZV pregled dojki pokazuje simterično građene dojke mješovitog tipa s gustim ostatnim 
parenhimom koji je blago difuzno fibrocistično promijenjen.
Ciljano u LD na prijelazu LK zona punktiformih kalcifikata veličine oko 1 cm, medijalnije još pokoji kalcifikat, koreliraju s istima na mamografiji,
učinit će se core biopsija pod kontrolom UZVa, termin osiguran odvje 5.7.2023. u 9 h
Ovisno o nalazu core biopsije planirati vakumsku biopsiju pod kontrolom MMG.
Nema drugih fokalnih lezija.
Aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi.
translation: Ultrasound examination of the breasts shows symmetrically structured breasts of a mixed type with dense residual parenchyma that is mildly diffusely fibrocystic. Targeted in the left breast at the transition of the upper outer quadrant, there are punctate calcifications approximately 1 cm in size, with a few more calcifications medially, correlating with those seen on mammography. A core biopsy will be performed under ultrasound guidance, scheduled for 7/5/2023 at 9 AM. Depending on the core biopsy results, a vacuum-assisted biopsy under mammographic guidance will be planned. No other focal lesions are present. Axillary lymph nodes are reactive.

report:
Na UZV pregledu na prijelazu donjih kvadranata desne dojke prikaže se iregularna, hipoehogena zona s dorzalnom akustičkom muklinom, veličine oko 2.5 cm, bez pojačane vaskularizacije. Opisano može odgovarati ožiljku nakon ranije učinjene biopsije, no ne može se isključiti niti druga etiologija.
U lijevoj dojci ne izdvaja se suspektnih lezija.
Obostrano aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi.
U nastavku pregleda se pod nadzorom UZV nakon aplikacije lokalnog anestetika učini core biopsija opisane lezije u desnoj dojci te se 4 cilindra pošalju na PHD analizu.
translation: On the ultrasound examination of the lower quadrants of the right breast, an irregular, hypoechoic area with posterior acoustic shadowing is observed, measuring approximately 2.5 cm, without increased vascularization. This finding may correspond to a scar from a previous biopsy, but other etiologies cannot be excluded. No suspicious lesions are identified in the left breast. Bilateral reactive axillary lymph nodes are noted. During the continuation of the examination, under ultrasound guidance and after the application of local anesthetic, a core biopsy of the described lesion in the right breast is performed, and four cores are sent for histopathological analysis.

report:
Ucini se core biopsija u podrucju mikrokalcifikata GLK desne dojke i MR gdje se pokazuje imbibicija u podrucju lateralnih kvadranata DD. Na UZV inhomogeno hipoehogeno podrucje s mikrokalcifikatima. Postavi se klip na mjestu ucinjene core biopsije i ucini kontrolna MMG, no rubno prema aksili. 
Uzme se 4 cilindra za PHD analizu i posalje na patologiju. 
U D aksili bez suspektnih l. cvorova, iako su na MMG suspekti povecani l. cvorovi.
translation:
A core biopsy was performed in the area of microcalcifications in the right breast's GLK and on MRI, where enhancement is observed in the lateral quadrants of the right breast. On ultrasound, there is an inhomogeneous hypoechoic area with microcalcifications. A clip was placed at the site of the core biopsy, and a follow-up mammogram was performed, though it is marginally towards the axilla. 

Four cores were taken for histopathological analysis and sent to pathology. 

In the right axilla, there are no suspicious lymph nodes, although suspiciously enlarged lymph nodes are noted on the mammogram.

report:
Na UZV pregledu lijeva dojka urednog je prikaza, involutivnog tipa, bez suspektnih žarišnih lezija.
U desnoj dojci supramamilarno, na prijelazu gornjih kvadranata i u GLK vidi se veći areal (>4 cm) gustog i inhomogenog parenhima, izrazito prokrvljen na CD i tvrđi na shear wave elastografiji (Emax oko 145 kPa). U nastavku se učini core biopsija pod nadzorom UZV - nakon aplikacije lokalnog anestetika, uzmu se 4 uzorka, koji se pošalju na PHD analizu. Periproceduralno bez komplikacija.
Obostrano aksilarno bez patološki promijenjenih limfnih čvorova.
translation: On the ultrasound examination, the left breast appears normal, of involutive type, with no suspicious focal lesions. In the right breast, above the nipple, at the junction of the upper quadrants and in the upper outer quadrant, there is a larger area (>4 cm) of dense and heterogeneous parenchyma, highly vascularized on color Doppler and firmer on shear wave elastography (Emax approximately 145 kPa). A core biopsy was subsequently performed under ultrasound guidance—after the application of local anesthetic, 4 samples were taken and sent for histopathological analysis. No complications occurred during the procedure. Bilaterally, the axillary regions show no pathologically altered lymph nodes.

report: UZV pokazuje fibrocistične promjene obostrano s makrocistama. U GLK lijeve dojke uočava se horizontalno položena iregularna, heterogena lezija duljine 15 mm, nepravilnijih rubova koja se bioptira i više cilindara se pošalje na HP analizu.
translation: The ultrasound reveals fibrocystic changes bilaterally with macrocysts. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a horizontally oriented, irregular, heterogeneous lesion measuring 15 mm with irregular borders. A biopsy is performed, and multiple cores are sent for histopathological analysis.

report:
Prikaže se vertikalno orijentirana trokutasta hipoehogena tvorba  5 mm na granici LK LD uz mamilu, bez detektabilne vaskularizacije, elastografski mekana (el max 13 kPa)

U aksilarnom repu lijeve dojke okrugla hipoehogena lezija 4 mm s dorzalnim pojačanjem snopa - ciljano se citološki punktira.
translation:
A vertically oriented triangular hypoechoic mass measuring 5 mm is observed at the border of the left breast near the nipple, with no detectable vascularization and elastographically soft (el max 13 kPa).

In the axillary tail of the left breast, there is a 4 mm round hypoechoic lesion with posterior acoustic enhancement - targeted for cytological aspiration.

report: Ucini se UZV dojke koji pokazuje uredan kontinuitet implantata. U DLK lijeve dojke nalazi se intrakapsularno hiperehogena tvorba koja je elastografski tvrdja i vaskularizirana i uz nju sada vidljiva jos jedna manja tvorba promjera 3 mm isto vaskularizirana.
translation: An ultrasound of the breast was performed, showing an intact continuity of the implant. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is an intracapsular hyperechoic mass that appears elastographically harder and is vascularized. Additionally, there is now another smaller mass visible, measuring 3 mm in diameter, which is also vascularized.

report:
U DLK lijeve dojke prikaže se na MR pregledu opisana vretenasto oblikovana hipoehogena, relativno dobro ograničena tvorba 17 x 10 mm, horizontalne orijentacije, prepektoralno smještena, s rubno vidljivom vaskularizacijom i elastografski rubno tvrda (elmax oko 300 kPa). 
U lijevoj aksili jedan limfonod prominentnijeg korteksa debljine do 2 mm - ciljano se citološki punktira.
translation: On the MRI of the left breast, a spindle-shaped, hypoechoic, relatively well-defined mass measuring 17 x 10 mm is observed, with a horizontal orientation, located prepectorally. It shows marginal vascularization and is marginally firm on elastography (elmax approximately 300 kPa). In the left axilla, there is one lymph node with a more prominent cortex, up to 2 mm thick, which is targeted for cytological aspiration.

report:
Ucini se core biopija vertikalno orijentirane lezije veličine 9x7 mm, iregularnijih rubova, na prijelazu g.kvadranata DD i više cilindara se pošalje na HP anlizu. Također se ova lezija i ciljano citološki punktira.
Ponovi se i ciljana citološka punkcija l.čvora u d.aksili duljne 14 mm, s pravilnim sinusom i nešto debljim kortetksom.
translation: A core biopsy is performed on a vertically oriented lesion measuring 9x7 mm, with irregular borders, located at the junction of the upper quadrants. Multiple cylinders are sent for histopathological analysis. This lesion is also targeted for cytological aspiration. A targeted cytological aspiration of a lymph node in the right axilla, measuring 14 mm in length, with a regular sinus and a slightly thickened cortex, is also repeated.

report:
UZV pregled pokazuje dojke mješovitog tipa s gustim žljezdanim parenhimom koji je difuzno fibrocistično promijenjen. 
U lijevoj dojci u gornjem lateralnom kvadrantu, bliže granici lateralnih kvadranata prikazuje se hipo i heteroehogena, vertikalno orijentirana lezija s internim odjecima mikrokalcifikata temeljito suspektna na npl proces, veličine oko 1x1,2 cm.
translation: Ultrasound examination reveals breasts of mixed type with dense glandular parenchyma that is diffusely fibrocystic. In the left breast, in the upper outer quadrant, closer to the boundary of the lateral quadrants, there is a hypo- and heterogeneous, vertically oriented lesion with internal echoes of microcalcifications, highly suspicious for a neoplastic process, measuring approximately 1x1.2 cm.

report:
Mamografija s RXS i u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrično građene dojke involutivnog tipa, ACR tip A.  U desnoj dojci u GLK nodozno stelatna lezija veličine oko 3 cm odgovara infiltrativnom npl procesu i zahtijeva daljnju obradu, UZV i core biopsija.
Nema drugih lezija u involutivnom dojkama. Bez patoloških mikrokalcifikata.
Prikazani dijleovi aksila bez patološke limfadenopatije.
translation: Mammography with digital tomosynthesis (RXS) in two projections shows symmetrically structured breasts of the involutional type, ACR type A. In the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, there is a nodular stellate lesion approximately 3 cm in size, consistent with an infiltrative neoplastic process, which requires further evaluation, including ultrasound and core biopsy. No other lesions are present in the involutional breasts. No pathological microcalcifications are observed. The visualized portions of the axillae show no pathological lymphadenopathy.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje za dob guste, miješano-žljezdane dojke, s heterogenim i inhomogenim žljezdanim parenhimom, u kojem su vidljive fibrocistične promjene. U GLK lijeve dojke uočava se stelatna mekotkivna lezija promjera 12-13 mm, koja zahtijeva dopunsku obradu. U desnoj dojci distrofični ovapnjeli fibroadenom centralno.  Nema vidljivih patoloških mkc. Uredan je pikaz kože i pektoralnih mišića.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows dense, mixed-glandular breasts for the age, with heterogeneous and inhomogeneous glandular parenchyma, in which fibrocystic changes are visible. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, a stellate soft tissue lesion measuring 12-13 mm is observed, which requires further evaluation. In the right breast, there is a centrally located dystrophic calcified fibroadenoma. No visible pathological microcalcifications. The skin and pectoral muscles appear normal.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje izrzaito asimietrične, guste, miješano-žljezdane dojke, ACR tipa C. Koža lijeve dojke je izrzazito zadebljana, a dojka je edematozna. Moguća je inflamatrna npl ili lymphangitis. U desnoj dojci retroareolarno kuglasta tvorba pravilnih rubova 18 mm, relativno niske gustoće, otvorene etiologije. Ne vide se patološke mkc. Lijevi pektoralni mišić nije adekvatno prikazan, te se ne može procijenti aksila. U desnoj aksili ne uočavam limfadnopatiju.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows markedly asymmetric, dense, mixed-glandular breasts, ACR type C. The skin of the left breast is significantly thickened, and the breast is edematous. An inflammatory neoplasm or lymphangitis is possible. In the right breast, there is a retroareolar spherical mass with regular borders measuring 18 mm, relatively low density, of indeterminate etiology. No pathological microcalcifications are seen. The left pectoral muscle is not adequately visualized, and the axilla cannot be assessed. No lymphadenopathy is observed in the right axilla.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje guste, miješano-žljezdane dojke, ACR C tipa. U desnoj dojci nema vidljivih fokalnih suspektnih lezija, niti patoloških mkc. Fibrozne i FC promjene. U lijevoj dojci prepektoralno, na prijelazu gornjih kvadranata i prema GMK gušći areal, moguća tvorba nepravilnijih rubova, promjera 12-13 mm.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows dense, mixed-glandular breasts, ACR type C. In the right breast, there are no visible focal suspicious lesions or pathological microcalcifications. Fibrous and fibrocystic changes are noted. In the left breast, prepectorally, at the transition of the upper quadrants and towards the central glandular tissue, there is a denser area, possibly a formation with irregular borders, measuring 12-13 mm in diameter.

report:
Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcija pokazuje žljezdano-miješane heterogene dojke, ACR C tipa, s inhomogenim, fibrozno promijenjenim heterogenim parenhimom i fibroznim i FC promjenama. Dispergirane kalcfikacije benignog izgleda u desnoj dojci.
U GLK lijeve dojke uočava se novonastala mekotkivna sjena promjera 5 mm, iregularnijih rubova, koja zahtijeva dopunsku obradu, odnosno UZV dojki, te ovisno o nalazu odlučiti o punkciji ili biopsiji.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows glandular-mixed heterogeneous breasts, ACR type C, with inhomogeneous, fibrously altered heterogeneous parenchyma and fibrous and fibrocystic changes. Scattered calcifications of benign appearance in the right breast. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, a newly developed soft tissue shadow with a diameter of 5 mm and irregular borders is observed, which requires further evaluation, specifically a breast ultrasound, and depending on the findings, a decision should be made regarding aspiration or biopsy.

report: MMG obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje vrlo guste miješano-žljezdane dojke, ACR tipa C, s heterogenim i inhomogenim parenhimom i fibroznim i FC promjenama. U GLK lijeve dojke uočava se mekotkivna tvorba nešto nepravilnijih rubova veličine 12x9 mm, koja zahtijeva dopunsku obradu, odnosno UZV te vj.core biopsiju pod nadzorom UZV.
translation: Mammography of the breasts in two projections shows very dense mixed-glandular breasts, ACR type C, with heterogeneous and inhomogeneous parenchyma and fibrous and fibrocystic changes. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a soft tissue mass with somewhat irregular borders measuring 12x9 mm, which requires further evaluation, specifically an ultrasound and a core needle biopsy under ultrasound guidance.

report:
Mamografija u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrično građene dojke mješovito-involutivnog tipa 
ACR tip B.
U LD u GMK lobulirna nodozna lezija veličine 17x15 mm djelomice neoštro konturirana i odgovara npl. procesu. Nema drugih lezija u dojkma.
Aksile bez patološke limfadeniopatije.
translation: Mammography in two projections shows symmetrically structured breasts of a mixed-involutive type, ACR type B. In the left breast, in the upper outer quadrant, there is a lobulated nodular lesion measuring 17x15 mm, partially with indistinct margins, corresponding to a neoplastic process. No other lesions are present in the breasts. Axillary regions show no pathological lymphadenopathy.

report:
Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje desnu dojku bez promjena u usporedbi sa snimkama od listopada 2019.godine.
U lijevoj dojci retroareolarno sada je vidljiv novonastali areal suspektnih mkc duljine 3.5 cm, što je temeljito suspektno na recidiv DCIS. Nema asociranih tvorbi.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows no changes in the right breast compared to the images from October 2019. In the left breast, retroareolar, there is now a newly visible area of suspicious microcalcifications measuring 3.5 cm, which is highly suspicious for a recurrence of DCIS. No associated masses are present.

report:
Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje miješane dojke sa dosta održanog žlijezdanog parenhima što je neuobičajeno obzirom na visoku dob pacijentice.
U lijevoj dojci vidljivo je nekoliko nodoznih lezija koje su smještene vrlo blizu dominantno u gornjem lateralnom kvadrantu, promjera od 8 do 17 mm od kojih se neke superponiraju i moguće odgovaraju konglomeratu cista u gornjem lateralnom kvadrantu nešto ispod ovih opisanih lezija uočava se stelatna lezija promjera oko 9 mm otvorene etiologije i promjene su umjerene suspektne.
U desnoj dojci uočava se u gornjem medijalnom kvadrantu mekotkivna tvorba iregularnijih rubova promjera 9 mm koja također zahtijeva dopunsku obradu.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections reveals mixed breast tissue with a considerable amount of preserved glandular parenchyma, which is unusual given the patient's advanced age. In the left breast, several nodular lesions are visible, predominantly located in the upper outer quadrant, ranging from 8 to 17 mm in diameter. Some of these lesions overlap and may correspond to a conglomerate of cysts. Below these described lesions in the upper outer quadrant, there is a stellate lesion approximately 9 mm in diameter of indeterminate etiology, and these changes are moderately suspicious. In the right breast, a soft tissue mass with irregular borders measuring 9 mm is observed in the upper medial quadrant, which also requires further evaluation.

report:
Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje involutivno miješane dojke.
U lijevoj dojci nema vidljivih fokalnih lezija.
U desnoj dojci na MLO snimci visoko prepektoralno praktički u aksilarnom repu vidljiva je mekotkivna lezija veličine 17x9 mm, nepravilnih rubova koja vjerojatno pripada aksilarnom repu dojke ali je potrebno svakako učiniti odmah UZV pregled sa core biopsijom ovisno o UZV i elastografskom nalazu.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows involutive mixed breast tissue. No focal lesions are visible in the left breast. In the right breast, on the MLO view, a soft tissue lesion measuring 17x9 mm with irregular borders is visible high in the prepectoral area, practically in the axillary tail. This lesion likely belongs to the axillary tail of the breast, but an immediate ultrasound examination with core biopsy is necessary, depending on the ultrasound and elastography findings.

report: Učini se MRI dojki prema standardnom multiparametrijskom protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama. U desnoj dojci se u GLK uočava areal non-mass nakupljanja dojke veličine 12x5 mm, koji pokazuje restrikciju difuzije na DWI i suspektan je na DCIS. Nema uočljivih drugih područja patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta niti tvorbi u DD i u LD. U d.aksili l.čvor duljine 15 mm s masnim hilusom, vj. reatkivni, ali se prep.učiniti ciljanu citološku punkciju. Nema vidljivih drugih uvećanih l.čvorova.
translation: An MRI of the breasts was performed following the standard multiparametric protocol, including T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. In the upper outer quadrant of the right breast, there is an area of non-mass enhancement measuring 12x5 mm, which shows diffusion restriction on DWI and is suspicious for DCIS. No other areas of pathological contrast enhancement or masses are observed in the lower inner quadrant or the lower outer quadrant. In the right axilla, there is a lymph node measuring 15 mm with a fatty hilum, likely reactive, but a targeted fine-needle aspiration is recommended. No other enlarged lymph nodes are visible.

report:
Učini se MRI prema standardnom mp protokolu s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama.
Na DCE sekvencama vidljivo je umjereno izraženo pozadinsko nakupljanje. Vidljive su multiple T2 hiperintenzivne ciste obostrano. U GLK DD prepektoralno vidljiva je fokalna lezija koja se intenzivno imbibira, promjera 12-13 mm, s restrikcijom difuzije, diskretno iregularnih rubova.
translation: An MRI was performed using the standard mp protocol with T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. The DCE sequences show moderate background enhancement. Multiple T2 hyperintense cysts are visible bilaterally. In the left upper quadrant, prepectoral region, there is a focal lesion that shows intense enhancement, measuring 12-13 mm in diameter, with diffusion restriction and slightly irregular margins.

report:
Desno u GLK prema prijelazu gornjih kvadranata prikazuje se lobulirana nepravilna lezija aksijalnih dimenzija 19x17 mm, inhomogena T1 nativnog signala koja pokazuje inhomogenu postkontrastnu imbibiciju s centralnom nepravilnom zonom bez imbibicije koja odgovara centralnoj nekrozi. Bez jasnog ispiranja na dinamičkoj studiji, ali s platoom na zadnjim sekvencama- tip 2 krivulje. Na DWI i ADC pokazuje areale restrikcije difuzije. Nalaz odgovara bioptiranoj leziji.
Ne vidi se patološka limfadenopatije aksilarno.
Ne nalazi se drugih morfološki suspektnih lezija, patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije lijevo.
translation: In the right upper outer quadrant, transitioning towards the upper quadrants, there is a lobulated irregular lesion with axial dimensions of 19x17 mm. It exhibits an inhomogeneous native T1 signal and shows inhomogeneous post-contrast enhancement with a central irregular zone lacking enhancement, corresponding to central necrosis. There is no clear washout on the dynamic study, but a plateau is observed in the later sequences, indicating a type 2 curve. On DWI and ADC, there are areas of diffusion restriction. The findings correspond to the biopsied lesion. No pathological axillary lymphadenopathy is observed. No other morphologically suspicious lesions, pathological contrast enhancement, or areas of diffusion restriction are found on the left.

report:
Učini se MRI standardnim tehnikama snimanja po multiparametrijskom protokolu, uključujući DWI i DCE sekvence.
Na učinjenim sekvencama prikažu se simetrične dojke heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima koji pokazuje minimalno pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva.
U desno dojci u DLK vidljiv nepravilni areal  veličine 11 x 9 mm, koji okazuje postkontrastnu imbibiciju,  te blazu restrikciju difuzije. Opisano vj. odgovara podrucju ma MMGte je potrebno uciniti core biopsiju. 
U preostalom parenhimu desne dojke i u lijevoj dojci ne nalazi suspeknih promjena.
translation:
MRI was performed using standard imaging techniques with a multiparametric protocol, including DWI and DCE sequences. 

The sequences show symmetrical breasts with heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma, exhibiting minimal background enhancement of contrast material. 

In the right breast, in the upper outer quadrant, there is an irregular area measuring 11 x 9 mm, which shows post-contrast enhancement and mild diffusion restriction. The described area likely corresponds to the region seen on mammography, and a core biopsy is recommended. 

No suspicious changes are found in the remaining parenchyma of the right breast or in the left breast.

report:
Desno u GLK prikazuje se nejasno ograničen i iregularan areal pojačane rane imbibicije u odnosu na ostali parenhim dimenzija 13x10 mm. Pokazuje perzistentnu postkontrastnu imbibiciju s platoom, a na DWI i ADC pokazuje diskretniju restrikciju difuzije. Nalaz prema polozaju odgovara bioptiranom neoplastičnom procesu.
Desno na prijelazu gornjih kvadranata prema GMK ovalni lobulirani jasno ograničeni areal pojačane kontinuirane imbibicije s restrikcijom difuzije- moze odgovarati FA ili limfnom cvoru, no potrebna UZV evaluacija. 
Desno još pokoji punktiformni nespecificni fokus koji se kontuirano imbibira. 
Lijevo stanje po rad. mastektomiji, bez znakova recidiva.
Ne vidi se patološka limfadenopatija.
translation:
In the right upper outer quadrant, there is a poorly defined and irregular area of early enhancement compared to the surrounding parenchyma, measuring 13x10 mm. It shows persistent post-contrast enhancement with a plateau, and on DWI and ADC, it demonstrates subtle diffusion restriction. The findings correspond to the location of the biopsied neoplastic process.

In the right breast, at the transition of the upper quadrants towards the upper inner quadrant, there is an oval, lobulated, well-defined area of enhanced continuous imbibition with diffusion restriction, which could correspond to a fibroadenoma or a lymph node, but an ultrasound evaluation is necessary.

On the right side, there are a few other punctate nonspecific foci that show continuous enhancement.

On the left side, post-radical mastectomy status is noted, with no signs of recurrence.

No pathological lymphadenopathy is observed.

report: Dojke su miješano-involutivnog tipa, s blagim pozadinskim nakupljanjem. U lijevoj dojci nema vidljivih suspektnih lezija, niti patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta. U desnoj dojci se na postkontrastnim suptrakcijskim sekvencama na prijelazu medijalnih kvadranta uočava lezija promjera 8 mm, koja se imbibira, iregularnijih rubova, s wash-out tipom dinamičke krivulje. U drugim djelovima DD nema uočljivih tvorbi, niti non-mass nakupljanja.
translation: The breasts are of a mixed involutive type, with mild background enhancement. In the left breast, there are no visible suspicious lesions or pathological contrast enhancement. In the right breast, on post-contrast subtraction sequences, a lesion measuring 8 mm is observed at the transition of the medial quadrants. This lesion shows enhancement, has irregular borders, and exhibits a washout type of dynamic curve. No other masses or non-mass enhancements are observed in other parts of the right breast.

report:
Učini se MRI dojki prema mp protokolu, s T2, DWI i DCE sekvencama.
Na prijelazu g.kv. desno dojke prema GMK uočava se T2 hiperintenzivna lezija koja se imbibira kontrastom, veličine 12x7 mm, relativno pravilnih rubova, koja pokazuje restrikciju difuzije i ima plateau tip dinamičke krivulje (mucinozna lezija?). Lateralno i iznad ove lezije u DD još jedna duguljasta lezija koja se imbibira. Nema vidljivih uvećanih l.čvorova. U LD nema uočljivih suspektnih lezija.
translation: Breast MRI was performed according to the mp protocol, with T2, DWI, and DCE sequences. At the junction of the upper outer quadrant of the right breast towards the central glandular tissue, there is a T2 hyperintense lesion measuring 12x7 mm with relatively regular borders, which enhances with contrast, shows diffusion restriction, and has a plateau type dynamic curve (mucinous lesion?). Lateral and superior to this lesion, there is another elongated lesion that also enhances. No enlarged lymph nodes are visible. No suspicious lesions are observed in the left breast.

report: Dojke su simetricne s rasprsenim fibroglandularnim parenhimom, ACR tip B. U GLK lijeve dojke na arealu 6x4 cm vidljivo je podrucje non mass imbibicije koje odgovara podrucju opisanih mikrokalcifikata i zahtijeva daljnju obradu. U preostalom tkivu lijeve kao i u desnoj dojci bez suspektnih lezija. Blaza postkontrastna pozadinska imbibicija.
translation: The breasts are symmetrical with scattered fibroglandular parenchyma, ACR type B. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a 6x4 cm area of non-mass enhancement corresponding to the region of described microcalcifications, which requires further evaluation. No suspicious lesions are observed in the remaining tissue of the left breast or in the right breast. Mild post-contrast background enhancement is noted.

report:
Na učinjenim sekvencama prikažu se simetrične dojke miješano-involutivnog tipa, a parenhim  pokazuje blago pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. 
Obostrano u dojkama prikažu se T2 hiperintenzivni fokusi nakupljanja kontrasta, morfološki izgleda fibrocističnih promjena.
U GLK lijeve dojke, 1,7 cm udaljeno od kože lateralnih kvadranata,  prikaže se nepravilni areal nakupljanja kontrasta dimenzija na aksijalnom presjeku 18 x 8 mm koji ne pokazuje ispiranje kontrasta, morfološki je umjereno suspektan - preporučuje se daljnja obrada.
Na granici medijalnih kvadranata lijeve dojke T2 hiperintenzivna lezija promjera 7 mm, morfologije fibrocistične promjene.
U desnoj dojci nalazi se morfološki suspektnih lezija kao ni patološkog nakupljanja kontrasta ili područja restrikcije difuzije.
Aksilarno bez morfološki suspektnih limfnih čvorova.
translation:
The sequences performed show symmetrical breasts of a mixed-involutive type, with the parenchyma exhibiting mild background enhancement of contrast material. 

Bilateral T2 hyperintense foci of contrast accumulation are observed in the breasts, morphologically appearing as fibrocystic changes.

In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, 1.7 cm from the skin of the lateral quadrants, there is an irregular area of contrast accumulation measuring 18 x 8 mm on the axial section, which does not show contrast washout and is moderately suspicious in morphology - further evaluation is recommended.

At the boundary of the medial quadrants of the left breast, there is a T2 hyperintense lesion with a diameter of 7 mm, morphologically consistent with fibrocystic changes.

In the right breast, there are no morphologically suspicious lesions, nor is there pathological contrast accumulation or areas of diffusion restriction.

Axillary regions show no morphologically suspicious lymph nodes.

report:
Na učinjenim snimkama prikažu se dojke heterogenog fibroglandularnog parenhima koji pokazuje blago pozadinsko nakupljanje kontrastnog sredstva. 
U lijevoj dojci retromamilarno prikaže se ovalna, oštroograničena T2 hiperintenzivna tvorba aksijalnih dimenzija 20x10 mm. Ne pokazuje restrikciju difuzije, a postkontrastno diskretno rubno se imbibira - dif. dg. cista/FA.
Obostrano ciste i fc. promjene, no na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranata lijeve dojke izdvaja se grudasto non mass nakupljanje, segmentalne distribucije na arealu veličine oko 6 cm u AP smjeru - potrebna je daljnja obrada, ne može se isključiti DCIS.
U DLK desne dojke straga također se izdvaja areal nespecifičnog, fokalnog non mass nakupljanja, bez jasne restrikcije difuzije - najvjerojatnije fc. promjene/sklerozirajuća adenoza, ne može se isključiti niti druga etiologija.
Na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranata iste dojke u prednjoj trećini izdvaja se sitna tvorba uz krvnu žilu, može odgovarati otočiću fc. promjene ili limfnom čvoru.
translation: The images reveal breasts with heterogeneous fibroglandular parenchyma, showing mild background enhancement of contrast material. In the left breast, retroareolar, there is an oval, well-defined T2 hyperintense lesion with axial dimensions of 20x10 mm. It does not exhibit diffusion restriction and shows slight peripheral enhancement post-contrast - differential diagnosis includes cyst/fibroadenoma. Bilateral cysts and fibrocystic changes are noted, but at the junction of the lateral quadrants of the left breast, there is a lobulated non-mass enhancement with segmental distribution over an area approximately 6 cm in the anteroposterior direction - further evaluation is needed, as DCIS cannot be ruled out. In the posterior part of the right breast's lower outer quadrant, there is also an area of nonspecific, focal non-mass enhancement, without clear diffusion restriction - most likely fibrocystic changes/sclerosing adenosis, but other etiologies cannot be excluded. At the junction of the lateral quadrants of the same breast in the anterior third, there is a small lesion adjacent to a blood vessel, which may correspond to an island of fibrocystic change or a lymph node.

report: Mamografija obje dojke  u dvije projekcije pokazuje miješane dojke, s inhomogenijim i heterogenijim parenhimom. U lijevoj dojci nema vidljivih fokalnih suspektnih lezija, niti patoloških mkc. U desnoj dojci na prijelazu gornjih kvadranta i u GLK vidljiva je stelatna mekotkivna lezija iregularnih rubova, promjera 3.5 cm, koja najvj.odgovara invazivnoj npl. Uočava se uvećani limfni čvor u desnoj aksili. U lijevoj aksili nema uvećanih l.čvorova.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows mixed breast tissue with more inhomogeneous and heterogeneous parenchyma. In the left breast, there are no visible focal suspicious lesions or pathological microcalcifications. In the right breast, at the junction of the upper quadrants and in the upper outer quadrant, there is a stellate soft tissue lesion with irregular borders, measuring 3.5 cm, most likely corresponding to an invasive neoplasm. An enlarged lymph node is observed in the right axilla. There are no enlarged lymph nodes in the left axilla.

report: Mamografija obje dojke pokazuje za dob guste dojke miješanog tipa, s heterogenijim i inhomogenijim parenhimom i fibroznim i fibrocističnim promjenama u desnoj dojci. U lijevoj dojci u GLK vidljiva je stelatna mekotkivna tvorba iregularnih rubova, promjera 4 cm, koja odgovara invazivnoj npl i koju je potrebno bioptirati pod nadzorom UZV. Tvorba retrahira kožu. U lijevoj aksili vidljiv je uvećan limfni čvor, suspektna meta, koji je potrebno citološki punktirati pod nadzorom UZV.
translation: Mammography of both breasts reveals dense breasts of mixed type for the patient's age, with more heterogeneous and inhomogeneous parenchyma, as well as fibrous and fibrocystic changes in the right breast. In the left breast, in the upper outer quadrant, there is a stellate soft tissue mass with irregular borders, measuring 4 cm in diameter, consistent with an invasive neoplasm, which requires biopsy under ultrasound guidance. The mass causes skin retraction. An enlarged lymph node is visible in the left axilla, suspected to be metastatic, which needs to be aspirated cytologically under ultrasound guidance.

report: Mamografija obje dojke pokazuje involutivne dojke. U desnoj dojci nema patoloških mkc, niti suspektnih stelatnih tvorbi. U lijevoj dojci na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranata, straga, prepektoralno, vidljiva je velika mekotkivna tvorba promjera preko 4 cm, dominantno cirkularna, lobuliranih rubova, odgovara invazivoj npl, s uvećanim, najvjerojatnije metastatski promijenjenim limfnim čvorovima u lijevoj aksili.
translation: Mammography of both breasts shows involuted breasts. In the right breast, there are no pathological microcalcifications or suspicious stellate lesions. In the left breast, at the junction of the lateral quadrants, posteriorly, prepectorally, there is a large soft tissue mass over 4 cm in diameter, predominantly circular with lobulated margins, consistent with an invasive neoplasm, with enlarged lymph nodes in the left axilla, most likely metastatically altered.

report:
Mamografija s digitalnom tomosintezom i UZV pregled dojki pokazuju
u lijevoj dojci u GLK stelatnu leziju veličine 2,2 cm, sonografski hipoehogenu neoštro ograničenu tvrdu npl. leziju veličine oko 2,4 cm.
Nema drugih fokalnih lezija u dojkama, dojke mješovitog tipa, ACR tip B, s difuznim fibrocističnim promjenama. Bez patoloških mikrokalcifikata.
Aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi, nema patološke limfadenopatije.
translation: Mammography with digital tomosynthesis and breast ultrasound reveal a spiculated lesion in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, measuring 2.2 cm. Sonographically, it appears as a hypoechoic, poorly defined, hard mass lesion measuring approximately 2.4 cm. No other focal lesions are observed in the breasts, which are of mixed type, ACR type B, with diffuse fibrocystic changes. No pathological microcalcifications are present. Axillary lymph nodes are reactive, with no pathological lymphadenopathy.

report:
Desna dojka je smanjena, kontrahirana, zauzeta mekotkivnom ekspanzivnom tvorbom promjera preko 5 cm, koja infiltrira kožu i zadebljava je. Lijeva dojka je involutivna, bez vidljivih fokalnih lezija i bez patoloških mkc, te bez uvećanih čvorova lijevo aksilarno.
Preporučuje se biopsija DD pod nadzorom UZV - invazivna npl s vj.limfangiitis carcinomatosa -
translation: The right breast is reduced in size, contracted, and occupied by a soft tissue mass over 5 cm in diameter, which infiltrates and thickens the skin. The left breast is involuted, with no visible focal lesions, no pathological microcalcifications, and no enlarged lymph nodes in the left axilla. A biopsy of the right breast under ultrasound guidance is recommended - likely invasive neoplasm with lymphangitis carcinomatosa.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrične dojke inovlutivno-miješanog tipa. U desnoj dojci nema vidljivih stelatnih lezija i bez patoloških MKC. U lijevoj dojci u GLK vidljiva je solitarna mekotkivna tvorba veličine 10x9 mm, iregularnijih rubova, koja je suspektna na malu invazivnu npl. Nema patoloških clustera mkc. Uredan je prikaz kože i pektoralnih mišića. Intramamarni l.čvor u GLK LD.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows symmetrical breasts of involutive-mixed type. In the right breast, there are no visible stellate lesions and no pathological microcalcifications. In the left breast, in the upper outer quadrant, there is a solitary soft tissue mass measuring 10x9 mm with irregular borders, which is suspicious for a small invasive neoplasm. There are no pathological clusters of microcalcifications. The skin and pectoral muscles are well visualized. There is an intramammary lymph node in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast.

report:
Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje mješane dojke sa heterogenijim i inhomogenijim parenhimom. Lijeva dojka s urednim prikazom kože i pektoralnog mišića, bez stelatnih lezija i patoloških mkc. 
Desna dojka manja. U GLK vidljiva je stelatna mekotkivna ekspanzivno-infiltrativna npl tvorba promjera 2 cm, spikuliranih rubova, koja retrahira kožu i smanjuje dojku. Aksila nije prikazana.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two views shows mixed breast tissue with more heterogeneous and inhomogeneous parenchyma. The left breast displays normal skin and pectoral muscle, with no stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications. The right breast is smaller. In the upper outer quadrant, there is a visible stellate soft tissue expansile-infiltrative mass measuring 2 cm in diameter, with spiculated margins, which is retracting the skin and reducing the size of the breast. The axilla is not visualized.

report:
Lijeva dojka izrazito promijenjena, zadebljane kože, smanjena, sa heterogenom tvorbom promjera iznad 3 cm na prijelazu lateralnih kvadranta i nepravilnim mkc. Tvorbu je nužno bioptirati i po svemu odgovara invazivnoj npl, sa meta u l.čvoru u lijevoj aksili, te limfogenom diseminacijom (inflamatorni ca lijeve dojke). Moguć lobularni invazivni ca prema morfologiji.

Desna dojka je miješanog tipa, dosta gusta za dob, s heterogenim, inhomogenim parenhimom, bez vidljivih fokalnih lezija u parenhimu. 
Preporučuje se učiniti i CE-MRI dojki, te sa nalazom core-biopsije i ostalim nalazima prikazati na MD timu za dojku radi odluke o daljnjem liječenju.
translation:
The left breast is significantly altered, with thickened skin and reduced size, featuring a heterogeneous mass over 3 cm in diameter at the junction of the lateral quadrants, along with irregular microcalcifications. A biopsy of the mass is necessary, and it is consistent with an invasive neoplasm, with metastasis to the lymph node in the left axilla and lymphatic dissemination (inflammatory carcinoma of the left breast). A possible lobular invasive carcinoma is suggested based on morphology.

The right breast is of mixed type, quite dense for the patient's age, with heterogeneous, inhomogeneous parenchyma, and no visible focal lesions in the parenchyma. It is recommended to perform a contrast-enhanced MRI of the breasts, and to present the findings from the core biopsy and other results to the breast multidisciplinary team for a decision on further treatment.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje simetrično građene dojke miješano-involutivnog tipa, ACR tipa C, s vidljivim fibrocističnim promjenama u LD. U desnoj dojci u GLK vidljiva je stelatna, mekotkivna tvorba, promjera 1.6 cm, koja odgovara invazivnoj npl i koju je potrebno pregledati UZV i učiniti core biopsiju. U lijevoj dojci nema vidljivih stelatnih lezija, niti patoloških mkc. Uredan prikaz kože i pektoralnih mišića. Nema MMG uočljivih uvećanih aksilarnih l.čvorova.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows symmetrically structured breasts of a mixed-involutive type, ACR type C, with visible fibrocystic changes in the left breast. In the right breast, in the upper outer quadrant, there is a stellate, soft tissue mass measuring 1.6 cm, which corresponds to an invasive neoplasm and requires ultrasound examination and core biopsy. No stellate lesions or pathological microcalcifications are visible in the left breast. The skin and pectoral muscles are well visualized. No mammographically detectable enlarged axillary lymph nodes are present.

report: Mamografija obje dojke u dvije projekcije pokazuje manju lijevu dojku, s retrakcijom kože prema mekotkivnoj stelatnoj leziji na prijelazu gornjih kvadranata retroareolarno, koja po svemu odgovara ožiljku, uz koji su vidljive poslijeoperacijske klipse. U desnoj dojci u GLK vidljiv je kuglasti, lobulirani, mekotkivni tumorski proces veličine 3x2.2 cm, koji odgovara invazivnoj neoplazmi. Reaktivni l.čvorovi obostrano aksilarno.
translation: Mammography of both breasts in two projections shows a smaller left breast, with skin retraction towards a stellate soft tissue lesion at the junction of the upper quadrants retroareolar, which appears consistent with a scar, alongside visible postoperative clips. In the right breast, in the upper outer quadrant, there is a spherical, lobulated, soft tissue tumor measuring 3x2.2 cm, consistent with an invasive neoplasm. Reactive lymph nodes are present bilaterally in the axillary regions.

report:
UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene dojke, mješovitog tipa.
Žljezdani parenhim fibrocistično promijenjen sa pokojom cistom promjera do 7 mm.
 U GLK DD nalazi se hipoehogena lezija nepravilnih rubova, promjera do 11 mm, bez stražnje atenuacije signala. Elastografski rubno povećana tvrdoća, EL max180 kPa.
Uredan izgled kože i potkožnog masnog tkiva.
Reaktivni limfni čvorovi u obje aksile.
translation: Breast ultrasound shows symmetrically structured breasts of mixed type. The glandular parenchyma is fibrocystically altered with a few cysts up to 7 mm in diameter. In the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a hypoechoic lesion with irregular borders, measuring up to 11 mm in diameter, without posterior signal attenuation. Elastography shows marginally increased stiffness, with a maximum elasticity of 180 kPa. The appearance of the skin and subcutaneous fat tissue is normal. Reactive lymph nodes are present in both axillae.

report: UZV pokazuje u LD na prijelazu donjih kvadranata hipoehogenu, vertikalnu, relativno malu, tvrdu leziju.
translation: The ultrasound shows a hypoechoic, vertical, relatively small, firm lesion in the left breast at the junction of the lower quadrants.

report: UZV dojki pokazuje malu, skvrčenu lijevu dojku, prožetu tumorom koji infiltrira kožu, koji je veličine >3 cm, iregularnih rubova, hipoehogen, tvrd. Obzirom da zbog stanja pacijentice nije moguće napraviti biopsiju učini se ciljana citološka punkcija. Radi se o invazivnoj npl koja infiltrira kožu. Zbog stanja pacijentice nije moguće pregledati aksile.
translation: Ultrasound of the breast reveals a small, shrunken left breast permeated by a tumor infiltrating the skin, measuring over 3 cm, with irregular borders, hypoechoic, and firm. Due to the patient's condition, a biopsy cannot be performed, so a targeted fine-needle aspiration is conducted. It is an invasive neoplasm infiltrating the skin. The patient's condition also prevents examination of the axillae.

report: Na prijelazu g.kv.LD i prema GLK LD vidljiva je hipohogena, iregularna tvorba veličine 22x15 mm, elastografski vrlo tvrda, koja odgovara invazivnoj npl. Učini se core biopsija i više cilindara se pošalje na HP analizu. U lijevoj aksili reaktivni l.čvorovi, nema vidljivih morfološki promijenjenih l.čvorova.
translation: At the junction of the upper outer quadrant and towards the lower outer quadrant of the left breast, there is a hypoechoic, irregular mass measuring 22x15 mm, which is very hard on elastography, consistent with an invasive neoplasm. A core biopsy is performed, and multiple cylinders are sent for histopathological analysis. In the left axilla, reactive lymph nodes are present, with no morphologically altered lymph nodes visible.

report: Prikaže se nepravilna, vertikalno oorijentirana hipoehogena tvorba 14 x 14 mm retroareolarno u DMK lijeve dojke, rubno blaže vaskularizirana, s internim kalcifikatima, elastografski vrlo tvrda (el max 300 kPa). Opisana tvorba je tračkom povezana s prepektoralno smještenom hipoehogenom tvorbom 12 x 10 mm, koja se može jasno razgraničiti od pektoralnog mišića. Zadebljanje okolne kože.
translation: The report shows an irregular, vertically oriented hypoechoic mass measuring 14 x 14 mm located retroareolarly in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, with mild peripheral vascularization and internal calcifications. Elastography indicates it is very hard (el max 300 kPa). The described mass is connected by a strand to a prepectorally located hypoechoic mass measuring 12 x 10 mm, which can be clearly delineated from the pectoral muscle. There is thickening of the surrounding skin.

report: Na ciljanom UZV pregledu lijeve dojke prikaže se ranije verificirana hipoehogena tvorba u GMK koja je na današnjem pregledu regresivne dinamike veličinom (9 mm) i elastografskim vrijednostima.
translation: On the targeted ultrasound examination of the left breast, the previously identified hypoechoic lesion in the upper outer quadrant is observed. On today's examination, it shows regressive dynamics in size (9 mm) and elastographic values.

report:
Učini se core biopsija tm tvorbe u DLK LD, koja je duljine 2.2 cm, hipoehogena, iregularnih rubova, vrlo tvrda na SWSE, s internim mkc i odgovara invazivnoj npl. Više cilindara se pošalje na HP analizu.

Također se učini ciljana citološka punkcija čvora duljine 12 mm u l.aksili koji ima široki centralni sinus i hipoehogeni korteks.
translation:
A core biopsy was performed on the mass in the lower outer quadrant of the left breast, which measures 2.2 cm, is hypoechoic, has irregular borders, and is very hard on shear wave elastography, with internal microcalcifications, consistent with an invasive neoplasm. Multiple cores were sent for histopathological analysis.

A targeted fine needle aspiration was also performed on a 12 mm lymph node in the left axilla, which has a broad central sinus and a hypoechoic cortex.

report:
UZV dojki pokaže simetrično građene dojke, intermedijarnog tipa.
U lijevoj dojci supraareolarno, na granici gornjih kvadranata, nepravilna prostrana hipoehogena infiltrativna lezija mjeri 19x17 mm, elastografijom tvrda (LLxCC). U DLK dvije hipoehogene lezije veličine oko 5 mm i 6 mm - ddg. sateliti i/ili intramamarni limfni čvor. 
U desnoj dojci bez fokalnih lezija.
Lijevo aksilano vidi se uvećan, ovalni sekundarno promijenjnei limfni čvor, dimenzija 19x10mm.
Desno aksilano se ne vidi patološke limfadenopatije.
translation: Ultrasound of the breasts shows symmetrically structured breasts of intermediate type. In the left breast, supra-areolar at the junction of the upper quadrants, there is an irregular, extensive hypoechoic infiltrative lesion measuring 19x17 mm, which is hard on elastography (LLxCC). In the lower outer quadrant, there are two hypoechoic lesions measuring approximately 5 mm and 6 mm - differential diagnosis includes satellites and/or intramammary lymph nodes. No focal lesions are observed in the right breast. In the left axilla, an enlarged, oval, secondarily changed lymph node is seen, measuring 19x10 mm. No pathological lymphadenopathy is observed in the right axilla.

report:
UZV pregled pokazuje lijevo retromamilarno hipoehogenu heterogeno strukturiranu nepravilnu leziju ukupne veličine oko 4 cm koja odgovara infiltrativnom npl procesu.
Aksilarno reaktivni limfni čvorovi.
Učini se citološka punkcija npl. lijeve dojke i limfonoda lijeve aksile
translation: Ultrasound examination reveals a left retroareolar hypoechoic, heterogeneously structured irregular lesion measuring approximately 4 cm, consistent with an infiltrative neoplastic process. Reactive lymph nodes are present in the axilla. A cytological aspiration of the neoplastic lesion in the left breast and the lymph nodes in the left axilla is recommended.

report:
Desna dojka je voluminoznija, edematozna, crvene i zadebljane kože. U gornjem lateralnom kvadrantu prema aksili velika egzulcerirajuća tvorba koja secernira. 
Lateralni kvadranti dojke prožeti su velikom, ekspanzivnom tvorbom koja se pruža do u aksilu,  infiltrira kožu. Subkutano izražen edem. Tvorba je iregularna, izrazito prokrvljena. Desno aksilarno uz samu tvorbu izdvajaju se dvije okrugle lezije, vjerojatno patološki promijenjeni limfni čvorovi koji se citološki punktira.
Lijeva dojka je heterogenog parenhima, s inhomogenim žljezdanim parenhimom no bez jasno vidljivih suspektnih solidnih lezija. Koža i potkožje urednog su prikaza. Aksilarno lijevo uredan prikaz limfnih čvorova.
