Conclusioni: cardiomiopatia dilatativa post-ischemica, con aspetto pseudo-aneurismatico dell'apice, che mostra pareti assottigliate e severa riduzione della funzione sistolica globale a riposo (FE: 25%). Concomita discinesia dell'apice, acinesia dei segmenti anteriore, antero-settale ed inferiore in sede medio-ventricolare, ipo/acinesia della parete laterale medio-ventricolare ed ipocinesia del segmento inferiore in sede basale, con aree di necrosi miocardica agli stessi livelli.
translation:
CARDIAC MRI WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST

The examination was performed with the patient at rest, using Cine b-SSFP sequences aligned with the main cardiac axes, STIR sequences, and MDE sequences acquired after intravenous injection of Gadovist contrast agent at a dose of 0.1 mmol/kg. Biometric data: height: 172 cm; weight: 78 kg; body surface area/BSA: 1.85 m² (according to Mosteller).

Clinical question: Further evaluation in a patient with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) with stenosis of the left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery, treated with percutaneous angioplasty.

Left Ventricle: Enlarged cavity dimensions (maximum diameter 62 mm) with a pseudo-aneurysmal appearance of the apex, which shows thinned walls, and mild hypertrophy of the interventricular septum (13 mm). Severe reduction in global systolic function at rest (ejection fraction: 25%) with dyskinesia of the apex, akinesia of the anterior, anteroseptal, and inferior segments at the mid-ventricular level, hypo/akinesia of the mid-ventricular lateral wall, and hypokinesia of the inferior segment at the basal level.

Left Atrium: Cavity dimensions are within normal limits. Mild mitral regurgitation (+/++++).

Right Ventricle: Cavity dimensions are within normal limits with preserved wall thickness, maintaining global and segmental systolic function at rest.

Right Atrium: Dimensions are within normal limits. Mild tricuspid regurgitation (+/++++).

STIR sequences do not reveal any areas of altered intramyocardial signal.

Post-contrast study: Presence of an extensive area of transmural necrosis at the apical and mid-ventricular levels, with relative sparing of the anterolateral segment and the mid-ventricular septum, as well as the inferior wall at the basal level.

Conclusions: Post-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy with a pseudo-aneurysmal appearance of the apex, showing thinned walls and severe reduction in global systolic function at rest (ejection fraction: 25%). Accompanied by dyskinesia of the apex, akinesia of the anterior, anteroseptal, and inferior segments at the mid-ventricular level, hypo/akinesia of the mid-ventricular lateral wall, and hypokinesia of the inferior segment at the basal level, with myocardial necrosis in the same areas.

report:
RM RACHIDE LOMBOSACRALE
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: trauma circa 40 giorni fa.
Sequenze: sagittali TSE T1, T2 e T2 Fat Sat, assiali TSE T2.
Verticalizzazione della fisiologica lordosi in clinostatismo.
Avvallamento del terzo medio-anteriore della limitante somatica superiore di L1, con edema osseo intraspongioso, come da frattura vertebrale non consolidata; necessaria consulenza neurochirurgica/neuroradiologica interventistica. Edema intraspongioso a carico della prima vertebra coccigea, di altezza ridotta, come da recente frattura, con edema peri-ostale.
Manifestazioni di spondilo-artrosi lombare con osteofitosi marginale a ponte (esuberante a livello di L5-S1) e ipertrofia dei massicci articolari.
Canale spinale di ampiezza conservata del canale spinale nel tratto esplorato.
Fenomeni degenerativi dei dischi intersomatici, con riduzione in altezza del relativo spazio a livello di L5-S1.
A livello D12-L1 è presente una modica protrusione discale posteriore mediana,  paramediana bilaterale che impronta appena il sacco durale.
A livello L1-L2, L2-L3 è presente una protrusione discale posteriore mediana,  paramediana e sub-articolare bilaterale che impronta il sacco durale.
A livello L3-L4 e L4-L5 è presente una protrusione discale posteriore ad ampio raggio che impronta il sacco durale e impegna parzialmente i forami di coniugazione in particolare a destra.
A livello L5-S1 è presente una modesta protrusione discale posteriore mediana-paramediana bialterale che impronta appena il sacco durale. 
Regolare rappresentazione del cono midollare che termina a livello di L1.
translation:
LUMBOSACRAL SPINE MRI

Indication and clinical notes: trauma approximately 40 days ago.

Sequences: sagittal TSE T1, T2, and T2 Fat Sat, axial TSE T2.

Straightening of the normal lordosis in the supine position.

Depression of the middle-anterior third of the superior endplate of L1, with intraspongious bone edema, consistent with an unhealed vertebral fracture; neurosurgical/interventional neuroradiological consultation is necessary. Intraspongious edema involving the first coccygeal vertebra, which is reduced in height, consistent with a recent fracture, with periosteal edema.

Manifestations of lumbar spondyloarthritis with bridging marginal osteophytes (prominent at L5-S1) and hypertrophy of the facet joints.

The spinal canal is of preserved wiRXh in the explored segment.

Degenerative changes of the intervertebral discs, with reduced height of the corresponding space at L5-S1.

At the D12-L1 level, there is a mild posterior median and bilateral paramedian disc protrusion that slightly indents the dural sac.

At the L1-L2, L2-L3 levels, there is a posterior median, paramedian, and bilateral sub-articular disc protrusion that indents the dural sac.

At the L3-L4 and L4-L5 levels, there is a broad-based posterior disc protrusion that indents the dural sac and partially occupies the neural foramina, particularly on the right.

At the L5-S1 level, there is a modest posterior median-paramedian bilateral disc protrusion that slightly indents the dural sac.

The conus medullaris is normally represented, terminating at the level of L1.

report:
RM RACHIDE CERVICALE
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: cervicobrachialgia bilaterale, vertigini.
Sequenze: sagittali TSE T1, T2 e STIR, assiali mFFE T2.
Verticalizzazione della fisiologica lordosi in clinostatismo.
Conservata altezza dei somi in esame. Canale spinale di ampiezza nei limiti.
Iniziali fenomeni disidratativi dei dischi intersomatici.
A livello C3-C4 è presente una minima prostrusione disco-artrosica posteriore mediana che impronta appena lo spazio perimidollare anteriore.
A livello C4-C5 è presente una prostrusione disco-artrosica posteriore mediana che comprime lo spazio perimidollare anteriore.
A livello C5-C6 è presente un’ampia prostrusione disco-artrosica circonferenziale posteriore che comprime lo spazio perimidollare anteriore, lambendo la superficie ventrale del midollo spinale, ed impegna parzialmente i forami di coniugazione
Regolare rappresentazione del midollo spinale nel tratto esplorato.
translation:
CERVICAL SPINE MRI

Indication and clinical notes: bilateral cervicobrachialgia, dizziness.

Sequences: sagittal TSE T1, T2, and STIR, axial mFFE T2.

There is straightening of the normal cervical lordosis in the supine position. The vertebral bodies maintain normal height. The spinal canal is of normal wiRXh.

There are early signs of dehydration in the intervertebral discs.

At the C3-C4 level, there is a minimal posterior median disc-osteophyte protrusion that slightly indents the anterior perimedullary space.

At the C4-C5 level, there is a posterior median disc-osteophyte protrusion that compresses the anterior perimedullary space.

At the C5-C6 level, there is a broad circumferential posterior disc-osteophyte protrusion that compresses the anterior perimedullary space, comes into contact with the ventral surface of the spinal cord, and partially encroaches on the neural foramina.

The spinal cord is normally represented in the explored segment.

report:
RM RACHIDE LOMBOSACRALE
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: lombosciatalgia bilaterale.
Sequenze: sagittali TSE T1, T2 e T2 Fat Sat, assiali TSE T2. 
Verticalizzazione della fisiologica lordosi in clinostatismo.
Manifestazioni di spondilo-artrosi lombare con osteofitosi marginale a prevalente sviluppo anteriore e ipertrofia dei massicci articolari e dei legamenti gialli.
Conservata ampiezza del canale spinale nel tratto esplorato.
Diffusi fenomeni degenerativi dei dischi intersomatici (con riduzione di altezzo dello spazio L2-L3) e sofferenza algodistrofica delle limitanti somatiche contrapposte dove sono presenti piccoli nuclei intraspongiosi di Schmorl.
A livello L1-L2 si apprezza un'ernia discale posteriore paramediana, sub-articolare ed intraforaminale sinistra che comprime il sacco durale ed impegna il relativo forame di coniugazione.
A livello L2-L3 si apprezza una protrusione discale posteriore paramediana, sub-articolare ed intraforaminale bilaterale che impronta il sacco durale ed impegna parzialmente i relativi forami di coniugazione. 
A livello L3-L4 si apprezza una protrusione discale posteriore mediana, paramediana bilaterale che impronta il sacco durale. 
A livello L4-L5 si apprezza una protrusione discale posteriore mediana, paramediana, sub-articolare bilaterale che impronta il sacco durale e sporge nei relativi forami di coniugazione. 
A livello L5-S1 si apprezza una protrusione discale posteriore ad ampio raggio che impronta il sacco durale ed impegna i relativi forami di coniugazione in particolare il destro con possibile conflitto con la radice emergente di L5.
Regolare rappresentazione del cono midollare che termina a livello di L1-L2.
translation:
LUMBOSACRAL SPINE MRI

Indication and clinical notes: bilateral sciatica.

Sequences: sagittal TSE T1, T2, and T2 Fat Sat, axial TSE T2.

Straightening of the normal lordosis in the supine position.

Findings of lumbar spondyloarthritis with marginal osteophyte formation predominantly anteriorly, and hypertrophy of the facet joints and ligamenta flava.

The spinal canal maintains normal wiRXh in the examined segment.

Widespread degenerative changes of the intervertebral discs (with reduced height of the L2-L3 space) and dystrophic changes of the opposing vertebral endplates, where small Schmorl's nodes are present.

At the L1-L2 level, there is a posterior paramedian, subarticular, and foraminal left disc herniation compressing the dural sac and occupying the corresponding neural foramen.

At the L2-L3 level, there is a posterior paramedian, subarticular, and bilateral foraminal disc protrusion indenting the dural sac and partially occupying the corresponding neural foramina.

At the L3-L4 level, there is a posterior median and bilateral paramedian disc protrusion indenting the dural sac.

At the L4-L5 level, there is a posterior median, paramedian, and bilateral subarticular disc protrusion indenting the dural sac and protruding into the corresponding neural foramina.

At the L5-S1 level, there is a broad-based posterior disc protrusion indenting the dural sac and occupying the corresponding neural foramina, particularly on the right, with possible conflict with the emerging L5 nerve root.

The conus medullaris is normally represented, terminating at the L1-L2 level.

report:
RM SPALLA DESTRA
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: spalla dolorosa, in paziente operato di sutura di cuffia circa 12 anni fa. Visionata precedente RM del 29.11.22
Sequenze: assiale TSE PD SPAIR Fat Sat, coronali TSE PD e T2 SPAIR Fat Sat, sagittali TSE T1 e T2.
Persistono manifestazioni degenerative artrosiche dell'articolazione acromion-claveare con rimaneggiamento dei capi articolari e modico ispessimento sinovitico. Sostanzialmente conservata l'ampiezza dello spazio di scorrimento subacromiale. Esiti di sutura della cuffia dei rotatori, con sostanziale sovrapponibilità degli avanzati fenomeni di tendinosi del sovra e dell'infraspinoso che risultano assottigliati e slaminati, con ampie aree di degenerazione intratendinea in assenza di chiari segni di lesione. Lievemente ridotto il trofismo dei ventri muscolari. Omoartrosi eccentrica di grado severo con completa usura del rivestimento condrale articolare gleno-omerale e fenomeni di attrito delle superfici articolari contrapposte con allo stato incrementata sofferenza dell'osso subcondrale; sovrapponibile osteofita omerale polare inferiore che impegna parzialmente il recesso ascellare. Millimetrica formazione geodico-cistica subcondrale a carico dell’estremo cefalico omerale postero-superiore, lievemente incrementata in dimensioni. Discreto versamento intrarticolare con distensione dei recessi periarticolari; minima distensione fluida della borsa subacromion-deltoidea. Il tendine del CLB, regolarmente contenuto nella sua doccia anatomica, presenta modica distensione fluida della sua guaina.
translation:
RIGHT SHOULDER MRI

Indication and clinical notes: painful shoulder in a patient who underwent rotator cuff repair approximately 12 years ago. Previous MRI from 11/29/22 reviewed.

Sequences: axial TSE PD SPAIR Fat Sat, coronal TSE PD and T2 SPAIR Fat Sat, sagittal TSE T1 and T2.

There are persistent degenerative arthritic changes in the acromioclavicular joint with remodeling of the joint surfaces and mild synovial thickening. The subacromial space is essentially preserved. There are post-surgical changes from rotator cuff repair, with significant tendinosis of the supraspinatus and infraspinatus tendons, which appear thinned and delaminated, with extensive areas of intratendinous degeneration but no clear signs of a tear. There is a slight reduction in the muscle bulk. Severe eccentric glenohumeral osteoarthritis is noted, with complete wear of the articular cartilage and friction phenomena of the opposing joint surfaces, currently with increased subchondral bone stress; there is a comparable inferior humeral polar osteophyte partially occupying the axillary recess. A small subchondral geode-cystic formation is present at the posterosuperior aspect of the humeral head, slightly increased in size. There is moderate joint effusion with distension of the periarticular recesses; minimal fluid distension of the subacromial-subdeltoid bursa. The long head of the biceps tendon, regularly contained within its groove, shows mild fluid distension of its sheath.

report:
RM ANCA BILATERALE
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: dolore.
Sequenze: assiali TSE T1, T2 e PD SPAIR Fat Sat, coronali TSE T1 e STIR, sagittali TSE STIR
Iniziali manifestazioni di coxartrosi bilaterale, con lieve riduzione di ampiezza della rima articolare e modica usura del rivestimento condrale coxo-femorale; millimetrica formazione geodico-cistica della testa femorale in sede subcondrale a destra; assenza di definite alterazioni di segnale dell’osso subcondrale a sinistra.
Non vi sono segni d’impingement femoro-acetabolare né di osteonecrosi delle teste femorali.
Modica quota di versamento articolare coxo-femorale destro; non significativo versamento articolare coxofemorale sinistro.
Focale area di edema osseo midollare a carico del versante anteriore dell’ala sacrale destra sul versante articolare sacro-iliaco. Fenomeni di sclerosi delle sacro-iliache, in particolare a sinistra.
Segni di entesite peritrocanterica dei muscoli medio-glutei bilateralmente.
Regolare rappresentazione delle restanti strutture muscolo-tendinee del cingolo pelvico.
translation:
BILATERAL HIP MRI

Indication and clinical notes: pain.

Sequences: axial TSE T1, T2, and PD SPAIR Fat Sat, coronal TSE T1 and STIR, sagittal TSE STIR

Initial signs of bilateral hip osteoarthritis, with slight narrowing of the joint space and moderate wear of the hip joint cartilage; small geode-cystic formation in the subchondral area of the right femoral head; no definite signal alterations in the subchondral bone on the left.

There are no signs of femoroacetabular impingement or osteonecrosis of the femoral heads.

Moderate amount of joint effusion in the right hip; non-significant joint effusion in the left hip.

Focal area of bone marrow edema on the anterior aspect of the right sacral ala on the sacroiliac joint side. Sclerosis phenomena of the sacroiliac joints, particularly on the left.

Signs of peritrochanteric enthesitis of the gluteus medius muscles bilaterally.

The remaining musculoskeletal structures of the pelvic girdle are normally represented.

report:
RM GINOCCHIO SINISTRO
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: gonalgia sul versante esterno. Non riferisce traumi.
Sequenze: assiali TSE T1 e PD Fat Sat, sagittali TSE PD e PD Fat Sat, coronale TSE PD Fat Sat.
Si segnala la presenza di alcune aree di edema osseo intraspongioso a carico del condilo femorale mediale, sul versante anteriore, del condilo femorale laterale, sul versante posteriore, e dell’emipiatto tibiale esterno, sul versante anteriore, queste ultime piu' sfumate; si consiglia inquadramento ortopedico (non riferita distorsione? fenomeni algodistrofici?).
Fibrocartilagini meniscali di regolare morfologia, spessore e segnale, senza segni di lesione.
Legamenti crociati e collaterali integri, di regolare calibro e decorso.
Le cartilagini di rivestimento femoro-tibiali presentano profilo, spessore e intensità di segnale regolari.
La rotula è in asse, senza segni di condropatia femoro-rotulea.
Regolare spessore e segnale del tendine rotuleo.
Minimo film fluido intra-articolare.
translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

Indication and clinical notes: pain on the outer side of the knee. No history of trauma reported.

Sequences: axial TSE T1 and PD Fat Sat, sagittal TSE PD and PD Fat Sat, coronal TSE PD Fat Sat.

There are some areas of bone marrow edema noted in the medial femoral condyle on the anterior side, the lateral femoral condyle on the posterior side, and the external tibial plateau on the anterior side, with the latter being more subtle. An orthopedic evaluation is recommended (no reported distortion? algodystrophic phenomena?).

The meniscal fibrocartilages are of normal shape, thickness, and signal, with no signs of tears.

The cruciate and collateral ligaments are intact, with normal thickness and course.

The femorotibial cartilage shows normal contour, thickness, and signal intensity.

The patella is well-aligned, with no signs of femoropatellar chondropathy.

The patellar tendon has normal thickness and signal.

There is a minimal amount of intra-articular fluid.

report:
RM GINOCCHIO SINISTRO
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: gonalgia in assenza di trauma.
Sequenze: assiali TSE T1 e PD Fat Sat, sagittali TSE PD e PD Fat Sat, coronale TSE PD Fat Sat.
Tenue imbibizione edematosa del cellulare adiposo sottocutaneo pre-rotuleo.
Sottile falda fluida intrarticolare, con piccola quota fluida anche posteriormente all'inserzione tibiale del tendine rotuleo.
Stria di lesione longitudinale del corno posteriore del menisco esterno.
Non sono evidenti lesioni del menisco interno.
Iniziali segni di denenerazione mucoide del legamento crociato anteriore.
Segni di infiammazione dei fasci profondi del legamento collaterale mediale al tratto medio-prossimale; concomita la presenza di due subcentimetriche formazioni ipointense in T1 e T2 subito lateralmente all’inserzione femorale del collaterale mediale, di verosimile natura calcifica.
Restanti strutture legamentose di regolare calibro e decorso.
Lievemente assottigliato il rivestimento cartilagineo femoro-tibiale, con segni di condropatia.
Rotula in asse, con segni di condromalacia.
translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

Indication and clinical notes: knee pain without trauma.

Sequences: axial TSE T1 and PD Fat Sat, sagittal TSE PD and PD Fat Sat, coronal TSE PD Fat Sat.

Mild edema in the pre-patellar subcutaneous fat tissue.

Thin joint effusion, with a small amount of fluid also present posterior to the tibial insertion of the patellar tendon.

Longitudinal tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.

No evident lesions of the medial meniscus.

Early signs of mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.

Signs of inflammation in the deep fibers of the medial collateral ligament at the mid-proximal segment; accompanied by the presence of two subcentimeter hypointense formations on T1 and T2 just lateral to the femoral insertion of the medial collateral ligament, likely calcific in nature.

Remaining ligamentous structures are of normal caliber and course.

Slight thinning of the femorotibial cartilage, with signs of chondropathy.

Patella is aligned, with signs of chondromalacia.

report:
RM GINOCCHIO SINISTRO
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: gonalgia sul versante laterale. No trauma.
Sequenze: assiali TSE T1 e PD Fat Sat, sagittali TSE PD e PD Fat Sat, coronale TSE PD Fat Sat.
Fibrocartilagini meniscali di regolare morfologia, spessore e segnale, senza segni di lesione.
Legamenti crociati e collaterali integri, di regolare calibro e decorso.
Le cartilagini di rivestimento femoro-tibiali presentano profilo, spessore e intensità di segnale regolari.
I capi articolari femoro-tibiali presentano trofismo scheletrico conservato.
La rotula è in asse, con segni di condropatia femoro-rotulea di grado moderato.
Regolare spessore e segnale del tendine rotuleo.
Non significativo versamento intra-articolare.
translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

Indication and clinical notes: lateral knee pain. No trauma.

Sequences: axial TSE T1 and PD Fat Sat, sagittal TSE PD and PD Fat Sat, coronal TSE PD Fat Sat.

The meniscal fibrocartilages are of normal shape, thickness, and signal, with no signs of tears.

The cruciate and collateral ligaments are intact, with normal caliber and course.

The femorotibial cartilage shows normal contour, thickness, and signal intensity.

The femorotibial joint surfaces have preserved skeletal trophism.

The patella is aligned, with moderate femoropatellar chondropathy.

The patellar tendon has normal thickness and signal.

No significant intra-articular effusion.

report:
RM CAVIGLIA SINISTRA
Indicazione e note anamnestiche: nota lesione osteocondrale del domo astragalico, con dolore ed instabilità. Visionato precedente analogo esterno.
Sequenze: assiali TSE T1, T2 e PD Fat Sat, sagittali TSE T1 e PD Fat Sat, coronale TSE STIR.
Nota lesione osteocondrale del domo astragalico sul versante mediale, con sovrapponibile edema della spongiosa ossea (che mostra un'estensione di circa 18mm); lieve reazione sinoviale di pari livello.
Non evidenzia alterazioni delle componenti legamentose periastragaliche, che conservano spessore e intensità di segnale nei limiti della normalità, con continuità conservata.
Le strutture legamentose del seno del tarso conservano regolare aspetto RM.
Le strutture muscolo-tendinee esaminate sono nei limiti della normalità.
Osso navicolare accessorio.
translation:
MRI LEFT ANKLE

Indication and clinical notes: Known osteochondral lesion of the talar dome, with pain and instability. Previous similar external imaging reviewed.

Sequences: Axial TSE T1, T2, and PD Fat Sat, sagittal TSE T1 and PD Fat Sat, coronal TSE STIR.

Findings: There is a noted osteochondral lesion on the medial aspect of the talar dome, with associated bone marrow edema extending approximately 18mm. There is a mild synovial reaction at the same level.

No abnormalities are observed in the peritalar ligamentous components, which maintain normal thickness and signal intensity, with preserved continuity.

The ligamentous structures of the sinus tarsi appear normal on MRI.

The examined musculoskeletal and tendinous structures are within normal limits.

Accessory navicular bone.

report:
Indicazione: PSA elevato.
Preparazione dell’esame: premedicazione con spasmolitico (Buscopan) i.m.
Tecnica di acquisizione: magnete 1.5 T con bobina phased-array; sequenze morfologiche FSE
T2 ad alta risoluzione nei tre piani a livello della loggia prostatica, sequenza FSE T2 assiale
panoramica addomino-pelvica, studio di Diffusione assiale, sequenza Dinamica di perfusione
LAVA 3D T1 Fat Sat multifasica assiale prima, durante e dopo somministrazione di mdc ev.
Descrizione: Prostata di volume aumentato (60ml; PSA density: 0.18).
Ipertrofia adenomatosa multinodulare della zona transizionale e retrouretrale che aggetta
parzialmente in vescica, senza evidenza di alterazioni focali sospette per malattia prostatica
clinicamente significativa a tale livello (PI-RADS score 2).
A carico della zona periferica in sede apicale posteriore destra, si segnala la presenza di
un'area pseudonodulare (dmax circa 16mm) caratterizzata da basso segnale in T2, iperintensa
in DWI a b-value elevati ed ipointensa nella mappa di ADC con precoce enhancement focale
allo studio dinamico di perfusione (PI-RADS score 5); tale area mostra ampia superficie di
contatto con la capsula, il cui profilo appare bozzuto.
Vescichette seminali di dimensioni nei limiti e segnale conservato.
Vescica moderatamente distesa, a pareti lievemente ispessite, con pseudodiverticoli e
contenuto omogeneo.
Alcuni elementi linfonodali in sede iliaca e otturatoria bilaterale (asse corto <1 cm).
Conclusioni: voluminosa area pseudonodulare PI-RADS score 5 (alta probabilità di neoplasia
prostatica maligna clinicamente significativa) a carico della zona periferica medio-basale sinistra
che mostra segni di estensione extracapsulare (dubbio interessamente della vescichetta
seminale omolaterale).
translation:
Indication: Elevated PSA.

Exam Preparation: Premedication with antispasmodic (Buscopan) intramuscularly.

Acquisition Technique: 1.5 T magnet with phased-array coil; high-resolution FSE T2 morphological sequences in three planes at the level of the prostate, panoramic axial FSE T2 sequence of the abdomen and pelvis, axial Diffusion study, multiphasic axial LAVA 3D T1 Fat Sat perfusion sequence before, during, and after intravenous contrast administration.

Description: Enlarged prostate (60ml; PSA density: 0.18). Multinodular adenomatous hypertrophy of the transitional and retrourethral zone partially protruding into the bladder, without evidence of focal alterations suspicious for clinically significant prostate disease at this level (PI-RADS score 2). In the peripheral zone at the right posterior apex, there is a pseudonodular area (maximum diameter approximately 16mm) characterized by low T2 signal, hyperintense on DWI at high b-values, and hypointense on the ADC map with early focal enhancement on dynamic perfusion study (PI-RADS score 5); this area shows a broad contact surface with the capsule, which appears bulging.

Seminal vesicles are within normal size limits and signal is preserved. Bladder is moderately distended, with slightly thickened walls, pseudodiverticula, and homogeneous content. Some lymph nodes are present in the iliac and obturator regions bilaterally (short axis <1 cm).

Conclusions: Large pseudonodular area with a PI-RADS score of 5 (high probability of clinically significant malignant prostate neoplasm) in the left mid-basal peripheral zone showing signs of extracapsular extension (possible involvement of the ipsilateral seminal vesicle).

report:
Anamnesi: controllo adenocarcinoma prostatico trattato con radioterapia.
Preparazione dell’esame: premedicazione con spasmolitico (Buscopan) i.m.
Tecnica di acquisizione: magnete 3T con bobina phased-array multicanale; sequenze morfologiche TSE T2 ad alta risoluzione nei tre piani a livello della loggia prostatica, sequenza
TSE T2 assiale panoramica addomino-pelvica, sequenze di Diffusione sul piano assiale, sequenza Dinamica di perfusione Vibe 3D T1 Fat Sat multifasica assiale prima, durante e dopo
somministrazione di mdc ev.
Descrizione: vescica distesa, a pareti lievemente ispessite, con alcune estroflessioni diverticolari di parete. Prostata di volume ridotto rispetto al precedente (ml), con modica ipertrofia adenomatosa
multinodulare della zona transizionale che impronta il pavimento vescicale. La zona periferica appare diffusamente e marcatamente disomogenea e di basso segnale in T2, con scarsa distinzione tra ghiandola centrale e periferica per postumi di terapia radiante. Lo studio DWI mostra disomogeneo incremento del segnale a "valori di b elevati" senza definite alterazioni focali a diffusività ristretta nella mappa di ADC.
Lo studio dinamico di perfusione non mostra alterazioni focali dell'impregnazione. Moderatamente imbibito il cellulare adiposo dello scavo pelvico. Vescicole seminali in involuzione. Sovrapponibili elementi linfonodali in sede iliaca ed otturatoria bilaterale (asse corto <1 cm).
Conclusioni: postumi di radioterapia, senza definite alterazioni focali, da correlare alla variazione dei marcatori biochimici.
translation:
History: Follow-up for prostate adenocarcinoma treated with radiotherapy.  
Exam Preparation: Premedication with antispasmodic (Buscopan) administered intramuscularly.  
Acquisition Technique: 3T magnet with a multichannel phased-array coil; high-resolution T2 TSE morphological sequences in three planes at the level of the prostate bed, axial panoramic T2 TSE abdominopelvic sequence, Diffusion sequences on the axial plane, 3D T1 Fat Sat Vibe multiphasic dynamic perfusion sequence axially before, during, and after intravenous contrast administration.  
Description: The bladder is distended, with slightly thickened walls and some diverticular outpouchings. The prostate is reduced in volume compared to the previous exam (ml), with mild multinodular adenomatous hypertrophy of the transitional zone impacting the bladder floor. The peripheral zone appears diffusely and markedly heterogeneous with low T2 signal, with poor distinction between central and peripheral gland due to post-radiation therapy effects. The DWI study shows a heterogeneous increase in signal at "high b-values" without definite focal alterations with restricted diffusion on the ADC map. The dynamic perfusion study does not show focal enhancement alterations. The pelvic fat tissue is moderately imbibed. Seminal vesicles are regressing. Lymph nodes in the iliac and obturator regions are comparable bilaterally (short axis <1 cm).  
Conclusions: Post-radiotherapy changes, without definite focal alterations, to be correlated with changes in biochemical markers.

report:
Indicazione: PSA elevato.
Preparazione dell’esame: premedicazione con spasmolitico (Buscopan) i.m.
Tecnica di acquisizione: magnete 3T con bobina phased-array multicanale; sequenze morfologiche TSE T2 ad alta risoluzione nei tre piani a livello della loggia prostatica, sequenza TSE T2 assiale panoramica addomino-pelvica, sequenze di Diffusione sul piano assiale, sequenza Dinamica di perfusione Vibe 3D T1 Fat Sat multifasica assiale prima, durante e dopo somministrazione di mdc ev.
Descrizione: Prostata di volume aumentato (80 ml; PSA density: 0.11).
Ipertrofia adenomatosa multinodulare della zona transizionale e retrouretrale che aggetta parzialmente in vescica, senza evidenza di alterazioni focali sospette per malattia prostatica clinicamente significativa a tale livello (PI-RADS score 2).
La zona periferica appare disomogenea in T2, con evidenza in entrambi i lobi di alcune strie e bande ipointense in T2 con modesta restrizione della diffusività, compatibili in relazione alla morfologia con esiti prostatitici (PI-RADS score 2); lo studio dinamico di perfusione non mostra patologiche alterazioni dell'impregnazione nella zona periferica.
Profilo capsulare regolare con conservata rappresentazione dell'adiposo peri-prostatico.
Vescicole seminali di volume nei limiti e segnale omogeneo.
Vescica moderatamente distesa, a pareti lievemente ispessite e contenuto omogeneo.
Alcuni elementi linfonodali in sede iliaca ed otturatoria bilaterale (asse corto <1 cm).
Conclusioni: non sono evidenti focali aree con caratteristiche RM di neoplasia prostatica clinicamente significativa (PI-RADS score 2), ma il reperto va correlato al dato clinico e biochimico.
translation:
Indication: Elevated PSA.

Exam Preparation: Premedication with antispasmodic (Buscopan) intramuscularly.

Acquisition Technique: 3T magnet with multichannel phased-array coil; high-resolution T2 TSE morphological sequences in three planes at the level of the prostate, panoramic axial T2 TSE abdominopelvic sequence, Diffusion sequences on the axial plane, multiphasic axial 3D T1 Fat Sat Vibe Dynamic perfusion sequence before, during, and after intravenous contrast administration.

Description: Enlarged prostate volume (80 ml; PSA density: 0.11). Multinodular adenomatous hypertrophy of the transitional and retrourethral zone partially protruding into the bladder, without evidence of focal alterations suspicious for clinically significant prostate disease at this level (PI-RADS score 2). The peripheral zone appears heterogeneous on T2, with evidence in both lobes of some T2 hypointense streaks and bands with mild diffusion restriction, morphologically compatible with post-inflammatory changes (PI-RADS score 2); the dynamic perfusion study shows no pathological enhancement alterations in the peripheral zone. Regular capsular profile with preserved representation of periprostatic fat. Seminal vesicles are within normal volume limits and show homogeneous signal. Bladder is moderately distended, with slightly thickened walls and homogeneous content. Some lymph nodes are present in the iliac and obturator regions bilaterally (short axis <1 cm).

Conclusions: No focal areas with MRI characteristics of clinically significant prostate neoplasia are evident (PI-RADS score 2), but the findings should be correlated with clinical and biochemical data.

report: Esame TC dell'encefalo eseguito senza somministrazione e.v. di m.d.c. Non evidenza di aree di alterata densità a carico del parenchima cerebrale. Sistema ventricolare sovratentoriale in asse, di ampiezza regolare. IV ventricolo sulla linea mediana, di dimensioni nei limiti. Nei limiti per l'età gli spazi liquorali periencefalici.
translation: CT scan of the brain performed without intravenous contrast administration. No areas of altered density observed in the cerebral parenchyma. The supratentorial ventricular system is aligned and of regular wiRXh. The fourth ventricle is midline and within normal size limits. The periencephalic cerebrospinal fluid spaces are within normal limits for the patient's age.

report: Esame TC dell'encefalo eseguito senza somministrazione e.v. di m.d.c. Ipodensità della sostanza bianca biemisferica, riferibile a sofferenza ipoperfusiva cronica. Concomitano areole di ipodensità a sede nucleo-capsulare bilaterale, compatibili con esiti ischemici o spazi perivascolari ectasici. Sistema ventricolare sovratentoriale in asse, di ampiezza modicamente aumentata. IV ventricolo sulla linea mediana, di dimensioni nei limiti. Ampi gli spazi liquorali periencefalici.
translation: CT scan of the brain performed without intravenous contrast administration. Hypodensity of the bihemispheric white matter, suggestive of chronic hypoperfusion injury. There are also areas of hypodensity in the bilateral nucleus-capsular region, compatible with ischemic changes or ectatic perivascular spaces. The supratentorial ventricular system is midline, with moderately increased size. The fourth ventricle is midline and within normal size limits. The periencephalic cerebrospinal fluid spaces are enlarged.

report: Esame RM dell'encefalo eseguito prima e dopo somministrazione e.v. di m.d.c. Lesione espansiva in sede frontale destra (35x11 mm) con associato edema perilesionale che determina modesto effetto massa con compressione del ventricolo frontale omolaterale. La suddetta lesione presenta enhancement di m.d.c. e restrizione della diffusione isotropica dell’acqua. Tale reperto è sospetto per secondarismo, utile valutazione specialistica. Restante sistema ventricolare sovratentoriale in asse, di ampiezza regolare. IV ventricolo sulla linea mediana, di dimensioni nei limiti. Nei limiti per l'età i restanti spazi liquorali periencefalici.
translation: MRI of the brain was performed before and after intravenous administration of contrast material. There is an expansive lesion in the right frontal region (35x11 mm) with associated perilesional edema, causing a mild mass effect with compression of the ipsilateral frontal ventricle. The lesion shows contrast enhancement and restricted isotropic water diffusion. This finding is suspicious for metastasis, and specialist evaluation is recommended. The remaining supratentorial ventricular system is midline and of regular size. The fourth ventricle is midline and within normal limits. The remaining periencephalic cerebrospinal fluid spaces are within age-appropriate limits.

report: L'esame RM del massiccio facciale è stato eseguito con sequenze TSE T2 sui piani assiali e coronali, TSE T2 STIR sui piani assiali e coronali, SE T1 assiale. Ispessimento della mucosa di entrambi i seni mascellari, più evidente a livello del pavimento e della parete posteriore, del seno sfenoidale e delle cellette etmoidali posteriori. Regolare morfologia e segnale delle strutture endo-orbitarie bilateralmente. Laterodeviazione destro-convessa del setto nasale con sperone osseo controlaterale, che riduce l'ampiezza della cavità nasale. Non evidenza di lesioni ossee focali.
translation: The MRI examination of the facial mass was performed using TSE T2 sequences on axial and coronal planes, TSE T2 STIR on axial and coronal planes, and SE T1 axial. There is mucosal thickening in both maxillary sinuses, more pronounced at the floor and posterior wall, as well as in the sphenoid sinus and posterior ethmoid air cells. The morphology and signal of the intraorbital structures are normal bilaterally. There is a right-convex deviation of the nasal septum with a contralateral bony spur, which reduces the wiRXh of the nasal cavity. No evidence of focal bone lesions.

report: Esame eseguito senza m.d.c. e.v. Non evidenza di alterazioni tomodensitometriche a carico del parenchima polmonare da ambo i lati. Non evidenza di versamento pleurico. Trachea e bronchi principali pervi. Cuore di volumetria nei limiti; non evidenza di versamento pericardico. Non apprezzabili, nei limiti risolutivi della metodica, significative tumefazioni linfonodali in sede mediastinica.
translation: Exam performed without intravenous contrast. No evidence of tomodensitometric alterations in the lung parenchyma on either side. No evidence of pleural effusion. Trachea and main bronchi are patent. Heart size is within normal limits; no evidence of pericardial effusion. No appreciable significant lymph node enlargement in the mediastinal region, within the resolution limits of the method.

report: Esame eseguito senza m.d.c. e.v. Cospicuo versamento pleurico apico-parieto-basale a destra (spessore massimo 84 mm) con compressione e addensamento del parenchima polmonare adiacente. A sinistra, il polmone è regolarmente espanso con evidenza di alterazioni fibro-disventilatorie in sede basale. Trachea e bronchi principali pervi. Cuore di volumetria nei limiti; modesto versamento pericardico (8 mm). Apprezzabili multiple tumefazioni linfonodali (dimensioni max asse corto <10 mm) in sede mediastinica.
translation: Exam performed without intravenous contrast. Significant right apico-parieto-basal pleural effusion (maximum thickness 84 mm) with compression and consolidation of the adjacent lung parenchyma. On the left, the lung is normally expanded with evidence of fibrotic and ventilatory changes at the base. Trachea and main bronchi are patent. Heart size is within normal limits; mild pericardial effusion (8 mm). Multiple lymph node enlargements are noted in the mediastinal region (maximum short-axis dimension <10 mm).

report: Apprezzabili livelli idro-aerei a carico dell’intestino tenue distale, con ridotta rappresentazione del meteorismo intestinale a valle, come da sospetta occlusione. Ampolla rettale abitata da gas. Non evidente aria libera in sede sottodiaframmatica.
translation: Appreciable air-fluid levels are present in the distal small intestine, with reduced representation of intestinal gas downstream, suggestive of a suspected obstruction. The rectal ampulla contains gas. No free air is evident under the diaphragm.

report: Accentuazione della trama interstiziale. Area di opacità nodulare (circa 10 mm) proiettantesi in medio campo polmonare a sinistra, utile integrazione TC. Profilo diaframmatico regolare con seni costo-frenici normoespansi. Marginali mediastiniche regolari. Ateromasia calcifica aortica.
translation: Increased interstitial markings. A nodular opacity (approximately 10 mm) is projected in the mid-left lung field, further evaluation with CT is recommended. The diaphragmatic contour is regular with normally expanded costophrenic angles. The mediastinal margins are regular. Calcified aortic atherosclerosis.

report: Tiroide in sede anatomica, di dimensioni conservate. L'ecostruttura ghiandolare risulta disomogenea per la presenza di una nodulazione al terzo inferiore del lobo destro. Tale formazione (24x12 mm) presenta struttura mista con aspetto spongiforme, in assenza di vascolarizzazione intra-lesionale al color-Doppler. Vettore tracheale in asse. Spazi latero cervicali liberi da linfoadenomegalie in atto.
translation: Thyroid is in its anatomical position, with preserved dimensions. The glandular echotexture is heterogeneous due to the presence of a nodule in the lower third of the right lobe. This formation (24x12 mm) has a mixed structure with a spongiform appearance, with no intralesional vascularization on color Doppler. Tracheal axis is aligned. Lateral cervical spaces are free from current lymphadenopathy.

report: Esame eseguito con acquisizione volumetrica ed integrato da ricostruzioni multiplanari. Normale calibro e decorso dei condotti uditivi esterni. Obliterazione dell’orecchio medio di destra da tessuto isodenso. Analoga alterazione si apprezza a carico dell’antro e delle cellette mastoidee omolateralmente. Indenni il tegmen tympani, il tegmen antri ed il muro della loggetta. Tali reperti sono sospetti per processo flogistico, utile valutazione specialistica. Regolare pneumatizzazione del cavo del timpano sinistro. Catene ossiculari in sede e normoconformate. Regolare rappresentazione delle strutture del labirinto osseo cocleo-vestibolare bilateralmente. Normale calibro e decorso del canale del nervo faciale da ambo i lati. Regolare calibro e simmetria dei condotti uditivi interni. Regolare pneumatizzazione delle cellette mastoidee di sinistra.
translation: The examination was performed with volumetric acquisition and supplemented by multiplanar reconstructions. The external auditory canals are of normal caliber and course. There is obliteration of the right middle ear by isodense tissue. A similar alteration is noted in the antrum and mastoid air cells on the same side. The tegmen tympani, tegmen antri, and the wall of the epitympanic recess are intact. These findings are suspicious for an inflammatory process; a specialist evaluation is recommended. The left tympanic cavity shows normal pneumatization. The ossicular chains are in place and normally configured. The bony labyrinth structures of the cochlea and vestibule are well-represented bilaterally. The facial nerve canal is of normal caliber and course on both sides. The internal auditory canals are of regular caliber and symmetry. The mastoid air cells on the left are normally pneumatized.

report: Diffuso meteorismo colico. Fegato in sede di dimensioni conservate (DL Lobo destro: 136 mm) ad ecostruttura parenchimale diffusamente disomogenea senza apprezzabili alterazioni focali. Vie biliari intra ed extra epatiche non ectasiche. Asse spleno portale di calibro regolare. Vene sovraepatiche non dilatate. Colecisti di forma normale, a pareti non ispessite, in assenza di fango biliare e\o nuclei litiasici. Pancreas non visualizzato per meteorismo. Milza di dimensioni normali ad ecostruttura omogenea (DL: 123 mm). Reni in sede anatomica di dimensioni normali a margini regolari (DL destro: 122 mm; DL sinistro: 130 mm). Il rapporto cortico-midollare è nella norma per l’età. A sinistra, si apprezza ectasia dei calici, del bacinetto e del tratto esplorabile dell’uretere. In relazione alla clinica riferita dal paziente (dolore), utile integrazione TC per sospetta calcolosi. Assenza di segni da riferire a patologia ostruttiva a destra. Vescica ben distesa a pareti non ispessite. Prostata dimensioni conservate (volume stimato: 27 ml). Non evidenza di liquido libero in addome.
translation: Diffuse colonic gas. The liver is in its normal position with preserved size (right lobe length: 136 mm) and diffusely heterogeneous parenchymal echotexture without appreciable focal lesions. Intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The splenoportal axis has a regular caliber. Hepatic veins are not dilated. The gallbladder is of normal shape, with non-thickened walls, and there is no evidence of biliary sludge or gallstones. The pancreas is not visualized due to gas. The spleen is of normal size with a homogeneous echotexture (length: 123 mm). The kidneys are in their anatomical position with normal size and regular margins (right length: 122 mm; left length: 130 mm). The corticomedullary ratio is normal for the patient's age. On the left, there is dilation of the calyces, renal pelvis, and the visible portion of the ureter. Given the patient's reported symptoms (pain), a CT scan is recommended for suspected kidney stones. There are no signs of obstructive pathology on the right. The bladder is well distended with non-thickened walls. The prostate is of preserved size (estimated volume: 27 ml). No evidence of free fluid in the abdomen.

report: Riduzione della fisiologica lordosi cervicale in clinostatismo. Segni di artrosi interapofisaria con associati fenomeni degenerativi somatici. Conservata altezza dei somi vertebrali senza evidenza di alterazioni di segnale a carattere focale. Ridotto tono idrico dei dischi intersomatici. Agli spazi inclusi nel tratto C5-C7, si apprezza sfiancamento disco-artrosico circonferenziale che impronta lo spazio epidurale anteriore. Regolare spessore del midollo spinale. Conservata ampiezza del canale rachideo.
translation: Reduction of the normal cervical lordosis in the supine position. Signs of facet joint osteoarthritis with associated degenerative changes in the vertebral bodies. The height of the vertebral bodies is preserved without evidence of focal signal alterations. Reduced water content of the intervertebral discs. At the levels included in the C5-C7 segment, there is circumferential disc-arthrosis bulging that indents the anterior epidural space. The thickness of the spinal cord is normal. The wiRXh of the spinal canal is preserved.

report: Regolare cifosi dorsale in clinostatismo. Segni di artrosi interapofisaria con associati fenomeni degenerativi somatici. In particolare, si segnala nodulo di Schmorl alla limitante superiore di D10, con edema osseo circostante. Conservata altezza dei somi vertebrali senza evidenza di alterazioni di segnale a carattere focale. Conservato tono idrico dei dischi intersomatici. Conservata ampiezza del canale rachideo. Regolare spessore del midollo spinale.
translation: Normal dorsal kyphosis in the supine position. Signs of facet joint osteoarthritis with associated degenerative changes in the vertebral bodies. Notably, there is a Schmorl's node at the superior endplate of D10, with surrounding bone edema. The height of the vertebral bodies is preserved without evidence of focal signal alterations. The hydration of the intervertebral discs is maintained. The wiRXh of the spinal canal is preserved. The thickness of the spinal cord is normal.

report: Accentuazione della lordosi lombare in clinostatismo. Anterolistesi di L4 su L5, grado 2, con spondilolisi bilaterale. Tale alterazione determina ridotta ampiezza del canale rachideo e dei forami di coniugazione di pari livello. Segni di artrosi interapofisaria con associati fenomeni degenerativi somatici. Conservata altezza dei somi vertebrali senza evidenza di alterazioni di segnale a carattere focale. Ridotto tono idrico e sfiancamento dei dischi intersomatici, specie nel tratto L3-S1. Cono midollare in sede.
translation: In the supine position, there is an accentuation of the lumbar lordosis. There is grade 2 anterolisthesis of L4 over L5, with bilateral spondylolysis. This condition results in a reduced wiRXh of the spinal canal and the neural foramina at the same level. There are signs of facet joint osteoarthritis with associated degenerative changes in the vertebral bodies. The height of the vertebral bodies is preserved without evidence of focal signal alterations. There is decreased water content and bulging of the intervertebral discs, particularly in the L3-S1 segment. The conus medullaris is in its normal position.

report: Ridotta mineralizzazione dei segmenti ossei in esame. Riduzione della fisiologica lordosi lombare in clinostatismo. Segni di artrosi interapofisaria con associati fenomeni degenerativi somatici. Ridotta altezza dei somi L2 (<26%), L3 (>40%) e L5 (26-40%), come da cedimenti morfostrutturali in osteoporosi. Ridotta ampiezza degli spazi intersomatici, specie a livello L5-S1. Conservata ampiezza del canale rachideo.
translation: Reduced mineralization of the examined bone segments. Decreased physiological lumbar lordosis in the supine position. Signs of facet joint osteoarthritis with associated degenerative changes in the vertebral bodies. Reduced height of the vertebral bodies L2 (<26%), L3 (>40%), and L5 (26-40%), consistent with morphostructural collapse due to osteoporosis. Narrowed intervertebral spaces, particularly at the L5-S1 level. Preserved wiRXh of the spinal canal.

report: Prostata di volume globalmente aumentato (circa 88 ml) per ipertrofia adenomatosa del lobo medio che impronta il pavimento vescicale. Aspetto disomogeneo della zona transizionale da ambo i lati, con apprezzabilità di multipli noduli stromali (PI-RADS 2), senza chiare aree di restrizione della diffusione isotropica. Aspetto disomogeneo e compresso della zona periferica, con evidenza di area di focale restrizione della diffusione isotropica che presenta precoce enhancement dopo contrasto (PI-RADS 4). Tale lesione (dmax 12 mm) è localizzata in sede medio-ghiandolare posteriore destra. Regolare aspetto del profilo capsulare. Vescichette seminali nei limiti. Vescica parzialmente distesa, a contenuto di intensità di segnale omogenea. Non apprezzabili tumefazioni linfonodali sospette nello scavo pelvico.
translation: The prostate is globally enlarged (approximately 88 ml) due to adenomatous hypertrophy of the median lobe, which indents the bladder floor. The transitional zone appears heterogeneous on both sides, with multiple stromal nodules visible (PI-RADS 2), without clear areas of isotropic diffusion restriction. The peripheral zone appears heterogeneous and compressed, with evidence of a focal area of isotropic diffusion restriction that shows early enhancement after contrast (PI-RADS 4). This lesion (maximum diameter 12 mm) is located in the mid-glandular posterior right region. The capsular profile appears regular. Seminal vesicles are within normal limits. The bladder is partially distended, with homogeneously intense signal content. No suspicious lymph node enlargements are appreciable in the pelvic cavity.

report: Vescica ben distesa, a contenuto di intensità omogenea e pareti di spessore regolare. Utero in sede, anteroverso, di dimensioni nei limiti per l’età. Ispessimento endometriale a livello del fondo uterino (4 x 6 mm), con evidenza di impregnazione dopo contrasto e restrizione della diffusione isotropica. Non sono evidenti definite discontinuità della linea giunzionale. Conservata la fisiologica ipointensità della cervice uterina, senza evidenza di aree di alterata impregnazione. Regolare aspetto del parametrio e del grasso periviscerale. Non evidenza di formazioni espansive in sede annessiale bilateralmente. Non apprezzabili significative tumefazioni linfoghiandolari nelle stazioni visualizzabili. Assenza di falde fluide libere nello scavo pelvico.
translation: The bladder is well distended, with homogeneously intense contents and walls of regular thickness. The uterus is in its normal position, anteverted, and of size appropriate for age. There is endometrial thickening at the uterine fundus (4 x 6 mm), with evidence of enhancement after contrast and restriction of isotropic diffusion. No definite discontinuities of the junctional zone are evident. The physiological hypointensity of the uterine cervix is preserved, with no evidence of areas of altered enhancement. The appearance of the parametrium and perivisceral fat is normal. There is no evidence of mass formations in the adnexal regions bilaterally. No significant lymph node enlargements are appreciable in the visualized stations. There is no presence of free fluid in the pelvic cavity.

report: Artrosi acromion-claveare, con ridotta ampiezza dello spazio subacromiale. Borsite subacromiale e sottodeltoidea. Aspetto disomogeneo del tendine del sopraspinoso, con lesione completa in sede inserzionale e retrazione del moncone prossimale di circa 12 mm. Nei limiti della norma per segnale e morfologia i restanti tendini della cuffia dei rotatori. Conservato trofismo dei ventri muscolari della cuffia dei rotatori. Versamento fluido gleno-omerale. Non si apprezzano alterazioni del labbro glenoideo. Regolare morfologia e segnale del tendine del capo lungo del bicipite. Nei limiti della norma il cercine osseo glenoideo. Conservati i rapporti articolari gleno-omerali. Non evidenza di lesioni focali ossee.
translation: Acromioclavicular joint osteoarthritis with reduced subacromial space. Subacromial and subdeltoid bursitis. The supraspinatus tendon appears heterogeneous, with a full-thickness tear at the insertion site and retraction of the proximal stump by approximately 12 mm. The remaining rotator cuff tendons show normal signal and morphology. The muscle bellies of the rotator cuff maintain normal trophism. There is glenohumeral joint effusion. No abnormalities are noted in the glenoid labrum. The morphology and signal of the long head of the biceps tendon are normal. The glenoid bony rim is within normal limits. Glenohumeral joint relationships are preserved. No evidence of focal bone lesions.

report: Esame eseguito prima e dopo somministrazione di m.d.c. e.v. Fegato di volume nei limiti della norma, ad intensità di segnale diffusamente disomogenea. Apprezzabile lesione focale (18x12 mm) al VI segmento. Tale formazione presenta precoce enhancement in fase arteriosa con washout in fase portale e tardiva, come da HCC. Vie biliari intra ed extra-epatiche non dilatate. Colecisti in sede, distesa, a pareti regolari e contenuto di intensità omogenea. Tronco portale di calibro regolare, pervio. Milza di dimensioni nei limiti, con intensità di segnale omogenea. Pancreas morfo-volumetricamente nei limiti; dotto pancreatico principale non ectasico; conservata rappresentazione dei piani adiposi peripancreatici. Regolare morfologia e segnale dei surreni. Reni in sede, di dimensioni e struttura nei limiti, senza segni da riferire a stasi urinaria bilateralmente; conservata la funzionalità escretoria da ambo i lati. Non si apprezzano significative tumefazioni linfonodali nel tratto esplorato.
translation: Examination performed before and after intravenous contrast administration. The liver is of normal volume, with diffusely heterogeneous signal intensity. A focal lesion (18x12 mm) is noted in segment VI. This lesion shows early arterial phase enhancement with washout in the portal and delayed phases, consistent with HCC. Intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The gallbladder is in place, distended, with regular walls and homogenous content. The portal vein is of regular caliber and patent. The spleen is of normal size, with homogeneous signal intensity. The pancreas is normal in size and shape; the main pancreatic duct is not dilated; the peripancreatic fat planes are well-preserved. The adrenal glands have normal morphology and signal. The kidneys are in place, with normal size and structure, without signs of urinary stasis bilaterally; excretory function is preserved on both sides. No significant lymph node enlargement is appreciated in the explored area.

report: Alle scansioni precontrastografiche, si reperta ateromasia calcifica diffusa delle strutture vascolari arteriose in esame. Lo studio angio-TC degli arti inferiori ha mostrato bilateralmente: Regolare opacizzazione dell'arteria iliaca esterna, con decorso e calibro regolari. Regolare opacizzazione, calibro e decorso delle arterie femorali comuni e profonde. A destra, si apprezza occlusione completa del tratto distale dell’arteria femorale superficiale, con riabitazione da circoli collaterali a livello popliteo. A sinistra, regolare opacizzazione e decorso dell’arteria femorale superficiale, con minime irregolarità ateromasiche di parete che non determinano stenosi significative. Regolare opacizzazione, calibro e decorso dell'arteria poplitea. Regolare opacizzazione calibro e decorso dell'arteria tibiale anteriore, del tronco tibio-peroniero, dell'arteria tibiale posteriore ed interossea, apprezzabili sino alle scansioni più distali. Conservato trofismo delle strutture muscolari del tratto in esame.
translation: In the pre-contrast scans, there is diffuse calcific atheromatous disease of the arterial vascular structures under examination. The CT angiography of the lower limbs showed bilaterally: Normal opacification of the external iliac artery, with regular course and caliber. Normal opacification, caliber, and course of the common and deep femoral arteries. On the right, there is a complete occlusion of the distal segment of the superficial femoral artery, with revascularization through collateral circulation at the popliteal level. On the left, normal opacification and course of the superficial femoral artery, with minimal atheromatous wall irregularities that do not cause significant stenosis. Normal opacification, caliber, and course of the popliteal artery. Normal opacification, caliber, and course of the anterior tibial artery, the tibio-peroneal trunk, the posterior tibial artery, and the interosseous artery, appreciable up to the most distal scans. The trophism of the muscular structures in the examined area is preserved.

report:
Thorax:
Emphysematöse Lungengerüstveränderungen in zentrilobulärer Verteilung. Lungenparenchym allseits der Thoraxwand anliegend. Kein Nachweis suspekter intrapulmonaler Rundherde. Pathologisch vergrößerter Lymphknoten in der Regio 11R mit circa 1,4 cm KAD sowie 10R mit 1,2cm KAD. Weitere betonte Lymphknoten in multiplen mediastinalen Regionen allesamt unter 1 cm Kurzachsendurchmesser. 

Abdomen/Becken:
Leberparenchym scharf begrenzt. Hypodense Leberläsion im Segment II/IVa DD Zyste. Nieren mit seitensymmetrische Kontrastmittelanflutung. Milz nicht vergrößert. Raumforderung der linken Nebenniere mit einem Maximaldurchmesser von 3,1 cm und negativen Dichtewerten um circa -10, bildmorphologisch einem Adenom entsprechend. Kein Nachweis freier Flüssigkeit oder freier Luft. Sichelförmiger Thrombus distal des Abgangs der AMI mit Komprimierung des Aortenlumens. Nachweis einer circa 0,9 x 0,7 cm messenden Kontrastmittel Aussackung ebendort. Kein Nachweis pathologisch vergrößerter Lymphknoten infradiaphragmal.

Skelett:
Osteochondrose LWK 5/SWK 1. Fortgeschrittene degenerative Veränderungen der Wirbelsäule.

Beurteilung:
-Verdacht auf PAU der infrarenalen Aorta, unmittelbar distal des Abgangs der Arteria mesenterica inferior (tiefe 0,9 cm, Breite 0,7 cm).
-Pathologisch vergrößerte Lymphknoten in der Regio 11 und 10 R DD reaktiv. Ansonsten bildmorphologisch kein Hinweis auf eine infektiös/entzündliche Veränderung des Thorax sowie des Abdomens.
-Nebenbefundlich Raumforderung der linken Nebenniere mit einem Maximaldurchmesser von 3,1 cm und negativen hu Werten, vereinbar mit einem Nebennierenadenom.
translation:
Chest:
Emphysematous changes in the lung structure with a centrilobular distribution. Lung parenchyma is adjacent to the thoracic wall throughout. No evidence of suspicious intrapulmonary nodules. Pathologically enlarged lymph nodes in region 11R measuring approximately 1.4 cm in short-axis diameter and 10R measuring 1.2 cm in short-axis diameter. Additional prominent lymph nodes in multiple mediastinal regions, all measuring less than 1 cm in short-axis diameter.

Abdomen/Pelvis:
Liver parenchyma is well-defined. Hypodense liver lesion in segment II/IVa, differential diagnosis includes a cyst. Kidneys show symmetrical contrast enhancement. Spleen is not enlarged. Mass in the left adrenal gland with a maximum diameter of 3.1 cm and negative density values around -10, morphologically consistent with an adenoma. No evidence of free fluid or free air. Crescent-shaped thrombus distal to the origin of the inferior mesenteric artery with compression of the aortic lumen. Evidence of a contrast-enhanced outpouching measuring approximately 0.9 x 0.7 cm at the same location. No evidence of pathologically enlarged lymph nodes below the diaphragm.

Skeleton:
Osteochondrosis at L5/S1. Advanced degenerative changes of the spine.

Impression:
-Suspected penetrating aortic ulcer (PAU) of the infrarenal aorta, immediately distal to the origin of the inferior mesenteric artery (depth 0.9 cm, wiRXh 0.7 cm).
-Pathologically enlarged lymph nodes in regions 11 and 10 R, differential diagnosis includes reactive changes. Otherwise, no imaging evidence of infectious/inflammatory changes in the chest or abdomen.
-Incidental finding of a mass in the left adrenal gland with a maximum diameter of 3.1 cm and negative Hounsfield unit values, consistent with an adrenal adenoma.

report:
Befund:
Zustand nach Schrittmacherimplantation, das Aggregat linkspektoral, die Sonden in Projektion auf den rechten Vorhof und Ventrikel. Kein Nachweis eines Pneumothorax. Randwinkel beidseits frei einsehbar. Kein Nachweis eines frischen, entzündlichen Infiltrates. Zustand nach Mitral-Clipping. Das obere Mediastinum ist schmal, die Trachea ist mittelständig und frei. Herz nicht vitientypisch geformt und nicht vergrößert. Aortensklerose. Degenerative Veränderungen der BWS.

Beurteilung:
Zustand nach Schrittmacherimplantation linkspektoral, die Sonden in Projektion auf den rechten Vorhof und Ventrikel. Kein Nachweis eines Pneumothorax. Kein Pleuraerguss.
translation:
Findings:  
Status post pacemaker implantation, with the device located in the left pectoral region and leads projecting into the right atrium and ventricle. No evidence of pneumothorax. Costophrenic angles are clear on both sides. No evidence of a new inflammatory infiltrate. Status post mitral clipping. The upper mediastinum is narrow, and the trachea is midline and unobstructed. The heart is not abnormally shaped and is not enlarged. Aortic sclerosis is present. Degenerative changes in the thoracic spine.

Conclusion:  
Status post pacemaker implantation in the left pectoral region, with leads projecting into the right atrium and ventricle. No evidence of pneumothorax. No pleural effusion.

report:
Befund:
Z.n. Anlage eines Fixateur externe, bei komplexer Unterschenkelfraktur rechtsseitig. Unveränderte Stellungsverhältnisse, bei schwer dislozierter mehrfragmentärer Fraktur der distalen Tibia, unter Beteiligung der Dia-, Meta- und Epiphyse sowie  dislozierter Fraktur. der distalen Fibuladiaphyse. Kein Nachweis einer sekundären Dislokation. Kein Nachweis einer sekundären Fraktur, soweit projektionsradiographisch beurteilbar.

Beurteilung:
Soweit projektionsradiografisch beurteilbar, weitestgehend unveränderte Stellungsverhältnisse, bei Zustand nach Anlage eines Fixateur externe, bei komplexer Unterschenkelfraktur rechtsseitig.
translation:
Findings:  
Status post application of an external fixator for a complex fracture of the right lower leg. The alignment remains unchanged in the presence of a severely displaced, comminuted fracture of the distal tibia involving the diaphysis, metaphysis, and epiphysis, as well as a displaced fracture of the distal fibular diaphysis. No evidence of secondary displacement. No evidence of a secondary fracture, as far as can be assessed radiographically.

Assessment:  
As far as can be assessed radiographically, the alignment remains largely unchanged following the application of an external fixator for a complex fracture of the right lower leg.

report:
Befund: Eingeschränkte Beurteilbarkeit bei aufliegenden Extremitäten mit entsprechenden Aufhärtungsartefakten. Multiple Verkalkungen des Brust Parenchyms beidseits. Schmalsaumiger Pleuraerguss beidseits.  Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung der basalen Lungenabschnitte. Leberparenchym scharf begrenzt. Milz nicht vergrößert.  rechtsseitiger Harnstau Grad 2 mit erweitertem Ureter  auf circa 1,4 cm. Im Kreuzungsbereich der Arteria illiaca communis zeigt sich in Kontinuität des Ureterverlaufs ein circa 5 mm messendes Konkrement. Bei letztlich unübersichtlichen Verhältnissen ist eine intraluminale Lage nicht zu bestätigen. Große Hiatushernie. Divertikulose des gesamten Kolonrahmens mit diskreter perikolische Imbibierung um das Colon ascendens. Ausgedehnte Verkalkung der Arteria splenica. Einliegender DK. Deckplattenimpressionsfraktur von  LWK 5, mit Ausläufer in das Bandscheibenfach. Zystische Veränderungen im tendinösen Anteil des rechten M. iliopsoas.

Beurteilung:
-Rechtsseitiger Harnstau Grad II mit Erweitetung des Ureters und ca. 5mm messenden Konkrement, mutmaßlich im mittleren Ureter.
-Bild einer unkomplizierten Divertikulitis im Colon ascendens, bei Divertikulose des gesamten Kolonrahmens.
-Gering dislozierte Wirbelkörperfraktur von LWK 5, ohne Nachweis einer Hinterkantenbeteiligung.
translation:
Findings: Limited assessability due to overlying extremities with corresponding hardening artifacts. Multiple calcifications in the breast parenchyma on both sides. Narrow pleural effusion on both sides. Otherwise, the basal lung sections appear unremarkable. Liver parenchyma is sharply defined. Spleen is not enlarged. Right-sided hydronephrosis Grade 2 with ureteral dilation to approximately 1.4 cm. At the crossing area of the common iliac artery, there is a stone measuring approximately 5 mm in the course of the ureter. Due to ultimately unclear conditions, an intraluminal position cannot be confirmed. Large hiatal hernia. Diverticulosis of the entire colon frame with slight pericolic imbibition around the ascending colon. Extensive calcification of the splenic artery. Indwelling catheter. Compression fracture of the L5 vertebral body, extending into the disc space. Cystic changes in the tendinous part of the right iliopsoas muscle.

Impression:
- Right-sided hydronephrosis Grade II with ureteral dilation and an approximately 5 mm stone, presumably in the mid-ureter.
- Imaging consistent with uncomplicated diverticulitis in the ascending colon, with diverticulosis of the entire colon frame.
- Slightly displaced vertebral fracture of L5, without evidence of posterior involvement.

report:
Befund:
Sonographisch minimales residuelles Drüsengewebe nach prophylaktischer Mastektomie mit subpektoraler Implantateinlage beidseits (2016). Kein Hinweis auf eine Implantatruptur bei geringer Faltenbildung beidseits. Kein Nachweis solider suspekter Herdbefunde. Keine suspekte axilläre Lymphadenopathie.
Beurteilung:
Kein Anhalt für Malignität nach prophylaktischer subkutaner Mastektomie mit subpektoraler Implantateinlage beidseits.
translation:
Findings:  
Ultrasound shows minimal residual glandular tissue following prophylactic mastectomy with subpectoral implant placement on both sides (2016). No evidence of implant rupture, with only minor folding on both sides. No solid suspicious lesions detected. No suspicious axillary lymphadenopathy.

Conclusion:  
No indication of malignancy following prophylactic subcutaneous mastectomy with subpectoral implant placement on both sides.

report:
Befund:
Mammographisch inhomogen dichtes Brustgewebe beidseits. Kein Nachweis eines suspekten Herdbefundes. Keine suspekten Mikroverkalkungen. Vereinzelte Mikrokalke beidseits. Streifige Verdichtung und Architekturstörung links oben außen, DD Narbenregion.

Beurteilung:
Kein Anhalt für ein Rezidiv oder kontralaterales Zweitkarzinom.
translation:
Findings:
Mammography shows heterogeneously dense breast tissue on both sides. No evidence of any suspicious mass. No suspicious microcalcifications. Scattered microcalcifications are present on both sides. There is a streaky density and architectural distortion in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast, differential diagnosis includes scar tissue.

Conclusion:
No indication of recurrence or contralateral second primary carcinoma.

report:
Befund:
Erweiterte innere und äußere Liquorräume. Kein Nachweis blutungssuspekter Hyperdensitäten oder frisch imponierender hypodenser Areale. Foramen magnum basale Zisternen frei einsehbar. Erhaltene Mark-Rinden-Differenzierung. Plexus sowie Pinealiskalk. Kein Nachweis einer Fraktur der Schädelkalotte. Lobulierte Osteolyse median okzipital mit erhaltene Tabula externa DD arachnoide Granulation. Kyphotische Stellung der Halswirbelsäule. Moderate degenerative Veränderungen. Eingeschränkte Beurteilbarkeit bei einliegenden Zahnimplantaten mit entsprechenden Aufhärtungsartefakten. Regelrechte Zahnokklusion soweit beurteilbar. Gering dislozierte Nasenbeinfraktur linksseitig. Struma nodosa.

Beurteilung:
-Kein Nachweis einer intrakraniellen Blutung.
-Gering dislozierte Nasenbeinfraktur linksseitig.
translation:
Findings:  
There is an enlargement of the internal and external cerebrospinal fluid spaces. No evidence of hyperdense areas suggestive of bleeding or newly appearing hypodense regions. The basal cisterns at the foramen magnum are clearly visible. The differentiation between white and gray matter is preserved. There is calcification of the choroid plexus and pineal gland. No evidence of a skull cap fracture. There is a lobulated osteolytic lesion in the mid-occipital region with an intact outer table, differential diagnosis includes arachnoid granulation. The cervical spine shows a kyphotic alignment with moderate degenerative changes. Assessment is limited due to dental implants causing corresponding hardening artifacts. Dental occlusion appears normal as far as can be assessed. There is a slightly displaced fracture of the left nasal bone. Nodular goiter is present.

Conclusion:  
-No evidence of intracranial bleeding.  
-Slightly displaced fracture of the left nasal bone.

report:
Befund:
Achsgerechte Stellungsverhältnisse der abgebildeten Gelenke. Moderate degenerative Veränderungen im PIP und DIP mit basoapikal zunehmenden Gradienten. Kein Nachweis einer Fraktur. Unauffälliger Weichteilmantel.

Beurteilung:
Moderate degenerative Veränderungen im PIP und DIP mit basoapikal zunehmenden Gradienten.
translation:
Findings:
The joints depicted show normal alignment. There are moderate degenerative changes in the PIP and DIP joints, with a gradient increasing from base to apex. No evidence of fracture. The soft tissue envelope appears unremarkable.

Conclusion:
Moderate degenerative changes in the PIP and DIP joints, with a gradient increasing from base to apex.

report:
Befund:
Sonographisch kräftig aufgebautes sowie stark vaskularisiertes Drüsengewebe, bei laktierender Mamma, als physiologisch zu werten. Konstant zur Voruntersuchung zeigt sich die kleinste Zyste links oben mittig. Etwas rückläufig der echoarme, glatt berandete Herdbefund links oben außen von 3mm auf 1-2mm. Neu zur Voruntersuchung mamillennahe glatt berandete Herdbefunde mit dorsaler Schallverstärkung rechts auf 9 uhr mit einem max. DM von 7mm sowie links auf 11 Uhr mit einem max. DM von 6mm. Kein Nachweis neu aufgetretener solider suspekter Herdbefunde. Keine suspekte axilläre Lymphadenopathie.
Beurteilung:
Kein Anhalt auf Malignität. Neu zur Voruntersuchung bilaterale mamillennahe zystische Herdbefunde auf 9 Uhr rechts sowie 11 Uhr links, bei aktueller Stillzeit DD Zysten DD Duktektasien.
translation:
Findings:  
Ultrasound reveals prominently structured and highly vascularized glandular tissue in the lactating breast, considered physiological. Consistent with the previous examination, the smallest cyst is noted in the upper central left area. The hypoechoic, smoothly bordered lesion in the upper outer left area has slightly decreased from 3mm to 1-2mm. Newly observed since the last examination are smoothly bordered lesions near the nipple with posterior acoustic enhancement, located at 9 o'clock on the right with a maximum diameter of 7mm, and at 11 o'clock on the left with a maximum diameter of 6mm. No evidence of newly developed solid suspicious lesions. No suspicious axillary lymphadenopathy.

Conclusion:  
No indication of malignancy. Newly observed since the last examination are bilateral cystic lesions near the nipple at 9 o'clock on the right and 11 o'clock on the left, likely due to current lactation, differential diagnosis includes cysts or duct ectasia.

report:

translation:
Findings: Status post right hip total endoprosthesis (TEP) implantation. No evidence of a loosening line, no pathological contrast enhancement around the prosthesis. Signal alteration in the lateral approach path, with marked contrast enhancement. Overall, abundant fibrotic tissue. Insertional tendinopathy of the anterior gluteus minimus muscle, with largely normal attachment of the gluteus medius.

Assessment:
-No indication of hip TEP loosening or periprosthetic infection (PPI).
-Gluteal tendon insufficiency of the anterior portion of the gluteus minimus.
-Fibrosis formation in the surgical approach path and around the prosthetic neck.

report:

Flaue Verschattung mutmaßlich im linken Lungenunterlappen, vereinbar mit einem pneumonischen Infiltrat. Randwinkelerguss linksseitig DD parapneumonisch.
translation:
Findings:  
Reduced inspiratory depth. The left costophrenic angle is obscured. There is a faint opacity in the left lower lung field projecting dorsally in the lateral view, most likely associated with the lower lobe. Hypertensive configuration of the heart and aorta. The upper mediastinum is not widened, and the trachea is not stenosed. Moderate degenerative changes in the spine. Clip material projected over the right upper abdomen, consistent with post-cholecystectomy status.

Impression:  
Faint opacity likely in the left lower lung lobe, consistent with a pneumonic infiltrate. Left-sided costophrenic angle effusion, possibly parapneumonic.

report:
Befund:

Achsgerechte Stellungsverhältnisse der abgebildeten Gelenke. Geringe Tendinose der Supraspinatussehne, ohne Hinweis auf eine frische Läsion. Deutliche Bursitis subdeltoidea und subakromiale. Kräftige vordere Kapsel. Tendinose der LBS. Gewisse Dysbalance zwischen anterioren und posterioren Labrums mit geringen paralabralen Ganglien posterior. Unauffällige Darstellung der Muskelbäuche der Rotatorenmanschette. Moderate degenerative Veränderungen im Akromioklavikulargelenk.

Beurteilung:
-Bursitis subacromialis und subdeltoidea.
-Kein Nachweis einer frischen Läsion der Rotatorenmanschette.
translation:
Findings:

The alignment of the depicted joints is normal. There is mild tendinosis of the supraspinatus tendon, with no evidence of a recent tear. There is significant subdeltoid and subacromial bursitis. The anterior capsule appears robust. There is tendinosis of the long head of the biceps tendon. There is some imbalance between the anterior and posterior labrum with small paralabral cysts posteriorly. The muscle bellies of the rotator cuff are unremarkable. There are moderate degenerative changes in the acromioclavicular joint.

Impression:
- Subacromial and subdeltoid bursitis.
- No evidence of a recent rotator cuff tear.

report:

translation:

report:
