Η υπερηχογραφική εξέταση του δεξιού αγκώνα αναδεικνύει μια σαφώς περιγεγραμμένη συλλογή υγρού στον υποδόριο ιστό υπερκείμενα της ωλεκρανικής απόφυσης με εσωτερική συνοβιακή υπερτροφία, μετρούμενη 4x5 cm. Τα ευρήματα είναι συμβατά με ωλεκρανική θυλακίτιδα.
Οι πλάγιοι σύνδεσμοι, ο τρικέφαλος, ο κοινός τένοντας των εκτεινόντων και των καμπτήρων απεικονίζονται φυσιολογικοί.
Το μέσο, κερκιδικό και ωλένιο νεύρο απεικονίζονται φυσιολογικά.
Δεν παρατηρείται ενδαρθρική συλλογή.
translation: The ultrasound examination of the right elbow reveals a well-defined fluid collection in the subcutaneous tissue overlying the olecranon process, with internal synovial hypertrophy, measuring 4x5 cm. These findings are consistent with olecranon bursitis. The collateral ligaments, triceps, common extensor, and flexor tendons appear normal. The median, radial, and ulnar nerves are also depicted as normal. No intra-articular fluid collection is observed.

report: Indicazione: sospetta polmonite. Non si osservano lesioni pleuro-parenchimali a focolaio in atto. Ombra cardiaca nei limiti. Seni costofrenici liberi bilateralmente.
translation: Indication: Suspected pneumonia. No focal pleuro-parenchymal lesions are currently observed. Cardiac silhouette is within normal limits. Costophrenic angles are clear bilaterally.

report: Indicazione: sospetta polmonite. Nel campo polmonare inferiore destro si osserva una sfumata radiopacità compatibile con il quesito clinico. Ombra cardiaca nei limiti. Seni costofrenici liberi bilateralmente
translation: Indication: suspected pneumonia. In the right lower lung field, there is a faint radiopacity consistent with the clinical question. Cardiac silhouette is within normal limits. Costophrenic angles are clear bilaterally.

report: Esame eseguito post impianto di pacemaker. Non si osserva pneumotorace. Non si rilevano lesioni pleuro-parenchimali a focolaio in atto. Ombra cardiaca nei limiti. Seni costofrenici liberi bilateralmente.Presenza di pacemaker bicamerale.
translation: Examination performed post pacemaker implantation. No pneumothorax observed. No focal pleuro-parenchymal lesions detected. Cardiac silhouette within normal limits. Costophrenic angles are clear bilaterally. Presence of a dual-chamber pacemaker.

report: Esame eseguito post impianto di pacemaker. Presenza di falda di pneumotorace SN. Non si rilevano lesioni parenchimali a focolaio in atto. Non significativo shift delle strutture mediastiniche. Presenza di pacemaker bicamerale
translation: Examination performed post pacemaker implantation. Presence of a left-sided pneumothorax. No focal parenchymal lesions detected. No significant shift of mediastinal structures. Presence of a dual-chamber pacemaker.

report: Indicazione: ARDS. Pneumotorace ampio sul lato destro. Il polmone destro è collassato e vi è uno spostamento verso sinistra del mediastino compatibile con un pneumotorace iperteso.
translation: Indication: ARDS. Large pneumothorax on the right side. The right lung is collapsed, and there is a leftward shift of the mediastinum consistent with a tension pneumothorax.

report: Indicazione: Dispnea in un paziente con cancro al seno. Ampio versamento pleurico a sinistra, con secondario shift mediastinico verso destra. Sono presenti multiple opacità polmonari lungo il polmone destro, con dimensioni fino a circa 7 mm
translation: Indication: Shortness of breath in a patient with breast cancer. Large left pleural effusion with secondary mediastinal shift to the right. Multiple pulmonary opacities are present throughout the right lung, measuring up to approximately 7 mm.

report: Indicazione: Dispnea. Esame eseguito nella sola proiezione AP. Accentuazione della trama vascolare in sede ilare bilaterale. Cardiomegalia. Bilaterale obliterazione dei seni costo frenici. Reperti suggestivi per quadro di scompenso cardiaco
translation: Indication: Dyspnea. Examination performed in the AP projection only. Accentuated vascular markings in the bilateral hilar regions. Cardiomegaly. Bilateral obliteration of the costophrenic angles. Findings suggestive of heart failure.

report: Indicazione: Difficolta respiratorie in paziente con recente infarto miocardico. In sede polmonare bilateralmente, si osserva diffuse aree nodulari mal definite tendenti alla confluenza. Concomita ispessimento dell’interstizio a distribuzione periferica.
translation: Indication: Respiratory difficulties in a patient with a recent myocardial infarction. Bilaterally in the lung fields, there are diffuse, poorly defined nodular areas showing a tendency to coalesce. There is also associated thickening of the interstitium with a peripheral distribution.

report: Indicazione: Dispnea in paziente con COVID-19. Opacizzazione diffusa e simmetrica degli spazi aerei bilateralmente in entrambi i polmoni nelle zone medio-inferiori. Ombra cardio-mediastinica nei limiti della norma.
translation: Indication: Shortness of breath in a patient with COVID-19. There is diffuse and symmetrical airspace opacification bilaterally in both lungs, predominantly in the mid to lower zones. The cardio-mediastinal silhouette is within normal limits.

report: Indicazione: Dolori addominali. Non aria libera né significativi livelli idro-aerei
translation: Indication: Abdominal pain. No free air or significant air-fluid levels.

report: Indicazione: Occlusione intestinale. Il colon è riempito di gas e dilatato fino al livello del colon discendente-sigma distale. L'intestino tenue è collassato. Non vi è presenza di gas libero.
translation: Indication: Bowel obstruction. The colon is filled with gas and dilated up to the level of the descending colon-distal sigmoid. The small intestine is collapsed. There is no presence of free gas.

report: Indicazione: Ostruzione. Dilatazione di anse del piccolo intestino localizzate in sede mediana, con un aspetto di ansa di intestino proiettata nella regione inguinale destra, in possibile rapporto ad ernia inguinale.
translation: Indication: Obstruction. There is dilation of small bowel loops located in the mid-abdomen, with the appearance of a bowel loop projecting into the right inguinal region, possibly related to an inguinal hernia.

report: Molteplici anse intestinali dilatate a distribuzione mediana in ipogastrio con livelli fluido/aerei. Non gas rettale. Reperti suggestivi per volvolo del sigma
translation: Multiple dilated bowel loops with a midline distribution in the hypogastric region, accompanied by air-fluid levels. Absence of rectal gas. Findings are suggestive of sigmoid volvulus.

report: Indicazione: Dolore in fianco DX. In fianco DX, si osserva formazione ad opacità calcifica delle dimensioni di max 7 mm, compatibile con formazione litiasica localizzata nel tratto addominale dell'uretere.
translation: Indication: Right flank pain. In the right flank, there is a calcified opacity measuring up to 7 mm, consistent with a calculus located in the abdominal segment of the ureter.

report: Indicazione: trauma.  Frattura angolata ed impattata del collo chirurgico omerale con avulsione della grande tuberosità.
translation: Indication: Trauma. Angulated and impacted fracture of the surgical neck of the humerus with avulsion of the greater tuberosity.

report: Indicazione: trauma.  Frattura  impattata del collo femorale sinistro
translation: Indication: trauma. Impacted fracture of the left femoral neck.

report: Indicazione: lombosciatalgia. Non alterazioni ossee morfostrutturali. Non alterazioni focali ossee da riferire a lesioni ossee traumatiche di data recente.Conservati i rapporti articolari.
translation: Indication: lumbosciatica. No morphostructural bone alterations. No focal bone changes indicative of recent traumatic bone lesions. Joint relationships are preserved.

report: Indicazione: Dolore lombare post-traumatico. Riduzione in altezza del soma di L4, con modica (max 6 mm) retropulsione del muro somatico posteriore. Regolari in altezza i restanti somi vertebrali
translation: Indication: Post-traumatic lower back pain. Decreased height of the L4 vertebral body, with mild (up to 6 mm) retropulsion of the posterior vertebral wall. The remaining vertebral bodies are of normal height.

report: Indicazione: Incremento enzimi epatici: Fegato di dimensioni aumentate e margini regolari. L'ecostruttura risulta finemente e diffusamente addensata come si osserva nelle condizioni di epatopatia su base steatosica, senza evidenza di alterazioni focali. Colecisti normoconformata ed alitiasica. Non dilatazione delle vie biliari intra ed extraepatiche Nella norma il calibro della vena porta.
translation: Indication: Elevated liver enzymes: The liver is enlarged with regular margins. The echotexture is finely and diffusely increased, as seen in liver disease due to steatosis, without evidence of focal lesions. The gallbladder is normal in shape and free of stones. There is no dilation of the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts. The caliber of the portal vein is normal.

report: Vescica appare distesa, con pareti ispessite e marcatamente disomogenea per contenuto in relazione all’evidenza di plurimi echi iperecogeni in sospensione, mobili con il decubito, riferibili a una condizione di cistite. Rivalutazione previa adeguata terapia medica
translation: The bladder appears distended, with thickened walls and markedly heterogeneous content due to the presence of multiple hyperechoic echoes in suspension, which are mobile with changes in position, suggestive of cystitis. Re-evaluation is recommended following appropriate medical therapy.

report: Indicazione: dolore colico in fianco DX. Dilazione del sistema calico-pielico del rene di DX a monte di formazione iperecogena delle dimensioni di max 6 mm con cono d'ombra posteriore, da riferire a formazione litiasi.
translation: Indication: Colicky pain in the right flank. Dilation of the right kidney's calyceal-pelvic system upstream of a hyperechoic formation measuring up to 6 mm with posterior acoustic shadowing, suggestive of a calculus formation.

report: Esame eseguito in urgenza miarto allo studio dell'arto inferiore sinistro come specificato nella richiesta per sospetta trombosi venosa profonda (esame limitato dalla scarsa collaborazione della paziente). Non segni riferibili a trombosi venosa profonda a carico dell'arto sinistro. Pervio e comprimibile anche l'asse venoso superficiale. Si segnala edema dei tessuti sottocutanei a livello della porzione mediale della gamba.
translation: Emergency examination focused on the left lower limb as specified in the request for suspected deep vein thrombosis (examination limited by the patient's poor cooperation). No signs indicative of deep vein thrombosis in the left limb. The superficial venous system is patent and compressible. Notable edema of the subcutaneous tissues in the medial portion of the leg is observed.

report: Dilatazione aneurismatica dell’aorta sottorenale, con aorta sovrarenale regolare per decorso e calibro ma a pareti marcatamente ateromasiche. Calibro massimo aorta sottorenale XXX cm. Presenza di deposizioni trombotiche parietali: Spessore massimo del trombo di mm XXX Calibro del lume vero mm XXX Non evidenti immagini riferibili a raccolte periaortiche. Arteria iliaca sinistra e destra destra regolari per decorso e calibro, diffusamente ateromasiche.
translation: Aneurysmal dilation of the infrarenal aorta, with the suprarenal aorta appearing normal in course and caliber but with markedly atheromatous walls. Maximum diameter of the infrarenal aorta is 2.4cm. Presence of mural thrombotic deposits: Maximum thrombus thickness is 12mm. True lumen diameter is 15 mm. No evidence of periaortic collections. The left and right iliac arteries are normal in course and caliber, but diffusely atheromatous.

report: Nota fistola artero-venosa su braccio sinistro ( localizzata a livello di piega di gomito) con versante arterioso aneurismatico con morfologia a clessidra, del diametro massimo di 48 mm, esteso in CC per 8 cm sino alla biforcazione delle arterie dell avambraccio con grossolane apposizioni trombotiche parietali. L’arteria radiale appare stenotica nel suo tratto più prossimale. L’arteria omerale a monte presenta kinking sia nel segmento distale che nel segmento prossimale, con calibro ectasia tra le due tortuosità. Le vene afferenti alla fistola artero-venosa appaiono totalmente trombizzate con focali dilatazioni aneurismatiche, la maggiore nel tratto medio di braccio ( max 27 mm)
translation: Arteriovenous fistula noted on the left arm (located at the level of the elbow crease) with an aneurysmal arterial segment exhibiting an hourglass shape, with a maximum diameter of 48 mm, extending longitudinally for 8 cm up to the bifurcation of the forearm arteries, with coarse parietal thrombotic deposits. The radial artery appears stenotic in its most proximal segment. The brachial artery upstream shows kinking in both the distal and proximal segments, with ectasia in caliber between the two tortuosities. The veins draining into the arteriovenous fistula are completely thrombosed with focal aneurysmal dilations, the largest being in the mid-arm segment (maximum 27 mm).

report: Indicazione: Ematuria. Reni di destra nei limiti della norma per sede, forma, dimensioni e caratteri strutturali. Spessore parenchimale nei limiti. Non dilatazione delle cavità calico-pieliche. Rene di sinistra di dimensioni aumentate ( diam. BP 14 cm) per la presenza di una grossolana formazione rotondeggiante ipoecogena di 7 x 7 cm a livello del terzo medio-polo inferiore di non univoca interpretazione; utile integrazione diagnostica mediante esame TC dell’addome con mdc ev. e videat specialistico. Non sicure immagini da riferire a formazioni litiasiche. Nella norma appare la vascolarizzazione del parenchima renale bilateralmente.
translation: Indication: Hematuria. The right kidney is within normal limits for position, shape, size, and structural characteristics. Parenchymal thickness is within normal limits. No dilation of the calyceal-pelvic cavities. The left kidney is enlarged (14 cm in bipolar diameter) due to the presence of a large, rounded, hypoechoic mass measuring 7 x 7 cm at the mid to lower pole, which is of uncertain interpretation; further diagnostic evaluation with a CT scan of the abdomen with intravenous contrast and specialist consultation is recommended. No definite images suggestive of lithiasis formations. The vascularization of the renal parenchyma appears normal bilaterally.

report: ndicazione: Valutazione rene trapiantato. Si documenta la presenza di rene trapiantato in FID di regolari dimensioni. La corticale appare disomogenea con evidenza di aree sfumatamente iperecogene nel contesto, come per sofferenza edemigena. Coesiste lieve infiltrazione edemigena del tessuto lasso adiposo ilare. Non immagini riferibili a calcoli né a dilatazioni. Tale reperto necessita di correlazione con il dato clinico-laboratoristico e valutazione specialistica nel sospetto di processo infiammatorio in atto.
translation: Indication: Evaluation of transplanted kidney. The presence of a transplanted kidney in the right iliac fossa of regular size is documented. The cortex appears heterogeneous with evidence of mildly hyperechoic areas, suggestive of edematous distress. There is also mild edematous infiltration of the loose adipose tissue in the hilum. No images indicative of stones or dilations. This finding requires correlation with clinical and laboratory data and specialist evaluation on suspicion of an ongoing inflammatory process.

report: Nel rachide lombare, frattura da compressione del corpo vertebrale di L5 con alterato segnale midollare, ipointenso in t1 ed iperintenso in T2, da riferire ad edema della spongiosa in frattura di data recente. Non retropulsione. Alterazione del segnale del legamento interspinoso in possibile rapporto a  Lacerazione/distrazione ed edema dei tessuti molli paravertebrali destri.
translation: In the lumbar spine, there is a compression fracture of the L5 vertebral body with altered marrow signal, hypointense on T1 and hyperintense on T2, indicative of bone marrow edema in a recent fracture. No retropulsion is observed. There is signal alteration of the interspinous ligament possibly related to laceration/distraction and edema of the right paravertebral soft tissues.

report: Indicazione: Neurite ottica retrobulbare. Non si osservano alterazioni di segnale dei tessuti encefalici, del tronco e dell’angolo ponto cerebellare né a carico delle strutture orbitarie. Nella norma il nervo ottico ed i muscoli estrinseci, bilateralmente. Regolare il segnale del grasso retrobulbare.. Sistema ventricolare in asse, normoteso
translation: Indication: Retrobulbar optic neuritis. No signal abnormalities are observed in the brain tissues, brainstem, or cerebellopontine angle, nor in the orbital structures. The optic nerve and extrinsic muscles are normal bilaterally. The signal of the retrobulbar fat is regular. The ventricular system is midline and normotensive.

report: Incremento PSA. Diffusa disomogeneità della ghiandola prostatica, con diametri di circa LL 6 cm x  AP 4,7 cm x CC 4,8 cm, per un volume di circa 70 cc. Si osserva ipertrofia della zona centrale-transizionale con diverse formazioni di aspetto nodulare. In sede transizionale anteriore e laterale dx, in sede medio-basale, si osserva area di alterato segnale, di morfologia approssimativamente lenticolare estesa per circa 35 mm, che mediamente supera la linea mediana, caratterizzata da ipointensità in T2 , a margini mal definiti, che supera la pseudo capsula e protrude verso lo stroma anteriore, iperintensa in DWI ad alti b, significativamente ipointensa nella mappa dADC,  che assume intensa precoce impregnazione contrasto grafica (PIRADSv2.1=5: molto probabile la presenza di lesione eteroplasica; necessaria biopsia mirata). Non evidenti alterazioni di segnale delle vescicole seminali. Vescica in sede, distesa, con pareti regolari. Non si osservano significative linfoadenopatie a carico delle stazioni comprese nell'indagine
translation: PSA increase. The prostate gland shows diffuse heterogeneity, with dimensions of approximately 6 cm in transverse diameter, 4.7 cm in anteroposterior diameter, and 4.8 cm in craniocaudal diameter, resulting in a volume of about 70 cc. There is hypertrophy of the central-transitional zone with several nodular formations. In the anterior and right lateral transitional zone, at the mid-basal level, there is an area of altered signal with an approximately lenticular shape extending about 35 mm, crossing the midline. This area is characterized by T2 hypointensity, poorly defined margins, extending beyond the pseudocapsule and protruding towards the anterior stroma, hyperintense on high b-value DWI, significantly hypointense on the ADC map, and shows intense early contrast enhancement (PIRADSv2.1=5: highly likely presence of a neoplastic lesion; targeted biopsy necessary). No signal alterations are evident in the seminal vesicles. The bladder is in place, distended, with regular walls. No significant lymphadenopathy is observed in the stations included in the examination.

report: La colecisti appare di dimensioni ridotte, disomogenea per la presenza di numerosi calcoli endoluminali. In  corrispondenza del tratto distale del dotto cistico, a livello della confluenza con l’epatico, si evidenzia un difetto di riempimento , estesa per  circa 1 cm, riferibile a calcolo.. Non si osservano dilatazioni delle vie biliari extra ed intraepatiche. Wirsung regolare.
translation: The gallbladder appears reduced in size and heterogeneous due to the presence of numerous intraluminal stones. At the distal portion of the cystic duct, near the confluence with the hepatic duct, there is a filling defect measuring approximately 1 cm, suggestive of a stone. No dilatation of the extrahepatic and intrahepatic bile ducts is observed. The pancreatic duct (Wirsung) is normal.

report: Indicazione: Sospetta IBD. Esame eseguito previa distensione del tratto enterico con soluzione di PEG per os (circa 2 L), senza e con somministrazione di MdC paramagnetico per via ev. Si somministra 1/2 fl buscopan ev. Buona la qualità della distensione per ottimale compliance della paziente. L'indagine non documenta patologici ispessimenti di parete a carico delle anse tenuali. Non aree di enhanceemtn sospetto dopo somministrazione di MdC. Non aree di restrizione del coefficiente di diffusione nelle sequenze pesate in DWI. Non versamento libero endoaddominale.
translation: Indication: Suspected IBD. The examination was performed after distension of the enteric tract with oral PEG solution (approximately 2 L), both without and with the administration of intravenous paramagnetic contrast medium. Half a vial of Buscopan was administered intravenously. The quality of the distension was good due to the patient's optimal compliance. The study does not show any pathological wall thickening of the small bowel loops. No suspicious areas of enhancement after contrast medium administration. No areas of diffusion coefficient restriction in the DWI-weighted sequences. No free intra-abdominal fluid.

report: Buona la qualità della distensione.  ispessimento di parete a carico dell'ultima ansa ileale subito in corrispondenza della valvola ileo-cecale, con spessore di circa 8.5 mm. Multiple ulteriori localizzazioni di malattia si documentano, con distribuzione discontinua, a carico dei tratti ileali a monte, sino alla porzione prossimale, con ispessimento di parete (diametro medio circa 6 mm), ipetrofia adiposa della sottomucosa. Dopo somministrazione di Mdc si documenta pattern di enhancement stratificato, con vivace impregnazione della tonaca mucosa in particolare in sede di ultima ansa.  Il quadro RM appare compatibile con attività di malattia su condizione cronica fibrotica substenosante. Multipe linfoadenopatie con asse corto subcentimetrico e di verosimile significato reattivo si osservano nel contesto della radice del mesentere. Non evidnti immagini sicuramente riferibili a raccolte ascessuali. Non versamento libero endoaddominale
translation: The quality of distension is good. There is wall thickening involving the terminal ileal loop immediately adjacent to the ileocecal valve, with a thickness of approximately 8.5 mm. Multiple additional disease sites are documented, with a discontinuous distribution affecting the upstream ileal segments up to the proximal portion, showing wall thickening (average diameter about 6 mm) and submucosal fat hypertrophy. After contrast administration, a layered enhancement pattern is observed, with marked mucosal uptake, particularly at the site of the terminal loop. The MRI findings are compatible with active disease on a chronic fibrotic substenosing condition. Multiple lymphadenopathies with subcentimeter short axes, likely of reactive significance, are observed at the root of the mesentery. No definite images suggestive of abscess collections are evident. No free intra-abdominal fluid is present.

report: A carico dell’ultima ansa ileale/colon ascendete si apprezza un diffuso edema della parete che appare ispessita con aspetto trilaminare a “target” e accentuata impregnazione di MDC nelle fasi portale e tardiva; concomita infiltrazione adiposa della parete colica segno di cronicità del processo flogistico. Il tessuto adipose adiacente appare di incrementata densità e I vasa recta venosi appaiono prominenti. Il quadro descritto depone per riacutizzazione del morbo di Crohn.
translation: Involving the terminal ileum/ascending colon, there is diffuse wall edema with thickening, displaying a trilaminar "target" appearance and marked contrast enhancement in the portal and delayed phases. There is also fatty infiltration of the colonic wall, indicating chronicity of the inflammatory process. The adjacent adipose tissue shows increased density, and the venous vasa recta appear prominent. The findings are consistent with a flare-up of Crohn's disease.

report: Si apprezza distensione fluida di ansa ileale in FID che presenta una torsione sul suo asse mesenteriale, quest’ultimo ispessito ed imbibito. Il quadro potrebbe riferirsi a volvolo e necessita di valutazione chirurgica. Non aria libera né significative falde fluide.
translation: There is fluid distension of an ileal loop in the right iliac fossa, which shows a twist on its mesenteric axis. The mesentery appears thickened and edematous. This finding could suggest a volvulus and requires surgical evaluation. No free air or significant fluid collections are observed.

report: Indicazione: incremento D-Dimero, sospetta embolia polmonare. Difetto di riempimento a carico delle diramazioni segmentarie e subsegmentarie postero-basali di entrambi i lobi inferiori, più evidenti a destra. Non sono evidenti difetti di riempimento a carico dei rami di divisione primaria delle arterie polmonari e delle restanti diramazioni lobari. Non falde di versamento pleurico. Non linfoadenomegalie ilo-mediastiniche ed ascellari. L’arteria polmonare conserva calibro nei limiti della normalità con lieve incremento della camera ventricolare destra
translation: Indication: Elevated D-Dimer, suspected pulmonary embolism. There is a filling defect in the posterior-basal segmental and subsegmental branches of both lower lobes, more pronounced on the right. No filling defects are observed in the primary division branches of the pulmonary arteries and the remaining lobar branches. No pleural effusion is present. No hilar-mediastinal or axillary lymphadenopathy. The pulmonary artery maintains a caliber within normal limits with a slight enlargement of the right ventricular chamber.

report: Indicazione: Sospetto ictus. Non alterazioni della densità dei tessuti encefalici di data recente.  Difetto di riempimento dell’arteria cerebrale media di sinistra nel tratto M2. Regolare il restante poligono del Willis e le principali diramazioni arteriose intracraniche Diffusa ateromasia calcifica parietale in corrispondenza del bulbo carotideo, che coinvolge il III prossimale dell’arteria carotide interna bilateralmente, in assenza di significative stenosi luminali. Regolare emergenza dei vasi epiaortici all’arco. Strutture mediane in asse.
translation: Indication: Suspected stroke. No recent changes in the density of brain tissues. Filling defect in the left middle cerebral artery at the M2 segment. The rest of the circle of Willis and the main intracranial arterial branches are normal. Widespread calcified atheroma in the walls at the carotid bulb, involving the proximal third of the internal carotid artery bilaterally, without significant luminal stenosis. Normal origin of the supra-aortic vessels at the arch. Midline structures are in alignment.

report: Indicazione: cefalea. Emorragia subaracnoidea bilaterale fronto-temporale più evidente a destra con interessamento degli spazi subaracnoidei parafalcali e della cisterna del Willis. Concomita quota ematica a livello dei ventricoli sovratentoriali. La valutazione angiografica mostra la presenza di dilatazione aneurismatica sacciforme a livello di comunicante anteriore con colletto di 1,9 mm e dimensioni trasverse di 5,4 mm x 5,1 mm. Regolare calibro e pervietà dei restanti vettori arteriosi del poligono del Willis. Esenti da patologia gli assi carotideo-vertebrali nel tratto intra ed extra-cranico. Pervi all’arco i vasi epiaortici.
translation: Indication: headache. Bilateral fronto-temporal subarachnoid hemorrhage, more pronounced on the right, involving the parafalcine subarachnoid spaces and the cistern of Willis. There is also a presence of blood within the supratentorial ventricles. Angiographic evaluation reveals a saccular aneurysmal dilation at the level of the anterior communicating artery with a neck measuring 1.9 mm and transverse dimensions of 5.4 mm x 5.1 mm. The remaining arterial vessels of the circle of Willis are of normal caliber and patency. The carotid-vertebral axes are free from pathology in both the intra- and extra-cranial segments. The epiaortic vessels are patent up to the arch.

report: Indicazione: crisi comiziale. Nel lobo temporale destro si osserva una formazione rotondeggiante, solida, delle dimensioni massime di 35 mm, con accumulo disomogeneo di mezzo di contrasto e margini irregolari, festonati. È associato a un esteso edema vasogenico adiacente con effetto massa sulle strutture cerebrali adiacenti e uno spostamento della linea mediana di circa 7 mm
translation: Indication: Seizure episode. In the right temporal lobe, there is a round, solid mass measuring up to 35 mm, with heterogeneous contrast enhancement and irregular, scalloped margins. It is associated with extensive adjacent vasogenic edema, causing a mass effect on the surrounding brain structures and a midline shift of approximately 7 mm.

report: Indicazione: dolore toracico atipico. Il tronco comune presenta regolare canalizzazione. Arteria discendente anteriore presenta diffusa patologia calcifica coinvolgente in toto il tratto prossimale condizionante stenosi moderata ( circa 60 %, con possibile sovrastima per artefatti da blooming), segue patologia calcifica nel tratto medio e al passaggio medio-distale determinante lieve riduzione del calibro vasale. Primo diagonale con patologia calcifica nel tratto medio prossimale non significativa Secondo diagonale filiforme Presenza di ramo intermedio di esile calibro  Arteria circonflessa presenta placca prevalentemente calcifica nel suo tratto prossimale con lieve riduzione del calibro vasale, segue nel tratto medio placca fibrolipidica condizionante stenosi significativa. Primo marginale coinvolto da patologia calcifica non significativa. Arteria coronaria destra, vaso dominante per calibro e decorso, presenta diffusa irregolarità di parete determinante da patologia ateromasica calcifica con lieve moderata riduzione del calibro vasale (circa 40- 50%), Arteria discendente posteriore presenta patologia calcifica non significativa. Ramo postero-laterale scarsamente opacizzato
translation: Indication: atypical chest pain. The left main coronary artery shows normal patency. The left anterior descending artery exhibits diffuse calcific disease affecting the entire proximal segment, causing moderate stenosis (approximately 60%, with potential overestimation due to blooming artifacts). There is further calcific disease in the mid-segment and at the mid-distal transition, causing a slight reduction in vessel caliber. The first diagonal branch has calcific disease in the mid-proximal segment, which is not significant. The second diagonal branch is thread-like. There is a small-caliber intermediate branch present. The circumflex artery has a predominantly calcific plaque in its proximal segment, causing a slight reduction in vessel caliber, followed by a fibrolipidic plaque in the mid-segment causing significant stenosis. The first marginal branch is affected by non-significant calcific disease. The right coronary artery, which is the dominant vessel by size and course, shows diffuse wall irregularity due to calcific atheromatous disease, with a mild to moderate reduction in vessel caliber (approximately 40-50%). The posterior descending artery has non-significant calcific disease. The posterolateral branch is poorly opacified.

report: indicazione: studio dell'auricola pre-operatoria. Regolare opacizzazione delle vene polmonari, con evidenza di ostio venoso comune a sinistra. A livello dell'auricola sinistra si osserva immagine di minus delle dimensioni di max circa 7 mm x 5 mm, suggestiva per stratificazione trombocita Collateralmente, a livello del parenchima polmonare, solo in parte compreso nel volume di studio, non si osservano lesioni parenchimali.
translation: Indication: Pre-operative study of the left atrial appendage. Normal opacification of the pulmonary veins, with evidence of a common venous ostium on the left. In the left atrial appendage, there is an image of a filling defect measuring approximately 7 mm x 5 mm, suggestive of thrombus layering. Incidentally, in the pulmonary parenchyma, only partially included in the study volume, no parenchymal lesions are observed.

report: Non si evidenziano consolidamenti parenchimali. Ombra cardiaca nei limiti. PICC con accesso dall'arto superiore di sinistra e apice distale in vena cava superiore.
translation: No parenchymal consolidations are observed. Cardiac silhouette is within normal limits. PICC line inserted from the left upper limb with the distal tip in the superior vena cava.

report: Esame posto a confronto con precedente del 06/04/2024. Sostanzialmente stabile la falda di PNX a destra con distanza massima della linea pleurica dalla parete toracica di circa 27 mm (ex 3 cm). Invariata anche la falda di PNX a sinistra. Persiste modico versamento pleurico a livello delle basi bilateralmente, lievemente più rappresentato a destra. Invariata la maggior evidenza dell'interstizio. Ombra cardiaca nei limiti. Invariata la posizione del sondino naso-gastrico. In riduzione l'enfisema sottocutaneo soprattutto a livello della base del collo.
translation: Examination compared with the previous one from 04/06/2024. The right pneumothorax remains essentially stable, with the maximum distance of the pleural line from the chest wall measuring approximately 27 mm (previously 3 cm). The left pneumothorax is also unchanged. There is a persistent mild pleural effusion at the bases bilaterally, slightly more pronounced on the right. The prominence of the interstitium remains unchanged. Cardiac silhouette is within normal limits. The position of the nasogastric tube is unchanged. Subcutaneous emphysema is decreasing, particularly at the base of the neck.

report: Rispetto al precedente controllo del 04/04/2024, si apprezza modesta riduzione del versamento pleurico in campo inferiore a dx, e dei fenomeni disventilatori sovrapposti e pervietà del seno costofrenico di sinistra. Non più apprezzabile l'enfisema sottocutaneo parietale a destra. Rimozione del CVC. Non ulteriori modificazioni dell'obiettività radiologica.
translation: Compared to the previous examination on 04/04/2024, there is a modest reduction in the pleural effusion in the lower right field, as well as in the associated atelectatic changes, and the left costophrenic angle is clear. The subcutaneous emphysema on the right is no longer visible. The central venous catheter (CVC) has been removed. No further changes in the radiological findings.

report: Esame eseguito in regime di pre ospedalizzazione per intervento chirurgico.  Accentuazione della trama vascolare in assenza di consolidamenti parenchimali. Ombra cardiaca ingrandita con salienza delle sezioni di sinistra.-Aorta scleroectasica con decorso scoliotico. Esiti di valvuloplastica Mitralica.  Esiti di cedimento dorsale verosimilmente a D8 e in sede lombare.
translation: The examination was performed in a pre-hospitalization setting for surgical intervention. There is an accentuation of the vascular markings without any parenchymal consolidations. The cardiac silhouette is enlarged with prominence of the left sections. The aorta is sclerotic and ectatic with a scoliotic course. There are findings consistent with previous mitral valvuloplasty. There are signs of vertebral collapse, likely at D8 and in the lumbar region.

report: I polmoni sono liberi. Accentuazione della trama peribroncovasale in assenza di lesioni parenchimali polmonari con caratteri d'aria in atto. Liberi i seni costofrenici. Ombra cardiaca nei limiti.
translation: The lungs are clear. There is an accentuation of the peribronchovascular markings without any current pulmonary parenchymal lesions. The costophrenic angles are clear. The cardiac silhouette is within normal limits.

report: Esame eseguito in condizioni basali in paziente con interstiziopatia NSIP posto a confronto con il precedente del 22/03/2023.Al controllo odierno si documenta modesta progressione del quadro interstiziale, in particolare appare incrementato l'ispessimento dei setti inter- ed intralobulari cosi come le aree di aumentata densità con sostanziale stabilità delle bronchiectasie da trazione e delle iniziali manifestazioni di honeycombina. Minima maggiore evidenza dell'ipertrofia del tessuto extrapleurico e mediastinico. Stabili gli esiti pleurici a sede apicale destra con calcificazione nel contesto che determinano fenomeni di retrazione delle strutture bronchiali e vascolari. Invariato il millimetrico consolidamento subpleurico al segmento basale posteriore del lobo inferiore di sinistra. Non noduli o micronoduli parenchimal polmonari con carattere di sospetto. Non versamento pleurico. Non linfoadenomegalie mediastiniche. Calcificazioni aortiche e coronariche. Invariati i cedimenti dei metameri dorsali così come i restanti reperti.
translation: Exam performed under baseline conditions in a patient with NSIP interstitial lung disease, compared with the previous exam from 03/22/2023. Today's follow-up shows a modest progression of the interstitial pattern, particularly with increased thickening of the inter- and intralobular septa, as well as areas of increased density, while traction bronchiectasis and early honeycombing manifestations remain essentially stable. There is minimal increased prominence of the hypertrophy of extrapleural and mediastinal tissue. The pleural findings at the right apical site remain stable, with calcification causing retraction phenomena of the bronchial and vascular structures. The small subpleural consolidation in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged. No suspicious pulmonary parenchymal nodules or micronodules. No pleural effusion. No mediastinal lymphadenopathy. Aortic and coronary calcifications are present. The collapse of the dorsal vertebrae and other findings remain unchanged.

report: Esame eseguito in paziente sottoposto a ablazione con micro-onde allottavo segmento (maggio 2021) e posto a confronto con precedente del 4/10/23.Al controllo odierno la focalità esofitica in S3 presenta incremento dimensionale (asse maggiore 23mm ex 20mm); comportamento post-contrastografico invariato caratterizzato unicamente da ipodensità in fase venosa e tardiva, privo di iperdensità in fase arteriosa. Non alterazioni focali ipervascolari con caratteristiche riferibili ad He nel restante ambito epatico che risulta diffusamente disomogeneo con noduli rigenerativi.--Non segni di ripresa di malattia in corrispondenza dell'esito di trattamento in S8. Non dilatazione delle vie biliari, colecisti priva di aggregati litiasici a densità calcica. Pervio l'asse spleno- mesenterico portale. -Linfonodo con asse corto di 1,3 cm (ex 1,5cm) a sede ilare epatica, in assenza di ulteriori linfoadenomegalie. Assente il versamento endoperitoneale. Invariati i restanti reperti.
translation: Examination performed on a patient who underwent microwave ablation of the eighth segment (May 2021) and compared with the previous study from 10/4/23. On today's follow-up, the exophytic lesion in segment 3 shows an increase in size (largest dimension 23mm from 20mm); post-contrast behavior remains unchanged, characterized solely by hypodensity in the venous and delayed phases, without hyperdensity in the arterial phase. No hypervascular focal alterations with characteristics suggestive of hepatocellular carcinoma in the remaining liver, which appears diffusely heterogeneous with regenerative nodules. --No signs of disease recurrence at the treatment site in segment 8. No dilation of the bile ducts, gallbladder free of calcified lithiasis aggregates. The spleno-mesenteric portal axis is patent. -Lymph node with a short axis of 1.3 cm (from 1.5 cm) at the hepatic hilum, with no additional lymphadenopathy. No intraperitoneal fluid collection. The remaining findings are unchanged.

report: Quadro di epatopatia cronica con ipertrofia delle sezioni di sn e del caudato e disomogeneità parenchimale, in assenza di lesioni focali con caratteristiche di HCC. Microlitiasi della colecisti, regolari le vie biliari. Pervio l'asse venoso spleno-mesenterico-portale, in assenza di significativi circoli collaterali porto sistemici. Splenomegalia (14cm), con alcune circoscritte aree ipodense sottocapsulari in sede polare inferiore. Pancreas con alcune dilatazioni cistiche dei dotti secondari, la maggiore di 8mm al tratto medio della coda; minima evidenza del dotto di Wirsung lungo tutto il decorso. Surreni di aspetto iperplasico: -Regolari i reni. Non linfoadenomegalie addominepelviche di dimensioni significative.--Minimo versamento periepatico perisplenico ed in pelvi. -In ambito polmonare si documenta nodulo di 7 mm al segmento sede apicodersale del Lsn; ulterori micronoduli sparsi bilaterali, il maggiore al segmento laterale del LM (6mm). Non linfoadenomegalie mediastiniche nè versamento pleurico.
translation: Chronic liver disease with hypertrophy of the left sections and caudate lobe, and parenchymal heterogeneity, without focal lesions characteristic of HCC. Gallbladder microlithiasis, with normal bile ducts. The spleno-mesenteric-portal venous axis is patent, with no significant portosystemic collateral circulation. Splenomegaly (14 cm), with some circumscribed hypodense subcapsular areas at the lower pole. The pancreas shows some cystic dilations of the secondary ducts, the largest being 8 mm in the mid-tail region; minimal visibility of the Wirsung duct throughout its course. Adrenals appear hyperplastic. Kidneys are normal. No significant abdominal or pelvic lymphadenopathy. Minimal perihepatic, perisplenic, and pelvic fluid. In the pulmonary field, a 7 mm nodule is documented in the apicodorsal segment of the left upper lobe; additional scattered bilateral micronodules, the largest being 6 mm in the lateral segment of the left middle lobe. No mediastinal lymphadenopathy or pleural effusion.

report: Esame  eseguito prima e dopo somministrazione di mdc ex. (lopamiro 370).Parenchimografia corticale renale disomogonea in fase arteriosa bilateralmente, in particolare a destra, dove si associa anche fine irregolarità del tessuto adiposo perirenale come da infiltrato edemigene. Necessaria correlazione con il quadro clinico-laboratoristico. Dilatati gli ureteri bilateralmente lungo tutto il decorso fino allo sbocco in vescica con pelvi e calici renali lievemente dilatati. Dilatazione di pelvi e calici maggiormente evidente nella fase urografica a 25' dalla somministrazione del mdc e dal clampaggio del catetere vescicale. Regolare opacizzazione e progressione di urina iodata nel sistema calice-pielico bilateralmente, con sistema di destra con ritardo rispetto al controlaterale. La vescica risulta vuota, con catetere in sede , pareti diffusamente  ispessite.Assenza di litiasi nel sistema escretore. Esiti di prostatectomia Pervi i vasi renali bilateralmente. Cisti epatica centimetrica in S1. Esiti di colecistectomia.-Diverticoli paraduodenali a livello della 2° e 3° porzione duodenale (quest'ultimo il maggiore di circa 4,5cm). Nella norma pancreas, surreni e milza. Non versamento libero, non linfoadenomegalie.
translation: Exam performed before and after administration of contrast agent (Lopamiro 370). The renal cortical parenchyma shows heterogeneous enhancement in the arterial phase bilaterally, particularly on the right, where there is also fine irregularity of the perirenal fat tissue suggestive of edematous infiltration. Correlation with clinical and laboratory findings is necessary. The ureters are dilated bilaterally along their entire course up to their entry into the bladder, with mildly dilated renal pelvis and calyces. The dilation of the pelvis and calyces is more evident in the urographic phase 25 minutes after contrast administration and clamping of the bladder catheter. There is normal opacification and progression of iodinated urine in the calyceal-pelvic system bilaterally, with the right system showing a delay compared to the contralateral side. The bladder is empty, with a catheter in place, and the walls are diffusely thickened. No calculi in the excretory system. Post-prostatectomy changes. Renal vessels are patent bilaterally. A centimeter-sized hepatic cyst is present in segment 1. Post-cholecystectomy changes. Paraduodenal diverticula are noted at the level of the 2nd and 3rd portions of the duodenum, the largest measuring approximately 4.5 cm. The pancreas, adrenal glands, and spleen are normal. No free fluid or lymphadenopathy.

report: Valutazione pre-operatoria per poliposi nasale. I reperti confermano quadro di poliposi rino-sinusale, nettamente evoluto rispetto all'indagine del 11/05/2017. Esso determina obliterazione pressoché completa delle cavità nasali (in particolare della destra), del seno mascellare destro, delle cellette etmoidali, sfenoidale. del seno frontale destro e del versante destro del seno Obliterati anche i complessi osteo-meatali ed i dotti fronte-nasali bilateralmente. Concomita voluminoso polipo antro-coanale a destra. Finemente erosi i turbinati nasali, le pareti mesiali dei seni mascellari (sopratutto a destra), le lamelle etmoidali ed il setto.
translation: Pre-operative evaluation for nasal polyposis. The findings confirm a picture of rhinosinus polyposis, significantly progressed compared to the examination on 05/11/2017. This results in almost complete obliteration of the nasal cavities (particularly the right), the right maxillary sinus, the ethmoid air cells, the sphenoid sinus, the right frontal sinus, and the right side of the sinus. The osteomeatal complexes and the fronto-nasal ducts are also obliterated bilaterally. There is a concomitant large antrochoanal polyp on the right. The nasal turbinates, the medial walls of the maxillary sinuses (especially on the right), the ethmoid lamellae, and the septum are finely eroded.

report: Fegato modicamente aumentato di volume, con steatosi a livello ecostrutturale parenchimale, senza apprezzabili distinte lesioni focali a carattere sostitutivo --Colecisti normodistesa, alitiasica, con vie intra ed extraepatiche non dilatate. Pancreas non agevolmente esplorabile per interposto meteorismo, tendenzialmente iperecogeno, apparentemente privo di rilevanti espansi. Milza di normali dimensioni. Reni in sede, nei limiti per morfologia, dimensioni ed ecostruttura parenchimale, con seni renali regolari; non dilatazioni delle vie escretrici urinarie, bilateralmente. Non ectasie di dell'aorta addominale. Vescica mediamente repleta, a contenuto liquido omogeneo. Prostata simmetrica, moderatamente aumentata di volume, con diametro trasverso di circa 52 mm. Non versamenti liberi in peritoneo.
translation: The liver is moderately enlarged, with steatosis at the parenchymal echostructural level, without appreciable distinct focal lesions of a substitutive nature. The gallbladder is normally distended, without gallstones, and the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The pancreas is not easily explored due to interposed bowel gas, tends to be hyperechoic, and appears to be free of significant masses. The spleen is of normal size. The kidneys are in their usual position, within normal limits for morphology, size, and parenchymal echostructure, with regular renal sinuses; there is no dilation of the urinary excretory pathways on either side. There is no ectasia of the abdominal aorta. The bladder is moderately filled, with homogeneous liquid content. The prostate is symmetrical, moderately enlarged, with a transverse diameter of approximately 52 mm. There are no free fluid collections in the peritoneum.

report: il fegato presenta normali dimensioni ad ecostruttura normo-ecogena omogenea, calcificazioni parenchimali al V segmento. Non lesioni di natura focale. Colecisti regolarmente distesa priva di calcoli. Vie biliari intra ed extraepatiche non dilatate. Pancreas omogeneo con Wirsung sottile. Milza nella norma. Regolare rappresentazione cortice- midollare. Non segni di uropatia ostruttiva né formazioni iperecogene riferibili a calcoli. Aorta nella norma. Vescica depleta. All'esame del collo non linfoadenopatie in sede latere-cervicale bilateralmente. Tiroidectomia sinistra, a destra il lobo tiroideo e' omogeneo di normali dimensioni. Non linfonodi patologici in sede ascellare né inguinale.
translation: The liver is of normal size with a homogeneous, normal echogenic structure, and parenchymal calcifications in segment V. No focal lesions are present. The gallbladder is regularly distended and free of stones. Intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The pancreas is homogeneous with a thin Wirsung duct. The spleen is normal. The corticomedullary differentiation is regular. There are no signs of obstructive uropathy or hyperechoic formations suggestive of stones. The aorta is normal. The bladder is depleted. Examination of the neck shows no lymphadenopathy in the lateral-cervical regions bilaterally. There is a left thyroidectomy; the right thyroid lobe is homogeneous and of normal size. No pathological lymph nodes are present in the axillary or inguinal regions.

report: lI fegato presenta dimensioni ai limiti inferiori, margini arrotondati e struttura parenchimale dismogenea. Non sono apprezzabili lesioni nodulari sovracentimetriche nel contesto del parenchima epatico. -Pervia la vena splenica e la mesenterica in esiti di shunt porto-sistemico. Mal valutabile il cavernoma portale con scarso flusso a tale livello (visibili esili circoli, con velocimetria massima di 10cm/s). Pervie le vene sovrapatiche e la vena cava inferiore retroepatica, con flusso nei limiti. Dilatazione delle vie biliari intraepatiche con riduzione di calibro a livello della VBP che presenta calibro di 6mm e contenuto lievemente iperecogene. Nei limiti la colecisti (minimo materiale corpuscolato). Non formazioni espansive canco delle porzioni esplorabili del pancreas. La milza presenta dimensioni marcatamente aumentate con struttura parenchimale disomogenea e diffusi spot iperecogeni. Presenza di note alterazioni aneurismatiche note dell'arteria splenica con ulcerazioni intimali. Reni in sede, con piccoli noduli tenuemente iperecogeni in entrambe le corticali (1 cm). La vescica presenta dimensioni nei limiti, a contenuto omogeneo. Prostata simmetricamente aumentata di dimensioni, con diametro trasverso massimo di 55 mm.
translation: The liver is at the lower limits of normal size, with rounded edges and a heterogeneous parenchymal structure. No nodular lesions over one centimeter are appreciable within the hepatic parenchyma. The splenic and mesenteric veins are patent following a portosystemic shunt. The portal cavernoma is poorly assessed with low flow at this level (visible slender vessels, with a maximum velocity of 10 cm/s). The hepatic veins and retrohepatic inferior vena cava are patent, with flow within normal limits. There is dilation of the intrahepatic bile ducts with a reduction in caliber at the level of the common bile duct, which measures 6 mm and contains slightly hyperechoic material. The gallbladder is within normal limits (minimal particulate material). No expansive formations are noted in the explored portions of the pancreas. The spleen is markedly enlarged with a heterogeneous parenchymal structure and diffuse hyperechoic spots. There are known aneurysmal changes of the splenic artery with intimal ulcerations. The kidneys are in place, with small mildly hyperechoic nodules in both cortices (1 cm). The bladder is of normal size, with homogeneous content. The prostate is symmetrically enlarged, with a maximum transverse diameter of 55 mm.

report: Modesta quota di versamento pleurico bilateralmente, in particolare a destra, con componente atelettasica bibasilare. Non sono presenti consolidamenti parenchimali. Il cuore è ai limiti superiori per dimensioni. Non sono presenti segni di patologia parenchimale polomonare. A livello addominale, si rileva esile falda di versamento periepatico. Il fegato presenta struttura omogenea. Colecisti a contenuto microlitiasico. Milza aumentata di volue. Dilatazione di 5 cm a livello dellaorta addominale sottorenale, le arterie renali sono pervie.
translation: There is a modest amount of pleural effusion on both sides, more pronounced on the right, with a bibasilar atelectatic component. No parenchymal consolidations are present. The heart is at the upper limits of normal size. There are no signs of pulmonary parenchymal disease. In the abdominal region, a thin layer of perihepatic fluid is noted. The liver has a homogeneous structure. The gallbladder contains microlithiasis. The spleen is enlarged. There is a 5 cm dilation of the infrarenal abdominal aorta, and the renal arteries are patent.

report: TC pre-operatoria delladdome e della pelvi in paziente con storia di carcinoma della vescica, cistoprostatectomia e ricostruzione con condotto di Bricker. Minimo incremento di volume della lesione cistica della testa del pancreas (che ora presenta diametro massimo di 4 cm). Invariate le restanti alterazioni focali del parenchima pancreatico. Non si evidenziano segni di recidiva di tumore vescicale in corrispondenza del condotto di Bricker. Non si evidenziano significative variazioni a livello del fegato, della colecisti, delle vie biliari, della milza, dei reni o delle ghiandole surrenali. Laorta addominale è pervia. Non si evidenzia versamento libero intra-peritoneale o linfoadenopatie sospette.
translation: Preoperative CT of the abdomen and pelvis in a patient with a history of bladder cancer, cystoprostatectomy, and Bricker conduit reconstruction. There is a slight increase in the size of the cystic lesion in the head of the pancreas, now measuring a maximum diameter of 4 cm. The other focal changes in the pancreatic parenchyma remain unchanged. No signs of bladder cancer recurrence are observed at the site of the Bricker conduit. There are no significant changes in the liver, gallbladder, bile ducts, spleen, kidneys, or adrenal glands. The abdominal aorta is patent. No free intraperitoneal fluid or suspicious lymphadenopathy is detected.

report: Il fegato è lievemente ingrandito, ad ecostruttura disomogenea, in assenza di alterazioni focali, con vena porta nella norma. Colecisti a pareti calcifiche con microlitiasi, regolari le vie biliari. Il pancreas presenta ecostruttura omogenea. La milza è lievemente ingrandita. I reni sono nella norma, con piccolo aree iperecogene a livello parenchimale, in particolare a destra. Non si evidenzia dilatazione ureterale. La vescica è vuota, con pareti ispessite e lievemente irregolari. Non versamento peritoneale.
translation: The liver is slightly enlarged with a heterogeneous echotexture, without focal lesions, and the portal vein is normal. The gallbladder has calcified walls with microlithiasis, and the bile ducts are normal. The pancreas shows a homogeneous echotexture. The spleen is slightly enlarged. The kidneys are normal, with small hyperechoic areas in the parenchyma, particularly on the right. No ureteral dilation is observed. The bladder is empty, with thickened and slightly irregular walls. No peritoneal effusion is present.

report: Il fegato è incrementato lievemente di dimensioni, senza significative alterazioni focali. Colecisti a contenuto micro-litiasico, nella norma le vie biliari. Il pancreas non è facilmente valutabile a causa del sovrapposto gas intestinale, e presenta ecostruttura iperecogena. La milza è nella norma. Reni normali, con Differenziazione cortico-midollare regolare, in assenza di dilatazione della pelvi renale o calcoli. La vescica è vuota. La prostata è modestamente ingrandita con un volume di circa 50 ml. Non si evidenzia versamento fluido libero nel peritoneo.
translation: The liver is slightly enlarged, with no significant focal alterations. The gallbladder contains microlithiasis, and the bile ducts are normal. The pancreas is difficult to assess due to overlying intestinal gas and shows a hyperechoic echotexture. The spleen is normal. The kidneys are normal, with regular corticomedullary differentiation, and there is no dilation of the renal pelvis or stones. The bladder is empty. The prostate is moderately enlarged with a volume of approximately 50 ml. No free fluid is observed in the peritoneal cavity.

report: Il fegato è lievemente incrementato di dimensioni, a contorni rotondeggianti, con parenchima a ecostruttura disomogenea. Non sono apprezzabili lesioni focali con diametro maggiore di 1 cm. La vena porta mostra calibro regolare. La milza è marcatamente ingrandita, a ecostruttura iperecogena e un volume di 350 ml. Il pancreas appare omogeneo. I reni sono in sede, nella norma per morfologia e edimensioni, con alcune aree iperecogene nel parenchima. La vescica è moderatamente aumentata di volume, a pareti regolari. La prostata è ingrandita di dimensioni, a ecostruttura omogenea, in assenza di noduli sospetti.
translation: The liver is slightly enlarged with rounded contours and a heterogeneous parenchymal echotexture. No focal lesions greater than 1 cm in diameter are appreciable. The portal vein has a regular caliber. The spleen is markedly enlarged, with a hyperechoic echotexture and a volume of 350 ml. The pancreas appears homogeneous. The kidneys are in their usual position, normal in morphology and size, with some hyperechoic areas in the parenchyma. The bladder is moderately increased in volume, with regular walls. The prostate is enlarged, with a homogeneous echotexture, and no suspicious nodules are present.

report: Il fegato è nella norma per dimensioni, ad ecostruttura omogenea e in assenza di lesioni focali. La colecisti è regolarmente distesa in assenza di calcoli. Le vie biliari non sono dilatate. La milza è nei limiti per dimensioni. Il pancreas non è facilmente valutabile a causa dei gas sovraimposti, e appare omogeneo. I reni sono nella norma per morfologia, dimensioni, struttura, in assenza di segni di dilatazione pieloureterale. La vescica è nei limiti, con pareti regolari e in assenza di anomalie. La prostata è simmetricamente aumentata di dimensioni, in assenza di versamento fluido nel peritoneo.
translation: The liver is normal in size, with a homogeneous echotexture and no focal lesions. The gallbladder is properly distended with no stones. The bile ducts are not dilated. The spleen is within normal size limits. The pancreas is not easily assessable due to overlying gas, but appears homogeneous. The kidneys are normal in morphology, size, and structure, with no signs of pelvoureteral dilation. The bladder is within normal limits, with regular walls and no abnormalities. The prostate is symmetrically enlarged, with no fluid accumulation in the peritoneum.

report: Il fegato appare nei limiti per dimensioni, in assenza di alterazioni focali. La colecisti è regolare, in assenza di calcoli. La milza è nei limiti. Il pancreas non è ben valutabile a causa del gas sovraimposto. I reni sono nei limiti, in assenza di diltazione pielo-ureterale o calcoli. La vescica è vuota, in assenza di reperti patologici. La prostata è aumentata di dimensioni, simmetrica e in assenza di noduli sospetti.
translation: The liver is within normal limits for size, with no focal lesions. The gallbladder is normal, with no stones. The spleen is within normal limits. The pancreas is not well visualized due to overlying gas. The kidneys are within normal limits, with no pelvicalyceal or ureteral dilation or stones. The bladder is empty, with no pathological findings. The prostate is enlarged, symmetrical, and without suspicious nodules.

report:
兩側胸廓形態對稱，縱隔及氣管居中，兩肺紋理正常，右肺上葉見團片狀高密度，大小約1.8×1.3cm，呈分葉狀，内見支氣管走行僵硬狹窄，鄰近胸膜牽拉凹陷，周圍伴磨玻璃密度影。雙肺下葉見多發結節，其中最大者(Se5，Im141-144)爲實性結節，大小約爲5×4mm。右肺下葉見小圓形無肺紋理透亮區。雙側肺葉、段支氣管形態未見异常，右側肺門見鈣化淋巴結影，縱隔内見多個淋巴結影，未見明顯腫大淋巴結。主動脉及冠脉走行區可見鈣化影，主動脉稍寬，直徑約4.2cm。雙側胸膜未見异常。
附見：肝實質密度不均匀减低，CT均值約30HU。
胸部CT平掃示：
1.右肺上葉結節竈，考慮Ca可能大，建議必要時進一步檢查除外其它；
2.雙肺多發小結節；右肺下葉肺大疱；
3.右側肺門淋巴結鈣化；動脉粥樣硬化，升主動脉稍寬；
附見：脂肪肝。
translation:
The bilateral thoracic cage appears symmetrical, with the mediastinum and trachea centrally located. The lung markings are normal. In the right upper lobe, there is a lobulated mass-like high-density area measuring approximately 1.8×1.3 cm, with associated bronchial rigidity and narrowing, adjacent pleural retraction, and surrounding ground-glass opacity. Multiple nodules are observed in the lower lobes of both lungs, the largest of which (Se5, Im141-144) is a solid nodule measuring approximately 5×4 mm. A small round lucent area without lung markings is noted in the right lower lobe. No abnormal morphology is seen in the bronchi of either lung lobe or segment. Calcified lymph nodes are present at the right hilum, and multiple lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum without significant enlargement. Calcifications are visible in the aorta and coronary artery regions, with the aorta slightly widened, measuring approximately 4.2 cm in diameter. No abnormalities are noted in the pleura on either side.

Incidental finding: The liver parenchyma shows unevenly reduced density, with a CT mean value of approximately 30 HU.

Chest CT scan findings:
1. Nodule in the right upper lobe, with a high suspicion of carcinoma; further investigation is recommended if necessary to rule out other conditions.
2. Multiple small nodules in both lungs; bulla in the right lower lobe.
3. Calcified lymph nodes at the right hilum; atherosclerosis, with a slightly widened ascending aorta.

Incidental finding: Fatty liver.

report:
兩側胸廓形態對稱，縱隔及氣管居中，兩肺紋理增多，右肺門見一軟組織密度腫塊影，大小約50X38Mmm，邊緣可見分葉，邊界不清，周圍可見細長毛刺，其内可見支氣管管腔受壓變窄，走行截斷；雙肺見多發結節，部分部分爲磨玻璃及部分實性結節，邊界模糊，周圍可見多發條索，大者大小約20X16mm。兩肺多發類圓形無紋理透亮區，邊界清。縱隔内見多發淋巴結影，部分稍大，大者短徑約1.0cm。雙側胸膜局部增厚。主動脉及冠脉走行區見鈣化影。左側第2前肋、左側第9後肋、右側肩胛骨、右側胸10脊肋關節、腰1椎體可見不同程度高密度影。附見：甲狀腺密度欠均匀。
胸部HRCT平掃示：
1.右肺門占位、右上葉支氣管局部狹窄伴肺内多發結節，部分爲磨玻璃密度，符合肺Ca伴雙肺内多發轉移表現；
2.縱隔稍大淋巴結；雙側胸膜局部增厚；兩肺氣腫、局部肺大疱形成；
3.動脉粥樣硬化；
4.左側第2前肋、左側第9後肋、右側肩胛骨、右側胸10脊肋關節、腰1椎體多發骨轉移可能性大；
附見：甲狀腺改變，請結合超聲。

兩側大腦半球灰、白質界尚清，左側基底節區見斑點狀低密度影。腦室系統形態，位置及大小無异常。腦池、溝、裂無异常，中綫結構居中。
頭顱CT平掃示左側基底節區腔梗可能，必要時MRI助診。請結合臨床，隨診。
translation: The gray-white matter differentiation in both cerebral hemispheres is preserved. A punctate low-density area is observed in the left basal ganglia region. The ventricular system shows no abnormalities in shape, position, or size. The cisterns, sulci, and fissures are unremarkable, and the midline structures are centered. Non-contrast CT of the head suggests a possible lacunar infarct in the left basal ganglia region. MRI may be helpful for further evaluation if necessary. Please correlate with clinical findings and follow up as needed.

report:
腰椎生理曲度尚可，所示諸椎體邊緣可見骨質增生影，所示諸椎間隙未見明顯狹窄。腰3-4椎體後緣略呈小階梯樣改變。椎旁軟組織未見明顯异常。
腰椎攝片示：
1、腰椎退變；
2、腰3-4椎體輕度節段性不穩。
請結合臨床，隨診。
translation:
The physiological curvature of the lumbar spine is maintained. Osteophyte formation is observed at the margins of the vertebral bodies. No significant narrowing of the intervertebral spaces is noted. The prostate exhibits abnormal morphology with an irregular mass-like soft tissue signal, slightly lobulated at the edges. It shows low signal intensity on T1-weighted images and high signal intensity on T2-weighted images with fat suppression. The largest section measures approximately 66×60mm, with indistinct borders. The adjacent seminal vesicles are involved, with a small area of high signal on T1-weighted images in the right seminal vesicle. The mass extends posteriorly into the rectal mesentery, with unclear demarcation from the rectum, and the anterior margin is indistinct from the bladder. Multiple patchy areas of slightly high signal on fat-suppressed images are observed in the sacrum, right ischium, acetabulum, ilium, bilateral pubic bones, and proximal femurs, with localized bone destruction and soft tissue formation. Multiple patchy areas of slightly high signal on fat-suppressed images are also seen in the right gluteus medius, obturator internus and externus, and adductor magnus muscles.

The adjacent seminal vesicles, right ischium, acetabulum, ilium, bilateral pubic bones, proximal femurs, right gluteus medius, obturator internus and externus, and adductor magnus muscles extend posteriorly into the rectal mesentery, with unclear demarcation from the rectum. Both hip joints are in place, with no significant narrowing of the joint spaces. A small amount of fluid density is observed within the joint cavities.

Pelvic MRI plain scan indicates:
1. Prostatic mass with possible involvement of the seminal vesicles, bladder, and rectum, accompanied by hemorrhage in the right seminal vesicle. Consider carcinoma; please correlate with pathology. Multiple abnormal signals and localized bone destruction in the sacrum, right ischium, acetabulum, ilium, bilateral pubic bones, and proximal femurs suggest invasion/metastasis. Abnormal signals in the right gluteus medius, obturator internus and externus, and adductor magnus muscles suggest possible metastasis.
Please correlate with clinical follow-up.

The spleen is smooth in shape with homogeneous parenchymal density. The gallbladder is in a satisfactory position and size, with a non-thickened wall and no gallstones detected. There is no dilation or stones in the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts. The pancreas appears normal in shape and density. No abnormalities are seen in the renal parenchyma of both kidneys. No enlarged lymph nodes are observed in the abdominal or retroperitoneal regions.

A slightly hypodense area is noted on the posterior wall of the uterus, partially protruding beyond the contour, with an unclear boundary. The surrounding tissue spaces are relatively clear. No significant abnormal density is observed in the bilateral adnexa. The bladder is well distended with a smooth wall. No significant abnormalities are seen in the rectouterine pouch.

CT scan of the upper and mid-abdomen and pelvis without contrast shows:
1. A slightly hypodense lesion in segment 8 of the right hepatic lobe, suggestive of a hemangioma when compared with previous images;
2. A slightly hypodense lesion in the uterus, likely a uterine fibroid.

translation:
The cervical spine shows loss of normal curvature with localized kyphosis and osteophyte formation at the vertebral bodies and facet joints. There is posterior disc protrusion at C2/3 to C5/6 with corresponding dural sac compression. No thickening or calcification of the ligamentum flavum is observed, and there is no abnormal density within the spinal canal.

The thoracic spine exhibits a slightly straightened curvature with osteophyte formation at the vertebral bodies and facet joints. No thickening or calcification of the ligamentum flavum is observed, and there is no abnormal density within the spinal canal.

The lumbar spine shows loss of normal curvature with osteophyte formation at the vertebral bodies and facet joints. There is mild disc bulging at L2/3 to L4/5 and posterior disc protrusion at L5/S1 with corresponding dural sac compression. No thickening or calcification of the ligamentum flavum is observed, and there is no abnormal density within the spinal canal. Calcification of the posterior longitudinal ligament is noted at the L3/4 intervertebral space. Patchy areas of increased density are seen on the iliac surfaces of both sacroiliac joints, with joint spaces appearing preserved.

CT scan of the cervical, thoracic, and lumbar spine with 2D reconstruction shows:
1. Disc protrusion at C2/3 to C5/6; disc bulging at L2/3 to L4/5, and disc protrusion at L5/S1.
2. Degenerative changes in the cervical, thoracic, and lumbar spine; calcification of the posterior longitudinal ligament; possible osteitis condensans ilii of the bilateral sacroiliac joints.

translation:
Abdominal MRI without contrast: Axial T1WI, fat-suppressed T2, Dixon, DWI, ADC; Coronal T2WI; MR.  
Abdominal MRI with contrast: Liver-specific contrast agent with T1 three-phase enhancement and 15-minute delayed T1 enhancement.

The liver surface is smooth, with proportional lobes. Near the left hepatic lobe at the hepatic hilum, there is a mass-like abnormal signal with clear margins, measuring approximately 5.4×4.7×7.5 cm. It shows slightly low signal on T1WI, mixed high signal on T2WI, restricted diffusion on DWI and ADC, mild enhancement in the arterial phase, further enhancement in the venous and delayed phases, and low uptake in the hepatobiliary phase. The bile ducts at the hepatic hilum are not clearly visible, with significant intrahepatic bile duct dilation, more pronounced in the left lobe. The left branch of the portal vein and the inferior vena cava are locally compressed and narrowed, with partial obscuration of the left portal vein branch. The gallbladder is slightly displaced due to compression. In segment 7 of the liver, there is a patchy area with low signal on T1WI and high signal on T2WI, showing peripheral enhancement in the arterial phase and centripetal filling in the venous and delayed phases, with no significant restricted diffusion on DWI and ADC, measuring approximately 19 mm in diameter. No significant abnormalities are observed in the gallbladder region. No significant abnormal signals are seen in the pancreas and spleen. Both kidneys show cystic high signal on T2WI. Slightly enlarged lymph nodes are observed in the hepatic hilum, with the largest measuring approximately 10 mm in diameter.

Upper abdominal MRI without and with contrast indicates:
1. A mass near the left hepatic lobe at the hepatic hilum, with invasion and dilation of intrahepatic bile ducts, more pronounced in the left lobe, suggesting malignancy, possibly cholangiocarcinoma. There is compression and narrowing of the left branch of the portal vein and the inferior vena cava, with partial obscuration, and invasion cannot be ruled out. Slightly enlarged lymph nodes at the hepatic hilum.
2. Hemangioma in liver segment 7; renal cysts in both kidneys.

Please correlate with clinical follow-up.

translation:
Abdominal Imaging Sequences: Axial T1WI, DIXON, T2WI, T2WI with fat suppression, DWI, ADC; Coronal T2WI.

The left lobe of the liver is enlarged with heterogeneous density and shows localized undulating changes at the margins. Multiple patchy abnormal signal areas are observed within the liver, predominantly in the left lobe, where they coalesce into masses. These areas exhibit low signal on T1WI and mixed slightly high signal on T2WI. There is mild to moderate enhancement in the arterial phase, with reduced enhancement in the venous and delayed phases, and low uptake in the hepatobiliary phase. DWI and ADC show restricted diffusion. There is a filling defect in the main trunk and left branch of the portal vein with mild enhancement. The intrahepatic bile ducts in the left lobe are slightly dilated. Fluid signal is observed around the liver and spleen. The gallbladder is not enlarged, its wall is not thickened, and no abnormal signal is seen in the gallbladder. The pancreas and spleen show no abnormalities in size, shape, or signal. Both kidneys show small round high signal areas on T2WI. Multiple slightly enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the hepatic hilum and retroperitoneum.

Upper abdominal MRI without and with contrast shows:
1. Liver cancer with intrahepatic metastasis and tumor thrombus formation in the main trunk and left branch of the portal vein; slight dilation of intrahepatic bile ducts.
2. Liver cirrhosis; small amount of ascites.
3. Small renal cysts in both kidneys.
4. Slightly enlarged retroperitoneal lymph nodes.

Please correlate with clinical findings and follow up.

translation:
Imaging Procedure of Cervical, Thoracic, and Lumbar Spine: Sagittal T1WI, T2WI, T2WI with fat suppression; Axial T2WI with fat suppression.

The cervical spine shows a straightened curvature. There is a step-like change at the posterior margin of the C5-6 vertebral bodies, with mild osteophytic lipping observed at the vertebral edges. No significant narrowing of the intervertebral spaces is noted. The C5/6 disc is herniated towards the left posterior side, compressing the dural sac and cervical cord, leading to secondary stenosis of the spinal canal at this level. A high signal intensity is seen within the cervical cord on T2WI. Mild posterior and right posterior protrusions of the C2/3 to C4/5 and C6/7 discs are noted, with slight compression of the dural sac.

The lumbar spine also shows a straightened curvature. No significant osteophytic changes are observed at the vertebral edges, and there is no evidence of bone destruction or other abnormal signal changes. The intervertebral spaces are not significantly narrowed. The L4/5 and L5/S1 discs are protruding posteriorly, compressing the dural sac. The morphology of the spinal cord within the canal is normal, with no abnormal signal changes observed. A strip of high signal intensity on T2WI with fat suppression is seen in the interspinous ligaments from L3/4 to L5/S1.

Cervical and Lumbar Spine MRI Findings:
1. C5/6 disc herniation with corresponding level spinal canal stenosis and cervical cord compression and degeneration; mild protrusion of C2/3 to C4/5 and C6/7 discs.
2. L4/5 and L5/S1 disc protrusions.
3. Instability at the C5-6 vertebral segment; degenerative changes in the cervical and lumbar spine; edema in the interspinous ligaments from L3/4 to L5/S1.

Please correlate with clinical findings and follow-up.

translation:
The coronary artery distribution is right dominant, with normal origins of the left and right coronary arteries. The coronary artery calcium score is as follows: LM = 15.3, LAD = 192.72, LCX = 83.25, RCA = 115.04, with a total score of 406.31. 

Calcified plaques are observed in the wall of the LM, presenting as punctate calcifications, with mild eccentric luminal stenosis (1-24%). In the proximal segment of the LAD, calcified plaques are present, with moderate eccentric luminal stenosis (50-69%). A myocardial bridge is noted in the mid-segment of the LAD, which is superficial and approximately 2.5 cm in length. Calcified plaques are also present in this segment, with mild eccentric luminal stenosis (1-24%). No abnormal density or significant stenosis is observed in the distal segment of the LAD.

Calcified plaques are present in the wall of the RI, with moderate eccentric luminal stenosis (50-69%). In the proximal segment of the LCX, no abnormal density or significant stenosis is observed. However, in the distal segment, calcified plaques are present, with moderate eccentric luminal stenosis (50-69%). Calcified plaques are also observed in the wall of OM2, with mild stenosis (25-49%).

In the proximal segment of the RCA, calcified plaques are present, with mild eccentric luminal stenosis (1-24%). In the mid-segment, calcified plaques are observed, with mild eccentric luminal stenosis (25-49%). No abnormal density or significant stenosis is noted in the distal segment of the RCA.

Coronary CTA findings:
1. Coronary atherosclerosis (CAD-RADS 3);
2. Myocardial bridging in the mid-segment of the LAD.

translation:
Bilateral Knee Joint Imaging Sequences: Sagittal, Coronal, Axial PDWI with fat suppression; Sagittal T1WI.

The right knee joint is in place with a normal joint space, but there is narrowing of the patellofemoral joint space. There is cartilage wear on the articular surfaces of the patella and femur, with patchy high signal intensity on PDWI with fat suppression seen beneath the articular surface. Other bones show signs of osteophyte formation. The anterior and posterior horns of the medial and lateral menisci show spotty and linear high signal intensity on PDWI with fat suppression, not involving the articular surface. The anterior cruciate ligament and the quadriceps tendon at the patellar attachment show linear high signal intensity on PDWI with fat suppression. The posterior cruciate ligament, medial and lateral collateral ligaments, patellar tendon, and bilateral patellar retinacula show no abnormal signal morphology. A small amount of effusion is noted in the joint cavity.

The left knee joint is in place with a normal joint space. There is cartilage wear on the articular surface at the posterior edge of the patella, with patchy high signal intensity on PDWI with fat suppression beneath the articular surface. A round-like high signal intensity on PDWI with fat suppression is seen on the tibial plateau. Osteophyte formation is noted in the bones. The anterior and posterior horns of the medial and lateral menisci show spotty and linear high signal intensity on PDWI with fat suppression, not involving the articular surface. The anterior cruciate ligament shows linear high signal intensity on PDWI with fat suppression. The posterior cruciate ligament, medial and lateral collateral ligaments, patellar tendon, and bilateral patellar retinacula show no abnormal signal morphology. A small amount of effusion is noted in the joint cavity. There is slight varicose dilation of the veins on the medial side of the left lower leg.

translation:
CT of the abdomen with and without contrast:

1. An irregular soft tissue mass is observed between the gallbladder neck and the pancreatic head, with indistinct borders. The lesion is poorly demarcated from the descending part of the duodenum, measuring approximately 20mm x 43mm, and shows mild heterogeneous enhancement. The confluence of the common hepatic duct and cystic duct is not clearly visualized, with significant dilation of the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts, as well as the left and right hepatic ducts. The liver has a regular shape, with lobes proportionate within normal limits. Multiple patchy, slightly hypodense areas are seen within the liver parenchyma, most prominent in segment S5, measuring approximately 24mm x 17mm, with mild enhancement. A strip-like, slightly hypodense area is noted in the right hepatic lobe, accompanied by localized thickening of the liver capsule and surrounding soft tissue swelling and exudation. The spleen is smooth in contour with homogeneous parenchymal density. The gallbladder is enlarged with thickened walls and punctate high-density areas, and a round low-density area is seen in the neck. The pancreas is of acceptable size, shape, and density. A small round non-enhancing low-density lesion is noted in the left renal parenchyma, with no significant abnormalities in the right kidney and bilateral adrenal glands. Multiple lymph nodes are present in the hepatic hilum, some slightly enlarged; no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the retroperitoneum. Calcifications are noted in the walls of the abdominal aorta and its branches.

Impression:
1. Based on the clinical history, findings are suggestive of hilar cholangiocarcinoma with invasion of the gallbladder neck and the confluence of the common hepatic duct and cystic duct, resulting in significant dilation of the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts and gallbladder enlargement. The lesion is poorly demarcated from the descending duodenum, with multiple liver metastases and slightly enlarged lymph nodes in the hepatic hilum.
2. A slightly hypodense area in the right hepatic lobe with localized thickening of the liver capsule and surrounding soft tissue swelling and exudation, suggestive of a drainage tract.
3. Gallstones within the gallbladder and neck; small cyst in the left kidney.
