report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Polytraumaalarm: Patient aus 3 m Höhe von Leiter gestürzt. Retrograde Amnesie. Frage nach Traumafolgen.  
Die rechtfertigende Indikation wurde durch die zuständige, fachkundige Ärztin / durch den zuständigen, fachkundigen Arzt gestellt.  
Aufklärung und Einwilligung: 
Notfallindikation. Kontrolle der Nieren- und Schilddrüsenwerte empfohlen.  
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native Akquisition des Neurokraniums. Nach intravenöser Applikation von insgesamt 140 ml Xenetix 350 als Split-Bolus Akquisition des Kopfes, Halses, Thorax und Abdomens. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 1720,20 mGy*cm.  
Befund und Beurteilung: 
Es liegen konventionelle Aufnahmen der HWS vom 12.11.2023 sowie der LWS vom 10.11.2023 zum Vergleich vor.  
Neurokranium: 
Kleine 5 mm messende Hyperdensität links frontal - verdächtig auf kleine intrazerebrale Blutung. 
Keine frische oder sich demarkierende Ischämie. 
NPH-Aspekt bei Evans-Index von 0,39 und Erweiterung der Fissura Sylvii beidseits. 
Keine Mittellinienverlagerung. Keine Herniation. 
Schmales Galeahämatom links frontal  
Viszerokranium/Hals: 
Leichte Schleimhautschwellungen im rechten Sinus maxillaris, übrige Nasennebenhöhlen, Paukenhöhlen und Mastoidzellen frei belüftet.  
6 mm messende hypodense, randständig kalzifizierte Läsion im linken Schilddrüsenlappen.
Gefäßsystem: 
A. vertebralis beidseits durchgängig kontrastiert, jedoch rechtsseitig im V4-Segment an u.g. Fragment des Atlas unmittelbar angrenzend. 
Auch ansonsten keine Verletzung der großen Gefäße. 
Moderate Verkalkungen der Karotisbifurkation beidseits. Höhergradige Abgangsstenose der rechten A. carotis interna.
Teilthrombosierung der infrarenalen Aorta. 
Thorax: 
Kein Pneumothorax. Keine Pleuraergüsse, kein Hämatothorax. 
Kein Anhalt für eine Lungenkontusion oder Lungenlazeration. Keine Infiltrate. 
Herz grenzwertig groß. Koronar- und Aortensklerose.  
Abdomen: 
Keine freie Luft oder Flüssigkeit. 
Keine Verletzung der parenchymatösen Organe. 
Alte kortikale Parenchymdefekte der rechten Niere. 
Sigmadivertikulose.  
Skelettsystem: 
Mehrfragmentäre, dislozierte Fraktur des Atlas mit Beteiligung des vorderen Bogens rechts paramedian sowie des hinteren Bogens rechts- und linksseitig.
Nicht dislozierte Densfraktur (Typ II nach Anderson und d‘Alonzo)
Verdacht auf diskoligamentäre Begleitverletzung bei Inkongruenz im rechten Atlantoaxialgelenk. 
Fortgeschrittene degenerative Wirbelsäulenveränderungen mit mehrsegmentaler Osteochondrosis intervertebralis. 
Einliegende Hüft-TEP links. 
Zusammenfassung: 
Verdacht auf kleine intrazerebrale Blutung links frontal. 
Bild einer instabilen Verletzung der HWS mit mehrfragmentärer Fraktur des vorderen und hinteren Atlasbogens sowie Fraktur des Dens axis (Typ II nach Anderson und d‘Alonzo). 
Verdacht auf diskoligamentäre Begleitverletzung bei Inkongruenz im rechten Atlantoaxialgelenk.  
Anmerkung: 
Eine sofortige Befundbesprechung mit dem zuständigen Arzt der Unfallchirurgie ist erfolgt.
translation:
Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:
Polytrauma alert: Patient fell from a 3-meter height from a ladder. Retrograde amnesia. Question regarding traumatic injuries.
The justifying indication for the use of ionizing radiation was provided by the responsible, qualified physician.
Information and Consent:
Emergency indication. Monitoring of renal and thyroid function recommended.
Examination Technique:
Digital radiographs. Native acquisition of the neurocranium. Following intravenous administration of a total of 140 ml Xenetix 350 as a split-bolus, acquisition of the head, neck, chest, and abdomen was performed. Multiplanar reconstructions. Dose-length product: 1720.20 mGy*cm.
Findings and Assessment:
Conventional radiographs of the cervical spine from 11.12.2023 and lumbar spine from 11.10.2023 are available for comparison.
Neurocranium:
Small 5 mm hyperdensity in the left frontal lobe – suspicious for a small intracerebral hemorrhage.
No fresh or demarcating ischemia.
Normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) aspect with an Evans index of 0.39 and bilateral widening of the Sylvian fissures.
No midline shift. No herniation.
Small subgaleal hematoma left frontal.
Viscerocranium/Neck:
Mild mucosal swelling in the right maxillary sinus; other paranasal sinuses, tympanic cavities, and mastoid cells are well-aerated.
6 mm hypodense, peripherally calcified lesion in the left thyroid lobe.
Vascular System:
Vertebral arteries are bilaterally patent; however, the right vertebral artery in the V4 segment is in close proximity to the mentioned fragment of the atlas.
No other injuries to the major vessels.
Moderate calcifications in the carotid bifurcations bilaterally.
High-grade stenosis at the origin of the right internal carotid artery.
Partial thrombosis of the infrarenal aorta.
Thorax:
No pneumothorax, pleural effusion, or hemothorax.
No evidence of lung contusion or laceration. No infiltrates.
Heart borderline in size. Coronary and aortic sclerosis.
Abdomen:
No free air or fluid.
No injury to the parenchymal organs.
Old cortical parenchymal defects of the right kidney.
Sigmoid diverticulosis.
Skeletal System:
Comminuted, displaced fracture of the atlas involving the right paramedian anterior arch as well as the right and left posterior arches.
Non-displaced odontoid fracture (Type II according to Anderson and D’Alonzo).
Suspected disco-ligamentous injury due to incongruence in the right atlantoaxial joint.
Advanced degenerative changes in the spine with multisegmental osteochondrosis intervertebralis.
Left hip total endoprosthesis (TEP).
Summary:
Suspected small intracerebral hemorrhage in the left frontal lobe.
Imaging consistent with an unstable cervical spine injury, with a comminuted fracture of the anterior and posterior arches of the atlas and a fracture of the odontoid process (Type II according to Anderson and D’Alonzo).
Suspected disco-ligamentous injury due to incongruence in the right atlantoaxial joint.
Note:
An immediate discussion of the findings with the responsible trauma surgery physician has taken place.

report:
ANGIOSCANNER DES MEMBRES INFÉRIEURS

Indication :
Motif de la demande : AOMI bilatérale.
Antécédents du patient : tabagisme.

Protocole :
Acquisition volumique  hélicoïdal, après injection de produit de contraste iodé, et acquisition des coupoles diaphragmatiques aux avant-pieds. Reconstruction multiplannaires et CPR.

Résultats :
Aorte abdominale :
 Aorte de calibre normal, siège d'une infiltration athéromateuse au niveau sous-rénal discrète sans sténose significative.
 Une artère alimente chaque rein, sans disparité de calibre.
 Pas de sténose des artères viscérales abdominales.
A droite :
 Artères iliaques primitive et externe perméables, non-anévrismales, sans anomalies pariétales
 Artères fémorales commune occluse à sa moitié distale, sur 25 mm. 
 Artère fémorale profonde perméable, dont le flux est assuré par des branches issues de l'artère iliaque interne, de bon calibre.
 Artère fémorale superficielle occluse sur toute sa longueur, soit environ 356 mm.
 Artère poplitée occluse sur son tiers proximal sus-gonale, soit environ 90 mm, reprise par des collatérales issues de l'artère fémorale profonde par le biais du cercle anastomotique du genou.
 Artères tibiale antérieure et tibiale postérieure perméables au niveau de la cheville, alimentant une artère pédieuse et une arcade plantaire de calibre satisfaisant.
 Artère fibulaire perméable.
A gauche :
 Artères iliaques primitive et externe perméables, non-anévrismales, sans anomalies pariétales.
 Artères fémorales commune perméable, non-anévrismales, sans anomalies pariétales.
 Artères fémorales superficielle perméable, non-anévrismales, siège d'une infiltration athéromato-calcique sur ses deux tiers distaux, sans sténose significative (< 10 %).
 Absence de sténose à l’origine de l’artère fémorale profonde.
 Artère poplitée droite perméable, sans anomalies pariétales. Absence d’anévrisme.
 Artère fibulaire perméables.
 Artères tibiale antérieure et tibiale postérieur perméables au niveau de la cheville, alimentant une artère pédieuse et une arcade plantaire de calibre satisfaisant.

Conclusion :

Lésions classées : 
Etage aorto-iliaque : TASC B (sans sténose significative).
Etage fémoro-poplité droit : TASC D.
Etage fémoro-poplité gauche : infiltration athéromato-calcique sans sténose significative.
translation:
CT ANGIOGRAPHY OF THE LOWER LIMBS

Indication:
Reason for request: Bilateral peripheral artery disease (PAD).
Patient history: Smoking.

Protocol:
Helical volumetric acquisition following injection of iodinated contrast, covering from the diaphragmatic domes to the forefeet. Multiplanar and CPR reconstructions.

Results:
Abdominal Aorta:
 Aorta of normal caliber with mild atheromatous infiltration at the infrarenal level, without significant stenosis.
 One artery supplies each kidney, with no caliber disparity.
 No stenosis of the abdominal visceral arteries.
Right side:
 Common and external iliac arteries are patent, non-aneurysmal, with no wall abnormalities.
 Common femoral artery occluded at its distal half, over 25 mm.
 Deep femoral artery is patent, with flow maintained by branches from the internal iliac artery, of good caliber.
 Superficial femoral artery occluded along its entire length, approximately 356 mm.
 Popliteal artery occluded at its proximal third above the knee, approximately 90 mm, reconstituted by collaterals from the deep femoral artery via the knee anastomotic circle.
 Anterior and posterior tibial arteries are patent at the ankle, supplying a dorsalis pedis artery and a plantar arch of satisfactory caliber.
 Fibular artery is patent.
Left side:
 Common and external iliac arteries are patent, non-aneurysmal, with no wall abnormalities.
 Common femoral arteries are patent, non-aneurysmal, with no wall abnormalities.
 Superficial femoral arteries are patent, non-aneurysmal, with atheromatous-calcific infiltration in the distal two-thirds, without significant stenosis (< 10%).
 No stenosis at the origin of the deep femoral artery.
 Right popliteal artery is patent, with no wall abnormalities. No aneurysm.
 Fibular artery is patent.
 Anterior and posterior tibial arteries are patent at the ankle, supplying a dorsalis pedis artery and a plantar arch of satisfactory caliber.

Conclusion:

Lesion classification:
Aorto-iliac level: TASC B (without significant stenosis).
Right femoro-popliteal level: TASC D.
Left femoro-popliteal level: Atheromatous-calcific infiltration without significant stenosis.

 Segment moyen, excentrée,  responsable d'une sténose estimée à 63% et étendue sur 11 mm
 Segment distal, circonférentielle, responsable d'une sténose estimée à 40% et étendue sur 8.2 mm.

translation:
CORONARY CT ANGIOGRAPHY

Indication: History of hypertension. Reason: Acute coronary syndrome.

Protocol: Biphasic injection of iodinated contrast 370mg/ml. Good quality examination: minor artifacts but remains diagnostically reliable.

Results

Coronary Arteries: No congenital anomalies or abnormal course of the coronary arteries. Right coronary dominance.

Left System: 
Left main coronary artery: Originates normally from the left anterior sinus, with an eccentric atheromatous-calcified plaque causing minimal stenosis estimated at 20% and extending over 6.5 mm, showing signs of vulnerability: 
- Punctate calcification (< 3 mm).
- Positive remodeling (ratio > 1.1 compared to the average diameters upstream and downstream).

Left anterior descending artery: Infiltrated with multiple atheromatous-calcified stenotic plaques, the most significant being: 
- Ostial, eccentric, causing stenosis estimated at 30% and extending over 5.2 mm.
- Mid-segment, eccentric, causing stenosis estimated at 63% and extending over 11 mm.
- Distal segment, circumferential, causing stenosis estimated at 40% and extending over 8.2 mm.

Circumflex artery: Infiltrated with multiple atheromatous-calcified stenotic plaques, the most significant being: 
- Ostial, eccentric, causing stenosis estimated at 43% and extending over 6.4 mm, showing signs of vulnerability (hypodense plaques < 30 HU and positive remodeling).
- Distal segment, circumferential, causing moderate stenosis estimated at 66% and extending over 17 mm.

Right System: The right coronary artery originates normally from the right anterior sinus. It is infiltrated without focal stenosis.

No pleuro-parenchymal abnormalities within the limits of the exploration field.

Conclusion: CT scan classified as CAD-RADS 3 / P4 / HRP.

translation:
RIGHT SHOULDER ARTHROSCAN

Indication

Recurrent instability of the right shoulder.

Technique

Volumetric acquisition with multiplanar reconstructions following intra-articular injection of a radio-opaque preparation.

Results

No static glenohumeral abnormalities.

Bone and joint analysis:
- No humeral bone notch.
- No glenoid bone or cartilage lesions.
- Intact acromioclavicular and glenohumeral joints.

Labro-ligamentous analysis: No lesions of the glenoid labrum apart from degenerative changes.

Tendon analysis:
- Full-thickness tear of the supraspinatus tendon at its insertion with retraction to the glenoid (Patte type 03), approximately 24 mm from the bicipital groove. Associated fatty degeneration of the muscle belly classified as Goutallier grade 03 with muscle atrophy.

- Reduced subacromial space estimated at 4 mm.
- Intact subscapularis tendon.
- No subluxation of the long head of the biceps tendon.
- Bursitis of the subacromial-subdeltoid bursa.

Conclusion

Full-thickness tear of the supraspinatus tendon associated with intra-tendinous cleavage of the infraspinatus.

report:
ANGIOSCANNER DES TRONCS SUPRA-AORTIQUES
Indication :

Antécédents : patiente candidate pour un pontage.
Motif de la demande : Au Doppler :
• Sténose sévère de l'artère sous-clavière droite avec retentissement hémodynamique.
• Faux anévrisme de l'artère carotide interne.

Protocole :
Examen réalisé en mode hélicoïdal après injection de produit de contraste iodé au temps artériel.

Résultats :
Aorte thoracique ascendante de calibre normal, sans épaississement pariétal ni de sténose décelée.
Disposition modale des troncs supra-aortiques.
 
À droite :
• Tronc artériel brachio-céphalique : perméable sans anomalies pariétales.
• Artère sous-clavière : siège d'une plaque excentrée, régulière, mixte, sans remodelage positif, sans sténose significative (35 %), étendue sur 18 mm.
• Artère carotide commune et carotide externe : perméable sans anomalies pariétales.
• Artère carotide interne : tortueuse, siège d'une plaque bulbaire mixte par la présence d'un nombre modéré de calcifications, excentrée, responsable d'une sténose subtotale (> 95 %) étendue sur 25 mm, avec opacification du segment en amont qui est néanmoins collabé, filiforme.
• Artère vertébrale : siège d'une plaque à son segment V0, hypodense, régulière, excentrée, sans sténose significative (maximum de 30 %), étendue sur environ 02 mm.
 
À gauche :
• Artère sous-clavière : perméable sans anomalies pariétales.
• Artère carotide commune et carotide externe : perméable sans anomalies pariétales.
• Artère carotide interne : siège :
• D'une plaque bulbaire excentrée à surface régulière, mixte avec présence de quelques calcifications en son sein minimes, non sténosante.
• D'un kinking (angle < 60°) à son segment post-bulbaire.
• Artère vertébrale : hypoplasique, siège d'une plaque à son segment V1, hypodense, régulière, excentrée, sans sténose significative (maximum de 40 %), étendue sur environ 10 mm.
Les artères du polygone de Willis sont perméables, sans sténose décelable, hormis une infiltration athéromateuse du tronc basilaire.
 
Conclusion :
 
Sténose pré-occlusif de l'artère carotide interne gauche à son segment bulbaire sur plaque athéromateuse sans critères du vulnérabilité.
translation:
CT Angiography of the Supra-Aortic Trunks

Indication:

History: Patient is a candidate for bypass surgery.
Reason for request: On Doppler:
- Severe stenosis of the right subclavian artery with hemodynamic impact.
- Pseudoaneurysm of the internal carotid artery.

Protocol:
Examination performed in helical mode after injection of iodinated contrast during the arterial phase.

Findings:
The ascending thoracic aorta is of normal caliber, with no wall thickening or detected stenosis.
Normal arrangement of the supra-aortic trunks.

Right side:
- Brachiocephalic trunk: patent with no wall abnormalities.
- Subclavian artery: contains an eccentric, regular, mixed plaque without positive remodeling, no significant stenosis (35%), extending over 18 mm.
- Common carotid and external carotid arteries: patent with no wall abnormalities.
- Internal carotid artery: tortuous, with a mixed bulbous plaque containing a moderate number of calcifications, eccentric, causing a subtotal stenosis (> 95%) extending over 25 mm, with opacification of the upstream segment which is collapsed and threadlike.
- Vertebral artery: contains a plaque in its V0 segment, hypodense, regular, eccentric, without significant stenosis (maximum of 30%), extending over approximately 2 mm.

Left side:
- Subclavian artery: patent with no wall abnormalities.
- Common carotid and external carotid arteries: patent with no wall abnormalities.
- Internal carotid artery: features:
  - An eccentric bulbous plaque with a regular surface, mixed with a few minimal calcifications, non-stenosing.
  - A kinking (angle < 60°) in its post-bulbar segment.
- Vertebral artery: hypoplastic, contains a plaque in its V1 segment, hypodense, regular, eccentric, without significant stenosis (maximum of 40%), extending over approximately 10 mm.
The arteries of the circle of Willis are patent, with no detectable stenosis, except for atherosclerotic infiltration of the basilar trunk.

Conclusion:

Pre-occlusive stenosis of the left internal carotid artery at its bulbous segment due to an atherosclerotic plaque without vulnerability criteria.

translation:

Indication
FRP under treatment, follow-up.

Protocol
The examination was performed with volumetric acquisition before and after contrast injection in a tri-phasic mode. No prior radiological documents were available for comparison.

Findings

There is persistent infiltration of the retroperitoneal fat, presenting as a peri-aortic cuff measuring 31 x 60 mm (W x H), surrounding the sub-renal abdominal aorta over more than 180° with relative sparing of the posterior aspect, extending to the left common iliac artery, with mild enhancement in the delayed phase. 
There are a few retroperitoneal lymph nodes without concerning features.
The aorta is not displaced, remains patent, and shows some parietal calcifications without detectable stenosis.
Its visceral branches are patent.
No stenosis of the inferior vena cava is observed.
Both kidneys and the spleen appear normal on CT, with no dilation of the pyelocaliceal systems.
The ureters are long and slender, remaining distant from this infiltration.
The gonadal veins are preserved.
No digestive stenosis is noted.

Additionally:
Thoracic region:
No parenchymal lesions are seen in either the interstitial or alveolar sectors.
Vascular structures are normally positioned, of usual caliber, and patent.
No hilar or mediastinal lymphadenopathy is present.
No pleural or pericardial effusion is observed.

Abdominal-pelvic region:
The liver is of normal size, with homogeneous enhancement and regular contours.
The portal vein is patent and of normal caliber.
No dilation of the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts.
The gallbladder is not distended, with a thin wall.
The pancreas is of normal size, with homogeneous enhancement. No dilation of the ductal structures.
The spleen is of normal size and usual density.
Both adrenal glands are intact.

No intra-peritoneal fluid collection is observed.
No suspicious bone lesions are noted in the explored volume.

Conclusion:
Appearance consistent with FRP with persistent mild enhancement. A comparison with the previous examination is recommended to assess treatment progress.

report:
SCANNER THORACO ABDOMINO PELVIEN
Indication : Motif de la demande : contrôle.Antécédents du patient : néoplasie mammaire au stade métastatique sous hormonothérapie.
Protocole :
Coupes volumiques avec reconstruction fine multi planaire sans et avec injection de produit de contraste.Examen de contrôle réalisé comparativement à celui du 20/02/2024.
 
Résultats :
A l'étage thoracique :
Augmentation en volume du nodule mammaire du QIE droit en zone profonde de 27 x 22 x 21 mm (AP x T x H) vs 18 x 16 x 16 mm.
Augmentation de volume des adénopathies axillaires intéressant les zones I et III de Berg, grossièrement arrondies, à limites externes irrégulières, rehaussées dont une avec nécrose centrale. 
Absence d'adénopathie ou d'adénomégalies axillaires gauches, sus-claviculaires ainsi que mammaires internes.
Respect des chaînes ganglionnaires hilaires et médiastinales.
Absence de nodule pulmonaire suspect.
Pas d'épanchement pleural ou de épaississement particulier de la plèvre.
Pas d'épanchement péricardique.
Axe trachéo-bronchique libre.
 
A l'étage abdomino-pelvien :
Foie augmenté de taille (FH à 150 mm), globalement hypodense (< 40 UH avec gradient hépato-splénique > 10 UH), aux contours réguliers bien limités, sans signe de dysmorphie évidente. Il est le siège d'une lésion nodulaire à cheval sur les segments V et VI, sous-capsulaire, de rehaussement périphérique en mottes discontinues avec remplissage progressif, stable depuis l'examen du 11/06/2020 d'approximativement 30 mm de grand axe, en rapport avec un angiome hépatique typique;
Formation nodulaire splénique, arrondie aux contours réguliers bien limités, de 20 x16 x 18 mm de grands axes (T x AP x H), légèrement hypodense par rapport au parenchyme splénique, faiblement rehaussée après contraste, en rapport avec une localisation secondaire
Formation nodulaire surrénalienne droite, arrondie bien limitée de 10 mm de grand axe (contre 07 mm sur l'examen du 11/06/2020)
Respect de la surrénale gauche.
Absence d’adénomégalie de taille significative intra ou rétro péritonéale.
Absence d'épanchement péritonéal notamment dans le cul de sac de Douglas.

Par ailleurs : 
Tronc porte est perméable, de calibre normal.
Absence de dilatation des voies biliaires intra ou extra hépatiques.
Vésicule biliaire non distendue, à paroi fine.
Pancréas de taille normale, de rehaussement homogène. Il n'y a pas de dilatation des structures canalaires.
Rate de taille normale et de densité habituelle. .
Surrénales sans anomalies.
Reins de taille et de situation normales, opacifiés dans les délais habituels sans dilatation des cavités pyélocalicielles.
Kyste rénal simple, polaire supérieur gauche, à développement exophytique interne de 15x22mm de grands axes classé Bosniak I.
Vessie de capacité normale, à paroi fine et régulière.
Defect de la ligne blanche sus ombilicale de 34 x 30 mm (T x H), laissant passer un sac herniaire à contenu épiploïque de 47 x 79 x 94 mm (T x AP x H) sans signe de complications.
 
Trame osseuse :
Persistance de la lésion osseuse sacro-coccygienne lytique, étendue aux 2ème, 3ème et 4èmes vertèbres sacrées ainsi qu'au coccyx, prenant les foramens sacrés correspondant et étendue aux arcs postérieurs, hétérogène par la présence de quelques débris osseux en son sein ,aux contours flous mal limités avec rupture de la corticale par endroit.
Lésion ostécondensante du grand torchanter gauche, stable comparativement à l'examen du 24/05/2023.
Absence d'autre lésion osseuse suspecte sur le volume exploré.

Conclusion :

RESICT : maladie en progression .
Augmentation significative de la lésion splénique d'allure secondaire.
Augmentation du volume de la masse mammaire droite.
translation:
THORACO-ABDOMINO-PELVIC CT SCAN

Indication: Follow-up. Patient history: Metastatic breast cancer under hormone therapy.

Protocol:
Volumetric slices with fine multi-planar reconstruction, both with and without contrast injection. Follow-up examination compared to the one from 02/20/2024.

Results:

Thoracic region:
Increase in size of the right breast nodule in the deep inner quadrant, measuring 27 x 22 x 21 mm (AP x T x H) compared to 18 x 16 x 16 mm.
Enlargement of axillary lymph nodes in Berg zones I and III, roughly rounded with irregular outer margins, enhanced, one with central necrosis.
No axillary, supraclavicular, or internal mammary lymphadenopathy on the left side.
Hilar and mediastinal lymph node chains are preserved.
No suspicious pulmonary nodule.
No pleural effusion or significant pleural thickening.
No pericardial effusion.
Tracheobronchial axis is clear.

Abdomino-pelvic region:
Liver is enlarged (FH at 150 mm), generally hypodense (< 40 HU with a hepato-splenic gradient > 10 HU), with well-defined regular contours, no obvious signs of dysmorphia. It contains a nodular lesion straddling segments V and VI, subcapsular, with peripheral nodular enhancement and progressive filling, stable since the exam on 06/11/2020, approximately 30 mm in long axis, consistent with a typical hepatic hemangioma.
Splenic nodular formation, rounded with well-defined regular contours, measuring 20 x 16 x 18 mm (T x AP x H), slightly hypodense compared to splenic parenchyma, mildly enhanced post-contrast, consistent with a secondary localization.
Right adrenal nodular formation, rounded and well-defined, 10 mm in long axis (compared to 07 mm on the exam from 06/11/2020).
Left adrenal gland is preserved.
No significant intra or retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy.
No peritoneal effusion, particularly in the Douglas pouch.

Additionally:
Portal vein is patent, with normal caliber.
No dilation of intra or extrahepatic bile ducts.
Gallbladder is not distended, with a thin wall.
Pancreas is of normal size, with homogeneous enhancement. No ductal structure dilation.
Spleen is of normal size and usual density.
Adrenals show no abnormalities.
Kidneys are of normal size and position, opacified within usual timeframes without pyelocaliceal cavity dilation.
Simple renal cyst, upper left pole, with internal exophytic development measuring 15 x 22 mm in long axes, classified as Bosniak I.
Bladder has normal capacity, with a thin and regular wall.
Defect in the linea alba above the umbilicus measuring 34 x 30 mm (T x H), allowing passage of a hernial sac with epiploic content measuring 47 x 79 x 94 mm (T x AP x H) without signs of complications.

Bone structure:
Persistence of the sacrococcygeal lytic bone lesion, extending to the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th sacral vertebrae as well as the coccyx, involving the corresponding sacral foramina and extending to the posterior arches, heterogeneous due to the presence of some bony debris within, with poorly defined fuzzy contours and cortical disruption in places.
Osteoblastic lesion of the left greater trochanter, stable compared to the exam from 05/24/2023.
No other suspicious bone lesion in the explored volume.

Conclusion:

RESICT: Disease progression.
Significant increase in the secondary-appearing splenic lesion.
Increase in the volume of the right breast mass.

report:
IRM ENCÉPHALIQUE

Indication

Antécédents : trisomie 21. 
Motif : exploration d'AVC ischémiques à répétition.

Protocole

Coupes axiales en FLAIR, diffusion, T2 EG, sagittales en T1 et coronales en T2
Séquences vasculaire 3D TOF et 3D T1 après injection de gadolinium.

Résultats

Multiples lésions lacunaires bilatérales des centres semi-ovales, de signal similaire à celui du LCS sur toutes les séquences, d'origine ischémique systématisées au territoire jonctionnel profond.
Cavité porencéphalique pariétale gauche, cernée par de la gliose périphérique, en rapport avec un AVC sequellaire dans le territoire jonctionnel superficiel postérieur. 
Pas de lésion ischémique récente sur la séquence de diffusion.
Visualisation d'un microbleed lenticulaire gauche.
Sur la séquence vasculaire on note une sténose des portions terminales des artères carotidiennes ainsi que du segments initiaux l'ACM droite à sa portion M1, de la portion M1 de l'ACM gauche sur toute sa longueur et des portions A1 des ACA de façon bilatérale. Le flux est repris en par le biais de multiples collatérales au niveau des noyaux gris centraux prenant un aspect en "volûte de fumée", se traduisant par des flow void sur la séquence T2/FLAIR. On ne note pas de développement d'une circulation collatérale à partir de la circulation postérieure ou de la carotide externe.
Bonne perméabilité des artères temporales superficielles qui sont de calibre satisfaisant.
Sur les séquences de perfusion, on note une diminution du rCBF en frontal de façon bilatérale, contrastant avec un rCBV normal à augmenté avec allongement du MTT par endroit. Respect des aspects perfusionnels dans les territoires de la circulation postérieure.

Conclusion

Aspect IRM d'un syndrome de Moya-moya avec hypoperfusion prédominante en frontale de façon bilatérale plus marquée à gauche.
translation:
BRAIN MRI

Indication

History: Down syndrome.
Reason: Investigation of recurrent ischemic strokes.

Protocol

Axial slices in FLAIR, diffusion, T2 GRE, sagittal in T1, and coronal in T2.
3D TOF and 3D T1 vascular sequences post-gadolinium injection.

Findings

Multiple bilateral lacunar lesions in the semi-oval centers, with signal characteristics similar to CSF on all sequences, of ischemic origin localized to the deep watershed territory.
Left parietal porencephalic cavity, surrounded by peripheral gliosis, related to a chronic stroke in the posterior superficial watershed territory.
No recent ischemic lesions on the diffusion sequence.
A left lenticular microbleed is observed.
The vascular sequence shows stenosis of the terminal portions of the carotid arteries as well as the initial segments of the right MCA at its M1 portion, the entire M1 portion of the left MCA, and the A1 portions of the ACAs bilaterally. Flow is maintained through multiple collaterals at the level of the basal ganglia, giving a "puff of smoke" appearance, resulting in flow voids on the T2/FLAIR sequence. No development of collateral circulation from the posterior circulation or the external carotid artery is noted.
The superficial temporal arteries are patent with satisfactory caliber.
Perfusion sequences show a decrease in rCBF in the frontal regions bilaterally, contrasting with normal to increased rCBV and prolonged MTT in some areas. Perfusion aspects in the posterior circulation territories are preserved.

Conclusion

MRI features consistent with Moyamoya syndrome with predominant frontal hypoperfusion, more pronounced on the left.

report:
IRM ENCÉPHALIQUE
 
Indication
Antécédents : HTA.
Motif : trouble de la conscience d’apparition brutale.
 
Protocole
Coupes axiales en FLAIR, diffusion, SWI, sagittales en T1 et coronales en T2.
Séquences vasculaire 3D TOF et 3D T1 après injection de gadolinium.
 
Résultats
Hématome fronto-pariétal droit s'étendant à la vallée Sylvienne, grossièrement ovalaire bien limité mesurant 47 x 53 x 31 mm (AP x T x H soit un volume de 40 cc), se présentant en hyposignal T2 avec important blooming en SWI en, hypo à isosignal T1, témoignant de son caractère aigu, entouré par une plage oedémateuse en hypersignal T2/FLAIR, hypersignal diffusion avec franche restriction en rapport avec une composante ischémique.
Celui-ci est expansif, responsable d'un engagement sous-falcoriel avec déviation de la ligne médiane mesuré à 06 mm.
Comblement des sillons de la convexité de façon bilatérale ainsi que des citernes de la base et de la vallée Sylvienne droite, se présentant en hypersignal T2/FLAIR, hyposignal SWI.
Inondation intra-ventriculaire minime des deux cornes occipitales ainsi que du V3 et du V4 se présentant en hypersignal T2/FLAIR, hyposignal SWI, sans dilatation du système ventriculaire.
 
Individualisation d'un anévrisme sacciforme à la jonction M1/M2 de l'ACM droite présentant les caractéristiques suivantes :
• Mensurations : 02 mm (collet) x 04 mm (longueur).
• Ratio dome/neck : 2.
• Limites : régulières.
• Directions : en bas en dedans et en avant.
• Opacification : demeure perméable.
Sinus veineux duremériens perméables.
 
Par ailleurs :
Anomalies de signal arrondies de la substance blanche profonde péri-ventriculaire, non expansives, se présentant en hypersignal T2/FLAIR sans traduction sur la Diffusion, non rehaussées après contraste.
FCP : pas d'anomalie de signal du tronc cérébral ou des hémisphères cérébelleux.
Pas d'anomalie de la charnière cervico-occipitale.
 
Conclusion
Anévrisme sacciforme de la jonction M1/M2 de l'ACM droite rompu compliqué d'un hématome intra-parenchymateux aigu associé à une HSA classés IV de Fisher.
Ischémie parenchymateuse du territoire superficiel de l'ACM droite.
translation:
BRAIN MRI

Indication
History: Hypertension.
Reason: Sudden onset of altered consciousness.

Protocol
Axial slices in FLAIR, diffusion, SWI, sagittal in T1, and coronal in T2.
3D TOF vascular sequences and 3D T1 post-gadolinium injection.

Findings
Right fronto-parietal hematoma extending to the Sylvian fissure, roughly oval-shaped, well-defined, measuring 47 x 53 x 31 mm (AP x T x H, with a volume of 40 cc), appearing as T2 hypointense with significant blooming on SWI, hypo to isointense on T1, indicating its acute nature, surrounded by an edematous area with T2/FLAIR hyperintensity, diffusion hyperintensity with marked restriction related to an ischemic component.
It is expansive, causing subfalcine herniation with a midline shift measured at 6 mm.
Bilateral filling of the convexity sulci as well as the basal cisterns and right Sylvian fissure, appearing as T2/FLAIR hyperintense, SWI hypointense.
Minimal intraventricular hemorrhage in both occipital horns as well as the third and fourth ventricles, appearing as T2/FLAIR hyperintense, SWI hypointense, without ventricular system dilation.

Identification of a saccular aneurysm at the M1/M2 junction of the right MCA with the following characteristics:
• Measurements: 2 mm (neck) x 4 mm (length).
• Dome/neck ratio: 2.
• Margins: regular.
• Direction: downward, inward, and forward.
• Opacification: remains patent.
Dural venous sinuses are patent.

Additionally:
Rounded signal abnormalities in the deep periventricular white matter, non-expansive, appearing as T2/FLAIR hyperintense without diffusion correlation, not enhanced post-contrast.
Posterior fossa: no signal abnormality in the brainstem or cerebellar hemispheres.
No abnormality at the cervico-occipital junction.

Conclusion
Ruptured saccular aneurysm at the M1/M2 junction of the right MCA complicated by an acute intraparenchymal hematoma associated with a Fisher grade IV subarachnoid hemorrhage.
Parenchymal ischemia in the superficial territory of the right MCA.

report:
IRM ENCÉPHALIQUE
 
Indication
Antécédents : cardiopathie sous traitement.
Motif : troubles de la conscience avec hémiplégie + PFP gauche.
 
Protocole
Coupes axiales en FLAIR, diffusion, T2 EG, sagittales en T1 et coronales en T2
Séquences vasculaire 3D TOF et 3D T1 après injection de gadolinium.
 
Résultats
Plage lésionnelle cortico-sous-corticale fronto-pariéto-temporale droite systématisée au territoire de l'ACM et de l'ACA homolatérales, se présentant en hypersignal T2/FLAIR, hyposignal T1, hypersignal diffusion (b1000) avec restriction de celle-ci, hétérogène par la présence de remaniements hémorragiques en son sein linéaires/punctiformes ainsi qu'à type d'hématome en hyposignal T2*, occupant moins de 30 % du volume de l'infarctus (38 x 20 x32 mm AP x T x H, soit un volume de 126 cc) soit classé PH1 selon la classification ECASS 02. Il s'y associe une hémorragie intra-ventriculaire minime au niveau de la corne occipitale du VL homolatéral.
Cette plage exerce un effet de masse sur le parenchyme cérébral adjacent, avec :
• Engagement sous falcoriel avec déviation de la ligne médiane estimé à 18 mm.
• Engagement temporal droit. Avec bâillement paradoxal de la citerne quadrigéminal.
• D'une hydrocéphalie d'exclusion gauche sans signes de résorption trans-épendymaire.
Sur la séquence vasculaire, on note une occlusion de la carotide interne à partir de son segment C5 avec stigmates de ralentissement de flux en aval.
 
Par ailleurs :
Anomalies de signal arrondies de la substance blanche profonde et péri-ventriculaire sus tentorielle, non expansives, se présentant en hypersignal T2/FLAIR sans traduction sur la Diffusion, non rehaussées après contraste, classées FAZEKAS 02.FCP : pas d'anomalie de signal du tronc cérébral ou des hémisphères cérébelleux.
Sinus veineux duremériens perméables.
Pas d'anomalie de la charnière cervico-occipitale.
 
Conclusion
AVC ischémique aigu systématisé aux territoires de l'ACM et de l'ACA droites sur occlusion de la portion C5 de la carotide interne, avec remaniements hémorragiques type PH1, responsable d'engagements sous-falcoriel et temporal droit.
translation:
BRAIN MRI

Indication
History: Heart disease under treatment.
Reason: Consciousness disturbances with hemiplegia and left facial palsy.

Protocol
Axial slices in FLAIR, diffusion, T2 GRE, sagittal in T1, and coronal in T2.
3D TOF vascular sequences and 3D T1 post-gadolinium injection.

Findings
A lesion area in the right fronto-parieto-temporal cortico-subcortical region, corresponding to the territory of the ipsilateral MCA and ACA, appears as T2/FLAIR hyperintense, T1 hypointense, diffusion hyperintense (b1000) with restricted diffusion, heterogeneous due to linear/punctate hemorrhagic changes and a hematoma-like T2* hypointense area, occupying less than 30% of the infarct volume (38 x 20 x 32 mm AP x T x H, with a volume of 126 cc), classified as PH1 according to the ECASS 02 classification. There is also a minimal intraventricular hemorrhage in the occipital horn of the ipsilateral lateral ventricle.

This area exerts a mass effect on the adjacent brain parenchyma, with:
• Subfalcine herniation with a midline shift estimated at 18 mm.
• Right temporal herniation with paradoxical widening of the quadrigeminal cistern.
• Left exclusion hydrocephalus without signs of transependymal resorption.

On the vascular sequence, there is an occlusion of the internal carotid artery starting from its C5 segment with downstream flow slowing signs.

Additionally:
Rounded signal abnormalities in the deep and periventricular white matter above the tentorium, non-expansive, appearing as T2/FLAIR hyperintense without diffusion restriction, not enhanced post-contrast, classified as FAZEKAS 02. Brainstem and cerebellar hemispheres show no signal abnormalities.
Dural venous sinuses are patent.
No abnormalities at the cervico-occipital junction.

Conclusion
Acute ischemic stroke in the territories of the right MCA and ACA due to occlusion of the C5 segment of the internal carotid artery, with PH1 type hemorrhagic changes, causing subfalcine and right temporal herniations.

report:
IRM ENCÉPHALIQUE
Indication

Antécédents : méningiome opéré  en 2017.                                                        
Motif : recrudescence des céphalées  avec exopthalmie gauche.

Protocole

Coupes axiales en FLAIR, diffusion, T2 EG, sagittales en T1 et coronales en T2
Séquences 3D T1 après injection de gadolinium.

Résultats

Examen réalisé comparativement à celui du 28/12/2023 : 
Stabilité du processus tumoral extra-axial des étages moyen et postérieur de la base du crâne, latéralisé à gauche, aux contours réguliers bien limités, mesurant actuellement 48 x 46 x 37 mm (T x H x AP) (contre 45 x 48 x 34 mm à l'examen du 28/12/2023), se présentant en hypersignal T2, isosignal T1, fortement rehaussé après injection de gadolinium.
Celui-ci présente les extensions suivantes :
- En dedans : à la loge sellaire refoulant le parenchyme pituitaire en haut et en dehors, et aux deux sinus caverneux, engainant les artères carotides internes sur 360°, sans diminution de leur calibre.
- En dehors : arrive au contact du lobe temporal gauche.
- En avant : au cavum de Meckel ainsi qu'en intra-orbitaire via la fissure orbitaire supérieure, entourant le nerf optique, qui reste de signal habituel. Cette extension est responsable d'une exophtalmie de grade 02 (distance orbite-ligne bi-canthal de 03 mm).  
- En arrière : comblement des citernes pré-pontique et arquée gauche, exerçant un effet de masse sur le pont et le pédoncule cérébrale gauche sans anomalie de leur signal, et refoulant l'artère basilaire vers la droite sans anomalie de son calibre.
- En haut : comblement de la citerne supra-sellaire et arrivant au contact du chiasma optique, sans anomalie de son signal.
Ptose des amygdales cérébelleuses à 10 mm au-dessous du foramen magnum.
Système ventriculaire de taille normale.
Remaniements séquellaires du parenchyme temporal gauche avec ectasie passive de la corne temporale du VL gauche.
Quelques anomalies de signal de la substance blanche profonde sus-tentorielle, se présentant en hypersignal T2/FLAIR sans traduction sur la séquence de diffusion, sans rehaussement après injection de gadolinium non spécifique.
A noter : comblement liquidien des cellules mastoïdiennes gauches.

Conclusion

Stabilité relative du méningiome comparativement à l'examen du 28/12/2023.
translation:
BRAIN MRI

Indication

History: Meningioma operated on in 2017.  
Reason: Increased headaches with left exophthalmos.

Protocol

Axial slices in FLAIR, diffusion, T2 GRE, sagittal in T1, and coronal in T2.  
3D T1 sequences after gadolinium injection.

Results

Exam compared to that of 12/28/2023:  
Stability of the extra-axial tumor process in the middle and posterior skull base, left-sided, with well-defined regular borders, currently measuring 48 x 46 x 37 mm (T x H x AP) (compared to 45 x 48 x 34 mm on the 12/28/2023 exam), appearing as T2 hyperintense, T1 isointense, and strongly enhanced after gadolinium injection.  
It presents the following extensions:  
- Medially: to the sellar region, displacing the pituitary parenchyma upwards and laterally, and to both cavernous sinuses, encasing the internal carotid arteries 360° without reducing their caliber.  
- Laterally: reaching the left temporal lobe.  
- Anteriorly: to Meckel's cave and intra-orbitally via the superior orbital fissure, surrounding the optic nerve, which remains of normal signal. This extension is responsible for grade 02 exophthalmos (orbit-bi-canthal line distance of 03 mm).  
- Posteriorly: filling the pre-pontine and left ambient cisterns, exerting a mass effect on the pons and left cerebral peduncle without signal abnormality, and displacing the basilar artery to the right without caliber abnormality.  
- Superiorly: filling the suprasellar cistern and reaching the optic chiasm, without signal abnormality.  
Cerebellar tonsillar descent 10 mm below the foramen magnum.  
Ventricular system of normal size.  
Sequelae changes in the left temporal parenchyma with passive dilation of the left lateral ventricle's temporal horn.  
Some signal abnormalities in the deep supratentorial white matter, appearing as T2/FLAIR hyperintense without diffusion sequence translation, no enhancement after gadolinium injection, nonspecific.  
Note: Fluid filling of the left mastoid cells.

Conclusion

Relative stability of the meningioma compared to the exam of 12/28/2023.

report:
IRM DU RACHIS LOMBAIRE

Indication :
Antécédents : Non précisés. Motif de consultation : Lombosciatalgies/lombalgies.
 
Protocole Coupes sagittales TSE en pondération T1 sans saturation de la graisse. Coupes sagittales et axiales TSE en pondération T2 sans saturation de la graisse. Examen réalisé sans injection de gadolinium.
 
Résultats

Absence de dysostoses rachidiennes évidentes sur le segment exploré.
Trouble de la statique à type de scoliose présentant les caractéristiques suivantes :
• Angle de Cobb estimé à 14,25°.
• Convexité gauche à vertèbre sommet L1.
• Vertèbres limites T11 - L4.
Antélisthésis léger (< 25 %) de L3 sur L4 par subluxation des articulations zygapophysaires.
Tassement vertébraux légers de L2 et L3 d'allure bénigne.
Absence d'anomalies de signal suspectes de l'os.
Remaniements dégénératifs rachidiens avec notamment arthrose zygapophysaire étagée.
A l'étage L1-L2 : bombement discal circonférentiel avec bec ostéophytique postérieur sans rétrécissement canalaire ou de conflit disco-radiculaire.
A l'étage L2-L3 : bombement discal circonférentiel avec hypertrophie des ligaments jaunes responsables :
• D'un rétrécissement canalaire classé B selon Schizas (diamètre AP 15 mm).
• D'une sténose bilatérale des récessus latéraux prédominant à droite.
• Absence de sténose foraminale.
A l'étage L3-L4 : bombement discal circonférentiel avec hypertrophie des ligaments jaunes responsables :
• D'un rétrécissement canalaire classé C selon Schizas (diamètre AP 09 mm).
• D'une sténose bilatérale des récessus latéraux de L4.
• D'une sténose légère foraminale gauche.
A l'étage L4-L5 et L5-S1 : bombements discaux sans rétrécissement canalaire ou de conflit disco-radiculaire.
Projection du cône médullaire en L1.
Absence d'anomalies de signal médullaires ou des racines sur les segments explorés.
Respect des parties molles péri vertébrales
 
Conclusion

Rachis dégénératif avec rétrécissements canalaires étagés plus sévère à l'étage L3-L4 associé à des sténoses des récessus latéraux.
translation:
MRI OF THE LUMBAR SPINE

Indication:
History: Not specified. Reason for consultation: Low back pain with sciatica/back pain.

Protocol:
Sagittal TSE T1-weighted images without fat saturation. Sagittal and axial TSE T2-weighted images without fat saturation. Examination performed without gadolinium injection.

Results:

No obvious spinal dysostosis in the examined segment.
Postural abnormality in the form of scoliosis with the following characteristics:
• Cobb angle estimated at 14.25°.
• Left convexity with the apex at L1.
• Limiting vertebrae T11 - L4.
Mild anterolisthesis (< 25%) of L3 over L4 due to subluxation of the facet joints.
Mild vertebral compression of L2 and L3 appearing benign.
No suspicious signal abnormalities in the bone.
Degenerative changes in the spine, notably with multilevel facet joint osteoarthritis.
At the L1-L2 level: circumferential disc bulge with posterior osteophyte formation without canal narrowing or disc-root conflict.
At the L2-L3 level: circumferential disc bulge with hypertrophy of the ligamentum flavum causing:
• Canal narrowing classified as grade B according to Schizas (AP diameter 15 mm).
• Bilateral lateral recess stenosis, more pronounced on the right.
• No foraminal stenosis.
At the L3-L4 level: circumferential disc bulge with hypertrophy of the ligamentum flavum causing:
• Canal narrowing classified as grade C according to Schizas (AP diameter 09 mm).
• Bilateral lateral recess stenosis at L4.
• Mild left foraminal stenosis.
At the L4-L5 and L5-S1 levels: disc bulges without canal narrowing or disc-root conflict.
Conus medullaris projects at L1.
No signal abnormalities in the spinal cord or nerve roots in the examined segments.
Preservation of the perivertebral soft tissues.

Conclusion:

Degenerative spine with multilevel canal narrowing, more severe at the L3-L4 level, associated with lateral recess stenosis.

translation:
ABDOMINO-PELVIC ULTRASOUND

Indication

Patient history: No significant medical history.
Reason: Right lower quadrant pain with abnormal blood work (12,000 WBC).

Protocol

The examination was performed on an emergency basis using a 5 MHz convex probe and a 9 MHz superficial probe.

Findings

The appendix, located internally and laterally to the cecum, was fully visualized and found to be enlarged, measuring 11 mm in diameter, while maintaining its usual layering. No fecalith was observed. No sonographically detectable fluid collection was visualized. There is fat stranding in the right lower quadrant with mesenteric hyperemia. A few lymph nodes in the right lower quadrant appear reactive. No intraperitoneal fluid accumulation was noted.

Additionally:
The liver is of normal size, with a homogeneous echotexture and usual echogenicity, and has regular contours. There is no dilation of the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts. The gallbladder is free of stones and has a thin wall. The pancreas, visualized in its body and head portions, is of normal size and echotexture. The spleen is of normal size and homogeneous echotexture. Both kidneys are of normal size and position, maintaining good corticomedullary differentiation. There is no dilation of the renal collecting systems. The bladder is partially filled, with anechoic content.

Conclusion

Ultrasound findings are suggestive of acute appendicitis without signs of complication at this time.

report:
ÉCHOGRAPHIE THYROÏDIENNE

Indication

Protocole
 
Examen réalisé avec une sonde de haute fréquence de 12MHz.

Résultats
 
La thyroïde est de taille normale présentant les mensurations suivantes :
 Lobe droit : volume estimé à 06 cm³.
 Lobe gauche : volume estimé à 07 cm³.
 Isthme fin et régulier.
 Absence d'extension médiastinale. 
Elle est d'échogénicité normale et d'échostructure homogène, à vascularisation habituelle au Doppler couleur.
Individualisation de deux nodules thyroïdiens de sémiologie similaire : solido-kystiques, ovalaires d'axe harmonieux, aux contours réguliers bien limités, dont la portion solide est iso-échogène par rapport au parenchyme thyroïdien adjacent, sans visualisation de microcalcifications en son sein, les classant EU-TIRADS 03. Ceux-ci siègent et mesurent comme suit :
 N1 : lobaire supérieur droit, de 07 x 12 x 09 mm de grands axes (AP x T x H).
 N2 : lobaire moyen gauche, de 04 x 07 x 06 mm de grands axes (AP x T x H).
Multiples formations ganglionnaires cervicales bilatérales sans critère échographique péjoratif.

Conclusion
 
Deux nodules thyroïdiens classés EU-TIRADS 03. Un contrôle à 01-02 ans est préconisé.
translation:
THYROID ULTRASOUND

Indication

Patient history: No significant findings.
Reason: Palpable cervical nodular lesion.

Protocol

The examination was performed using a high-frequency 12MHz probe.

Results

The thyroid is of normal size with the following measurements:
 Right lobe: estimated volume of 06 cm³.
 Left lobe: estimated volume of 07 cm³.
 Isthmus is thin and regular.
 No mediastinal extension.
The thyroid exhibits normal echogenicity and homogeneous echotexture, with usual vascularization on color Doppler.
Two thyroid nodules with similar characteristics were identified: solid-cystic, oval-shaped with harmonious axes, well-defined regular borders, with the solid portion being isoechoic compared to the adjacent thyroid parenchyma, and no microcalcifications observed within, classifying them as EU-TIRADS 03. Their locations and measurements are as follows:
 N1: upper right lobe, measuring 07 x 12 x 09 mm in major axes (AP x T x H).
 N2: middle left lobe, measuring 04 x 07 x 06 mm in major axes (AP x T x H).
Multiple bilateral cervical lymph node formations without adverse echographic criteria.

Conclusion

Two thyroid nodules classified as EU-TIRADS 03. A follow-up in 1-2 years is recommended.

translation:

translation:

translation: CT head without contrast. Artifacts hinder assessment, especially of the structures in the posterior fossa and base of the skull; otherwise: the brain shows no identifiable focal lesions, no obvious signs of bleeding or edema. The ventricular system is not dilated, not displaced, and symmetric. The subarachnoid spaces are of normal wiRXh. Air spaces in the mastoid processes and middle ear are preserved bilaterally. The skull bones show no identifiable fractures or destructive changes.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Niesymetryczne ustawienie ciała od zdjęcia. Kąty przeponowo – żebrowe wolne. Kopuły przepony ustawione w granicach normy. Obustronnie przywnękowo i w przyśrodkowych częściach dolnych pól płucnych wzmożony rysunek naczyniowo – śródmiąższowy (w tym miejscami okołooskrzelowy) płuc (mogący odpowiadać zmianom zapalnym). Cień serca wielkości w granicach normy, o uwypuklonej talii i uwypuklonych zarysach prawej środkowej części cienia środkowego (wada zastawek?, tylko efekt asymetrii ustawienia? - weryfikacja w USG serca i dużych naczyń).
translation: Chest X-ray PA: Asymmetric positioning of the body from the image. The costophrenic angles are clear. The diaphragmatic domes are within normal limits. Bilaterally, perihilar and in the medial lower lung fields, there is increased vascular and interstitial marking (including some peribronchial) which may correspond to inflammatory changes. The cardiac silhouette is of normal size, with an accentuated waist and prominent outlines of the right middle part of the mediastinal silhouette (valve defect? only an effect of positional asymmetry? - verification with echocardiography and large vessels).

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. Nieznaczne, okołownękowe wzmożenie rysunku naczyniowego. Poza tym-pola płucne bez zmian ogniskowych. Cień środkowy w normie.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. There is slight, perihilar increased vascular marking. Otherwise, the lung fields show no focal changes. The mediastinal silhouette is normal.

report: Opis badania: Badanie TK głowy wykonano bez wzmocnienia kontrastowego. Cech ostrego krwawienia śródczaszkowego nie uwidoczniono. Niejednoznaczny obraz lewego płata skroniowego - widoczny drobny obszar hyperdensyjny wielkości do około 15mm - możliwy artefakt od kości, przy czym wskazana ocena w badaniu MR. Poza tym gęstość tkankowa substancji białej i szarej prawidłowa. Układ komorowy nadnamiotowy prawidłowej wielkości, nieprzemieszczony. Struktury tylnojamowe i komora IV bez zmian. W obrębie części kostnych mózgoczaszki zmian nie uwidoczniono.
translation: Description of the study: The CT of the head was performed without contrast enhancement. No signs of acute intracranial bleeding were identified. Ambiguous appearance of the left temporal lobe - a small hyperdense area of up to about 15mm is visible - possibly an artifact from bone, indicating assessment in an MRI study. Otherwise, the density of the white and gray matter is normal. The supratentorial ventricular system is of normal size, not displaced. The posterior fossa structures and fourth ventricle show no changes. No changes were observed in the bony structures of the skull.

report: MR głowy ze wzmocnieniem kontrastowym; Kora mózgowa oraz istota biała o prawidłowej intensywności sygnału. Ognisk patologicznego wzmocnienia kontrastowego w strukturach mózgowia nie wykazano. Układ komorowy nieposzerzony, nieprzemieszczony, symetryczny. W przysadce mózgowej drobne ognisko hypointensywne po podaniu środka kontrastowego śr. ok 1,5mm - do rozważenia ocena w badaniu dedykowanym. Szyszynka o budowie torbielkowatej. Struktury środkowe nieprzemieszczone. Bruzdy mózgu i rowki móżdżku prawidłowej szerokości. Kompleksy nerwów VII i VIII nieposzerzone, prawidłowo otoczone płynem w obrębie przewodów słuchowych wewnętrznych. Migdałki móżdżku powyżej poziomu otworu wielkiego.
translation: MRI head with contrast: The cerebral cortex and white matter show normal signal intensity. No pathological contrast enhancement was detected in the brain structures. The ventricular system is not dilated, not displaced, and symmetric. In the pituitary gland, a small hypointense focus was observed following contrast administration, approximately 1.5mm - assessment in a dedicated study is recommended. The pineal gland has a cystic structure. The midline structures are not displaced. The brain sulci and cerebellar fissures are of normal wiRXh. The complexes of cranial nerves VII and VIII are not dilated, normally surrounded by fluid in the internal auditory canals. The cerebellar tonsils are above the level of the foramen magnum.

report:
MR mózgu i pnia mózgu bez i ze wzmocnieniem kontrastowym: W sekwencji DWI nie uwidoczniono cech restrykcji dyfuzji. W sekwencji SWI nie uwidoczniono obecności produktów rozpadu hemoglobiny. Po podaniu kontrastu nie uwidoczniono ognisk patologicznego wzmocnienia. Układ komorowy symetryczny, nieposzerzony. Wielkość przysadki mózgowej w normie. Kąty mostowo-móżdżkowe bez widocznej patologii. Przestrzenie płynowe przymózgowe w normie. Prawidłowy obraz połączenia czaszkowo-szyjnego. Oczodoły bez widocznych zmian. Zatoki oboczne nosa powietrzne.
Wnioski: Badanie wykazało prawidłowy obraz mózgowia i przestrzeni płynowych wewnątrzczaszkowych.
translation:
MRI of the brain and brainstem without and with contrast: In the DWI sequence, no signs of diffusion restriction were detected. In the SWI sequence, no presence of hemoglobin breakdown products was observed. After contrast administration, no foci of pathological enhancement were seen. The ventricular system is symmetric and not dilated. The size of the pituitary gland is normal. The cerebellopontine angles show no visible pathology. The pericerebral fluid spaces are normal. The cranio-cervical junction shows a normal appearance. The orbits are without visible changes. The paranasal sinuses are air-filled.
Conclusions: The study showed a normal appearance of the brain and intracranial fluid spaces.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo – żebrowe wolne. Kopuły przepony ustawione w granicach normy. Na wykonanym zdjęciu obustronnie w dolnych polach płucnych oraz prawym polu środkowym i lewostronnie przywnękowo wzmożenie rysunku naczyniowo – śródmiąższowego o charakterze zmian zapalnych. Obustronnie w polach nadprzeponowych oraz środkowych polach płucnych pasma bezpowietrznej tkanki płucnej. Obustronnie miejscami drobne cienie (mogące odpowiadać trafionym osiowo naczyniom krwionośnym i/lub zmianom typu lymphangiosis). Cień serca powiększony, o dyskretnie uwypuklonej talii (do rozważenia weryfikacja w USG serca i dużych naczyń). Skrzywienie kręgosłupa piersiowego i/lub pochylenie ciała w trakcie zdjęcia.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. The diaphragmatic domes are within normal limits. The image shows bilateral increased vascular and interstitial marking of an inflammatory nature in the lower lung fields, as well as in the right middle field and left perihilar region. Bilaterally, there are bands of airless lung tissue in the supradiaphragmatic and central lung fields. There are small shadows in some areas bilaterally (possibly corresponding to struck axial blood vessels and/or changes of lymphangiosis). The cardiac silhouette is enlarged, with a discreetly accentuated waist (consider verification with echocardiography and large vessels). There is a curvature of the thoracic spine and/or tilt of the body during the imaging.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. Pola płucne bez zmian ogniskowych. Cień środkowy w normie. Cień cewnika mózgowego w rzucie śródpiersia.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. The lung fields show no focal changes. The mediastinal silhouette is normal. A shadow of the gastric tube is noted in the mediastinal projection.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo – żebrowe wolne. Kopuły przepony o kilkułukowych zarysach, ustawione w granicach normy. Na wykonanym zdjęciu w rzucie prawego środkowego i środkowo – dolnego pola płucnego pasma bezpowietrznej tkanki płucnej; w rzucie obwodowej części prawego środkowo – dolnego pola płucnego delikatne przymglenie (mogące odpowiadać zmianom niedomowym/niedodmowo – zapalnym i/lub zaburzeniom perfuzji, lub zwiewnemu zagęszczeniu o charakterze mlecznej szyby). W rzucie przyśrodkowej części prawego dolnego pola płucnego cień śr. ok. 5mm (mogący odpowiadać trafionemu osiowo naczyniu krwionośnemu i/lub węzłowi chłonnemu w dgn.różn.m.in.: zmiana na skórze, ziarniniak/st.p.tbc – brak bliższych informacji oraz zdjęć poprzednich do ew.porównania). Obustronnie przywnękowo i w przyśrodkowych częściach dolnych pól płucnych wzmożony rysunek naczyniowo – śródmiąższowy (w tym miejscami okołooskrzelowy) płuc (mogący odpowiadać zmianom zapalnym/pozapalnym). Cień serca wielkości w granicach normy, o spłyconej talii. Skrzywienie kręgosłupa piersiowego. Do rozważenia dalsza diagnostyka m.in. CRP, d-dimery, TSH. Ze względu na używanie e-papierosów w dgn.różn. dolegliwości należy uwzględnić zespół EVALI.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. The diaphragmatic domes have several curved outlines, within normal limits. The image shows bands of airless lung tissue in the projection of the right middle and middle-lower lung fields; in the peripheral part of the right middle-lower lung field, there is a slight opacity (possibly corresponding to atelectasis/inflammatory changes and/or perfusion disorders, or a faint density of a ground-glass pattern). In the projection of the medial part of the right lower lung field, there is a shadow of approximately 5mm (possibly corresponding to a struck axial blood vessel and/or lymph node in differential diagnosis, including skin lesion, granuloma/st.p.tbc – no closer information and previous images for comparison). Bilaterally, there is increased vascular and interstitial marking (including some peribronchial) in the perihilar and medial lower lung fields (possibly corresponding to inflammatory/post-inflammatory changes). The cardiac silhouette is of normal size, with a flattened waist. There is curvature of the thoracic spine. Further diagnostics are to be considered, including CRP, d-dimers, TSH. Due to the use of e-cigarettes in differential diagnosis of complaints, EVALI syndrome should be considered.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Ustawienie niesymetryczne? lewostronna skolioza w odcinku piersiowym kręgosłupa? Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. Okołownękowe (o charakterze zapalnym) wzmożenie rysunku naczyniowego. Sylwetka serca ułożona poprzecznie.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: Asymmetric positioning? Left-sided scoliosis in the thoracic spine? The costophrenic angles are clear. There is perihilar (of an inflammatory nature) increased vascular marking. The cardiac silhouette is positioned transversely.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. W obu polach płucnych niejednolite zagęszczenia o charakterze zapalnym. Cień środkowy w normie.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. In both lung fields, there are heterogeneous opacities of an inflammatory nature. The mediastinal silhouette is normal.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. W środkowym prawym polu płucnym niejednolite zagęszczenia o charakterze zapalnym. Konieczna kontrola po leczeniu. Lewe pole płucne bez zmian ogniskowych. Sylwetka serca rtg w normie. Szerszy-zapalny-cień wnęki prawej.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. In the central right lung field, there are heterogeneous opacities of an inflammatory nature. Follow-up after treatment is necessary. The left lung field shows no focal changes. The cardiac silhouette is normal. There is a broader inflammatory shadow in the right hilum.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Zacienienie obwodowej części prawego, dolnego pola płucnego (płyn). W pozostałej części prawego dolnego pola płucnego oraz okołownękowo-po str. prawej - niejednolite zagęszczenia o charakterze zapalnym. Konieczna kontrola po leczeniu. Na poziomie końca żebra VI dość dobrze wysycony cień średnicy ok. 14mm - charakter niejednoznaczny. Lewy kąt przeponowo-żebrowy wolny. Nieznaczne, okołownękowe wzmożenie rysunku naczyniowego po str. lewej. Sylwetka serca ułożona poprzecznie. Możliwość obecności poj. poziomu płynu w jelicie na poziomie L5 po str. prawej.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: There is an opacity in the peripheral part of the right lower lung field (fluid). In the remaining part of the right lower lung field and perihilar on the right side - heterogeneous opacities of an inflammatory nature. Follow-up after treatment is necessary. At the level of the VI rib end, a well-saturated shadow of about 14mm in diameter is noted - of unclear character. The left costophrenic angle is clear. There is slight, perihilar increased vascular marking on the left side. The cardiac silhouette is positioned transversely. There is a possibility of the presence of fluid level in the intestine at the level of L5 on the right side.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. Kopuły przepony ustawione w granicach normy. W prawym dolnym polu płucnym pasma bezpowietrznej tkanki płucnej. Obustronnie przywnękowo i w przyśrodkowych częściach dolnych pól płucnych (nieco bardziej po stronie lewej) wzmożony rysunek naczyniowo-śródmiąższowy (w tym miejscami okołooskrzelowy) płuc (mogący odpowiadać zmianom zapalnym i/lub pozapalnym). Obustronnie miejscami drobne cienie (mogące odpowiadać trafionym osiowo naczyniom krwionośnym i/lub zmianom typu lymphangiosis). Cień serca wielkości w granicach normy, o uwypuklonej talii. Na wykonanym zdjęciu skrzywienie kręgosłupa piersiowego.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. The diaphragmatic domes are within normal limits. In the right lower lung field, there are bands of airless lung tissue. Bilaterally, there is increased vascular and interstitial marking (slightly more on the left side) in the perihilar and medial lower lung fields (possibly corresponding to inflammatory and/or post-inflammatory changes). There are small shadows bilaterally (possibly corresponding to struck axial blood vessels and/or lymphangiosis changes). The cardiac silhouette is of normal size, with an accentuated waist. The image shows curvature of the thoracic spine.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. Kopuły przepony ustawione w granicach normy. W rzucie lewego dolnego i środkowo-dolnego pola płucnego zagęszczenia plamisto-pasmowate o charakterze zmian zapalnych. Obustronnie miejscami drobne cienie (mogące odpowiadać trafionym osiowo naczyniom krwionośnym i/lub zmianom typu lymphangiosis). Na wykonanym zdjęciu oba szczyty nie w pełni objęte badaniem. Cień serca wielkości w granicach normy, o uwypuklonej talii (weryfikacja w USG serca i dużych naczyń). Skrzywienie esowate kręgosłupa piersiowego. Do rozważenia m.in. kontrolne rtg klp w trakcie i/lub po leczeniu.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. The diaphragmatic domes are within normal limits. In the projection of the left lower and middle-lower lung fields, there are patchy-banded opacities of an inflammatory nature. Bilaterally, there are small shadows (possibly corresponding to struck axial blood vessels and/or lymphangiosis changes). The image shows that both apices are not fully captured in the examination. The cardiac silhouette is of normal size, with an accentuated waist (verification with echocardiography and large vessels is recommended). There is a sigmoid curvature of the thoracic spine. Further control X-ray of the chest should be considered during and/or after treatment.

report: RTG mostka dwie projekcje: Niejednoznaczny obraz trzonu mostka II. żebra po str. lewej. Wskazana kons.orotop. i ew.usg serca (w celu wykluczenia stłuczenia mięśnia sercowego).
translation: Sternum X-ray two projections: Unclear image of the body of the sternum at the level of the second rib on the left side. Orthopedic consultation is indicated, and echocardiography is recommended (to rule out myocardial contusion).

report: RTG KLATKI PIERSIOWEJ p-a: Zacienienie prawego kąta przeponowo-żebrowego (płyn i/lub zrosty); lewy kąt wolny. Kopuły przepony ustawione w granicach normy. Na wykonanym zdjęciu w rzucie prawego pola nadprzeponowego pasma bezpowietrznej tkanki płucnej i/lub zmiany włókniste. Obustronnie w dolnych i częściowo środkowych polach płucnych wzmożony rysunek naczyniowo-śródmiąższowy płuc (o charakterze zmian zapalnych). Cień serca wielkości w granicach normy, o uwypuklonej talii. Skrzywienie kręgosłupa piersiowego, pogłębienie fizjologicznej kyfozy lub pochylenie ciała w trakcie zdjęcia. Brak zdjęć poprzednich do ew.porównania. Do rozważenia m.in. kontrolne zdjęcie klatki piersiowej w trakcie i/lub po leczeniu.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: There is an opacity in the right costophrenic angle (fluid and/or adhesions); the left angle is clear. The diaphragmatic domes are within normal limits. The image shows bands of airless lung tissue and/or fibrotic changes in the projection of the right supradiaphragmatic field. Bilaterally, there is increased vascular and interstitial marking in the lower and partially middle lung fields (of an inflammatory nature). The cardiac silhouette is of normal size, with an accentuated waist. There is curvature of the thoracic spine, deepening of physiological kyphosis, or body tilt during imaging. There are no previous images for comparison. Further control X-ray of the chest during and/or after treatment should be considered.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Niesymetryczne ustawienie ciała do zdjęcia. Prawy kąt przeponowo-żebrowy oraz obwodowa część cienia prawej kopuły przepony zlewają się z zacienieniem obwodowej części o charakterze zmian zapalnych/niedodmowo-zapalnych (segment 9?). Lewy kąt przeponowo-żebrowy wolny. Prawa kopuła przepony ustawiona wyżej. Obustronnie przywnękowo i w prawym dolnym polu płucnym wzmożenie rysunku naczyniowo-śródmiąższowego płuc (zmiany zapalne). Cień serca powiększony, o uwypuklonej talii (wstępna weryfikacja w USG serca i dużych naczyń). W zakresie badania lewostronne skupienie pętli jelit (powiększenie wątroby?); cień śr. ok. 5cm w rzucie L2-L3?. Do rozważenia dalsza diagnostyka oraz kontrolne zdjęcie klatki piersiowej po leczeniu.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: Asymmetric positioning of the body for the imaging. The right costophrenic angle and the peripheral part of the shadow of the right diaphragmatic dome merge with the opacity of the peripheral part of an inflammatory/atelectatic nature (segment 9?). The left costophrenic angle is clear. The right diaphragmatic dome is positioned higher. There is increased vascular and interstitial marking bilaterally in the perihilar and right lower lung fields (inflammatory changes). The cardiac silhouette is enlarged, with an accentuated waist (preliminary verification with echocardiography and large vessels is recommended). The examination shows left-sided concentration of intestinal loops (enlargement of the liver?); a shadow of about 5 cm is seen at the level of L2-L3. Further diagnostics and follow-up chest X-ray after treatment should be considered.

report: RTG kręgosłupa szyjnego dwie projekcje: Spłycenie lordozy szyjnej. Zaznaczona lewostronna skolioza. Częściowe zwężenie szpary międzykręgowej C7-D1. Prawostronna skolioza rotacyjna w widocznym odcinku kręgosłupa piersiowego.
translation: Cervical spine X-ray two projections: Flattening of cervical lordosis. Left-sided scoliosis is noted. There is partial narrowing of the intervertebral space at C7-D1. Right-sided rotational scoliosis is seen in the visible segment of the thoracic spine.

report: RTG zatok: Zatoki szczękowe nosa prawidłowo rozwinięte, powietrzne. Zatoka czołowa rozwinięta asymetrycznie, powietrzna.
translation: Sinus X-ray: The maxillary sinuses are normally developed and air-filled. The frontal sinus is asymmetrically developed and air-filled.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Ustawienie niesymetryczne. Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. Niejednolite zacienienie -o charakterze zapalnym - prawego środkowego i dolnego pola płucnego - konieczna kontrola po leczeniu. Lewe pole płucne bez zmian ogniskowych. Sylwetka serca rtg w normie wiekowej.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: Asymmetric positioning. The costophrenic angles are clear. There is heterogeneous opacity of an inflammatory nature in the right middle and lower lung fields - follow-up after treatment is necessary. The left lung field shows no focal changes. The cardiac silhouette is normal for age.

report: RTG klatki piersiowej p-a: Kąty przeponowo-żebrowe wolne. Niejednolite, częściowe zacienienie -o charakterze zapalnym- lewego pola płucnego. Prawe pole płucne bez zmian ogniskowych. Sylwetka serca w normie.
translation: Chest X-ray PA: The costophrenic angles are clear. There is heterogeneous, partial opacity of an inflammatory nature in the left lung field. The right lung field shows no focal changes. The cardiac silhouette is normal.

report: RTG odcinka szyjnego kręgosłupa: Na wykonanym zdjęciu lewostronne skrzywienie kręgosłupa szyjnego z rotacją. Częściowe zniesienie fizjologicznej lordozy odc.C. Na poz.C6/C7 rotacja i/lub przemieszczenie (kręgozmyk?). Obustronnie na poz.C7 tzw.wydłużone wyrostki poprzeczne (możliwość ucisku struktur sąsiednich). Na wykonanym zdjęciu bocznym pmk odcinka C zachowane. Przednie krawędzie trzonów C5 i C6 niższe w stosunku do pozostałych (w dgn.różn.: tzw.wariant anatomiczny, stan po urazie). Na poz.C7/Th1 wyrzutowane otwory międzykręgowe (możliwość rotacji). Do rozważenia dalsza diagnostyka.
translation: Cervical spine X-ray: The X-ray shows left-sided curvature of the cervical spine with rotation. Partial loss of the physiological lordosis of the cervical segment is observed. At the C6/C7 level, there is rotation and/or displacement (possible spondylolisthesis?). Bilaterally at C7, elongated transverse processes are noted (possible compression of neighboring structures). On the lateral view of the cervical segment, the alignment is preserved. The anterior edges of the C5 and C6 vertebral bodies are lower than the others (differential diagnosis: anatomical variant, post-traumatic state). At the C7/Th1 level, the intervertebral foramina are protruded (possible rotation). Further diagnostics should be considered.

report: MR głowy ze wzmocnieniem kontrastowym: Kora mózgowa oraz istota biała o prawidłowej intensywności sygnału. Ognisk patologicznego wzmocnienia kontrastowego w strukturach mózgowia nie wykazano. Układ komorowy nieposzerzony, nieprzemieszczony, asymetryczny w zakresie komór bocznych, z przewagą prawej, bez cech ucisku z zewnątrz. Okolica przysadki mózgowej zachowana prawidłowo. Torbiel szyszynki sr. ok. 5mm. Struktury środkowe nieprzemieszczone. Bruzdy mózgu i rowki móżdżku prawidłowej szerokości. W okolicy prawego kąta mostowo-móżdżkowego przebiega kręte drobne naczynie, kresuje kompleks nerwów VII i VIII stwarzając anatomiczne warunki do powstania konfliktu nerwowo-naczyniowego. Poza tym kompleksy nerwów VII i VIII nieposzerzone, prawidłowo otoczone płynem w obrębie przewodów słuchowych wewnętrznych. Migdałki móżdżku powyżej poziomu otworu wielkiego. Lewa zatoka szczękowa niemal całkowicie bezpowietrzna, wypełniona pogrubiałą błoną śluzową.
translation: MRI of the head with contrast enhancement: The cerebral cortex and white matter show normal signal intensity. No focal areas of pathological contrast enhancement in the brain structures were detected. The ventricular system is not dilated, not displaced, and asymmetric in the lateral ventricles, with a predominance of the right side, without external compression. The area of the pituitary gland is preserved normally. A pineal cyst of approximately 5 mm is noted. Central structures are not displaced. The sulci of the brain and the grooves of the cerebellum are of normal wiRXh. In the area of the right cerebellopontine angle, a small twisted vessel runs, outlining the VII and VIII nerve complexes, creating anatomical conditions for a neurovascular conflict. Additionally, the VII and VIII nerve complexes are not enlarged and are normally surrounded by fluid within the internal auditory canals. The cerebellar tonsils are positioned above the level of the foramen magnum. The left maxillary sinus is almost completely devoid of air, filled with thickened mucosa.

translation: CT of the head without contrast: Artifacts from the bones. No intracerebral hemorrhage is detected. The ventricular system is positioned midline, slightly asymmetric (left > right), and not dilated. The subarachnoid spaces are not dilated. Signs of an expansive process above and below the tentorium are not detected in the examination. A fluid zone measuring 15x8 mm is noted in the area of the choroid plexus of the third ventricle on the right side. The posterior fossa structures are normal. translation: CT of the head performed without contrast enhancement: No signs of acute intracranial hemorrhage are visualized. The density of the white and gray matter is normal. The supratentorial ventricular system is of normal size and not displaced. The posterior fossa structures and the fourth ventricle show no changes. No changes are noted in the bony parts of the cranial cavity.

translation:

As previously noted, in the anterior mediastinum, along the left lateral wall of the ascending aorta and aortic arch, a well-defined, oval, hypodense structure measuring 2.3 x 1.5 cm (stable dimensions) with low/negative density – likely an enlarged lymph node, with possible differential diagnosis of a lipoma, for planned follow-up.
No other signs of mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy were found. The thoracic aorta is not dilated.

Bone structures within the examination field show no pathological destruction.
In the upper part of the examination, small hypodense nodules are visible in both thyroid lobes – requires ultrasound evaluation.
