translation:
ABDOMINO-PELVIC CT SCAN

INDICATION
Etiological assessment of a pulmonary embolism.

TECHNIQUE
Helical acquisition in non-contrast phase followed by post-contrast injection of Gado-TM.
DLP: 1163 mGy.cm

RESULTS
No abnormalities in the liver, adrenal glands, pancreas, spleen, or kidneys. 
Significant prostatic hypertrophy.
Good vascular patency.
No intra-peritoneal effusion or lymphadenopathy. A few pelvic lymph nodes measuring between 3mm and 8mm.
Presence of scattered nodules above the diaphragm.
Osteosclerosis of the axial skeleton, predominantly affecting the spine and iliac wings.

Findings suggestive of prostatic neoplasia with secondary pulmonary and osseous metastases. Correlation with PSA levels and a prostate MRI is recommended.

Hypertrophie prostatique et élévation des PSA.

Acquisitions en différentes pondérations de signal dont une T2 dans les trois plans, une diffusion, T2 Haste en coupes axiales, une T1 DIXON sans et dynamique après injection de DOTAREM. 
IRM SIEMENS, SIEMPRA 1,5T.

La prostate mesure 72 x 76 x 72mm soit 196ml de volume.
Présence d ’une plage de la zone centrale en hyposignal T2 latéralisée à gauche en  hypersignal diffusion avec chute de l’ADC et rehaussement progressif des zones 5a, 9a et11a ( PIRADSIV). Il existe une effraction capsulaire et une infiltration débutante de la graisse en périphérie.

Reins et foie sans anomalie.

translation:
PROSTATE MRI REPORT

INDICATION:
Prostatic hypertrophy and elevated PSA levels.

TECHNIQUE:
Signal-weighted acquisitions including T2 in three planes, diffusion, T2 Haste in axial slices, and T1 DIXON without and with dynamic contrast enhancement using DOTAREM. 
Performed on a SIEMENS, SIEMPRA 1.5T MRI scanner.

RESULTS:
The prostate measures 72 x 76 x 72mm, with a volume of 196ml. 
There is an area in the central zone showing T2 hypointensity, lateralized to the left, with diffusion hyperintensity, ADC drop, and progressive enhancement in zones 5a, 9a, and 11a (PIRADS IV). There is capsular breach and early infiltration of the surrounding fat.
Bilateral iliac and obturator lymphadenopathy measuring between 13mm and 14mm.
No abnormalities in the kidneys and liver.
No suspicious bone abnormalities.

CONCLUSION:
Signal abnormalities highly suggestive of prostatic neoplasia classified as PIRADS 4.
Significant prostatic hypertrophy.

IRM ORBITAIRE



INDICATION :
Exophtalmie droite.

Acquisition en séquence pondérées T2, FLAIR, T2* et T1 en coupes sagittales.
Séquence Temps de Vol sur le polygone de Willis, séquence centrées  sur les orbites dont une T1 sans et après injection de Gadolinium.


RESULTAT : 
Comblement conique droit  par une hypertrophie de tous les muscles oculomoteurs et de la graisse orbitaire en hypersignal T1 et FLAIR avec  spot d’allure hémorragique. Absence d’hypersignal en séquence diffusion. Cette hypertrophie musculo-graisseuse refoule le globe occulaire en avant et est responsable d’une exophtalmie de stade III et d’une hernie du tissu graisseux. Le nerf optique est de taille normal.

Aspect de pseudo-tumeur orbitaire, éliminer une myosite orbitaire, un lymphome ou un syndrome inflammatoire idiopathique.
A confronter à la biopsie des muscles orbitaires.
translation:
ORBITAL MRI REPORT

INDICATION:
Right-sided proptosis.

TECHNIQUE:
T2-weighted, FLAIR, T2*, and T1-weighted sequences acquired in sagittal slices. Time-of-Flight sequence on the circle of Willis, sequences focused on the orbits including T1 before and after Gadolinium contrast injection.

RESULTS:
Right conical filling due to hypertrophy of all extraocular muscles and orbital fat, showing T1 and FLAIR hyperintensity with a hemorrhagic-appearing spot. No hyperintensity on diffusion sequence. This muscle-fat hypertrophy displaces the eyeball forward, causing stage III proptosis and a herniation of fatty tissue. The optic nerve is of normal size. The overall enhancement is moderate post-contrast. No abnormalities of the brain or cerebellum on the sequences performed.

CONCLUSION:
Appearance suggestive of an orbital pseudotumor; consider ruling out orbital myositis, lymphoma, or idiopathic inflammatory syndrome. Correlation with orbital muscle biopsy is recommended.

translation:
THORACIC CT ANGIOGRAM

REASON FOR EXAM:
Suspected pulmonary embolism.

PROCEDURE:
Helical scan performed after injection of contrast material during the arterial phase.

RESULTS:
Bilateral segmental pulmonary embolism in segments S9 and S10 on the right side and S1+3 on the left side. No enlargement of the right heart chambers.

There is a triangular consolidation with a pleural base in segment S9 on the right side, with a central ground-glass opacity, indicating a likely pulmonary infarction in this context. There is a small right pleural effusion.

No nodules or masses in the lung tissue. The trachea and bronchi are intact. No enlargement of the mediastinal, hilar, or axillary lymph nodes.

At the lower edge of the scan, there is a suspicion of dilation of the intrahepatic bile ducts.

CONCLUSION:
Bilateral segmental pulmonary embolism in segments S9 and S10 on the right side and S1+3 on the left side, complicated by a pulmonary infarction in segment S9 on the right side. No enlargement of the right heart chambers. At the lower edge of the scan, there is a suspicion of dilation of the intrahepatic bile ducts; a liver ultrasound is recommended in the department today.

INDICATION :

PROTOCOLE :
Acquisition hélicoïdale sans injection de produit de contraste.

RESULTAT :
Comparaison avec la radiographie de thorax réalisée dans la nuit.

Régression quasi-complète du pneumothorax droit complet non compressif avec un décollement mesuré à 15mm en antérieur au maximum.
Drain axillaire en place, bouclant dans le thorax.

Infiltration en verre dépoli avec quelques lignes septales de l’hémichamp pulmomnaire droit, en lien avec un probable oedème de ré-expansion.
Quelques bulles apicales droites, la plus volumineuse de 11mm (image clé dans le PACS).
Pas de nodule ou de masse du parenchyme pulmonaire.

Pas d’épanchement pleural gauche.
Quelques bulles apicales gauches, la plus volumineuse de 6mm (image clé dans le PACS).
 
CONCLUSION :
Régression quasi-complète du pneumothorax droit complet non compressif.
Oedème de ré-expansion du poumon droit.
Quelques bulles apicales droites, la plus volumineuse de 11mm (image clé dans le PACS).
translation:
CT SCAN OF THE CHEST

REASON FOR EXAM:
Evaluation of a right pneumothorax in an 18-year-old patient who had a pneumothorax on the opposite side last year.

PROCEDURE:
Helical scan performed without contrast injection.

RESULTS:
Comparison made with the chest X-ray taken overnight.

There is an almost complete regression of the non-compressive right pneumothorax, with a maximum separation of 15mm at the front. An axillary drain is in place, looping within the chest.

There is ground-glass opacity with some septal lines in the right lung field, likely due to re-expansion edema. A few apical blebs are present on the right side, the largest measuring 11mm (key image available in the PACS). No nodules or masses in the lung tissue.

No pleural effusion on the left side. A few apical blebs are present on the left side, the largest measuring 6mm (key image available in the PACS).

CONCLUSION:
There is an almost complete regression of the non-compressive right pneumothorax. Re-expansion edema is present in the right lung. A few apical blebs are noted on the right side, the largest measuring 11mm (key image available in the PACS).

report:
SCANNER THORACIQUE
 
INDICATION :
Bilan d’une toux productive chez un patient de 55 ans fumeur actif (50PA).
 
PROTOCOLE :
Acquisition hélicoïdale sans injection de produit de contraste. Acquisition complémentaire en expiration.

RESULTAT :
Pas d’examen antérieur disponible pour comparaison.

Pas de nodule ou de masse du parenchyme pulmonaire.
Infiltration à type de micronodules flous centrolobulaires des ragions supérieurs, en lien avec une bronchiolite respiratoire.
Piégeage expiratoire dans les régions inférieures. 
Epaississement modéré diffus des parois bronchiques.
Pas de verre dépoli, pas de réticulations, pas de rayon de miel.
Pas d’épanchement pleural ou péricardique.
Pas d’adénomégalie médiastino-hilaire ou axillaire.
Pas de lésion osseuse lytique ou condensante focale dans le volume exploré.
 
CONCLUSION :
Pas de nodule ou de masse du parenchyme pulmonaire.
Signes de poumon du fumeur (bronchopathie proximale et distale).
translation:
CT SCAN OF THE CHEST

REASON FOR EXAM:
Evaluation of a productive cough in a 55-year-old patient who is an active smoker with a 50 pack-year history.

PROTOCOL:
Helical acquisition without contrast injection. Additional acquisition during expiration.

RESULTS:
No previous exams available for comparison.

No nodules or masses in the lung tissue.
Presence of hazy centrilobular micronodules in the upper regions, associated with respiratory bronchiolitis.
Air trapping observed in the lower regions.
Moderate, diffuse thickening of the bronchial walls.
No ground-glass opacities, no reticulations, no honeycombing.
No pleural or pericardial effusion.
No enlargement of the mediastinal, hilar, or axillary lymph nodes.
No focal lytic or sclerotic bone lesions within the scanned area.

CONCLUSION:
No nodules or masses in the lung tissue.
Signs consistent with smoker's lung (proximal and distal bronchopathy).

report:
SCANNER THORACIQUE
 
INDICATION :
Bilan d’une PID découverte sur un angioscanner thoracique réalisé pour suspicion d’EP devant une dyspnée d’apparition progressive. Pas d’exposition professionnelle.
 
PROTOCOLE :
Acquisition hélicoïdale sans injection de produit de contraste. Acquisition complémentaire en expiration puis en procubitus.

RESULTAT :
Examen comparé avec l’angioscanner thoracique réalisé le 18 février 2024

Réticulations irrégulières bilatérales et symétriques prédominant en sous-pleural et dans les régions inférieures. Ces anomalies persistent en procubitus.
Il s’y associe moins majoritairement du verre dépoli au sein des régions atteintes par les réticulations.
Pas de rayon de miel.

Bronchiolectasie par traction dans les bases, notamment en S10 de manière bilatérale.
Aspect irrégulier des scissures témoignant de signes de distorsion architecturale.

Un nodule de 8mm de S9G (SPF 1448), rond et régulier.

Pas de masse, pas de condensation.
Discret piégeage expiratoire.
Epaississement modéré diffus des parois bronchiques.

Pas d’épanchement pleural ou péricardique.

Un ganglion hilaire gauche péricentimétrique, restant oblong.
 
CONCLUSION :
Infiltration du parenchyme pulmonaire compatible avec une PID de pattern PIC probable faiblement fibrosante.
Nodule de 8mm de S9G associé à un ganglion hilaire gauche péricentimétrique à confronter à un avis dédié et au minimum à un scanner de contrôle à 6 mois.
translation:
CT SCAN OF THE CHEST

INDICATION:
Evaluation of interstitial lung disease (ILD) discovered on a chest CT angiogram performed due to suspected pulmonary embolism (PE) in the context of progressively worsening shortness of breath. No occupational exposure.

PROTOCOL:
Helical acquisition without contrast injection. Additional scans taken during expiration and in the prone position.

RESULTS:
Compared with the chest CT angiogram performed on February 18, 2024.

Irregular bilateral and symmetrical reticulations predominantly in the subpleural areas and lower lung regions. These abnormalities persist in the prone position. There is also a lesser degree of ground-glass opacity in the areas affected by the reticulations. No honeycombing observed.

Traction bronchiectasis in the lung bases, particularly in segment S10 on both sides. Irregular appearance of the fissures indicating signs of architectural distortion.

A round and regular 8mm nodule in segment S9 of the left lung (SPF 1448).

No masses or consolidations. Mild air trapping on expiration. Moderate diffuse thickening of the bronchial walls.

No pleural or pericardial effusion.

A left hilar lymph node measuring just under a centimeter, remaining oblong in shape.

CONCLUSION:
Pulmonary parenchymal infiltration consistent with a probable pattern of usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) with mild fibrosis. An 8mm nodule in segment S9 of the left lung associated with a left hilar lymph node just under a centimeter should be further evaluated with a specialist opinion and at least a follow-up CT scan in 6 months.

translation:
Abdominal and Pelvic Ultrasound

Reason for Exam:
Sudden, intense abdominal pain for the past 3 days.

Findings:
- The liver is normal in size, with smooth edges and a uniform internal structure. No focal lesions were detected within the liver. The hepatic veins and portal vein are well open.
- The gallbladder is normal in size, with thin walls and contains no stones. There is no dilation of the bile ducts inside or outside the liver.
- The pancreas is visible in its head and body regions, with a uniform internal structure.
- The spleen is normal in size and has a uniform internal structure.
- The kidneys are symmetrical and normal in size, with good differentiation between the parenchyma and sinus. There is no dilation of the renal pelvis or calyces, and no masses or stones were detected.
- The bladder is partially filled and contains clear fluid.
- There is a small amount of fluid in the pelvic area.
- The appendix was not visible. No pain was noted when the probe was moved over the area.
- The right ovary is normal in size and shape.
- The left ovary was not visible.

Conclusion:
- Small amount of fluid in the pelvic area.
- Appendix not visible.
- Right ovary is normal in size and shape.
- Left ovary not visible.

report:

RESULTAT :
Foie de taille limite, aux contours réguliers. Flèche hépatique mesurée à 16 cm.
Parenchyme hépatique d'échogénicité normale, sans lésion focale suspecte.
Perméabilité du tronc porte et des veines sus-hépatiques.
Statut post-cholécystectomie.
Trop bonne visibilité secondaire de la voie biliaire principale, mesurée jusqu'à 10 mm, suivie jusqu'à la papille sans obstacle décelé.
Pas de dilatation des voies biliaires intrahépatiques.
 
Intégrité de la tête du corps du pancréas.
Rate de taille normale, homogène.
 
Reins de taille normale, avec un diamètre bipolaire de 10 cm à droite comme à gauche.
Pas dilatation des cavités pyélocalicielles.
Vessie en réplétion, à parois fines.
 
Pas d'épanchement intrapéritonéal.
 
CONCLUSION :

translation:
Abdominal and Pelvic Ultrasound

Reason for Examination:
The patient is experiencing epigastric pain, vomiting, and liver function test abnormalities indicating liver cell damage. The patient has a history of gallbladder removal.

Findings:
- The liver is at the upper limit of normal size with regular borders. The liver span is measured at 16 cm.
- The liver tissue has normal echogenicity, with no suspicious focal lesions.
- The portal vein and hepatic veins are open and unobstructed.
- The patient has had their gallbladder removed.
- The main bile duct is very clearly visible, measuring up to 10 mm, and can be traced to the papilla without any detected obstruction.
- There is no dilation of the intrahepatic bile ducts.

- The head of the pancreas is intact.
- The spleen is of normal size and homogeneous.

- The kidneys are of normal size, with a bipolar diameter of 10 cm on both the right and left sides.
- There is no dilation of the renal pelvis and calyces.
- The bladder is full and has thin walls.

- There is no fluid accumulation in the abdominal cavity.

Conclusion:
There is no dilation of the intrahepatic bile ducts.

report:
ECHOGRAPHIE CERVICALE
 
INDICATION :
Bilan d'une tuméfaction sous-mandibulaire droite.
 
RESULTAT :
La tuméfaction palpée correspond à une formation nodulaire à contours irréguliers, franchement hypo-échogène, mesurant 17x16 mm.
 
Elle apparaît hyperhémiée en mode Doppler.
Pas de microcalcifications.
 
Il semble exister un liseré graisseux entre cette formation et la glande sous-mandibulaire droite, en faveur d'une origine non salivaire : adénomégalie ?
 
Pas de compression des canaux salivaires.
 
Par ailleurs, pas d'autre adénomégalie jugulo-carotidienne ou sous-mandibulaire.
 
CONCLUSION :
Formation nodulaire sous-mandibulaire droite correspondant vraisemblablement à une adénomégalie.
 
Intérêt d'un avis ORL pour éventuel prélèvement.
 
Médecin demandeur prévenu.
translation:
CERVICAL ULTRASOUND

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
Evaluation of a swelling on the right side under the jaw.

RESULTS:
The palpable swelling corresponds to a nodular formation with irregular borders, clearly hypo-echoic, measuring 17x16 mm.

It shows increased blood flow on Doppler mode.
No microcalcifications are present.

There appears to be a fatty layer between this formation and the right submandibular gland, suggesting a non-salivary origin: possibly lymph node enlargement?

There is no compression of the salivary ducts.

Additionally, there is no other lymph node enlargement in the jugular-carotid or submandibular areas.

CONCLUSION:
Nodular formation under the right jaw likely corresponding to lymph node enlargement.

An ENT specialist's opinion is recommended for a possible biopsy.

The requesting physician has been informed.

Parenchyme thyroïdien hétérogène, globalement hypo-échogène, avec perte du gradient musculo-parenchymateux.
 
Pas d'hyperhémie en mode Doppler.
 
Pas de nodule.
 
Pas d'adénomégalie jugulo-carotidienne ou sous-mandibulaire.
 
CONCLUSION :

Pas de nodule thyroïdien suspect.
Aspect compatible avec des séquelles de thyroïdite.
translation:
Thyroid Ultrasound Report

Reason for Examination:
Evaluation of hypothyroidism that developed during immunotherapy treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

Findings:
- The isthmus measures 2 mm.
- The right lobe measures 46x21x19 mm, with a volume of 9.6 cc.
- The left lobe measures 36x17x14 mm, with a volume of 4.6 cc.

The thyroid tissue is heterogeneous and generally appears darker than normal on the ultrasound, with a loss of the usual muscle-to-tissue contrast.

There is no increased blood flow on Doppler mode.

No nodules are present.

No enlargement of the jugular-carotid or submandibular lymph nodes.

Conclusion:
There is no goiter.
No suspicious thyroid nodules are present.
The appearance is consistent with the aftereffects of thyroiditis.

translation:
ABDOMINO-PELVIC ULTRASOUND

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
Pain in the left iliac fossa radiating to the pelvic region, which resolves on its own.

RESULTS:
The liver is of normal size, with a uniform appearance and regular borders, and no focal lesions detected. The patient has had their gallbladder removed. There is no dilation of the bile ducts inside or outside the liver. The kidneys have a normal shape, and the urinary tracts are not dilated. The spleen is uniform and of normal size. There is no free fluid in the abdominal cavity.

The bladder was partially filled during the examination and contained anechoic fluid. The uterus is of normal size. The ovaries are of normal size and shape. There is a cystic formation on the left side, measuring 35 mm. The pouch of Douglas is clear.

CONCLUSION:
There is no dilation of the urinary tracts. There is a 35 mm cystic formation on the left side. A gynecological consultation and a follow-up ultrasound in 3 months are recommended.

translation:
ABDOMINO-PELVIC SCAN

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
Screening for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in the context of mixed cirrhosis.

PROCEDURE:
Helical scan focused on the abdomen without contrast, followed by contrast-enhanced imaging during the arterial phase, with an abdomino-pelvic spiral scan during the portal phase and an abdominal scan during the delayed phase.

RESULTS:
Comparison with the previous scan conducted on November 4, 2024.

The liver is misshapen with irregular contours. No suspicious focal intrahepatic lesions are observed, particularly during the arterial phase. There is a fibrotic area in segment VII. The portal vein and hepatic veins are normally open. There is no dilation of the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts. The gallbladder has thin walls. The adrenal glands, pancreas, and kidneys have normal shape and enhancement. There is moderate, uniform enlargement of the spleen.

There is a small amount of fluid accumulation in the pelvic area within the peritoneal cavity. No enlarged lymph nodes are found in the retroperitoneal or pelvic regions. There is partially calcified aortic atherosclerosis.

CONCLUSION:
Cirrhotic liver with no lesions suggestive of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

report:

INDICATION :
Patient cirrhotique, réévaluation de nodules hépatocytaire hypervasculaire.
 
PROTOCOLE :

RESULTAT :
Comparaison à l'IRM du 13/10/2024.
 
Foie dysmorphique de cirrhose avec contours bosselés.
Nodule hypervasculaire de la portion antérieure du segment IVa mesuré ce jour à 12x12mm contre 8x8 mm antérieurement, sans Wash out, discrètement majoré en taille.
Nodule hypervasculaire du segment VIII d’environ 12 mm de grand axe contre 13mm antérieurement, sans Wash out.
Troubles de perfusion diffus.

Absence d'ascite.
Aspect sans particularité des surrénales, du pancréas et des reins.
Absence d'adénomégalie rétropéritonéale, cœlio-mésentérique ou pelvienne.

Absence de lésion osseuse suspecte sur le volume exploré.
 
CONCLUSION :
Foie de cirrhose.
Majoration du nodule hypervasculaire de 12mm du segment IVa, sans wash-out, pour lequel on peut proposer une IRM.
translation:
ABDOMINO-PELVIC SCAN

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
The patient has cirrhosis and is undergoing reevaluation of hypervascular liver nodules.

PROCEDURE:
A helical scan was performed on the abdomen without and with contrast injection during the arterial, portal, and delayed phases.

RESULTS:
Comparison with the MRI from October 13, 2024.

The liver shows cirrhotic changes with irregular contours. There is a hypervascular nodule in the anterior part of segment IVa, currently measuring 12x12 mm, compared to 8x8 mm previously, with no washout observed, indicating a slight increase in size. Another hypervascular nodule in segment VIII measures approximately 12 mm in its longest dimension, compared to 13 mm previously, also with no washout. There are diffuse perfusion abnormalities. No new suspicious nodules have appeared. Signs of portal hypertension are present, including splenomegaly, with the spleen measuring 19 cm in its longest dimension on the axial plane, and the presence of porto-systemic shunts. There is no ascites. The adrenal glands, pancreas, and kidneys appear normal. There is no retroperitoneal, celiac-mesenteric, or pelvic lymphadenopathy. No abdominal or pelvic fluid collections are present.

No suspicious bone lesions were observed in the scanned area.

CONCLUSION:
Cirrhotic liver. The hypervascular nodule in segment IVa has increased to 12 mm, with no washout, for which an MRI can be considered.

report:
IRM HEPATIQUE

INDICATION :
Bilan d’un nodule du segment IVa hypervasculaire supra-centimétrique sans wash-out sur foie du cirrhose.
 
PROTOCOLE :
Séquences métaboliques, morphologiques, de diffusion et après injection.
 
RESULTAT :
Comparaison au scanner du 04/01/2025
 
Nodule hépatocytaire de 13x13mm sous-capsulaire du segment IVa, hypervasculaire avec discret wash-out.
Moins bonne visibilité en IRM du nodule du segment VIII.
Foie de cirrhose connu.
 
CONCLUSION :
Présence d’un wash-out en IRM du nodule hépatocytaire hypervasculaire du segment IVa, témoignant d’un CHC.
translation:
LIVER MRI

REASON FOR EXAM:
Evaluation of a hypervascular nodule larger than one centimeter in segment IVa, without wash-out, in a cirrhotic liver.

PROCEDURE:
Metabolic, morphological, diffusion sequences, and post-contrast imaging were performed.

RESULTS:
Comparison with the CT scan from January 4, 2025.

There is a 13x13mm hepatocellular nodule located just beneath the capsule in segment IVa, which is hypervascular with slight wash-out. The nodule in segment VIII is less visible on the MRI. The liver is known to be cirrhotic.

CONCLUSION:
The presence of wash-out in the MRI of the hypervascular hepatocellular nodule in segment IVa indicates hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

report:
SCANNER CÉRÉBRAL
 
INDICATION :
Bilan d'une hémiparésie droite.
 
PROTOCOLE :
Acquisition hélicoïdale sur le crâne sans injection de contraste
 
RESULTAT :
Absence de lésion hémorragique intra ou péri-cérébrale.
Absence d'hypodensité systématisée à un territoire artériel.
Séquelles punctiforme sylvienne profonde gauche et cortico sous corticale frontale supérieure gauche.
Hypodensité marquée péri-ventriculaire et des centres semi-ovales compatibles avec de la leucopathie probablement vasculaire.
Élargissement des espaces liquidiens intra et péri-cérébraux en rapport avec une atrophie cortico-sous-corticale diffuse.
Respect du système ventriculaire.
Ligne médiane en place. Absence d'engagement.
 
Bonne aération des sinus de la face et des cellules mastoïdiennes.
Absence de lésion osseuse d'allure traumatique.
 
CONCLUSION :
Absence d'élément TDM pouvant expliquer la symptomatologie.
translation:
BRAIN SCAN

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
Evaluation of right-sided hemiparesis.

PROCEDURE:
Helical scan of the skull without contrast injection.

RESULTS:
No intra- or peri-cerebral hemorrhagic lesions detected.
No localized low-density areas in any arterial territory.
Small residual effects in the deep left Sylvian region and the upper left frontal cortico-subcortical area.
Marked low-density areas around the ventricles and in the semi-oval centers, likely indicating vascular-related white matter disease.
Widening of the fluid spaces inside and around the brain, consistent with diffuse cortico-subcortical atrophy.
The ventricular system is intact.
The midline is in its normal position. No signs of brain herniation.

The sinuses in the face and the mastoid air cells are well-aerated.
No bone lesions suggestive of trauma.

CONCLUSION:
No CT findings that could explain the symptoms.

report:
SCANNER DE LA FACE
 
INDICATION :
Bilan de sinusite
 
PROTOCOLE :
Spirale sans injection centrée sur les sinus de la face. Reconstructions en fenêtres osseuse et parties molles.
 
RESULTAT :
Épaississement muqueux du bas fond du sinus frontal gauche, des cellules ethmoïdales et des bas-fonds des sinus maxillaires.
Aération normale des sinus sphénoïdaux.
Épaississement muqueux des canaux naso-frontaux.
Perméabilité normale des carrefours ostio-méatiques maxillaires.
Déviation de la cloison nasale vers la gauche avec éperon osseux.
Intégrité du toit de l'ethmoïde et des lames orbitaires.
translation:
**CT Scan of the Face**

**Reason for Examination:**
Evaluation of sinusitis

**Procedure:**
A spiral CT scan without contrast, focused on the facial sinuses. Images were reconstructed using bone and soft tissue windows.

**Findings:**
- There is mucosal thickening at the bottom of the left frontal sinus, within the ethmoid air cells, and at the base of the maxillary sinuses.
- The sphenoid sinuses are normally aerated.
- There is mucosal thickening in the nasofrontal ducts.
- The maxillary ostiomeatal complexes are normally open.
- The nasal septum is deviated to the left with a bony spur.
- The roof of the ethmoid and the orbital plates are intact.

report:
IRM HÉPATIQUE
 
INDICATION :
Suivi de vraisemblable NASH sans fibrose en mesure non-invasive mais avec dysmorphie hépatique marquée. Dépistage de CHC et quantification de la stéatose.
 
PROTOCOLE :
Séquences axiale et coronale T2, axiale diffusion, axial T1 Dixon sans et avec injection de gadolinium
 
RESULTAT :
Hépatomégalie stéatosique (flèche hépatique droite de 21 cm), modérément dysmorphique. Contours lisses. Perméabilité des vaisseaux afférents et efférents hépatiques. Pas de lésion focale hépatique visible.
Pas de dilatation des voies biliaires. Antécédent de cholécystectomie.
Splénomégalie de 16 cm. Pas de voie de dérivation porto-systémique visible. Pas d'ascite.
Pas d'autre lésion pancréatique focale. Canal pancréatique principal fin.
Pas d'adénomégalie à l'étage-abdominal. Surrénales fines
 
CONCLUSION :
Hépatomégalie stéatosique sans lésion focale suspecte.
translation:
LIVER MRI

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
Monitoring of likely non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) without fibrosis as measured by non-invasive methods, but with significant liver shape abnormalities. Screening for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and quantification of liver fat.

PROCEDURE:
Axial and coronal T2 sequences, axial diffusion, axial T1 Dixon without and with gadolinium injection.

RESULTS:
Fatty liver enlargement (right liver lobe measuring 21 cm), moderately misshapen. Smooth edges. The hepatic blood vessels are open and unobstructed. No visible focal liver lesions.
No dilation of the bile ducts. History of gallbladder removal.
Enlarged spleen measuring 16 cm. No visible portosystemic shunt. No ascites.
No other focal pancreatic lesions. Main pancreatic duct is thin.
No enlarged lymph nodes in the abdominal area. Adrenal glands are thin.

CONCLUSION:
Fatty liver enlargement without any suspicious focal lesions.

report:

translation:
LIVER MRI

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
Monitoring of a perihilar cholangiocarcinoma treated with chemotherapy.

PROTOCOL:
Metabolic, morphological, diffusion sequences, and post-contrast imaging.

RESULTS:
Comparison with the MRI from April 15, 2024 (nadir).

The dilation of the intrahepatic bile ducts, mainly affecting the left liver, remains stable. The tissue infiltration at the site of the left portal branch is stable and not visible. No new liver lesions have appeared.

There is a reduction in the size of the lymph node formation at the hepatic hilum, now measuring less than one centimeter.

No measurable target lesions are present. For reference, the bile duct stents in the right and left hepatic ducts remain in place.

CONCLUSION:
Stability of the partial remission.

report:

translation:
SPINAL MRI

REASON FOR EXAMINATION:
History of myelopathy due to nitrous oxide poisoning. One-year follow-up. No recurrence of symptoms.

PROTOCOL:
Sagittal T2, STIR, and T1 sequences before and after gadolinium injection. Axial T2 sequence focused on C5-C7.

RESULTS:
Comparison with the MRI from August 10, 2020.

No new morphological or signal abnormalities of the spinal cord were observed.

No abnormal contrast enhancement of the spinal cord, cauda equina nerve roots, or meninges.

Degenerative changes in the cervical spine, with posterior disc bulging at C6-C7 causing slight narrowing of the spinal canal. Persistent perimedullary fluid spaces. No signal abnormalities of the spinal cord at this level. Perimedullary fluid spaces are otherwise preserved.

CONCLUSION:
No MRI evidence supporting myelopathy.

translation:
Pelvic MRI

Reason for Exam:
Evaluation of abnormal uterine bleeding with a known fibroid seen on ultrasound.

Procedure:
Sequences were taken in three planes using T2-weighted imaging, axial T1 Dixon, axial TRUFI, and 3D-T1 after gadolinium contrast injection.

Findings:
The uterus is tilted forward and measures 87 x 51 x 49 mm. The endometrium is thin and regular, with a maximum thickness of 4 mm. There are a few small cystic formations beneath the endometrium, indicating superficial diffuse internal adenomyosis. There is a fibroid located in the left body-isthmus region of the uterus, measuring 34 mm, with both submucosal and subserosal components, classified as FIGO type 3 - 5.

The ovaries are in their normal positions within the ovarian fossae, with normal size and shape, and show no cystic or solid lesions.

There is no fluid accumulation within the peritoneal cavity. There is no dilation of the renal collecting systems. There is no enlargement of lymph nodes in the retroperitoneal or pelvic areas.

Conclusion:
Presence of superficial internal adenomyosis. Left body-isthmus fibroid.

translation:
Pelvic MRI

Reason for Exam:
Severe menstrual pain. Checking for deep pelvic endometriosis.

Procedure:
Rectal and vaginal marking using ultrasound gel.
Sequences in three spatial planes T2, axial TRUFI, axial T1 Dixon.

Findings:
The uterus is tilted forward and bent forward, measuring 64x32x35 mm.
The endometrium is thin and regular, with a maximum thickness of 3.5 mm.
No abnormalities in the junctional zone or the myometrium.
No fluid accumulation in the abdominal cavity.

The ovaries are in their normal positions in the ovarian fossae, with normal size and shape, and appear follicular. There is a non-specific hemorrhagic formation in the left ovary measuring 5 mm.

No dilation of the renal collecting systems.
No retroperitoneal or pelvic lymph node enlargement.

The recto-vaginal and vesico-uterine partitions are intact.
No abnormalities observed in the area of the torus or the origin of the uterosacral ligaments.

Conclusion:
No MRI evidence supporting the presence of deep pelvic endometriosis.

translation:

translation:

translation:
Brain Scan

Reason for Exam: 10-day follow-up of a right-sided epidural hematoma. The patient is showing good clinical progress, except for a persistent headache. Checking for cerebral venous thrombosis (CVT).

Procedure: Helical scan without contrast focused on the brain. Additional scan during the venous phase after contrast injection.

Results: 

Comparison with the scan from February 13, 2025:

- The acute right parietal epidural hematoma has decreased in density, now measuring 11mm in thickness compared to 12mm previously, and still spans approximately 35mm in width.
- The indentation on the parietal cortex remains unchanged.
- No new hemorrhagic lesions have appeared, and there is no blood accumulation in the ventricles.
- No brain herniation is observed.
- The previously noted right parieto-temporal fracture remains stable.
- A partial filling of the left maxillary sinus has appeared, which should be correlated with clinical data.
- After contrast injection, the intracranial venous sinuses are open and unobstructed.

Conclusion: The right parietal hematoma is showing normal progression. There is no cerebral venous thrombosis.

translation:

translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Reason for Exam:** Suspected Stroke (CVA).

**Procedure:**
Axial sequences T1, FLAIR, SWI, and Diffusion with ADC Map reconstruction. 3D TOF sequence on the Circle of Willis. Venous MRA sequence. 3D T1 Gradient Echo sequence after gadolinium injection.

**Findings:**
There is a hyperacute deep thalamo-capsular hematoma on the left side, measuring 40mm, with ventricular flooding. There is contrast extravasation within the hematoma (spot sign). There is a mass effect causing an 8mm shift of the midline to the right. Early-stage hydrocephalus is present.

There are signs of underlying microangiopathy with FLAIR hyperintensities in the supratentorial white matter (Fazekas grade 1) and multiple microbleeds predominantly in deep locations.

The venous system shows normal patency.

An incidental finding of a developmental venous anomaly in the left temporal region.

**Conclusion:**
There is a deep left thalamic hematoma complicated by ventricular flooding and early-stage hydrocephalus. There are signs of underlying microangiopathy.

translation:

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION Suspicion d'AVC. Déficit hémicorporel gauche et mutisme.
PROTOCOLESéquences Axiales FLAIR, SWI et Diffusion avec reconstruction Cartographie ADC.Séquence 3D TOF sur le polygone de WillisSéquence de perfusion ASL
RESULTAT
Hypersignal B1000 et ADC diminué intéressant une large zone corticale temporo-pariétale droite Pas de traduction en FLAIR.Il s’y associe un hypersignal B1000 avec ADC diminué, sans traduction en FLAIR, du pulvinar droit.Absence d’occlusion artérielle. Absence de flux lents visibles en FLAIR.
Au contraire, dilatation de l’artère sylvienne gauche et hyperperfusion corticale franche en ASL. L’aspect est en faveur d’une origine post-critique.
Par ailleurs, séquelles corticales connues hémisphériques droites en territoire jonctionnel.Hémosidérose corticale superficielle disséminée à prédominance frontale. Image d'addition anévrismale de 4mm de la bifurcation sylvienne droite de découverte fortuite.

CONCLUSION
Aspect compatible avec un oedème post-critique temporo-pariétal et du pulvinar droit. Image d'addition anévrismale de 4mm de la bifurcation sylvienne droite de découverte fortuite.
translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Reason for Exam:** Suspected stroke. Left-sided body weakness and mutism.

**Protocols:** Axial FLAIR, SWI, and Diffusion sequences with ADC map reconstruction. 3D TOF sequence on the circle of Willis. ASL perfusion sequence.

**Findings:**

- There is a high signal on B1000 and reduced ADC affecting a large area of the right temporo-parietal cortex, with no corresponding changes on FLAIR.
- A similar high signal on B1000 with reduced ADC is noted in the right pulvinar, also without corresponding FLAIR changes.
- No arterial occlusion is observed. No slow flow is visible on FLAIR.
- Conversely, there is dilation of the left sylvian artery and clear cortical hyperperfusion on ASL, suggesting a post-seizure origin.
- Additionally, there are known cortical sequelae in the right hemisphere in the watershed area. There is scattered superficial cortical hemosiderosis, predominantly in the frontal region.
- An incidental finding of a 4mm aneurysmal outpouching at the right sylvian bifurcation.

**Conclusion:**

The findings are consistent with post-seizure edema in the right temporo-parietal region and the right pulvinar. There is an incidental 4mm aneurysmal outpouching at the right sylvian bifurcation.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION :Suspicion de thrombose veineuse cérébrale.Diplopie binoculaire sans baisse d’acuité visuelle depuis 2 jours.
PROTOCOLE :Séquences axiales T1, Swi, 3D Flair, diffusion et diffusion optimisée centrée sur la fosse postérieure. Séquence 3D TOFSéquences ARM veineuseSéquence 3D EG T1 avec injection de gadolinium reconstruite dans les 3 plansInjection de Gadolinium (Clariscan)
RESULTATS :En fosse postérieureAbsence de lésion décelable du tronc cérébral, du vermis ou des hémisphères cérébelleux Le V4 est normal, en place.Respect des citernes de la base.
En sus-tentoriel,Pas d'anomalie de morphologie ou de signal des structures encéphaliques supratentorielles.Intégrité des noyaux gris centraux.Respect du système ventriculaire.
Perméabilité normale des artères du polygone de Willis.
Intégrité de l’ARM veineuse et remplissage normal du système veineux sur la séquence volumique T1 après injection de gadolinium.
Absence de prise de contraste pathologique. Doute sur une prise de contraste ponctiforme du genou du nerf facial gauche.
CONCLUSION :IRM encéphalique normale.Absence d’argument pour une thrombose veineuse cérébrale ou une hypertension intra cranienne
translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Reason for Exam:** Suspected cerebral venous thrombosis. The patient has been experiencing binocular double vision without any decrease in visual acuity for the past two days.

**Procedure:** Axial T1, SWI, 3D FLAIR, diffusion, and optimized diffusion sequences focused on the posterior fossa. 3D TOF sequences and venous MR angiography sequences. 3D T1-weighted sequence with gadolinium injection, reconstructed in three planes. Gadolinium (Clariscan) injection was administered.

**Findings:**

- **Posterior Fossa:** No detectable lesions in the brainstem, vermis, or cerebellar hemispheres. The fourth ventricle (V4) is normal and in its proper position. The basal cisterns are intact.

- **Supratentorial Region:** No abnormalities in the shape or signal of the supratentorial brain structures. The central gray nuclei are intact. The ventricular system is preserved.

- **Vascular System:** Normal patency of the arteries in the Circle of Willis. The venous MR angiography is intact, and the venous system shows normal filling on the volumetric T1 sequence after gadolinium injection. No pathological contrast enhancement is observed. There is a questionable small contrast enhancement at the bend of the left facial nerve.

**Conclusion:** The brain MRI is normal. There is no evidence to support cerebral venous thrombosis or intracranial hypertension.

Trou de trépan pariétal droit avec extrémité distale de la sonde de DVP au sein du carrefour ventriculaire droit, et sans remaniement hémorragique au pourtour de la sonde.Bulle de pneumencéphalie pariétale droite sur le versant gauche de la sonde, aspécifique dans ce contexte.

translation:
CEREBRAL SCAN

INDICATION
The patient underwent the placement of a ventriculoperitoneal shunt today due to chronic adult hydrocephalus. Upon waking, the patient exhibited drowsiness and left-sided hemiparesis. The scan was conducted to check for any recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions.

PROTOCOL
A cerebral scan was performed without the use of contrast material. Millimeter and 3 mm contiguous reconstructions were made. Dose-length product (DLP): 853 mGy.cm

RESULTS
No recent intra- or extra-axial hemorrhagic lesions were found. No localized hypodensity in any vascular territory was detected.

There is a right parietal burr hole with the distal end of the VP shunt catheter located within the right ventricular junction, with no surrounding hemorrhagic changes. There is a right parietal pneumocephalus bubble on the left side of the catheter, which is nonspecific in this context.

The ventricular system is enlarged, consistent with chronic adult hydrocephalus. The cortical sulci appear compressed.

The central gray nuclei are intact. The midline is in its normal position.

CONCLUSION
There is no recent intraparenchymal hemorrhagic lesion or localized hypodensity in any vascular territory. The VP shunt catheter is in place.

translation:
**Brain Scan Report**

**Reason for Examination:**
The patient experienced a head injury on March 20, 2013, which resulted in loss of consciousness and repeated vomiting. An initial scan on the day of the injury showed no lesions. Since then, the patient has been experiencing persistent dizziness, headaches, and nausea.

**Procedure:**
A brain scan was performed without the use of contrast dye. The images were reconstructed in both millimeter and 3-millimeter slices. The total dose-length product (DLP) was 734 mGy/cm.

**Findings:**
- No recent intra-axial or extra-axial hemorrhagic lesions were detected.
- The midline structures of the brain are in their normal position.
- The central gray matter structures are intact.
- The ventricular system is intact.
- The basal cisterns are intact.

There is a fracture of the squamous part of the left temporal bone, extending downward to the lateral part of the temporal bone. There is no associated fracture of the petrous part of the temporal bone.

**Conclusion:**
There is no recent intracranial bleeding. There is a fracture of the left temporal squama.

translation:
**Brain Scan Report**

**Reason for Examination:**  
Evaluation of confusion in a 72-year-old patient with a history of lung cancer.

**Procedure:**  
Brain scan performed without the use of contrast dye. Images were reconstructed in both millimeter and 3 mm slices. Dose-length product (DLP): 542 mGy.cm.

**Results:**  
There are no previous scans available for comparison.  
No recent intra- or extra-axial hemorrhagic lesions were observed. The midline structures are in their normal position. The ventricular system is intact. There is moderate widening of the spaces around the brain, which is associated with subcortical atrophy. The basal cisterns are intact.  
No post-traumatic bone lesions were detected.

**Conclusion:**  
There is no recent intracranial bleeding or any expanding process within the brain tissue.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Patient de 66 ans traitée d'un méningiome suprasellaire par chirurgie en 2020. Suivi du reliquat.
PROTOCOLESéquences coronales T1 et T2 centrée sur les voies optiques, 3D FLAIR, 3D T1 SE après injection de produit de contraste.Injection de CLARISCAN 20 
RESULTATComparaison à l'IRM du 25/03/2021.
Stabilité de la fine prise de contraste pachyméningée en regard de la clinoïde antérieure gauche et s'étendant au jugum sphénoïdal en rapport avec le reliquat méningiomateux.Pas d'extension décelable au sein du canal optique.
Stabilité de l'atrophie et hypersignal T2 du nerf optique gauche, séquellaire.Aspect inchangé des hypersignaux FLAIR cortico-sous-corticaux temporaux gauches en rapport avec des remaniements post-chirurgicaux.Stabilité de la fine prise de contraste réactionnelle pachyméningée frontale gauche en regard de la voie d'abord.Aspect inchangé de l'aspect de méningo-encéphalocèle du parenchyme cérébelleux en regard de l'écaille occipitale.
Pas d’autre prise de contraste pathologique du parenchyme cérébral, des méninges et des nerfs optiques.

translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Indication:**  
A 66-year-old patient who underwent surgery for a suprasellar meningioma in 2020. This MRI is for monitoring the remaining tumor.

**Protocol:**  
Coronal T1 and T2 sequences focused on the optic pathways, 3D FLAIR, and 3D T1 SE after contrast injection. CLARISCAN 20 was used as the contrast agent.

**Results:**  
Compared to the MRI from March 25, 2021:

- The slight contrast enhancement of the meninges near the left anterior clinoid process, extending to the sphenoidal ridge, remains stable and is associated with the residual meningioma. There is no detectable extension into the optic canal.
- The atrophy and T2 hyperintensity of the left optic nerve, which are sequelae, remain stable.
- The FLAIR hyperintensities in the left temporal cortico-subcortical areas, related to post-surgical changes, are unchanged.
- The slight reactive contrast enhancement of the left frontal meninges near the surgical approach remains stable.
- The appearance of the cerebellar parenchyma, resembling a meningoencephalocele near the occipital bone, is unchanged.
- There is no other pathological contrast enhancement in the brain tissue, meninges, or optic nerves.

**Conclusion:**  
Lesions remain stable.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Suspicion de maladie du motoneurone du spectre de la SLA évoluant depuis 2 ans. Faible évolutivité et présence d'un syndrome akinéto-hypertonique des membres inférieurs peu sensible à la L-DOPA.
PROTOCOLESéquence 3D T1 écho de gradient, SWI, T2 deux échos, Neuromélanine, Diffusion, 3D flair.
RESULTAT
Hyposignal SWI marqué du cortex moteur primaire, bilatéral et symétrique, étendu au lobule paracentral, réalisant un aspect de « motor band sign ».Pas d'anomalie de signal du faisceau corticospinal aux étages supra et infratentorielle.Pas d'anomalie de signal des noyaux gris centraux, en particulier absence de séquelle vasculaire.Visualisation préservée du nigrosome en séquence SWI et signal normal de la substance noire en séquence neuromélanine.Rares hypersignaux FLAIR punctiformes de la substance blanche périventriculaire et des centres semi-ovales, non spécifiques.

CONCLUSION
« Motor band sign » en faveur d'une maladie du motoneurone.Absence de lésion du noyau gris centraux, en particulier vasculaire.
translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Reason for Examination:**
There is a suspicion of motor neuron disease within the ALS spectrum, which has been progressing for 2 years. The progression is slow, and there is a presence of an akinetic-rigid syndrome in the lower limbs that is not very responsive to L-DOPA.

**Protocol:**
The examination included 3D T1 gradient echo, SWI, dual-echo T2, neuromelanin, diffusion, and 3D FLAIR sequences.

**Findings:**
There is a marked low signal on SWI in the primary motor cortex, which is bilateral and symmetrical, extending to the paracentral lobule, creating a "motor band sign" appearance. There are no signal abnormalities in the corticospinal tract at both the supratentorial and infratentorial levels. No signal abnormalities are observed in the basal ganglia, particularly no vascular damage. The nigrosome is clearly visible on SWI sequences, and the substantia nigra shows a normal signal on neuromelanin sequences. There are a few small, non-specific FLAIR hyperintensities in the periventricular white matter and semi-oval centers.

**Conclusion:**
The "motor band sign" supports the presence of motor neuron disease. There is no damage to the basal ganglia, particularly no vascular lesions.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Patiente de 34 ans présentant des lésions de la substance blanche d'allure inflammatoire.
PROTOCOLESéquences axiales diffusion, EPI SWI, 3D FLAIR.Après injection de gadolinium, séquences 3D FLAIR et 3D T1 SE.Injection de CLARISCAN 15
RESULTAT
Comparaison à l'IRM du 21/10/2022.
Stabilité de la charge lésionnelle en hypersignal FLAIR de la substance blanche supratentorielle essentiellement périventriculaire. Au moins une lésion juxta-corticale au niveau temporal moyen droit.La lésion radiaire du centre semi-ovale gauche est veino-centrée.Stabilité de l'hypersignal T2 du nerf optique droit dans sa portion intraorbitaire.Pas d'anneau paramagnétique décelé.Pas de nouvelle lésion en hypersignal FLAIR visible.Pas de prise de contraste de ces lésions.
Stabilité de la trophicité cérébrale. Stabilité de la prise de contraste pachyméningée de la tente du cervelet prédominant à gauche.Pas de lésion ischémique ou hémorragique récente.Stabilité en taille du système ventriculaire.Pas de signe d'engagement cérébral.
CONCLUSION Stabilité de la charge lésionnelle supratentorielle essentiellement périventriculaire, au moins une lésion juxtacorticale. On retrouve une lésion veino-centrée. Pas de nouvelle lésion apparue ou rehaussée.
translation:
BRAIN MRI

INDICATION
A 34-year-old female patient with inflammatory-appearing white matter lesions.

PROTOCOL
Axial diffusion sequences, EPI SWI, 3D FLAIR. After gadolinium injection, 3D FLAIR and 3D T1 SE sequences. Injection of CLARISCAN 15.

RESULTS
Comparison with the MRI from 10/21/2022.

The lesion load in the supratentorial white matter, primarily periventricular, remains stable with FLAIR hyperintensity. There is at least one juxtacortical lesion in the right middle temporal region. The radial lesion in the left centrum semiovale is vein-centered. The T2 hyperintensity of the right optic nerve in its intraorbital portion is stable. No paramagnetic ring detected. No new FLAIR hyperintense lesions visible. These lesions do not show contrast enhancement.

Cerebral volume remains stable. The pachymeningeal contrast enhancement of the cerebellar tentorium, predominantly on the left, is stable. No recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions. The size of the ventricular system is stable. No signs of brain herniation.

CONCLUSION
The lesion load in the supratentorial region, primarily periventricular, is stable, with at least one juxtacortical lesion. A vein-centered lesion is noted. No new or enhanced lesions have appeared.

report:

RESULTAT
Comparaison à l'IRM du 10/01/2023.

Apparition d’une lacune caudée droite.Stabilité des lacunes lenticulo-caudées et thalamiques bilatéral, lenticulaire droite, centre semi ovale gauche, mésencéphalique droite,Apparition d’un microsaignement lenticulaire gauche.Stabilité des microsaignements chroniques des noyaux gris centraux par ailleurs.
Stabilité en taille du système ventriculaire. Ligne médiane en place.

translation:
BRAIN MRI

INDICATION
A 44-year-old patient being monitored for small vessel disease, likely of genetic origin. The scan is to check for any new ischemic lesions.

PROTOCOL
Axial diffusion sequences, SWI, 3D FLAIR, and 3D T1 EG.

RESULTS
Comparison with the MRI from January 10, 2023.

No recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions were found. A new small cavity has appeared in the right caudate area. The small cavities in the lenticulo-caudate and thalamic regions on both sides, the right lenticular area, the left semi-oval center, and the right midbrain remain stable. A new small bleed has appeared in the left lenticular area. The chronic microbleeds in the central gray nuclei remain stable.

The size of the ventricular system is stable, and the midline is in place.

CONCLUSION
A new small cavity has appeared in the right caudate area, and a new chronic microbleed has appeared in the left lenticular area.

report:
IRM HYPOPHYSAIRE
INDICATION
Patiente de 64 ans suivi pour un incidentalome hypophysaire. Contrôle de l'évolutivité.
PROTOCOLESéquences 3D T1 EG, coronales T2.Après injection de gadolinium, séquences coronales T1 dynamiques T1 SE et 3D T1 SE.Injection de CLARISCAN
RESULTAT
Comparaison à l’IRM du 21/11/2016 et du 13/05/2013.
Depuis 2021, discrète majoration en taille du syndrome de masse intrasellaire mesuré à 15 x 19 mm dans le plan axial étendu sur 16 mm de hauteur, contre 12 x 17 mm dans le plan axial sur 11 mm de hauteur en 2019.Aspect inchangé de l’hypersignal T2 central et du rehaussement hétérogène de cette lésion.
Aspect inchangé de la proximité avec le sinus caverneux gauche sans envahissement de celui-ciAspect inchangé du contact avec le chiasma optique qui est refoulé vers le haut.Pas d'anomalie de signal au niveau du chiasma optique.Post-hypophyse en hypersignal T1 spontané en place.Hypophyse saine refoulée vers le haut et la droite.Apparition d'un petit comblement déclive de la partie droite du sinus sphénoïdal.
CONCLUSION 
Discrète majoration en taille de la lésion intra-sellaire depuis 2016, mesurant 15 x 19 x 16 mm ce jour.
translation:
MRI OF THE PITUITARY GLAND

REASON FOR EXAM
A 64-year-old female patient is being monitored for an incidental pituitary tumor. This MRI is to check for any changes.

PROTOCOL
3D T1-weighted gradient echo sequences, coronal T2-weighted sequences. After gadolinium injection, dynamic coronal T1-weighted spin echo and 3D T1-weighted spin echo sequences were performed. CLARISCAN was injected.

RESULTS
Comparison with MRIs from November 21, 2016, and May 13, 2013.

Since 2021, there has been a slight increase in the size of the intrasellar mass, now measuring 15 x 19 mm in the axial plane and extending 16 mm in height, compared to 12 x 17 mm in the axial plane and 11 mm in height in 2019. The central T2 hyperintensity and the heterogeneous enhancement of this lesion remain unchanged.

The proximity to the left cavernous sinus is unchanged, with no invasion. The contact with the optic chiasm remains unchanged, with the chiasm being pushed upwards. There is no signal abnormality at the optic chiasm. The posterior pituitary gland shows a spontaneous T1 hyperintensity and is in place. The healthy pituitary gland is displaced upwards and to the right. A small filling has appeared in the lower part of the right sphenoid sinus.

CONCLUSION
There is a slight increase in the size of the intrasellar lesion since 2016, now measuring 15 x 19 x 16 mm.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Patiente de 81 ans présentant un tremblement d'allure essentielle et une ataxie avec troubles de l'équilibre d'évolution rapide. Recherche de lésions des noyaux gris centraux ou cérébelleuses.
PROTOCOLESéquences axiales diffusion, SWI, 3D T1 EG, 3D FLAIR.Après injection de gadolinium, séquences T2 deux échos et 3D T1 SE.Injection de CLARISCAN 20 
RESULTATComparaison à l'IRM du 28/09/2024.
Pas de lésion ischémique ou hémorragique récente.Discrète majoration des hypersignaux FLAIR confluents de la substance blanche profonde et périventriculaire en rapport avec des lésions de leucopathie vasculaire classée FAZEKAS 2 + 2.Elargissement diffus des espaces péri-vasculaires sous-corticaux.Stabilité de l'élargissement modéré du système ventriculaire et des espaces liquidiens péricérébraux en rapport avec l'atrophie cortico-sous-corticale diffuse, modérée pour l'âge.Pas d'atrophie hippocampique.Pas de syndrome de masse intracrânien.
Pas de prise de contraste pathologique du parenchyme cérébral, des méninges et des paires crâniennes.Ligne médiane en place.Pas de signe d'engagement cérébral.Aspect inchangé du comblement liquidien des cellules mastoïdiennes bilatérales.
CONCLUSION 
Pas de lésion évolutive retrouvée au niveau des noyaux gris centraux ou du cervelet.Leucopathie vasculaire et atrophie corticale diffuse modérées
translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Indication:**
The patient is an 81-year-old woman experiencing tremors that appear to be essential, along with ataxia and rapidly progressing balance issues. The aim is to investigate potential lesions in the basal ganglia or cerebellum.

**Protocol:**
Axial diffusion sequences, SWI, 3D T1-weighted gradient echo, and 3D FLAIR sequences were used. Post-gadolinium injection, T2-weighted dual-echo and 3D T1-weighted spin echo sequences were performed. CLARISCAN 20 was administered.

**Results:**
Comparison with the MRI from 09/28/2024.

- No recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions were observed.
- There is a slight increase in the confluent FLAIR hyperintensities in the deep and periventricular white matter, consistent with vascular leukoencephalopathy, classified as FAZEKAS 2 + 2.
- There is a diffuse enlargement of the perivascular spaces in the subcortical areas.
- The moderate enlargement of the ventricular system and pericerebral fluid spaces remains stable, which is associated with diffuse cortico-subcortical atrophy, considered moderate for the patient's age.
- No hippocampal atrophy is present.
- There is no intracranial mass effect.
- No abnormal contrast enhancement of the brain tissue, meninges, or cranial nerves is noted.
- The midline structures are intact.
- There are no signs of brain herniation.
- The fluid filling of the mastoid air cells on both sides remains unchanged.

**Conclusion:**
No progressive lesions were found in the basal ganglia or cerebellum. The patient has moderate vascular leukoencephalopathy and diffuse cortical atrophy.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Patient de 79 ans suivi pour des troubles cognitifs d'origine vasculaire probable. Aggravation des performances cognitives depuis mars 2023.
PROTOCOLE
Séquences axiales diffusion, SWI, 3D T1 EG, 3D FLAIR.
RESULTATComparaison à l’IRM du 01/10/2023 et du 04/01/2021.
Pas de lésion ischémique ou hémorragique récente.Pas de syndrome de masse intracrânien.Stabilité des hypersignaux FLAIR confluents de la substance blanche profonde périventriculaire, des centres semi-ovales et centropontique, en rapport avec des lésions de leucopathie vasculaire classée FAZEKAS 2 + 2.Aspect inchangé largement espaces de Virchow-Robin.Stabilité des microsaignements chroniques disséminés en infra- et supra-tentorielle, centrale et périphérique.L’ensemble restant compatible avec une maladie des petites artères.Stabilité de l’élargissement du système ventriculaire et des espaces liquidiens péri-cérébraux, en rapport avec une atrophie cortico-sous-corticale modérée sans prédominance lobaire évidente.Discrète atrophie hippocampique bilatérale à prédominance gauche (Scheltens 2 à droite et 1 à gauche).Ligne médiane en place. Pas de signe d'engagement cérébral.Stabilité du comblement des cellules mastoïdiennes droites.
CONCLUSION 
Stabilité de la leucopathie vasculaire FAZEKAS 2 + 2 et des microsaignements chroniques diffus, restant compatible avec une atteinte des petites artères. Stabilité de l'atrophie cortico-sous-corticale modérée et de l'atrophie hippocampique SCHELTENS 2 à droite et 1 à gauche.
translation:
BRAIN MRI

INDICATION
The patient is a 79-year-old being monitored for cognitive impairments likely due to vascular causes. There has been a worsening of cognitive performance since March 2023.

PROTOCOL
Axial diffusion sequences, SWI, 3D T1 EG, 3D FLAIR.

RESULTS
Comparison with MRIs from 01/10/2023 and 04/01/2021.

No recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions. No intracranial mass effect. The FLAIR hyperintensities in the deep periventricular white matter, semi-oval centers, and centropontine areas remain stable, consistent with vascular leukoencephalopathy classified as FAZEKAS 2 + 2. The appearance of the Virchow-Robin spaces is largely unchanged. The chronic microbleeds scattered in both infra- and supra-tentorial regions, both central and peripheral, remain stable. Overall, these findings are compatible with small vessel disease. The enlargement of the ventricular system and the pericerebral fluid spaces is stable, associated with moderate cortico-subcortical atrophy without any obvious lobar predominance. There is mild bilateral hippocampal atrophy, more pronounced on the left (Scheltens score 2 on the right and 1 on the left). The midline structures are in place. No signs of brain herniation. The filling of the right mastoid cells remains stable.

CONCLUSION
The vascular leukoencephalopathy classified as FAZEKAS 2 + 2 and the diffuse chronic microbleeds remain stable, consistent with small vessel disease. The moderate cortico-subcortical atrophy and the hippocampal atrophy (SCHELTENS score 2 on the right and 1 on the left) are also stable.

translation:

translation:
MRI of the Pituitary Gland

**Reason for Examination:**
This MRI is a follow-up for a patient who was suspected of having anterior pituitary necrosis following a hemorrhagic event around the time of childbirth in July 2004. At that time, there was no evidence of corticotropic or thyrotropic deficiency after delivery (low FSH and LH levels and high prolactin levels in the postpartum context). We do not have any recent pituitary evaluations on file.

**Procedure:**
The MRI was performed using 3D T1 spin echo and coronal T2 spin echo sequences. After the injection of gadolinium, dynamic coronal T1, 3D T1 spin echo, and coronal T2* sequences were used.

**Results:**
The current examination was compared to MRIs from September 20, 2004. The size of the pituitary gland remains stable, though it appears slightly smaller than normal. There is delayed enhancement of the anterior pituitary, which is unchanged. The clear T2 hyposignal in the anterior pituitary, indicative of past damage, remains stable. There is no enlargement of the sella turcica. The pituitary stalk is neither thickened nor deviated. The posterior pituitary shows a normal spontaneous T1 hypersignal. The optic chiasm and the proximal portion of the optic nerve are intact. The cavernous sinuses are also intact.

**Conclusion:**
There is stability in the appearance of the pituitary gland following necrosis, with signs of reduced size, a clear T2 hyposignal, and decreased enhancement of the anterior pituitary.

translation:
MRI of the Pituitary Gland

**Reason for Examination:** Follow-up on a gonadotrope adenoma that was surgically removed in May 2020.

**Procedure:** The examination included a 3D T1 spin echo sequence of the hippocampus, a coronal T2 sequence, and a dynamic coronal T1 sequence after gadolinium injection, followed by a 3D T1 spin echo sequence. The MRI was performed using a 3T machine with Dotarem contrast injection.

**Results:** Compared to the MRI performed on June 12, 2020, there are post-surgical changes related to the transsphenoidal approach. No residual tumor is detected in the sella turcica. The optochiasmatic cisterns are clear. The cavernous sinuses are intact. The healthy pituitary gland is positioned against the anterior left part of the sella. The pineal cyst remains perfectly stable, with a thin peripheral contrast enhancement, measuring 11 x 12 mm.

translation:
BRAIN MRI

REASON FOR EXAMINATION
Investigation for signs of atypical parkinsonian syndrome as part of a pre-Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) evaluation.

PROTOCOL
3D T1 gradient echo, SWI, diffusion, 3D FLAIR, and 3D T1 gradient echo post-gadolinium sequences. Neuromelanin-weighted sequences.

RESULTS
No previous exams for comparison.

There is enlargement of the ventricular system and the pericerebral fluid spaces, associated with diffuse cortical and subcortical atrophy. There is relatively symmetrical hippocampal atrophy, rated as Scheltens grade 2. The midline structures are in their normal position. The brainstem and basal ganglia are intact. There are hyperintensities in the deep and periventricular white matter, likely due to vascular leukoencephalopathy (Fazekas grade 2+2).

The nigrosome 1 is not visible on SWI. There is a moderate decrease in the moderate hypersignal of the substantia nigra on the "neuromelanin" sequence.

No significant vascular abnormalities are noted, and the venous sinuses are patent. There is no pathological contrast enhancement.

CONCLUSION
No evidence to suggest Multiple System Atrophy (MSA) or Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP).

translation:
MRI of the Pituitary Gland

**Reason for Examination:**
Monitoring of a cyst-like lesion within the sella turcica, known since 2005, which gradually increased in size until 2014. The lesion remained stable on the last MRI in April 2016.

**Protocol:**
Coronal T2 sequences, 3D T1 sequences before and after contrast injection, and dynamic coronal T1 sequences.

**Results:**
Compared to the examination on April 20, 2016, the appearance of the collapsed cyst-like lesion in the right posterior-lateral part of the sella turcica remains stable. It shows an isosignal on T1, a hypersignal on T2, and does not enhance after contrast injection, supporting its cystic nature. The lesion currently measures 8 mm in anteroposterior diameter, 7 mm in height, and 5 mm in transverse diameter. There is no tissue contrast enhancement within the lesion. The healthy pituitary gland is displaced downward and to the right. The thickening of the pituitary stalk remains stable at 4 mm and is deviated to the right. The posterior pituitary is displaced forward and upward. The optic chiasm and the opto-chiasmatic cistern are intact. The cavernous sinuses are intact.

**Conclusion:**
The collapsed cyst-like lesion in the left posterior-lateral part of the sella turcica remains stable.

translation:

**Conclusion:**

translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Indication:**
The patient is an 81-year-old woman experiencing atypical cognitive issues. The goal is to rule out intracranial hypotension, which could mimic frontotemporal lobar degeneration.

**Protocol:**
The procedure included axial diffusion sequences, SWI, 3D FLAIR, and 3D T1 gradient echo. After administering gadolinium, a 3D T1 gradient echo venous MRA was performed. Anxiolytic premedication was given in preparation for the exam.

**Results:**
This exam was compared to the MRI from January 2021.

- No recent hemorrhagic or ischemic lesions were found.
- There is a single chronic microbleed in the right occipital region.
- FLAIR hyperintensities in the deep and periventricular white matter suggest leukoaraiosis, likely of vascular origin (Fazekas score 1+1).
- The bilateral frontal hygromas remain stable, with an estimated thickness of about 6 mm on the right and 8 mm on the left.
- There is a mass effect on the adjacent brain tissue, making it difficult to identify any atrophy patterns.
- No significant hippocampal atrophy is observed (Sheltens scale score of 1 on both sides).
- The basal cisterns are clear, with no signs of herniation.
- The mamillo-pontine distance remains unchanged.
- The pituitary gland appears normal in shape.
- There is no abnormal contrast enhancement, particularly in the meninges.
- The dural venous sinuses and deep cerebral veins are normally patent.
- No venous engorgement is present.

**Conclusion:**
There is no evidence to support intracranial hypotension. The bilateral frontal hygromas remain generally stable.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Patiente de 72 ans suivi pour un syndrome parkinsonien évoluant depuis deux ans compatible avec une maladie de Parkinson débutante.Éliminer des arguments en faveur d'un syndrome parkinsonien de type AMS ou d'une atrophie mésencéphalique.
PROTOCOLE
Séquences 3D T1 écho de gradient, axiales diffusion, SWI, 3D flair et séquence pondérée neuromélanine
RESULTAT
Pas d'examen comparatif
Pas d'anomalie de signal ou de morphologie des noyaux gris centraux, du mésencéphale, de la protubérance ou du cervelet.
Perte de la visualisation du nigrosome 1 bilatérale en SWI.Diminution modérée de l'hypersignal spontané de la substance FLAIR sur la séquence pondérée en neuromélanine.
Pas de lésion ischémique ou hémorragique récente.
Hypersignaux FLAIR de la substance blanche profonde et périventriculaire en lien avec une leucopathie probablement d'origine vasculaire (Fazekas 2 + 2).
Élargissement du système ventriculaire et des espaces liquidiens péricérébraux en lien avec une atrophie cortico-sous-corticale diffuse. À noter un aspect élargi des sillons centraux.
Aspect de selle turcique vide.
CONCLUSION Pas d'argument en faveur d'un syndrome parkinsonien de type AMS ou PSP.Leucopathie vasculaire Fazekas 2.
translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Indication:**
The patient is a 72-year-old woman being monitored for a parkinsonian syndrome that has been progressing for two years, consistent with early-stage Parkinson's disease. The goal is to rule out any signs indicative of a Multiple System Atrophy (MSA) type parkinsonian syndrome or mesencephalic atrophy.

**Protocol:**
The MRI was conducted using 3D T1 gradient echo sequences, axial diffusion, SWI, 3D FLAIR, and neuromelanin-weighted sequences.

**Results:**
- There is no previous exam for comparison.
- No signal or morphological abnormalities were found in the basal ganglia, midbrain, pons, or cerebellum.
- There is a bilateral loss of visualization of nigrosome 1 on SWI. There is a moderate decrease in the spontaneous hypersignal of the FLAIR substance on the neuromelanin-weighted sequence.
- No recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions were detected.
- FLAIR hypersignals in the deep and periventricular white matter are associated with leukoaraiosis, likely of vascular origin (Fazekas score 2 + 2).
- There is an enlargement of the ventricular system and pericerebral fluid spaces, indicating diffuse cortical and subcortical atrophy. Notably, the central sulci appear widened.
- The appearance of an empty sella turcica is observed.

**Conclusion:**
There is no evidence supporting a parkinsonian syndrome of the MSA or PSP type. The findings are consistent with vascular leukoaraiosis, Fazekas grade 2.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Bilan neurodégénératif étude de la charge cérébro-vasculaire chez un patient aux antécédents notamment d'AVP en 2010 avec traumatisme crânien grave et coma prolongé.Notion de troubles cognitifs d'allure attentionnelle avec modifications psycho-comportemental.
PROTOCOLE
Séquences 3D T1 écho de gradient, axiales diffusion, SWI et 3D FLAIR
RESULTAT
Examen comparé aux anciens IRM notamment à celui d'août 2012
Pas de lésion ischémique hémorragique récente.Microbleeds chroniques prédominant à l'étage sus-tentoriel notamment en région temporopolaire bilatérale, probablement en rapport avec les antécédents de coma prolongé sur traumatisme crânien.Hypersignaux flair de la substance blanche profonde et périventriculaire en lien avec une leucopathie probablement d'origine vasculaire (Fazekas 2 + 1).Séquelles post-traumatiques bi temporopolaires.Élargissement du système ventriculaires et des espaces liquidiens péricérébraux prédominant en région antérieure en lien avec une atrophie cortico-sous-corticale à prédominance lobaire frontale, déjà présente en 2012.Hypotrophie hippocampique bilatérale modérée et symétrique (échelle de Sheltens à 2).Majoration de l’atrophie mésencéphalque.Amincissement focal du corps du corps calleux probablement en lien avec le traumatisme crânien.
CONCLUSION Pas de lésion ischémique ou hémorragique récente.Globale stabilité de l'atrophie cortico-sous-corticale à prédominance frontale.Leucopathie vasculaire modérée.Majoration de l’atrophie sous-corticale mésencéphalique.
translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Reason for Examination:**
This MRI was conducted to assess neurodegenerative changes and cerebral vascular load in a patient with a history of a serious road traffic accident in 2010, which resulted in a severe head injury and prolonged coma. The patient has been experiencing cognitive issues, particularly with attention, along with changes in psychological and behavioral patterns.

**Procedure:**
The MRI included 3D T1 gradient echo sequences, axial diffusion, SWI, and 3D FLAIR sequences.

**Findings:**
The current MRI was compared to previous scans, particularly the one from August 2012. There are no new ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions. Chronic microbleeds are mainly found above the tentorium, especially in the bilateral temporal pole regions, likely related to the past prolonged coma due to the head injury. There are FLAIR hyperintensities in the deep and periventricular white matter, suggesting a vascular origin of leukoencephalopathy (Fazekas score 2 + 1). There are post-traumatic changes in both temporal poles. The ventricular system and pericerebral fluid spaces are enlarged, particularly in the anterior region, indicating cortical and subcortical atrophy, predominantly in the frontal lobes, which was already present in 2012. There is moderate and symmetrical hippocampal atrophy (Sheltens scale 2). There is an increase in midbrain atrophy. There is focal thinning of the corpus callosum, likely related to the head injury.

**Conclusion:**
There are no new ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions. The cortical and subcortical atrophy, predominantly in the frontal lobes, remains generally stable. There is moderate vascular leukoencephalopathy. There is an increase in midbrain subcortical atrophy.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Patiente de 78 ans présentant depuis plus d'un an troubles de la marche avec apparition d'un déficit hémicorporel droit et syndrome extrapyramidal hémicorporel droit. Recherche d'argument en faveur d'un processus dégénératif.
PROTOCOLE
Étage encéphalique : séquences 3D T1 écho de gradient, 3D FLAIR, diffusion, SWI.
RESULTAT
Etage cérébral:Atrophie focale marquée péricentrale gauche, associée à des dépôts ferriques au sein du cortex moteur primaire et du lobule paracentral, en faveur d'un processus dégénératif.Il s'y associe un hypersignal FLAIR sous cortical au sein du lobule paracentral.Atrophie pariétale supérieure et du précuneus, bilatérale et symétrique.Atrophie mésencéphalique modérée.Atrophie cérébelleuse supérieure.Par ailleurs, élargissement des espaces sous-arachnoïdiens de la convexité, compatible avec des hygromes sous-duraux bilatéraux.
Surcharge minérale de la substance noire bilatérale et symétrique associée à une perte de visibilité des nigrosomes. Diminution de l'hypersignal de la substance noire sur les séquences pondérées en neuromélanine.
Microhémorragie corticale unique occipitale gauche.
Dilatation focale des espaces de Virchow-Robin plus marquée en pariétal droit.
Quelques hypersignaux flair punctiformes et nodulaires des centres semi-ovales, en faveur d'une leucopathie probablement vasculaire FAZEKAS 1, stable.
CONCLUSION
Atrophie focale marquée des régions péricentrale et paracentrale gauche, avec dépôts ferriques corticaux et hypersignal FLAIR sous cortical.Aspect compatible en première hypothèse avec une dégénérescence corticobasale. Une atteinte associée du motoneurone pourrait être discutée.
translation:
**Brain MRI Report**

**Indication:**
A 78-year-old female patient has been experiencing walking difficulties for over a year, along with the development of weakness on the right side of her body and right-sided extrapyramidal syndrome. The examination aims to investigate the possibility of a degenerative process.

**Protocol:**
Brain level: 3D T1 gradient echo sequences, 3D FLAIR, diffusion, SWI.

**Results:**
- **Brain Level:** There is significant focal atrophy on the left side around the central region, accompanied by iron deposits in the primary motor cortex and the paracentral lobule, suggesting a degenerative process. There is also a FLAIR hyperintensity in the subcortical area of the paracentral lobule. There is bilateral and symmetrical atrophy of the superior parietal region and the precuneus. Moderate atrophy of the midbrain and superior cerebellar atrophy are noted. Additionally, there is an enlargement of the subarachnoid spaces on the brain's surface, consistent with bilateral subdural hygromas.
- There is a symmetrical and bilateral mineral overload in the substantia nigra, associated with a loss of visibility of the nigrosomes. There is a decrease in the hyperintensity of the substantia nigra on neuromelanin-weighted sequences.
- A single cortical microbleed is present in the left occipital region.
- There is focal dilation of the Virchow-Robin spaces, more pronounced on the right parietal side.
- A few small, punctate, and nodular FLAIR hyperintensities are present in the semi-oval centers, suggesting a likely vascular leukoencephalopathy, classified as FAZEKAS 1, which is stable.

**Conclusion:**
There is marked focal atrophy in the left pericentral and paracentral regions, with cortical iron deposits and subcortical FLAIR hyperintensity. This appearance is primarily compatible with corticobasal degeneration. An associated motor neuron involvement could also be considered.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE
INDICATION
Recherche d'accident vasculaire cérébral chez un patient présentant des troubles phasiques et un syndrome confusionnel confusionnel et ayant des antécédents d'angiopathie amyloïde.
PROTOCOLE
Séquences 3D T1EG, diffusion, 3D FLAIR, SWI, 3D TOF.
RESULTAT
Comparaison à l'examen du 17 mai 2019,
Interprétation limitée en raison d'artéfacts de mouvements.
Absence de lésion ischémique ou hémorragique récente.
Stabilité des multiples microhémorragies chroniques de distribution lobaire à prédominance postérieure.
Nette majoration de l'atrophie cortico-sous-corticale avec prédominance temporale et temporale interne. Atrophie hippocampique Scheltens 4.
Globale stabilité de l'étendue des hypersignaux confluents de la substance blanche périventriculaire des centres semi-ovales, FAZEKAS 3.
Perméabilité normale des artères du polygone de Willis.

CONCLUSION
Absence de lésion ischémique ou hémorragique récente.Franche majoration de l'atrophie cortico-sous-corticale à prédominance temporale.
translation:
BRAIN MRI

REASON FOR EXAMINATION
The patient is being evaluated for a possible stroke due to speech difficulties and confusion, with a history of amyloid angiopathy.

PROCEDURE
The MRI included 3D T1-weighted gradient echo, diffusion, 3D FLAIR, SWI, and 3D TOF sequences.

RESULTS
Compared to the previous exam on May 17, 2019, the interpretation is limited due to movement artifacts. There are no signs of recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions. The multiple chronic microbleeds in the lobar regions, predominantly in the posterior areas, remain stable. There is a significant increase in cortical and subcortical atrophy, especially in the temporal and inner temporal regions. The hippocampal atrophy is rated as Scheltens grade 4. The extent of the confluent high-signal areas in the periventricular white matter of the semi-oval centers is generally stable, rated as Fazekas grade 3. The arteries in the circle of Willis are normally open.

CONCLUSION
There are no recent ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions. There is a marked increase in cortical and subcortical atrophy, predominantly in the temporal regions.

report:
IRM HYPOPHYSAIRE

Protocole :Séquences 3D T1 spin écho, coronales T2 spin écho, coronales T1 dynamique après injection, 3D T1 spin écho sur l'encéphale après injection.
